Inventor_Name: Sandeep Tripathi | Om Prakash | Suryasarathi Bose
Abstract: The present disclosure relates to epoxy vitrimers and their applications in transparent, hydrophobic coatings. An epoxy vitrimer comprising an epoxy unit formed by the reaction of an epoxy resin with an initiator, and a dynamic crosslinker configured to form a covalent adaptive network with the epoxy unit is provided. The dynamic crosslinking occurs via silyl ether exchange, alone or in combination with additional exchange mechanisms such as transesterification, disulfide exchange, imine formation, thiol-ene vinyl reactions, and transcarbamoylation. Compared to conventional epoxy systems, the epoxy vitrimer disclosed herein exhibits shorter curing times and dynamic crosslinking, offering enhanced processability and functionality.

Patent_Title: SYMMETRIC AUTOENCODER-BASED METHOD FOR DETECTION OF SUB-SURFACE ANOMALIES AND A SYSTEM THEREOF

Abstract: SYMMETRIC AUTOENCODER-BASED METHOD FOR DETECTION OF SUB-SURFACE ANOMALIES AND A SYSTEM THEREOF The present disclosure utilizes a novel cost-effective and time-efficient tool to detect sub-surface anomalies, utilizing measured noise from a passive seismic source. The seismic waves produced by the noise from the passive seismic source are captured by seismic sensors, which are, in turn, collected and processed by a data acquisition system to distinguish the signature of the anomaly amidst the noise generated by the passive seismic source using a symmetric autoencoder (SymAE). The SymAE is trained to learn the capability of disentangling subsurface information, which is coherent across multiple noise gathers, from the remaining source effects. The SymAE extracts backscattered surface waves attributed to the anomaly, utilizing nearly half the recorded noise compared to that required for cross-correlation stacking approaches. Fig. 1

Abstract: ABSTRACT DETERMINING REHOLOGICAL PARAMETERS OF A FLUID USING MAGNETIC PROBES Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method of determining rheological properties of a fluid. A finite quantity of the suspension is aspirated and placed in a sample cell that is sealed to prevent evaporation of the fluid from the sample cell. The sample cell containing the suspension is then placed within a coil, wherein the coil is configured to produce a magnetic field when switched to an ON state. In an example, the EEG data includes a plurality of waveforms of electric signals, with each waveform corresponds to an electrode channel of the EEG testing setup. Patent_Title: A SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE FOR AUDIO PLAYBACK AND SOUND GENERATION
Applicant_Address: C V Raman Road, Bangalore - 560012, Karnataka, India.
Inventor_Name: PRATAP, Rudra | GARUD, Meera
Abstract: The present disclosure provides a sound/acoustic signal producing device which can include a single piece, or two pieces of a semiconductor coupled or stacked together. A silicon plate (lightly doped/metal coated) is loosely kept and is supplied with opposing voltages across its two flat surfaces or it has a voltage gradient across its thickness, the free charges move across the thickness towards the surface of opposing polarity. This creates depletion region within the plate in thickness direction. Upon application of AC voltage, an alternating potential gradient is created across this region and an alternating electric field is generated. This produces an alternating electrostatic force between these free charges of opposing polarity. We find that with variation in the voltage, we get a variation in depletion width and therefore, a variation in the electrostatic force. For example, consider an N-type silicon. In the first half cycle, the top surface is positively charged while the bottom is grounded. This pulls the majority carriers (electrons) to its top surface and pushes the minority charge carriers (holes) to the bottom surface. This widens the depletion width to a maximum. In the next half cycle, the carries are pushed away from the surface reducing the depletion width. The electrostatic force is inversely proportional to the square of the gap (depletion width) separating the charges. Therefore, a time varying electrostatic force is generated based on the applied voltage signal. When such a semiconductor piece is fixed at a point(s)/edge(s), bending vibrations are induced in that piece. When the vibration frequency is in the range of audible frequencies then the vibrations result in sound generation. Same theory is applicable to a stack of two silicon pieces (both N-type/both P-type or a combination of P-type and N-type).

Abstract: An embodiment of the present disclosure provides a method for preventing a side channel attack by executing an enclave on a remote computing device. The method comprises configuring the enclave based on configuration parameters defined by a computing device. A page created in first enclave cache memory in the remote computing device and adding virtual page address information and page security attributes corresponding to the page in a second enclave cache memory, and an encrypted log entry is created in a protected memory of the remote computing device. The enclave is initiated by comparing the log entry and a second hash key generated by the remote computing device. A new page of pre-defined size is dynamically added to the first enclave cache memory after initiation of the enclave. The enclave is executed based on a successful validation of a size of the page created in first enclave cache memory to be equal to the pre-defined page size.

Abstract: Disclosed is a method (200) and system for joint estimation of multi-target state parameters in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) wireless systems. The pitching motor is clamped on one end to the container via the stationary clamp and to the pitching subassembly on the rotating end via the pitching clamp, facilitates rotation of the entire pitching subassembly. Abstract: Protective Personal Equipment (PPE) is worn to reduce dangers that pose major occupational hazards to medical staff. Gloves are an important element of the PPE gear because they establish a barrier between the patient and the carer, preventing infections from passing through. The complete glove will protect the surgeon from blood borne antibodies and the surgical incision from microorganisms on the skin during surgical operations. Incisions on the surface of the gloves are very likely while executing these procedures using sharp instruments. This frequently results in glove perforation. The suggested method is unique in that it employs the electrical activity of the skin as a key parameter to identify any puncture, rupture, or failure in the glove, such as the galvanic skin response and skin hindrance. In addition to performing surgical procedures, this gadget may be utilised for forensic investigations, laboratory testing, and other duties. Sewage cleaners can also utilise it. This innovation is to provide therapy to medical workers who are exposed to a variety of microorganisms while conducting procedures on patients. The physicians are alerted to the puncture after discovering it in a glove, allowing them to take the necessary steps.

Abstract: Realizing the idea of Virtual Reality in aiding individuals with monoplegia, the innovation proposes is a device that allows monoplegia patients to access their paralyzed forelimb and use their active motor neurons to achieve movement and therapy. The arm consists of a 3D-printed Arm Exoskeleton model that uses load cell as a sensor and controls the movement of the same via feedback control (PID controller) and servo motor. Games can be task-oriented, incorporating activities of daily living (ADLs). The innovation intends to provide a simple pong game for rehabilitation therapy.

Abstract: This innovation, introduces a novel reactor design that addresses the limitations of previous research on converting waste plastics into value-added products through thermal and catalytic pyrolysis processes. Previous approaches either operated in a single liquid phase, where catalyst and plastics were mixed together, or in a two-step vapor phase, involving separate heating systems for plastic vaporization and catalytic degradation. The proposed innovative reactor allows either liquid phase or vapor phase pyrolysis in a single unit, utilizing a single heating source. This unique reactor design segregates catalysts and plastic waste within the reactor, with waste materials positioned at the bottom. Heating is efficiently achieved through a band heater, simplifying the process with a single heating source. Notably, an easily accessible and cost-effective catalyst is employed, which proves highly efficient in producing liquid yields rich in diesel-grade hydrocarbons while minimizing gas production

Abstract: The sensitive electrochemical detection technique for heavy metal ions present in acidic electrolyte, while efficient potentially eliminating the hindrance of other chemicals has been lacking at the present time. We found that the interfacial barrier of LaZr2O7 hetero-nanoparticle had powerful physical effects on electrochemical sensor investigation. As based on the interfacial physical barrier, it could avoid the existing problem of the traditional electrochemical sensing mechanism and apply in more interfering environment. High sensitivity and specificity towards sensitive detection of mercury ion (Hg2+) in acidic electrolyte (0.1M HCl) was achieved by employing the modified electrode of graphite-LaZr2O7 hetero-nanoparticle. The interfacial barrier effect provides a chance to develop sensors used in more interfering environment. Abstract: It is obvious that the airport authorities will have to implement an airfield bird removal system. The aircraft and the lives of the occupants might be seriously damaged by a bird hit or ingestion. This invention provides practical ways to get rid of flying creatures without endangering the lives of the natural world. Nowadays, the majority of airfields use antiquated technology or human techniques to deter birds. The study suggests a completely automated, non-lethal method that recognizes and classifies bird species using image processing and triggers an appropriate output repellent device. Using (a) the first boundary color approach, which recognizes birds as colored spheres, image processing was used. (b) A Haar cascade detector, which is used to identify patterns in the frames that are sent from a stereo or very precise camera. By virtually eliminating undesired flying creatures from the area of interest, this inventive and automated technology improves airport safety regulations and prevents potentially dangerous bird attacks. Applicant_Address: Akshaya Redstone, Villa 14, Whitefield-Hosakote Road, Kannamangala | 39, Skanda Moksh, Panathur Varthur Road, Bengaluru 560087, Karnataka, India | 132, AECS Layout, Bangalore 560037

Abstract: Simulation and optimization problems generally require repeated computations taking up a huge amount of computing resources as well as time. Further, quite a lot of computation may be wasteful. We disclose a Differential Computing Machine that better addresses such problems. The Differential Computing Machine comprises of Input Space and Output Space, represented using one or more dials and a Controller that steers the simulation runs. Here the input data is represented as a signal/setting on the dial corresponding to the input domain. Output from the simulation is represented as a range that may be discrete or continuous on the dial corresponding to the co-domain of the function at hand. The changes in input or computations are represented as rotations on the dials and resulting outputs are marked as settings on the output dial forming an arc in certain cases. Additionally, weights that apply to inputs can also be represented as dials. To manage the simulation and optimization studies we additionally make use of Computation and Correlation Space as well as Control Space. This invention is targeted for problems such as discrete event simulation and optimization of financial investment portfolios

Abstract: Connectionless vending machine using encrypted QR code [0040] The invention relates to a connectionless vending machine system designed to efficiently process orders in environments with unreliable internet connectivity. The vending machine reads QR codes containing encrypted order details generated by a mobile application (301), decrypts the data, and processes it. In the semi-offline mode, the vending machine connects to the admin's hotspot to exchange important data. The two-layer dispenser box enhancement, comprising a belt (701) and clip (702) arrangement, dispenses products securely and automatically cycles unclaimed products.

Abstract: TITLE: COLORIZING BLACK AND WHITE VIDEOS USING DAMPING FACTOR AND PIXEL TOLERANCE APPLICANT: PES UNIVERSITY ABSTRACT The present invention discloses a system for Colorizing Black and White Videos with effective Damping Factor and Pixel Tolerance with reduced flickering effect. The input device is registered with the system with unique ID. Abstract: TITLE:ANTI-FUNGAL NIOSOMAL TOPICAL SPRAY OF VORICONAZOLE ABSTRACT Voriconazole was formulated as a topical film forming niosomal spray for the treatment of deep seated fungal infections.. In vitro drug diffusion was found to be 75.6 at the end of 9th hour. Niosomes were prepared by rotary evaporator and ether injection method with varied ratios of surfactant span-60 and tween-80 were used in niosomal formulation to check its effect on formed niosomes along with drug entrapment efficiency within the vesicles. Niosome formulation NRE 1 showed acceptable results with having an entrapment efficiency of 97.5% and 98.2 % of drug content. The average particle size of the formulation was found to be 568.3nm as determined by DLS which also showed better stability with a zeta potential value of -23.2mV. Spray formulation of voriconazole niosomes were formulated using central composite optimization design by incorporating Eudragit RLPO as a film forming agent.

Abstract: ABSTRACT PATTERNED POROUS ELASTOMER FILM FOR A SENSOR DEVICE The present disclosure relates to methods and system for obtaining a patterned porous elastomer film, which may be used for manufacturing sensor arrays or electronics substrates. The method employs a first porous elastomer film formed by curing a first elastomer precursor comprising a curable elastomer resin and a leavening agent. The first porous elastomer film is used as a lithography mask to expose a first photosensitive photoresist layer, which is then developed to form a patterned photoresist structure. From this structure, a phase mask is fabricated by applying, curing, and separating a second elastomer film. The phase mask is then used in a proximity nano patterning configuration to expose a second photosensitive photoresist layer, generating 3D porous features that are developed into a patterned photoresist template. A third elastomer precursor is applied on the patterned photoresist template, cured, and separated to yield a patterned porous elastomer film.

Patent_Title: SPINTRONIC LOGIC ARCHITECTURE IN SINGLE-LAYER FERROMAGNETIC OXIDE THIN FILMS
Applicant_Address: Sir C.V. Raman Road, Bangalore - 560012, India

Abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a spintronic logic device comprising a crystalline Strontium Titanate (SrTiO3) substrate and an epitaxial single layer ferromagnetic oxide thin film formed of strontium doped samarium manganite (Sm1-xSxMnO3). The thin film is patterned with four electrodes arranged in a four probe geometry, wherein a first and fourth electrode deliver a drive current and a second and third electrode sense a voltage across the film. The applied drive current induces reversible switching of the thin film between low resistance and high resistance states. A magnetic field input subsystem applies a controllable magnetic field to modulate the switching behaviour, and a voltage sensing circuit generates a binary output by comparing the sensed voltage to a predetermined threshold voltage (Vth). The resulting binary output implements Boolean logic functions based on the interaction of the drive current, the controllable magnetic field, and the threshold voltage.

Abstract: ASTRACT OF INVENTION SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ENCODING OF NON-BINARY QUASI-CYCLIC LOW-DENSITY PARITY-CHECK CODES A system (200) for non-binary quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check codes is disclosed. The system (200) includes a processor (202) in communication with a memory (208). The processor constructs a parity-check matrix (204) having a quasi-cyclic block-circulant structure with block-rows and block-columns and derives a systematic generator matrix comprising an identity portion and a parity submatrix portion. An encoder (210) receives the systematic generator matrix and stores the parity submatrix portion. An exclusive-OR array (216) generates parity symbols by accumulating the partial products. A controller is coupled to the memory, multiplier bank, barrel shifter, and XOR array, coordinating the encoding operation.

Abstract: This invention introduces a real-time obstacle avoidance and failsafe control system designed to enhance the safety, adaptability, and efficiency of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in dynamic environments. Unlike traditional systems that rely on static velocity thresholds or complete path re-planning, this algorithm employs a multi-layered approach incorporating dynamic velocity reduction, component cancellation, and emergency braking. By integrating pilot input, obstacle proximity, and current speed, the system enables real-time, adaptive responses, allowing smoother navigation and proactive collision prevention. A quantifiable deviation metric ensures controlled adjustments that balance pilot commands and automated responses. The system's design supports both autonomous and pilot-assisted UAV operations, making it a robust and reliable solution for operating in cluttered or uncertain environments. FIG.3A

Abstract: An end-to-end (E2E) system for feasible configuration selection for network slice deployments in telecommunications networks is disclosed. The system addresses computational complexity of evaluating configuration combinations across heterogeneous network domains. The system comprises per-domain controllers (RAN, TN, CN), each having a per-domain admissible configuration selection engine that receives user Key Performance Indicator (KPI) requests and evaluates domain-specific configurations in parallel, and a per-domain KPI zone computation engine that computes the acceptable operating zones for each KPI based on statistically defined metrics. A cross-domain orchestrator receives admissible configurations from per-domain controllers and constructs end-to-end combinatorial configurations. The cross-domain orchestrator includes a zone analysis engine that utilizes the acceptable KPI zones of each domain and applies penalties to combinatorial configurations falling outside acceptable zones, and a utility engine that evaluates combinatorial configurations using a weighted fractional utility function combining maximization KPIs, minimization KPIs, and penalty scores to identify an optimal configuration. The inclusion of penalty score makes the system tolerant to channel variations and approximation or modelling errors, thereby minimizing the re-configurations in response to small deviations in KPI values. The system is applicable to 6G network slice deployments. (Fig. 2)

Abstract: A sensor system for ice detection in aircrafts and a method thereof is disclosed. The disclosed system pertains to an advanced sensor system for ice detection in aircraft. The system includes a cantilever housed within a casing, which integrates an electromagnetic pulse generator and an accelerometer. The pulse generator periodically stimulates the cantilever, while the accelerometer measures its acceleration and oscillation frequency. The ice formation changes the boundary condition from a cantilever to a propped beam, impacting its oscillation frequency and altering the response frequency under stimulation. Patent_Title: TWO HOP COMMUNICATION MECHANISM BETWEEN ON BOARD UNITS IN VEHICULAR NETWORKS
Applicant_Address: The Principal, B.M.S. College of Engineering, Bull Temple Road, Bangalore, India - 560019
Inventor_Name: Dr. Nandhini Vineeth | Dr. H S Guruprasad
Abstract: The present invention discloses a two-hop communication mechanism (100) to enable faster communication between two On-Board Units (OBUs) in vehicles that are out of range but have Recoder OBUs within range. The Recoder OBUs (135, 155) receive videos from their corresponding communicating OBUs (115, 175) and perform XOR operations on these videos. The XORed video is then transmitted back to the corresponding communicating OBUs (115, 175), which retrieve the original video by performing appropriate XOR operations. To address packet losses during transmission, Recoder OBUs (135, 155) send a copy of the XORed video to helper OBUs (125, 165). If packet loss occurs, helper OBUs transmit only the lost packets to the corresponding communicating OBUs (115, 175). This invention ensures faster communication between OBUs while maintaining video quality by efficiently managing packet loss during data transmission.

Patent_Title: SINGLE HOP COMMUNICATION MECHANISM BETWEEN ON BOARD UNITS IN VEHICULAR NETWORKS

Abstract: The present invention discloses single hop communication mechanism (100) to facilitate faster communication between two On Board Units (115 and 145) which are not in the range of each other but have a common On Board Unit in the range of both. The common On Board Unit termed as Recoder On Board Unit (135) receives videos from both the communicating On Board Units and performs XOR operation of these videos. The XORed video is sent to both communicating On Board Units (115 and 145). The video sent by the other communicating On Board Unit can be retrieved by performing appropriate XOR operation. During transmission from Recoder On Board Unit (135) to communicating On Board Units (115 and 145), there may be possibility of packet losses which will impact the video communication. To overcome this challenge, Recoder On Board (135) Unit sends a copy of the XORed video to the helper On Board Units (160 and 170). Whenever there is a packet loss, the helper On Board Units will transmit only the lost packets to the communicating On Board Units. The present invention will facilitate faster communication and also maintains the quality of videos by managing packet loss.

A shared-aperture feed array radiates into a multilayer dielectric lens that collimates and enhances beam directivity, while the shaped reflector redirects the focused beam beyond 45o to over an angular range of 70° to 120°. The dielectric layers (D1-D3 or D1-D5) possess increasing permittivity from center to edge, forming a compact, high-efficiency GRIN structure. The invention provides a lightweight, low-cost, and scalable antenna architecture suitable for 4G, 5G, and 6G base stations, radar, and integrated sensing systems, offering superior wide-angle coverage and gain stability compared to conventional mechanically steered or single-lens designs.

Each bin contains an ultrasonic sensor and microcontroller that monitor fill levels and update a cloud-based dashboard for real-time visualization and alerts. The system functions through wireless cloud communication, ensuring full automation, high precision, and scalability. By combining AI perception, robotic manipulation, and IoT-based monitoring, the disclosure provides a safe, efficient, and sustainable solution for e-waste recycling and resource recovery.

An emotional monitoring module evaluates behavioral indicators and conversational inputs to infer distress or loneliness, with anomalies generating automated caregiver alerts. A processing unit performs local artificial intelligence inference to ensure rapid decision-making without reliance on constant cloud connectivity. A caregiver dashboard provides remote access to vital signs, prescription compliance status, geofencing boundaries, and historical records. An embedded processor with an auxiliary controller executes on-device object detection to classify floating debris, while A* target selection and region-based steering drive electric propulsion toward detected waste and away from obstacles sensed ultrasonically. A front mesh-belt conveyor collects debris into an onboard receptacle. A multi-parameter sensing suite measures pH, turbidity, total dissolved solids, water temperature, ambient temperature/humidity, and nearby gases; all readings are time-stamped and geotagged via satellite positioning to generate hotspot logs for remediation. Power is supplied by a photovoltaic-recharged battery. A locally hosted dashboard streams live video and telemetry, renders tracks and hotspot overlays, and provides manual override. The architecture is modular, scalable, and suitable for sustained, data-driven operations in Indian urban and semi-urban waterways.

Patent_Title: Reputation-Weighted, Quality-Tier Tokenization and Fair Retirement of Carbon Credits on a Blockchain
Applicant_Address: Mysore Road, R.V. Vidyaniketan Post, Bengaluru- 560059, Karnataka, India.
Inventor_Name: Vinod A R | Jyoti Shetty | Eshaan Mathur | Manoj Kumar | Jigyasa Agrawal
Abstract: Title: Reputation-Weighted, Quality-Tier Tokenization and Fair Retirement of Carbon Credits on a Blockchain The disclosure provides a block chain-based carbon credit management system incorporating quality-tier tokenization, dynamic reputation scoring, and a dual-pool retirement mechanism to enhance transparency and fairness in voluntary carbon markets. Verified carbon credits undergo automated quality assessment using environmental datasets, including real-time site data and computational models such as machine learning models to determine carbon sequestration levels and are assigned to defined quality tiers with corresponding token multipliers. Credits are divided into a contributor-controlled priority pool and a general pool. Contributor reputation is calculated from both quality-weighted credit contributions and staked tokens, with staking influence capped. Retirement of credits occurs in two phases: direct selection from the priority pool and reputation-weighted allocation from the general pool. All processes are executed via block chain smart contracts, ensuring immutable record-keeping, verifiable audit trails, and protection against quality dilution. The system incentivizes the generation of high-quality credits, mitigates greenwashing risks, and promotes equitable allocation based on historical performance and contributor reputation.

Abstract: Title: Portable Osteoporosis Estimation Device using Stress Wave Frequency Analysis This invention is a portable, non-invasive, and radiation-free device for estimating osteoporosis based on stress wave frequency analysis of the tibial bone. The device employs a vibration motor to generate mechanical stress waves and two piezoelectric sensors placed 25 mm apart to capture signal variations along the tibia. A microcontroller processes the signals using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to compute the frequency difference (Δf), which correlates with bone density. Diagnostic results are wirelessly transmitted to a mobile application for real-time display. The system eliminates the need for ionizing radiation and complex imaging infrastructure, offering a cost-effective and field-deployable solution for early osteoporosis screening. Clinical validation against DEXA scans on 32 subjects showed full agreement, confirming diagnostic reliability. A manual fallback using a calibrated hammer ensures continued operation without motor dependency. The innovation is ideal for use in rural and resource-constrained settings, enabling accessible bone health monitoring.

Abstract: Title: V.E.C.T.O.R: A Real-Time System for Velocity-Enhanced Clustering and Transactional Outlier Recognition in Financial Fraud Detection The current disclosure, V.E.C.T.O.R (Velocity-Enhanced Clustering for Transactional Outlier Recognition), provides a real-time fraud detection system that adapts dynamically to user behaviour using behavioural clustering and personalized anomaly models. It processes high-throughput financial transactions with sub-100ms latency, extracting real-time features such as transaction velocity, frequency, and loan activity. New users are initially handled by a fallback model, while experienced users are grouped using dimensionality reduction and clustering systems. Each group is assigned a dedicated anomaly detection model for personalized scoring. Transactions are evaluated with a fraud probability score and routed accordingly-approved, verified via two-factor authentication, or blocked. The system maintains full auditability through buffered storage and real-time visualization via a monitoring dashboard. It supports scalable deployment across institutional, hosted, embedded, and mobile environments, addressing key limitations of conventional fraud systems by reducing false positives and enabling adaptive, explainable, and secure fraud prevention.

Applicant_Address: Mysore Road, R.V. Vidyaniketan Post, Bengaluru -560059, Karnataka, India.

Abstract: Title: Regenerative Suspension-Based Energy Harvesting System for Heavy Commercial Vehicles The present invention relates to a regenerative suspension system for Heavy Commercial Vehicles (HCVs) that captures and converts mechanical energy from suspension movement into electrical energy. The system includes a dual gear mechanism connected to the vehicle's suspension, which converts the linear motion of the suspension into rotational motion. This rotational motion drives a generator that produces alternating current (AC). The AC output is rectified using a bridge rectifier and converted into direct current (DC). The stabilized DC output is then stored in a rechargeable battery or directly supplied to power auxiliary vehicle systems such as lighting, climate control, and sensors. The system operates during both upward and downward suspension movement, ensuring continuous energy recovery. A control unit manages the flow of energy and regulates power distribution to maximize efficiency. A working prototype generated a stable output of 9V DC under test conditions and successfully powered an LED bulb, confirming the system's feasibility. This invention reduces the load on the vehicle's engine, improves fuel efficiency, and supports sustainable transportation by reducing emissions and operational costs. The system is compact, retrofittable, and cost-effective, contributing to the electrification and sustainability of commercial transport.

This system generates high resolution images by synchronizing raw IQ signal from the FMCW radar module with accurate positional data of the UAV. The data from the FMCW radar module is through optimized Serial Peripheral Interface data pipeline on the companion computer which transforms the synchronized data to single look complex formatted data. Patent_Title: A High-Gain Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna Array System for Ku-Band Satellite Downlink Communication in Low Earth Orbit Applications

Abstract: The present invention relates to a compact and high-performance rectangular microstrip patch antenna (MPA) array designed for Ku-band satellite downlink communication systems. The invention comprises a single rectangular patch antenna fabricated on a low-loss Rogers RT/Duroid 5880 substrate and an optimized planar array architecture capable of enhancing gain, radiation efficiency, and directional performance. The antenna operates at approximately 12 GHz and employs an inset microstrip feed mechanism for impedance matching. The invention further integrates a corporate feed network and optimized inter-element spacing to minimize mutual coupling while maximizing beam directivity. Experimental and simulation validations demonstrate superior return loss, low VSWR, high radiation efficiency, and enhanced gain suitable for LEO satellite communication terminals. The invention provides a lightweight, low-profile, cost-effective, and manufacturable antenna solution for next-generation satellite communication systems.

Abstract: ABSTRACT Development of a Quantum Computing Framework for IoT Device Data Security System for Communication Application A quantum computing framework system is being developed for the IoT device data security system for communication purposes in this patented work and it is the outcome of the funded project. The rapid growth of IoT devices in critical sectors such as agriculture has created an urgent need for advanced cybersecurity solutions capable of protecting sensitive information from modern and future cyber threats. This research project focused on developing a robust post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) framework to secure IoT-based agricultural systems, particularly agri-bots used in precision farming applications. The proposed framework aimed to ensure data confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity while addressing the vulnerabilities posed by the emergence of quantum computing. To achieve this, lattice-based cryptographic algorithms such as Kyber for secure key exchange and Dilithium for digital signatures were integrated to establish quantum-resistant communication channels. The framework was carefully designed to maintain strong security while ensuring energy efficiency and scalability for resource-constrained IoT environments. The first phase of the project concentrated on developing a standardized security framework for IoT communications using post-quantum cryptographic techniques. Kyber-based authenticated key exchange and Dilithium-based digital signatures were implemented to secure data exchanges between IoT devices and servers.

Patent_Title: Eco-Friendly Concrete Composition Utilizing Tamarind Seed Powder as Partial Cement Replacement for Improved Strength and Durability
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ujwal M S | Dr. Shiva Kumar G | Sridhar H N
Abstract: The present invention relates to a sustainable concrete composition utilizing Tamarind Seed Powder as a partial replacement of cement in concrete. Tamarind seeds, an agro-industrial waste generated in large quantities from food processing industries, are processed into fine powder and used as supplementary cementitious material. In a preferred embodiment, tamarind seed powder replaces 8% by weight of cement, providing an optimized balance between mechanical strength, workability, durability, and environmental sustainability. The tamarind seed powder contains natural polysaccharides, silica traces, and carbonaceous compounds which contribute to micro-filling action and improved particle packing in the cement matrix. The invention enhances compressive strength, split tensile strength, flexural performance, water resistance, and crack resistance when compared with conventional concrete. The invention further provides a controlled methodology involving drying, roasting, grinding, sieving, and proportionate blending of tamarind seed powder with cement. The developed concrete exhibits reduced permeability, improved long-term strength, lower heat of hydration, and reduced carbon footprint due to cement savings. The invention promotes sustainable construction through utilization of agricultural waste and reduced dependence on Portland cement. The composition is suitable for pavements, residential buildings, precast blocks, pavers, retaining walls, and general structural applications.

Patent_Title: A Hybrid Bio-Geo Stabilization Method for Expansive Soils Using Alkali-Treated Crumb Rubber and Microbially Induced Calcite Precipitation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Sridhar H N | Dr. Shiva Kumar G | Ujwal M S | Dr. H K Ramaraju | Dr. B.R. Manjunatha | Dr. Vinay A
Abstract: The present invention relates to a sustainable soil stabilization method for expansive soils using a hybrid approach combining alkali-treated crumb rubber (5-10%) and microbially induced calcite precipitation (MICP) employing Sporosarcina pasteurii. The alkali treatment enhances the surface reactivity of crumb rubber, improving its bonding with soil particles, while MICP facilitates calcite precipitation that binds soil grains. The synergistic interaction results in improved ductility, reduced brittleness, and enhanced compressive strength of the treated soil. The method offers an eco-friendly alternative to conventional stabilizers like lime and cement, while simultaneously addressing waste tire disposal issues. The stabilized soil is suitable for use in subgrades, embankments, and foundations in civil engineering applications. The proposed method provides a balanced mechanical response suitable for sustainable geotechnical applications.

Patent_Title: Portable Rapid EV Charging System

Abstract: In this changing world, there is major increment in popularity and demand of electric vehicles. A Portable Rapid EV Charging System is an innovative solution designed to provide fast and convenient electric vehicle (EV) charging on the go. This system combines compact, lightweight hardware with high-power output capabilities to enable quick recharging without relying on fixed charging stations. It typically includes advanced battery storage, power electronics, and intelligent control algorithms to ensure efficient energy transfer, safety, and compatibility with various EV models. By addressing range anxiety and expanding charging accessibility, this technology supports wider EV adoption and enhances user mobility in urban and remote environments.

Patent_Title: Smart Accident Detection and Emergency Response System Using ADAS
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The invention proposes a smart accident detection and emergency response system designed to enhance road safety mechanisms by minimizing emergency response time. The system utilizes Advanced Driving Assistance Systems (ADAS) integrated with IoT components such as accelerometers, GPS, and GSM modules to detect accidents in real-time. Machine learning technique using Isolation Forest algorithm distinguishes between normal and fatal conditions. Upon detection, alerts with location details are sent to emergency services to avail immediate medical attention.

Patent_Title: Hybrid Sonar Doppler Radar System for Real-Time Distance Mapping and Speed Estimation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Yuktha M Y | Nandkishor J | Sujal Pawar | Soundarya D Shetty | Dr. Yashaswini Gowda N | Dr. Sumit Swain
Abstract: The present invention pertains to a multifunctional detection device for concurrent spatial scanning and velocity evaluation, namely, a Hybrid Sonar-Doppler Radar System. Single-sensor systems tend to lag under dynamic conditions. In contrast, ultrasonic detectors provide precise distance information; they cannot measure radial velocity in real time, and although basic Doppler radar is competent at tracking moving objects, it is deficient at measuring stationary distances. This hybrid detector addresses such shortcomings by integrating a multi-mode hardware platform, which is capable of combining Ultrasonic Time of Flight (ToF) measurements with Microwave Doppler Frequency Shift computation. The device includes an ultrasonic sensor array for distance measurement and a microwave Doppler sensor for speed measurement, both controlled by a central processing module. The processor utilises a sensor fusion technique to correlate the dissimilar outputs, thereby producing a composite output consisting of both distance and velocity vectors for each object under observation. The design employs an array scanning technique, which usually involves the use of a high torque servo motor, providing an angular field of view up to 180 degrees, and thereby enabling full mapping of the surroundings. The correlation of reflected sound waves with changes in radio frequencies allows one to provide a degree of redundancy, thus reducing the influence of environmental noise and atmospheric interference. The proposed system can be used in the realms of automotive guidance systems, ADAS, and robotic applications, serving as a cheap but highly reliable tool of real-time collision avoidance and obstacle detection.

Patent_Title: A Dynamic Trust-Aware Ephemeral Memory Sandboxing Framework with Autonomous Data Destruction for Secure Code Execution
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rakshitha Kiran P | Dr. Mohammed Tajuddin | Dr. Pallavi Kulkarni | Dr. Deepthi V S
Abstract: The present invention discloses a dynamic trust-aware framework for securing code execution using ephemeral memory sandboxing combined with autonomous data destruction mechanisms. The system evaluates real-time trust parameters including execution context, behavioral patterns, and system integrity to dynamically control sandbox creation, execution privileges, and lifecycle. Sensitive computations are executed within isolated, short-lived memory environments where all data is encrypted using non-persistent cryptographic keys. A continuous runtime attestation module monitors execution integrity and updates trust scores dynamically. Based on trust evaluation, the system adapts execution policies and triggers autonomous destruction of memory, keys, and residual artifacts upon completion or anomaly detection. The invention ensures zero data persistence and mitigates risks from memory-based attacks, insider threats, and advanced persistent exploits, thereby enhancing security in cloud, enterprise, and critical computing infrastructures.

Patent_Title: Intelligent Smart Agriculture System Using IoT and Deep Learning for Automated Pest Detection and Precision Control
Applicant_Address: Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering, Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore-560111
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rose Bindu Joseph P | Dr. A. George Maria Selvam | Ms.S.Sowmya | Ms.Shruthi T S
Abstract: The present disclosure relates to an intelligent smart agriculture system integrating Internet of Things (IoT) and deep learning techniques for automated pest detection and precision control. The system comprises IoT-enabled sensors for real-time monitoring of environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, and soil moisture, along with camera modules for capturing crop images. The acquired images undergo technical processing methods including Gaussian filtering and histogram equalization for preprocessing, K-means clustering for segmentation, and feature extraction using SIFT descriptors. A deep learning model based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), utilizing architectures such as MobileNet and ResNet, is employed for accurate pest detection and classification. The model is trained using supervised learning with backpropagation and stochastic gradient descent (SGD), and enhanced through transfer learning and data augmentation techniques. Pest severity is estimated using softmax-based probabilistic scoring. Upon detection, a precision control mechanism is activated using fuzzy logic-based decision algorithms, enabling targeted pesticide application through IoT-connected smart sprayers controlled via pulse-width modulation (PWM). Communication is facilitated using MQTT and LoRaWAN protocols, with edge computing enabling real-time processing. The system improves detection accuracy, reduces pesticide usage, and supports sustainable precision farming.

Patent_Title: Schema-Aware Partial Homomorphic Encryption Middleware for Privacy-Preserving Clinical AI Inference
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rakshitha Kiran P | Dr. Mohammed Tajuddin | Dr. Pallavi Kulkarni | Dr. Deepthi V S
Abstract: The present invention proposes a schema-aware middleware system that integrates Partial Homomorphic Encryption (PHE) techniques to enable privacy-preserving clinical AI inference. The invention addresses the critical challenge of securely processing sensitive healthcare data without exposing it in plaintext during computation. The middleware intelligently interprets the schema of structured clinical datasets and selectively encrypts sensitive attributes using homomorphic encryption schemes that allow limited arithmetic operations directly on encrypted data. By acting as an intermediary layer between clinical data repositories and AI inference engines, the system ensures that machine learning models can perform inference tasks such as disease prediction or risk assessment without decrypting patient data. This approach significantly reduces the risk of data breaches while maintaining computational efficiency compared to fully homomorphic encryption methods. The invention thereby achieves a balance between data privacy, regulatory compliance, and real-time AI performance, making it suitable for deployment in modern healthcare systems.

Patent_Title: AI-Driven, Decentralized and Gamified Cybersecurity Ecosystem
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

It leverages gamified learning experiences to engage users, offering simulated cybersecurity scenarios that enhance awareness and skills. Additionally, it ensures continuous user engagement and data security by implementing password-less authentication and scanning the dark web for potential breaches. By integrating scalable solutions for enterprise clients and personalized features for individual users, it addresses both widespread and niche security concerns. Its decentralized, incentivized threat-sharing network fosters collaboration, while cybersecurity insurance offerings add an extra layer of protection tailored to users' risk profiles. It aims to create a more secure digital landscape, empowering users through education, robust technology, and a future-proof infrastructure that can withstand challenges like quantum computing. It represents a proactive, comprehensive, and collaborative approach to safeguarding the modern digital ecosystem.

Patent_Title: A Lever Actuated Mechanical Wiper System for Manual Cleaning of Solar Collectors
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mr. GIRISHKUMAR. G. S | Prof. G.S. MAHESH | Dr. NINGE GOWDA B. M. | Dr. P. SUDHAKAR | Mr. R. VINAYAKUMAR | Dr. BINDUSHREE B. S. | Mr. GOVINDARAJU H. | Mr. VIJAYAKUMAR N PATIL | Mr. ABHISHEK H. A | Dr. RANJITHA P. | Mrs. RADHA HALAGANI
Abstract: This invention pertains to a manual cleaning apparatus designed for solar energy equipment, specifically featuring a lever-operated mechanical wiper system to clear dust and contaminants from solar panels and solar thermal collectors. The system includes a wiper blade assembly attached to a supporting frame, which is linked to a hand-operated lever mechanism via a linkage system. By activating the lever, the wiper blade moves back and forth across the panel's surface, allowing for efficient cleaning without relying on electrical power or extensive water use. Guide rails or tracks are integrated to maintain consistent contact and alignment of the wiper during use. The device is straightforward in design, economical, and ideal for use in remote areas with limited water resources. The invention enhances the efficiency of solar energy systems by keeping surfaces clean while reducing the need for maintenance and resource use. Optional features include a spring-assisted return mechanism and the ability to integrate with fluid spraying units for improved cleaning effectiveness.

Patent_Title: Peristaltic pump assisted coolant draining system
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. V. R. SRINIVASAN | Dr. NINGE GOWDA B. M. | Prof. G.S. MAHESH | Mr. R. VINAYAKUMAR | Dr. BINDUSHREE B. S. | Mr. GOVINDARAJU H. | Prof. RADHA HALAGANI | Mr. VIJAYAKUMAR N PATIL | Mr. SAMARTH P BALBADRI
Abstract: The present invention relates to a coolant draining system utilizing a peristaltic pump mechanism for controlled and contamination-free fluid transfer. The system comprises a bin where the coolant is in stagnate condition, collecting tank and a flexible tube connecting the through a peristaltic pump assembly. The pump operates by cyclic compression of a flexible hose, enabling precise fluid movement without direct contact between the coolant and mechanical components, thereby minimizing contamination and wear. A vertically oriented hose facilitates the transfer of coolant from the bin to the lower collecting tank, assisted by the peristaltic pump positioned strategically along the flow path. The arrangement ensures efficient draining even in cases where gravitational flow is insufficient or inconsistent. The system further allows regulated flow rates, reverse flow capability, and enhanced operational safety compared to conventional gravity-based or centrifugal pump systems. The invention is particularly suitable for applications in machining systems, automotive coolant management and industrial fluid handling, where maintaining fluid integrity and preventing leakage or contamination is critical. The proposed design improves reliability, reduces maintenance requirements, and enables compact and modular integration into existing systems.

Patent_Title: Hybrid Emergency Beacon and Cooperative Traffic Clearance System for Predictive Ambulance Corridor Formation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Venkatesh Babu K P | Mr. Nitheesh Kumar B S | Dr. Swaraj Dominic Lewis | Mr. Radhakrishna | Mr. Nandan B K
Abstract: The invention reveals a hybrid emergency vehicle detection and cooperative traffic clearance mechanism that is aimed at offering an experimental or forecastive continuous right-of-way pathway to ambulances and other priority cars. It combines an Emergency Beacon Module (EBM) that is a low-cost component in emergency cars with a roadside of multi-modal sensors, such as audio-based siren sensors, Bluetooth/LoRa receivers, and optional crowdsourcing confirmation of connected user devices. These heterogeneous inputs are processed using a cloud-assisted computation engine to obtain a dynamic confidence model of emergency vehicle presence, direction, and estimated aircraft time. The system uses this information to send coordinated messages to retrofit capable traffic controllers, allowing them to control signal timing intervals, and to the vehicles adjacent to them, which undertake micro-manoeuvrers based on a common clearance behavior protocol. The invention also facilitates deployment that is agreeable to the policy by upgrading the infrastructure on a scalable level and end-nationwide communications systems. The system is collectively cost-effective, reliable and adaptive emergency corridor that greatly minimizes the time delays in response, optimizes traffic flow and boosts the safety of the population in varied road conditions.

Patent_Title: A Passive Bio-AI System for Pre-Symptomatic Neurodegeneration Risk Prediction
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: C V Balaji | Aprameya Bharadwaj | Anjana U | Dr. Suma V | Ishwari Suyog Bhawalkar | K Parjanya Ram
Abstract: The current invention describes a system and method for predicting the risk of neurodegeneration in clinically normal subjects prior to symptom onset utilizing a passive, non-invasive, multi-dimensional tracking approach. This is accomplished through the integration of user generated data from wrist worn wearable devices and a food diary to monitor a subject's estimated glycemic responses, gut brain axis health proxy, heart rate variability, sleep structure and exercise habits on a continuing basis. Unlike previous approaches that have used expensive and invasive medical equipment, this system uses commercially available devices. Additionally, while other systems require the need to collect large amounts of historical data before they can be personalized, this system supports ongoing personalization at regular intervals through standardized metabolic calibrations of fasting plasma glucose and glycated hemoglobin levels. These signals then undergo a four stage artificial intelligence processing pipeline: (1) An indirect estimation of blood glucose levels using a gated recurrent unit with fasting plasma glucose and glycated hemoglobin levels serving as calibration anchors; (2) A temporal fusion transformer that constructs an individualized baseline of their physiological status over time in an initial calibration period; (3) A bidirectional long short-term memory autoencoder that identifies changes in physiological status that occur without supervision by detecting metabolic drift through a comparison of original and reconstructed data sets; and (4) An attention based fusion module that produces a quantitative, Shapley value explained risk score. In addition to providing the first opportunity to develop early interventions to prevent or delay the onset of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease which are currently diagnosed when irreparable neuronal loss has already occurred.

Patent_Title: Metro-Integrated Parcel Transportation And Storage System With Electromagnetic Tube Network
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The Parcel System is integrated into the Metro Rail system by using a separate Tube Network that runs alongside of all Metro Tracks. Electromagnetic Propulsion Systems drive Capsules through the Tubes, which can be Bi-Directional, with Time Slot Scheduling and Anti-Collision Management utilizing RFID Technology. At each Station there is an Automated Sorting System that routes the Boxes to designated Storage Lockers. Users can then pick-up their boxes from these storage units by entering the box number and One-Time Password (OTP), at no cost if picked up within 3 days; users will also be charged for longer than 14 day storage. Features such as Entry Screening, CCTV Coverage, Moisture Detection, as well as Complete Audit Logging help to maintain high levels of Security. The entire Parcel System operates without Human Handling during Normal Operation (after Initial Security Screening), utilizes existing Metro Infrastructure to provide Efficient Urban Parcel Delivery, does not utilize Passenger Coaches or take away from Road Use/Congestion/Emissions while offering Convenient Collection Points at Stations throughout the Metro Network.

Patent_Title: A Location-Intelligent Digital Coordination Model for Agricultural Labor and Equipment Management
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Alamma B H | Dr. Samitha Khaiyum | Dr. T. Ratha Jeyalakshmi | Dr. Pavithra G Shetty | Prof. Smitha G V
Abstract: The new digital platform is made to help farmers work better by letting them talk to the people who provide things they need at the time. This system uses GPS to find workers, machines and other helpers near the farm. This way farmers can get what they need from people who're close by. The platform also has a code that farmers get on their phone to make sure they are who they say they are which is helpful, for farmers who do not use computers very much. The system also has a part that lets farmers see where the helpers are and watch them come to the farm. This helps farmers know what is going on and makes sure everything gets done on time. By using maps, booking and watching where things are the system helps farmers get things done faster and makes everything more open. The new platform is a way to make farming better and help farmers get more work done in places where it is hard to get things done.

Patent_Title: Intelligent Traffic Signal Control using IoT System with Emergency Preemption
Applicant_Name: Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering | Vayuvya Raksha Systems Private Limited
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore-560111 | No 78, South Sparta Apartments, Flat no 206, JP Nagar 5th phase, Bengaluru, IN
Inventor_Name: Mr. Chetan Umadi | Dr Santhosh B | Purshotham C N | Navyashree A V | Rashmi Ashok Teradal | Prajwal C M
Abstract: Urban traffic congestion and delayed emergency response are major obstacles to modern cities. Traditional signal systems operate on predetermined, fixed timers and do not have the ability to alter timing based on current traffic conditions or an emergency vehicle response required by the public. This project provides a unique way to dynamically manage signals by using an Automatic Traffic Control System that incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT). Through the use of ESP32 microcontrollers and MAX9814 sound sensors, our Automatic Traffic Control System can detect traffic density, identify when an ambulance sound is present, and track violations. In addition, our system includes web-based dashboards, which provide live traffic updates, allow users to access analytics, and allow traffic authorities to manage their roadways manually. Through experimental evaluation, we have been able to demonstrate a reduction in congestion and improved response times to emergency vehicles. The proposed AIoT framework provides a low-cost and scalable method of managing city traffic more efficiently in the future.

Patent_Title: A Layered Quantum-Secure Architecture for Central Bank Digital Currency Integrating Quantum Key Distribution, Post-Quantum Cryptography, and Byzantine Fault-Tolerant Consensus
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Velcia Mendonca | Deepa N P | Teena Srinivasan | Vignesh | Somesh R S | Sapna P J
Abstract: The current invention discloses a four-layer quantum protected and secure architecture for a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) system. This system is cryptographically secure again both classical and quantum computing related attacks. Threats arising from Shor's algorithms as well as the Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) attacks are resilient to this system as it doesn't rely on any single cryptographic layer for its overall security. The four layers are: information-theoretic session key secrecy, computational quantum-resistant cryptographic protection, Byzantine fault-tolerant distributed ledger operations, and quantum-safe encrypted key storage respectively. The system architecture is built such that even if there is a compromise of one whole layer, there is no trade-off in the overall security of the system. The novel structural contribution includes a secure key storage architecture backed up by quantum algorithms wherein a database compromise alone is insufficient to recover the protected keys, an authentication based on post-quantum mechanism which includes linear message complexity, a verifiable quantum-safe leader election implementation, a combined security guarantee with the help of a dual-path session architecture system and a highly confidential lattice-based homomorphic scheme for digital currency transactions.

Patent_Title: A High-Q Multi-Standard LC-VCO with Parasitic-Compensated Switched-Capacitor Banks for Constant Phase-Noise Performance across Sub-6 GHz Bands
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Sairam V | Akheel Ahmed P T | Akash R | Dr. Srividya B V | Dr. Rajesh Kumar | Ganesh KB
Abstract: The present invention discloses a reconfigurable LC-based Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (VCO) designed for multi-standard wireless communication across the 2.4-9 GHz spectrum. The oscillator utilizes a high-quality factor (High-Q) tank circuit integrated with a parasitic-compensated switched-capacitor bank. Traditional wide-tuning range VCOs suffer from significant Phase-Noise (PN) degradation at lower frequency bands due to the resistive loading of deactivated capacitor switches and the reduction of the overall tank quality factor. The disclosed architecture implements a compensation network comprising auxiliary passive elements and optimized switch biasing that neutralizes parasitic capacitance and minimizes on-resistance variations across the tuning range. This should enable the VCO to maintain a substantially constant phase-noise profile and uniform KVCO (oscillator gain) across multiple frequency bands, including LTE, 5G NR, and Wi-Fi. The invention further includes a digitized calibration loop for capacitor bank selection, ensuring optimal power-to-noise performance for each specific operational standard.

Patent_Title: Bio-Inspired Tendon-Driven Perching and Grasping Mechanism for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Jasti Anurag | Dhangar Snehal Kishorrao | Kavana K Gowda | Malvika Gautam Pillai | Srishti Tiwari
Abstract: This invention relates to a lightweight, bio-inspired perching and grasping mechanism for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). The mechanism employs a zygodactyl toe arrangement two forward-facing digits and two rearward-facing digits, inspired by the Eurasian Eagle Owl (Bubo bubo) to provide superior grip stability on irregular surfaces such as branches, pipes and narrow ledges. Actuation is achieved by a single continuous tendon routed through four tension segments across the phalangeal joints of each digit, enabling a natural distal-to-proximal curling motion that conforms passively to the grasped object's geometry. The mechanism allows UAV to transition from energy-intensive hovering to passive perching, significantly extending mission endurance.

Patent_Title: Enhanced optical logic half-adder functionality via nonlinear liquid-filled triangular triple-core PCF at 850 nm
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: T. Uthayakumar
Abstract: This patent reveals a design for a triple-core photonic crystal fiber (TCPCF) where the optical guiding cores are filled with liquid nitrobenzene, a substance known for its high nonlinearity, to enable all-optical logical half adder functionality at a central wavelength of 850 nm. The fiber's structure is crafted by strategically placing air holes within a silica glass matrix, creating the photonic crystal cladding. The design features an airhole next to the central core on the left side and two airholes on the right side, positioned above and below the central airhole; all these are filled with liquid nitrobenzene, serving as light-guiding cores. To ensure effective confinement and reduce boundary reflections, the PCF is enclosed within a perfectly matched boundary layer (PML). Finite element method (FEM) numerical simulations verify that this TCPCF design supports single-mode propagation at 850 nm, demonstrating strong nonlinear coefficients due to the nitrobenzene infiltration, with minimal absorption loss. The configuration is fine-tuned for implementing all-optical logic half adder operations at 850 nm, requiring notably low input peak power.

Patent_Title: Smart Prosthetic Hand for Physically Disabled
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: GANESHA G C | ZOYATAJ S | ANUSHA B S | APOORVA R | SREENIDHI N Z | SATISH B A | DEEKSHITHA ARASA | RACHANA M H | DR BALAMURUGAN M | DR ARJUNKUMAR G B
Abstract: The growing demand for affordable and intelligent assistive technologies has increased the need for effective upper-limb prosthetic solutions. Many commercially available prosthetic hands remain inaccessible due to high cost, mechanical complexity, or limited user interaction. This work presents the design and implementation of a low-cost smart prosthetic hand that enables intuitive control through voice commands and Bluetooth-based operation. The proposed system employs an Arduino UNO as the central control unit, servo motors for finger actuation, and a Bluetooth communication module for wireless command execution. Embedded C is used to implement control logic for synchronized finger movement, multiple grip patterns, and stable motor operation. System validation is initially performed using Proteus simulation to verify circuit behavior and control accuracy, followed by real-time hardware implementation. An LCD module is integrated to provide visual feedback on system status and operation modes. Voice command integration is achieved using a Bluetooth-based mobile application, allowing users to control hand movements with minimal physical effort. Experimental testing demonstrates reliable actuation, responsive command execution, and smooth grip operation under various control conditions. The developed prosthetic hand offers an economical and user-friendly alternative to high-cost prosthetic devices, with potential to enhance accessibility, independence, and quality of life for individuals with upper-limb disabilities.

Patent_Title: Semi-Autonomous UAV System for Facade Cleaning
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sundaramahalingam A | Dr. Prathik Jain S | Dr. Sankaralingam L | Hemanth S | S Sriram Balaji | Shreyas K S | Syed Mohidul Ameen
Abstract: This invention presents a tether-powered semi-autonomous facade-cleaning UAV developed for applications requiring long-endurance maintenance of high-rise buildings. A multicopter platform is powered through a ground based high-voltage DC tether, where conductor sizing and loss calculations are optimized in order to ensure efficient continuous power transmission. The drone integrates a dedicated cleaning mechanism consisting of a high-pressure nozzle driven by a AC pump and a rotating brush for mechanical scrubbing. These components are positioned using detailed CG and reaction-force analysis to maintain stability during spraying and contact operations. A Pixhawk flight controller running ArduPilot grants waypoint navigation, closed-loop attitude stabilization, and AUX-based actuation of the cleaning system. An array of ultrasonic proximity sensors, interfaced through an Arduino, provides real-time obstacle detection along with MAV Link-based safety feedback within Mission Planner. Additional stability measures implemented to counteract disturbances generated during high-pressure spraying include PID gain adjustments, notch filtering, counterweight balancing, and nozzle-angle tuning. The integrated system allows the execution of the cleaning path autonomously, with continuous telemetry monitoring, including the capability for manual RC override. This is a much safer and quite efficient alternative to the traditional facade cleaning methods. This work establishes the analytical models, component selection, power-system design, and control framework needed for full prototype fabrication.

Patent_Title: SEMI-AUTONOMOUS UAV - BASED SYSTEM FOR DUST REMOVAL AND CLEANING OF SUSPENDED AND ELEVATED STRUCTURES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Afreen Nizami | Dr. P. S. Shivakumar Gouda | Abhishek | Basavakumar | Deekshith Kumar S | Yashas K A | Ms. Fareen Nizami
Abstract: There is an increased need for safe, efficient, and automatic cleaning systems for suspended and inaccessible structures, which have driven the development of aerial robotic systems that have the potential to perform such cleaning tasks with reduced risk to human life. Accumulation of dust on suspended structures, industrial equipment, and such structures not only damages the aesthetic appearance of the objects but also has the potential to affect the structural integrity of these objects over time. Traditional manual cleaning is time-consuming and risky. This project is centered on the design and basic development of a semi-autonomous drone equipped with a blower and a robotic arm with a dust removal brush. This proposed system combines UAV mobility and air-based and mechanical dust removal methods for enhanced access and dust removal efficiency. The project covers analysis of requirements, blower performance analysis, determination of airflow velocity for dust removal, payload determination, thrust-weight ratio analysis, and CATIA V5 is used for CAD modelling of drones, robotic arms, blowers, and dust removal brushes. Also, the reaction forces that act on the system during dust removal are considered, and compensation methods for lateral forces are highlighted. The need for semi-autonomous operation is discussed in terms of striking a balance between automation and human control to achieve safe navigation, obstacle avoidance, as well as stable hovering when cleaning. The anticipated results include improved dust removal effectiveness, improved levels of safety, better access to hard-to-reach areas, as well as use in museums, industries, storage facilities, and other large interior spaces. This work provides the basis for the design, analysis, and feasibility study for future implementation of a cleaning system using drones.

Patent_Title: 5-Axis Mandrel Additive Manufacturing System with Leadscrew Tilting for Support-less Propellers
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Jasti Anurag | Dr Jadam Thrinadh
Abstract: The present invention discloses a novel 5-axis hybrid additive manufacturing system designed to eliminate the requirement for sacrificial support structures during Fused Deposition Modelling (FDM) of geometrically complex components, particularly aerodynamic variable-pitch propeller blades. The system employs unique kinematic architecture centered on a rotating mandrel upon which propeller blades are directly printed. The mandrel is mounted on a rotating bed driven by a dedicated motor and is capable of continuous angular indexing. A lead screw, coupled through a universal joint to a push rod, actuates the tilting of the rotating mandrel assembly: rotation of the screw causes the push rod to translate linearly, which in turn bends and tilts the mandrel to the required pitch angle. This lead-screw-based tilt mechanism provides inherent mechanical self-locking (preventing back-drive under gravity load), sub-degree angular resolution, and a compact, cost-effective architecture suitable for desktop-scale deployment. The system enables continuous-path, support-less fabrication of propeller blades with unlimited overhang angles, reducing material waste by up to 40%, eliminating post-processing time, and improving inter-layer adhesion along complex curved blade geometries.

Patent_Title: System and Method for Fully Autonomous Fire Detection, Spatial Localization, Wireless Communication and Drone-Based Suppression
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rudresh M | MAITHRI K | KRISHIKA VENKATESH | Dr. Ashwin C Gowda | Dr. Ravikumar M
Abstract: The present invention relates to an autonomous system for detecting fire in a monitored environment, determining the precise spatial location of the fire within that environment, issuing an audio alert, transmitting the fire location data wirelessly, and dispatching an unmanned aerial vehicle to the detected location to physically suppress the fire without any human intervention at any stage of the process. The system comprises a camera module mounted at a fixed overhead position above a monitored surface area, a single-board processing unit running a deep learning based fire detection model, a coordinate mapping module that converts pixel-space detections to real-world spatial measurements in centimetres, a wireless transceiver for transmitting fire location data to the aerial vehicle, an audio alert module, and an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a paired wireless receiver, a dedicated flight controller, an onboard microcontroller, and a fire suppression mechanism. Upon detection of fire with a confidence value at or above a defined threshold, the system extracts the center coordinates of the detection bounding in pixel space and converts them to centimetre-accurate real-world coordinates using a pre-calibrated pixels-per-centimetre constant derived from the fixed camera mounting height. The unmanned aerial vehicle receives the transmitted coordinates, decodes them using its onboard microcontroller, commands the flight controller to navigate to the corresponding position above the monitored surface, descends to a defined operating height, and activates the onboard suppression mechanism to extinguish the fire. A redundancy protocol ensures repeated transmission of coordinates for as long as fire detection persists, directing the aerial vehicle to make repeated suppression attempts if required. The invention achieves spatial coordinate accuracy within a few centimetres under controlled conditions and demonstrates fire-to-alert response times of under three seconds.

Patent_Title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SPATIAL AUDIO-VISUAL CAPTIONING FOR HEARING IMPAIRED INDIVIDUALS
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Krishnan Rangarajan | Prof. Aruna S
Abstract: A system and method for providing real-time, spatially-anchored audio-visual information to hearing impaired individuals is disclosed. The invention comprises a device equipped with a camera, microphone array, and display interface that captures visual scenes and audio signals, localizes multiple sound sources in three-dimensional space, classifies sounds as speech or environmental audio, performs automatic speech recognition on detected speech, and renders visual captions or labels directly overlaid on or adjacent to the corresponding sound source within the live visual feed. The system enables hearing impaired users to simultaneously see the scene before them and receive contextualized information about where sounds are originating, with spoken words transcribed and displayed as scrolling text anchored to the speaker's position, thereby enhancing situational awareness, communication accessibility, and safety for individuals with hearing challenges.

Patent_Title: An IoT-ML Framework for Quantifying Physical Impacts on Livestock Lactation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr.A.R.Aswatha | Karunya C | Bhavya Nayak | Praneel M | Fuzail Ahmed Khan
Abstract: An IoT-ML Framework for Quantifying Physical Impacts on Livestock Lactation is an integrated system designed for high-precision milk yield forecasting and proactive livestock health monitoring. The architecture is defined by a multi-layered approach, beginning with a conceptual Sensing Layer designed to interface with IoT telemetry including temperature, humidity, and livestock pulse data. This data acquisition strategy is integrated into a Machine Learning Engine powered by the CatBoost regressor algorithm, which identifies non-linear correlations between environmental stressors and biological inputs such as breed, age, and lactation stage. The framework is supported by an Application Layer featuring an interactive Web/Mobile GUI that translates predictive analytics into actionable insights. This enables a systematic transition from simulated datasets to live operational environments, allowing dairy producers to optimize resource management, predict daily yields, and perform early-stage binary health classification to identify physiological anomalies.

Patent_Title: Solar Powered Bluetooth Speaker
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Jami Rajesh | Pratiksha L Naik | Krithika Bogunuva Balaji | Shubhamshri P Patkar | Vandana Y
Abstract: The present invention is compact, energy-efficient solar-powered Bluetooth speaker for sustainable audio playback in indoor and outdoor environments. The device comprises a high-efficiency solar panel for converting sunlight into electrical energy, a regulated charging module for safely storing energy in a rechargeable battery, and power management circuitry including resistors and diodes for voltage stabilization and component protection. A Bluetooth module enables wireless audio reception from compatible electronic devices, while an integrated amplifier module amplifies low-power audio signals to drive one or more speaker units with clear sound output. The integrated system provides a portable, environmentally friendly, and energy-independent audio solution suitable for outdoor use, emergency situations, and off-grid applications, while reducing reliance on conventional power sources and minimizing environmental impact.

Patent_Title: HELMET INTEGRATED OVERSPEED INDICATION SYSTEM FOR TWO WHEELERS
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr P B Savitha | Ranjith Kumar Dasari
Abstract: The present invention discloses a helmet system for two-wheeler rider safety, specifically featuring integrated over speed indication. The system comprises a Bluetooth enabled microcontroller-controlled helmet unit integrated with LED indicators. It is configured to wirelessly connect with an external mobile device, such as a smartphone, to receive real-time speed data. The helmet's microcontroller compares this speed data against predefined thresholds and activates the integrated LED indicators to provide a visual overspeed alert to the rider when the speed limit is exceeded. The invention aims to enhance rider awareness of their speed in a non-distracting manner, thereby contributing to increased road safety.

Patent_Title: SMART AGRI-BOT FOR PRECISION FARMING
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Arunadevi M | Srinath M S | Vivek Bhandarkar V N | Vinay Kumar R | Mahesh G S | Ruchik M A | Siddu Varthar | Vishnu Prasad S | P Kishore Gandhi
Abstract: The present invention relates to an autonomous agricultural robot designed to enhance efficiency, productivity, and sustainability in farming operations. The system comprises a four-wheeled electrically powered vehicle integrated with imaging sensors, machine learning algorithms, and automated pesticide spraying mechanisms. The robot is capable of performing agricultural tasks such as crop monitoring, pest detection, and targeted pesticide application with minimal human intervention. The invention utilizes a camera-based vision system coupled with image processing techniques, including convolutional neural networks (CNN) and artificial neural networks (ANN), to identify pests and plant diseases in real time. A Raspberry Pi-based processing unit enables decision-making and controls a pump mechanism to spray pesticides only on affected regions, thereby reducing chemical usage and environmental impact. This invention provides an efficient and cost-effective solution for modern precision agriculture, addressing labor shortages and improving crop yield through automation.

Patent_Title: Analog Audio Mixer with Integrated Feedback Prevention and PC/Laptop Interface Compatibility
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rahulkumar J | Kiran Sangamesh Hattalli | Kiran Shivaraj Hulihalli | Kushanth S S | Koushalyarama
Abstract: The present invention relates to a custom-designed analog audio mixer configured for full-duplex communication in generalized applications such as meetings, conferences, and online communication systems.
