The mixer enables simultaneous speaking and listening while maintaining high audio clarity and eliminating feedback. The system integrates microphone, speaker, and personal computer (PC) interfaces through a hardware-based architecture. It comprises an input stage, pre-amplification stage, equalization stage, signal routing stage, level conversion stage, and output stage. A key feature of the invention is the prevention of PC output audio from re-entering the mixer input path, thereby eliminating feedback loops without requiring software-based signal processing. The mixer ensures impedance compatibility with computer microphone inputs and maintains stable, distortion-free audio output using entirely analog circuitry.

Patent_Title: REGENERABLE SOL-GEL BIOSORBENT TABLET WITH CHEMICALLY ENHANCED MORINGA BIOMASS FOR MULTI-CYCLE HEAVY METAL REMOVAL
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Bhanu Revathi K | Dr. Shinomol George K. | Dr. Akshatha Prasanna | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Dr. Pavithra G
Abstract: The invention relates to a regenerable biosorbent tablet comprising chemically enhanced Moringa oleifera biomass immobilized within a silica-based sol-gel matrix. The tablet demonstrates unexpectedly high reusability, enabling at least ten consecutive adsorption cycles of heavy-metal removal through simple passive air-drying at ambient temperature without the use of heat, chemicals, or external energy sources. The biosorbent exhibits a metal uptake capacity exceeding 10 mg/g while maintaining low biological oxygen demand (BOD) and chemical oxygen demand (COD) leaching due to stable immobilization within a porous sol-gel network. The tablet purifies 0.5-1 litre of contaminated water within approximately 20 minutes and exhibits storage stability for at least 90 days at room temperature without desiccation or structural degradation.

Patent_Title: IoT-Enabled Paper-Based Colorimetric Heavy Metal Detection System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Akshatha Prasanna | Bhanu Revathi K | Dr. Kusumika Krori Dutta | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Dr. Pavithra G
Abstract: The present invention discloses an Internet-of-Things (IoT) enabled heavy-metal detection system comprising disposable paper-based colorimetric testing strips and a compact optical reader for quantitative detection of lead (Pb2+) and hexavalent chromium (Cr6+) in water. The paper strips are impregnated with selective color-forming reagents that generate concentration-dependent color changes upon contact with contaminated water. The optical reader comprises a controlled illumination source, an RGB color sensor, and an embedded microcontroller configured for on-device processing of colorimetric data using pre-stored calibration models. The system provides immediate numerical concentration values and safety classification indicators in both offline and wireless data-logging modes, eliminating subjective visual interpretation and dependence on laboratory instrumentation.

Patent_Title: Fractional Capacitor-based Non-invasive Sensing of Biochemical Dynamics in Cashew-Apple
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Bidishasaimantini Nayak | Sumit Swain | Madhab Chandra Tripathy
Abstract: Cashew apple is highly perishable and undergoes rapid biochemical changes immediately after harvest, making continuous quality assessment challenging. In this study, a non-invasive Fractional Order Bio-Impedance (FOBI) method was applied to monitor short-term physiological variations in cashew apple within the same day. Impedance spectra were recorded at four intervals and analyzed using fractional-order models to extract parameters such as the fractional order (α), characteristic frequency (fc), and constant phase element (CPE) coefficients. The results showed clear time-dependent shifts, with α decreasing progressively and fc displaying noticeable fluctuations, reflecting electrolyte redistribution and changes in ionic mobility. The CPE values further highlighted modifications in the capacitive behavior of tissue during these transitions. These findings demonstrate that FOBI provides sensitive and real-time insights into electrolyte dynamics and structural changes at an hourly resolution, offering a promising non-destructive approach for fruit quality monitoring and post-harvest management.

Patent_Title: Method for Enhancing the Electrochemical Performance of Thin Films
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Priya A Hoskeri | Dr. C M Joseph
Abstract: The present invention pertains to phthalocyanine thin films and a method for improving their electrochemical properties through controlled thermal annealing. The thin films are deposited via thermal evaporation and subsequently annealed under vacuum at selected temperatures to optimize performance. Electrochemical characteristics are assessed using cyclic voltammetry, demonstrating that the films exhibit reversible color transitions under varying redox potentials. Films treated at optimal annealing temperatures show improved electrochemical reversibility and enhanced coloration efficiency. These enhancements render the annealed Pc thin films highly suitable for use in energy storage devices, electrochromic display systems, and chemical sensors.

Patent_Title: System and Method for Intelligent Occupancy-Based Energy Management in Indoor Environments
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ms. Sanjana Shankar | Mrs. H D Aparna | Dr. Archana Nandibewoor | Mr. Anil D | Mrs Sanjana M Nagaraj | Dr. Saba Tahseen | Ms Navya SK
Abstract: The present invention relates to an intelligent room automation system designed to reduce energy consumption by automatically controlling electrical appliances based on real-time occupancy tracking. The system utilizes dual Passive Infrared (PIR) sensors placed near an entry point to detect the direction of human movement and determine whether a person is entering or exiting a room. An ESP32 microcontroller processes the sensor inputs to maintain an accurate count of occupants present in the room. Based on this occupancy count, the system automatically controls electrical appliances such as lights and fans using relay modules. When the room becomes unoccupied, the system disconnects power to the appliances to minimize unnecessary energy usage. Additionally, the system integrates Internet of Things (IoT) technology to transmit occupancy data and device status to a cloud-based platform for remote monitoring and analysis. The proposed solution provides a cost-effective, scalable, and energy-efficient automation system suitable for classrooms, offices, libraries, and other indoor environments

Patent_Title: AI-Enabled Wind Energy Powered IoT System for Intelligent Cloud Seeding and Rainfall
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mrs Sanjana M Nagaraj | Mr. Anil D | Dr. Archana Nandibewoor | Mrs. H D Aparna | Ms Navya SK | Dr. Saba Tahseen | Ms. Sanjana Shankar
Abstract: Cloud seeding is a weather modification technique aimed at enhancing precipitation by introducing substances into the atmosphere that encourage cloud condensation and ice crystal formation. The proposed invention presents an AI-enabled IoT-based adaptive cloud seeding system powered by renewable wind energy, designed to improve the efficiency and sustainability of artificial rainfall generation. The system integrates meteorological sensors, real-time environmental monitoring, and machine learning-based predictive analytics to determine optimal conditions for seeding operations. Based on atmospheric parameters such as humidity, temperature, wind speed, and cloud density, the system autonomously activates a smart seeding mechanism mounted on an elevated wind turbine structure. The wind turbine provides renewable power for continuous monitoring and operation, making the system self-sustaining and suitable for remote regions. Simulation-based analysis and environmental data modeling are used to evaluate system performance across varying climatic conditions. The invention aims to provide a smart, energy-efficient, and automated weather modification platform for drought mitigation, water resource management, and climate resilience.

Patent_Title: Autonomous Traffic Signal Control System Using Sound Energy Harvesting and Environmental Sensors
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mrs. H D Aparna | Mrs. Sanjana M Nagaraj | Mr. Anil D | Dr. Saba Tahseen | Dr. Archana Nandibewoor | Ms. Sanjana Shankar | Ms. Navya SK
Abstract: The present invention relates to an autonomous traffic signal control system powered by sound energy harvesting from vehicular noise. The system utilizes piezoelectric sensors to capture vibrations generated by moving vehicles and convert the mechanical energy into electrical energy. The harvested energy is rectified using a bridge rectifier circuit and stored in energy storage units such as capacitors. The stored electrical energy powers traffic signal light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and associated control components without relying on conventional power sources such as batteries or grid electricity. The system further integrates environmental sensors and intelligent control mechanisms to enhance road safety and operational efficiency. Rain detection mechanisms adjust signal timing and activate street lighting during adverse weather conditions, while an emergency vehicle detection module prioritizes ambulance movement by dynamically overriding the signal cycle. By combining renewable energy harvesting with intelligent traffic management, the invention provides a sustainable and self-sufficient solution for smart city infrastructure.

Patent_Title: A HIGH-DENSITY COMPACT POWER ELECTRONIC CONVERTER MODULE FOR FAST CHARGING AND THERMAL-EFFICIENT OPERATION OF ELECTRIC VEHICLE BATTERIES
Applicant_Address: Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore - 560078, Karnataka, India
Inventor_Name: Dr. M. Balamurugan | Dr. Arjun Kumar G.B | Mr. Venu M | Mr. Abhishek T Banakar | Mr. Sharanabasava | Dr. Ganesha G C | Dr. N. Raghu
Abstract: A high-density compact power electronic converter module is disclosed for enabling fast charging and thermally efficient operation of electric vehicle batteries. The invention integrates advanced semiconductor switching devices, optimized magnetic components, and an intelligent thermal management framework within a compact architecture. The converter employs high-frequency switching and soft-switching techniques to minimize losses and improve power density. A layered thermal design incorporating heat spreaders, cooling channels, and real-time temperature monitoring ensures uniform heat dissipation and prevents thermal hotspots. The system dynamically regulates voltage and current based on battery state and charging requirements, thereby enhancing charging speed while maintaining safety. The compact modular configuration supports scalability and ease of integration into existing charging infrastructure. The proposed converter significantly reduces charging time, improves energy efficiency, and extends battery life. Overall, the invention provides a reliable, space-efficient, and thermally robust solution for next-generation electric vehicle fast charging systems.

Patent_Title: A MODULAR HIGH-EFFICIENCY MULTI-LEVEL INVERTER TOPOLOGY FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE TRACTION APPLICATIONS WITH REDUCED HARMONIC DISTORTION AND ENHANCED THERMAL MANAGEMENT
Applicant_Address: Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore - 560078, Karnataka, India
Inventor_Name: Dr. Arjun Kumar G. B | Dr. M. Balamurugan | Ms. Sumangala Police Patil | Ms. Vijayalaxmi Siddappa Karjagi | Ms. Sindhu Naidu K | Ms. Srushti D P | Dr. Ganesha G C | Dr. V.N. Trupti
Abstract: A modular high-efficiency multi-level inverter topology is disclosed for electric vehicle traction systems, designed to minimize harmonic distortion while improving thermal performance and reliability. The invention employs a scalable architecture consisting of cascaded submodules with optimized switching strategies and advanced pulse width modulation techniques. Each module integrates intelligent thermal pathways, heat spreading layers, and real-time temperature monitoring to ensure uniform heat dissipation. The system dynamically balances voltage levels across stages, reducing stress on power devices and enhancing efficiency under varying load conditions. By lowering total harmonic distortion, the inverter improves motor performance, reduces acoustic noise, and extends component lifespan. The modular design enables easy maintenance, fault isolation, and adaptability to different vehicle power ratings. Overall, the proposed topology offers a compact, energy-efficient, and thermally robust solution for next-generation electric vehicle propulsion applications. Additionally, control algorithms enable fault tolerance and operation during failures, ensuring continuous traction performance and improved safety margins.

Patent_Title: AI-Enabled Food Freshness Detection System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rudresh M | Dhruv Khanna | Rishika | Saurav Kumar | Yajat Kanaskar
Abstract: AI-Enabled Food Freshness Detection System is a smart, portable device that monitors and predicts the freshness of perishable food items. It has a small electronic tag with several gas sensors and a temperature sensor connected to an ESP32 microcontroller, powered by a coin-cell battery. The sensors detect gases like ethylene and ammonia, which signal food spoilage. A lightweight AI model analyzes this sensor data to estimate freshness levels and predict how long food will remain good. The freshness data is sent via Bluetooth to a mobile app that shows real-time freshness indicators and sends expiry alerts to users. This helps consumers cut down on food waste, make better choices about what to eat, and avoid health risks from spoiled food. It can also help retailers by enabling dynamic pricing, allowing products close to their freshness limit to be sold at lower prices instead of being wasted. This invention helps users make smart choices about food consumption offers a smart and sustainable approach to everyday food management and storage. It can also be used in retail and supply chain systems to adjust prices based on food freshness. By combining gas analysis with AI processing and wireless connectivity, the E-Nose offers an energy efficient way to monitor food spoilage.

Patent_Title: Intelligent Automatic Fuel Dispensing System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. S. Madhankumar | Dr. Geetha N K
Abstract: The current invention reveals a smart automatic fuel dispensing technology with vehicle identification, safe online payment, and two-layered fuel checks. The system will have vehicle identification module, programmable control unit, a dual flow-verification mechanism and a secure digital payment interface. The system automatically recognizes an authorized vehicle, authenticates the related digital wallet balance and turns on the dispensing of fuel via a controlled pump system. The delivery of fuel is constantly controlled with the help of two independent sensing devices which are a flow sensor and algorithm that checks the pump-operation to make sure that fuel is dispensed correctly and that it is not stolen or manipulated. The system also automatically stops dispensing once the desired amount or value is fulfilled and logs the transaction information in a database at a distance. The invention enhances security, accuracy of dispensing, and transparency in operations of the automated fuel stations.

Patent_Title: A System and Method for Real-Time Pothole Detection and Severity Assessment
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ramya R S | Dr. Santanu Roy | Dr. Pushpa C N | Srivathsa Bhat | Sourabh S Bettad | Supreeth Devarushi | Vasudev J B
Abstract: The invention discloses a hybrid quantum-classical framework for automated pothole-severity classification using deep convolutional feature extraction and variational quantum circuits. Road images are processed into embeddings using a pretrained ResNet model, compressed into a low-dimensional latent space using PCA, and encoded into a multi-qubit quantum circuit for classification. The system demonstrates improved robustness under low-data and noisy-label conditions, enabling reliable road-condition assessment and supporting real-time maintenance operations.

Patent_Title: An Intelligent Framework for Automated FIR Generation and Criminal Record Management
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof Soumya Patil | V V S Lohith | Yashwin M | Syed Ashraf Gufran | S Lakshman sai Nithya Santhosh
Abstract: This invention discloses an intelligent framework that automates the filing and management of First Information Reports (FIRs) and criminal records using advanced artificial intelligence techniques. The system combines optical character recognition (OCR) for extracting information from both printed and handwritten complaints, state-of-the-art natural language processing (NLP) for summarizing lengthy incident narratives and entity recognition, and speech recognition modules for enabling voice-based FIR registration. These integrated technologies allow for the automated population of FIR data fields with essential details such as names, dates, locations, and crime types, thereby greatly reducing manual effort and minimizing errors. The framework further incorporates a Legal chatbot, supported by a robust legal knowledge graph, to guide users through the applicable criminal codes and judicial procedures relevant to their complaints. The platform features secure digital record management, supports multilingual input and inclusive accessibility, and is designed to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for digital evidence and privacy. By enabling real-time automated legal guidance and streamlining the documentation workflow, this invention substantially enhances the transparency, speed, and accuracy of criminal justice administration while improving public access to legal systems.

Patent_Title: System and Method for Wearable sEMG and IMU-Based Displacement-Tolerant Indian Sign Language Recognition and Cross-Lingual Speech Output
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Pruthvi C N | Monisha R | Sufiya Sarwath | Supriya R | Yaseen Ahmed Khan | Harpreet Kaur Thind
Abstract: The invention provides a portable, real-time Indian Sign Language (ISL) to speech conversion system that enables seamless communication for individuals with hearing or speech impairments. The system integrates a wearable forearm band equipped with surface electromyography (sEMG) sensors and an inertial measurement unit (IMU) to capture muscular and motion signals associated with hand gestures. A low-power microcontroller ESP32 acquires and wirelessly transmits the preprocessed signals to a Transformer-based deep learning model that interprets the fused signals to recognize ISL gestures with high temporal and spatial accuracy. The recognized gestures are translated into meaningful words and sentences using a language-mapping module that adapts ISL grammar into natural spoken language. The generated text is further converted into speech in real time, with optional translation into Hindi or Kannada for wider usability. A companion mobile application manages device connectivity, displays recognized text, and plays synthesized speech, thereby providing an end-to-end communication channel. The invention offers significant advantages including portability, low latency, multilingual support, and robust gesture recognition, enabling practical day-to-day communication assistance.

Patent_Title: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PRE-EXECUTION NON-TERMINATION PREDICTION IN AUTONOMOUS AI AGENT TASK PIPELINES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: V. Shriyatha | Gagana. H. R | Dr. Suma V | Prof. Poornima D | Shobha N | Prof. Swathi B V | Nayana Shinde | Prof. Leelavathi R
Abstract: A system and method for predicting, prior to execution, whether an autonomous AI agent task pipeline will terminate within bounded resources or enter a non-terminating state. The system constructs a semantic graph of the proposed task, performs forward simulation using a lightweight shadow agent, and applies three halting failure detectors cyclic semantic similarity, monotonic resource trajectory, and self-referential goal modification to the simulated graph. Upon detection of a non-termination signature, the system generates a bounded reformulation of the task incorporating explicit termination conditions, and presents this to the operator for confirmation. The shadow agent operates at approximately one percent of the primary agent's compute cost. The system is model-agnostic and integrates with any agent framework through the task specification interface.

Patent_Title: A System for Lithium-Ion Battery Cell Internal Health Mapping
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: V. Shriyatha | Prof. Poornima D | Prof. Swathi B V | Prof. Leelavathi R | Shobha N | Dr. Suma V | Nayana Shinde
Abstract: This invention describes a way to look inside a sealed lithium-ion battery cell and assess its actual internal condition without opening it, without stopping it from working, and without any kind of chemical or electrical discharge test. The system does this using sound, specifically ultrasonic pulses, and a small piezoelectric sensor attached to the outside of the cell. The Acoustic Resonance Cell Tomography (ARCT) system emits a swept ultrasonic pulse into the cell from a thin-film piezoelectric transducer bonded to the cell surface, captures the transmitted acoustic response, converts it to a frequency-domain resonance spectrum, and feeds that spectrum into a neural network that has been trained to decode it into a set of internal health parameters specifically: how much lithium plating has occurred, whether electrode delamination is present and how severe, the estimated remaining safe cycle count, and a thermal runaway risk score. The measurement takes under 50 milliseconds per cell, occurs during normal device operation without any special test conditions, and adds no visible overhead to the user experience. The system integrates directly with the battery management system hardware and communicates over existing BMS bus interfaces. It is the first system capable of detecting lithium dendrite formation the primary precursor to thermal runaway battery fires before the internal short circuit that causes the fire has occurred.

Patent_Title: A Solar-Powered Unified Device for Real-Time Soil, Crop and Post-Harvest Agricultural Intelligence
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mohammad Yasin | Dr. Suma V | Prof. Poornima D | Shobha N | Prof. Swathi B V | Nayana Shinde | Prof. Leelavathi R
Abstract: Invention is a solar-powered, unified agricultural intelligence device designed to provide real-time, lifecycle-aware monitoring and decision support across soil preparation, crop growth, and post-harvest transport and storage stages. The system integrates multi-modal sensor fusion, including soil condition sensors, environmental sensors, spoilage-related gas sensors, and a reusable laser/LiDAR-based scanning module within a single portable physical unit. Through automatic context detection, the device dynamically operates in Soil Monitoring, Crop Health, or Post-Harvest Mode without manual configuration. An embedded edge-based decision engine processes the aggregated data locally to evaluate soil parameters, crop structural conditions, and spoilage indicators. Unlike conventional agricultural tools that present raw sensor values or require cloud-based analysis, it generates structured, action-based recommendations specifying intervention type, required quantity, optimal timing, and urgency level. The device operates autonomously using solar energy with intelligent power management and adaptive sensing frequency based on detected risk levels and energy availability. By unifying sensing, scanning, and decision intelligence within a single energy-independent platform, the invention enables early stress detection, spoilage prediction, and optimized farm-to-market decision-making, offering functionality not present in existing standalone agricultural devices.

Patent_Title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-DRIVEN ATMOSPHERIC WATER GENERATION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: MS. SWETTI JHA | DR. RAMARAJU H K | MS SOUMYA H N | Ms Vidyashree J.C | Mr VINOD H C
Abstract: The present invention relates to an AI-Driven Atmospheric Water Generation (AI-AWG) system designed to produce potable water from ambient air through intelligent, adaptive control. The system integrates atmospheric air intake, condensation or desiccant-based water extraction, multi-stage purification, and renewable-energy power management. An embedded artificial intelligence control unit analyses real-time environmental parameters-including temperature, relative humidity, air quality, and energy availability-alongside historical climate data to optimize system operation. Using machine-learning and reinforcement-learning algorithms, the system dynamically adjusts cooling cycles, airflow, desiccant regeneration, and power distribution to maximise water yield while reducing energy consumption. The invention further includes a sensor-based water quality assurance module that continuously monitors pH, TDS, turbidity, and microbial indicators, enabling automated filtration and UV sterilisation control. An integrated IoT communication platform provides remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, fault detection, and performance analytics. The AI-AWG system significantly enhances efficiency, reliability, and sustainability compared with conventional atmospheric water generators, making it suitable for domestic, industrial, and remote-area water supply applications.

Patent_Title: AI-Integrated Urban Mobility and Environmental Risk Assessment System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Harshitha M | Vidyashree JC | Swetti Jha | H K Ramaraju | B R Manjunatha
Abstract: The invention provides an AI-Integrated Urban Mobility and Environmental Risk Assessment System that analyzes real-time traffic conditions and environmental factors to generate a unified Urban Risk Index (URI). By integrating mobility data (vehicle flow, congestion, pedestrian movement) with environmental parameters (air quality, noise, temperature), the system uses machine learning algorithms to identify risk zones, predict future hazards, and recommend mitigation strategies. The AI engine processes multi-source data, performs automated analysis, and delivers actionable insights through a geospatial interface for traffic authorities and city planners. The system improves decision-making by enabling proactive risk management, reducing congestion, and enhancing environmental and public safety. This invention supports smarter, safer, and more sustainable urban mobility planning.

Patent_Title: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SATELLITE IMAGE CLASSIFICATION AND WATER-DOMINANT IMAGE FILTERING FOR CUBESAT-BASED OCEAN MONITORING USING CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORKS (CNNs)
Applicant_Name: Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering | Vayuvya Raksha Systems Private Limited
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore-560111 | No 78, KSA Layout, Nagaraja Garden, J P Nagar Phase 5, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078
Inventor_Name: Dr Smitha Sasi | Dr Santhosh B | Dr Vindhya P Malagi | Shahedhadeennisa S | Dhanush D B
Abstract: The present invention discloses a deep learning-based system for classifying satellite images into multiple land-cover categories and determining composition percentages of natural elements, including land, ocean, desert, and cloud formations. The invention introduces a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture trained on multi-class satellite imagery to compute category-wise softmax probabilities, which are interpreted as composition percentages. These percentages are used to automatically identify and filter water-dominant images for transmission to a ground-station hyperspectral processing system. The invention enables intelligent onboard CubeSat image filtering, reduces bandwidth usage, and enhances the efficiency of remote sensing pipelines..

Patent_Title: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR GENERATING HYPERSPECTRAL IMAGERY (HSI) FROM RGB IMAGES USING GENERATIVE ADVERSARIAL NETWORKS (GANs)
Applicant_Name: Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering | Vayuvya Raksha Systems Private Limited
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore-560111 | No 78, KSA Layout, Nagaraja Garden, J P Nagar Phase 5, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078
Inventor_Name: Dr Smitha Sasi | Dr Santhosh B | Dr Vindhya P Malagi | Dr Reshma S | Dr. Anitha Suresh | Dr. Suresh Kumar M | Dhanush D B
Abstract: The present invention discloses a novel artificial intelligence-based system that converts conventional RGB (Red-Green-Blue) images into high-dimensional Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) representations using a specially designed Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) architecture. The invention comprises a robust dataset alignment mechanism that automatically resolves mismatches between RGB and HSI files, a custom paired dataset loader for hyperspectral training, a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based Generator that maps 3-channel RGB inputs to 13-channel hyperspectral outputs, and a Discriminator that validates spectral authenticity. The invention provides a cost-effective, scalable alternative to physical hyperspectral sensors by computationally synthesizing near-accurate hyperspectral signatures from conventional imagery. Applicable in remote sensing, precision agriculture, defense surveillance, disaster monitoring, and environmental analysis, this invention significantly reduces hardware costs while enabling large-scale hyperspectral data generation.

Patent_Title: A System and Method for Optimized Partitioning of Multi-Chip Modules (MCMs) in Spaceborne and Satellite Electronic Systems Using Population-Based Computational Techniques
Applicant_Name: Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering | Vayuvya Raksha Systems Private Limited
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore-560111 | No 78, KSA Layout, Nagaraja Garden, J P Nagar Phase 5, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078
Inventor_Name: Dr.Rajeswari P | Dr Smitha Sasi | Dhanush D B
Abstract: The system and procedure for optimal Multi-Chip Module (MCM) partitioning using population-based computational techniques is the subject of the current invention. By minimizing inter-chip communication, lowering routing complexity, and balancing chip utilization, the invention seeks to increase circuit partitioning efficiency. Several potential partition configurations are produced by the system, which then assesses them using optimization metrics. The suggested framework finds the ideal partitioning configuration for large-scale integrated circuits through iterative improvement. Partitioning strategies can be analyzed and compared using simulation environments like MATLAB. When compared to traditional partitioning methods, the suggested strategy increases performance and scalability. Advanced semiconductor packaging technologies, high-performance electronic systems, and VLSI design automation can all benefit from the invention.

Patent_Title: Cognitive Stress and Concept Gap Identifier via Eye Behaviour and Speech Patterns
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ms. Sai S Joshi | Ms. Vani N Dixit | Ms. Monicashree M | Ms. Spoorthi M | Ms. Preethi Lokesh | Ms. Girija R
Abstract: This Multimodal Behavioral Analytics System is used for Real-Time Detection of Cognitive Load and Conceptual Knowledge Gaps in a subject through synchronized analysis of eye-behavior metrics and speech patterns. The idea is to capture ocular dynamics including fixation duration, saccadic velocity, blink frequency, and pupil dilation variability, along with acoustic and linguistic speech features including pause distribution, prosodic modulation, articulation latency, and semantic coherence. When the multi-modal features are extracted, these are fused using a machine learning inference engine that is trained to model baseline cognitive profiles and detect deviations that indicate cognitive overload or conceptual misunderstanding. The system generates a Cognitive Stress Index (CSI) and a Concept Gap Score (CGS), enabling real-time adaptive feedback in educational, evaluative, training, therapeutic, or assessment environments. The invention improves early detection of misunderstanding prior to overt error manifestation and provides a scalable framework for behavioral-intelligence-driven human-computer interaction.

Patent_Title: Digital Twinning Methodology in Indian Railway for Safety Enhancement, Vehicle Performance, Prediction and Traffic Flow Optimization
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mahendra Kumar B
Abstract: The present invention provides a digital twin-based system for railway transportation that optimizes traffic flow, predicts vehicle performance, and enhances safety. The system utilizes IoT sensors, real-time data processing, AI-based models, and automated safety protocols. The traffic optimization module dynamically adjusts scheduling, while the predictive analytics module detects potential failures, preventing costly breakdowns. The safety module identifies hazards in real time, enhancing passenger safety. This invention offers a scalable and adaptable solution for modern railway networks, improving efficiency and reliability.

Patent_Title: AI-Based Non-Intrusive System and Method for Accurate Localization of Water Pipeline Leaks Using Distributed Vibration Time-of-Arrival Sensing
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Arpitha T | Dr. Annapurna D | Harini.P | Sai Likith | Charan S | Keerti Patil
Abstract: This invention introduces a smart, non-intrusive system that finds and pinpoints leaks in pressurized water pipelines. Traditional methods usually mean someone has to go out and inspect pipes by hand, monitor pressure, or-even worse-install devices inside the pipes. These ways are often slow, not all that accurate, and can lead to unnecessary digging and big bills. Here's how this new system works: it uses several vibration sensors that stick to the outside of the pipe, all linked together through an IoT network. When a leak breaks out, the escaping water creates vibration waves that travel along the pipe. Each sensor picks up these waves at slightly different times. By comparing when each sensor hears the leak, and using a machine learning model that keeps getting smarter with more data, the system zeroes in on the exact spot where the leak happened. No need to cut into the pipeline or stop the water. The system gives you a real-time location for the leak. That means less wasted water, lower maintenance costs, faster repairs, and more reliable monitoring. You can use this system in city water mains, industrial pipelines, or even irrigation setups on farms.

Patent_Title: System and Method for Interactive Digital Logic Simulation with Real-Time Boolean Synthesis and Automated Behavioral Assessment
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Shashank S | Dr. Annapurna D | Keerti Patil | Dr. Arpitha T | Saket Kumar | Peeyush | Mujtaba Shahid | Anupam Raj
Abstract: The present disclosure describes an interactive, web-based platform for the simulation and educational assessment of digital logic circuits. The system comprises a graphical user interface allowing users to construct circuits using standard logic gates, advanced combinational components, and input/output peripherals. A central feature of the invention is an automated assessment engine configured to validate user submissions against a "solution circuit" defined by an instructor. Unlike static image matching, the system utilizes a behavioral verification method: it dynamically generates a Truth Table by simulating the user's circuit across all binary input permutations and compares this against the solution's Truth Table. This allows for topology-agnostic grading, verifying logical correctness regardless of the specific wiring implementation. Further embodiments include a real-time algebraic synthesizer that converts circuit graphs into simplified Boolean expressions and a cloud-based management dashboard for curriculum delivery and progress tracking.

Patent_Title: Adaptive Constraint Timing Analysis of APB Design in 45nm Technology Node
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Madhura R | Dr Dinesha P
Abstract: The Advanced Peripheral Bus (APB), part of the AMBA protocol family developed by ARM, is commonly used for low-speed peripheral communication within System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures. This work presents the design, synthesis, and static timing analysis (STA) of an APB interface using the Cadence digital implementation flow. The APB controller was developed using Verilog HDL and functionally verified through simulation. Code coverage analysis was also performed, achieving an overall coverage of 92.44%, indicating high verification quality. The design was synthesized using the Cadence Genus tool with a standard-cell technology library. Before optimization, the reported a slack of 278ps and gate count of 33,153 gates. Post-optimization, the slack was improved to 0ps, and the gate count was reduced to 20,049 gates, reflecting significant area reduction. Additionally, power consumption was also optimized during synthesis. Static Timing Analysis was carried out using the Cadence Tempus tool to ensure robustness across process-voltage-temperature (PVT) corners. The STA results reported a setup slack of 2.499ns and a hold slack of 0.240ns, confirming the design meets all required timing constraints. This analysis also examined critical paths and slack distribution, demonstrating that synthesis optimizations significantly improve design timing. The overall results validate the functional correctness and timing reliability of the APB interface and highlight the effectiveness of Cadence tools in digital design workflows.

Patent_Title: Adaptive Five-Stage Charging with Temperature-Integrated Current Control for Lithium-Ion Batteries
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Deekshitha Arasa | Satish B A | Rachana M H | Dr Soni M | Ganesh G C | Syed Zohair Ammar | Sureshkumar Kaluram Choudhary | Supriya Nayak | Suraj Mukherjee
Abstract: An innovative head protection wearable device designed to prevent falls and accidental collisions for the special people. The device is neck-worn and utilizes a unique structure in the form of a honeycomb which when a threat is recognized will expand in volume to form a protective shield around the head whilst in normal usage is small in size; when the danger is no longer perceived. Such a construction of honeycombs guarantees reliability and stability and at the same time optimizes the effects of forces on the structure. A multifunctional device integrating several sensors - accelerometer detection, gyroscope, and pulse and temperature sensors together with GPS and GSM modules activates the functions of devise. The elements listed work together to monitor the user's environment and the user himself in order to detect any potential hazards. Its sensors detect, impact and trigger the device to deploy as an additional cushion for the head when a potential safety threat is predicted and imminent, thereby reducing possible harm. Simultaneously, it automatically interfaces with a proprietary web portal to alert caregivers and provide them with a real-time status report of the surroundings of the user in distress. The first wearable technology that incorporates protection within its own design while simultaneously initiating automated communications (alarms) with caregivers based on critically predicted imminent future problems.

Patent_Title: Adaptive Five-Stage Charging with Temperature-Integrated Current Control for Lithium-Ion Batteries
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Soni M | Dr. Suvetha P S | Kavitha K | Afroz Pasha
Abstract: The invention relates to an adaptive five-stage constant current charging system for lithium-ion batteries that integrates real-time temperature monitoring to optimize charging performance. The system comprises a programmable multi-stage current controller, temperature sensors, and an intelligent control unit configured to dynamically adjust the current level in each stage based on battery temperature. By modulating current according to thermal conditions, the system prevents overheating, mitigates lithium plating at low temperatures, and enhances battery safety and longevity. The invention further includes logic to delay or halt stage transitions if temperature thresholds are violated, thereby providing a more reliable and energy efficient charging process under variable environmental and operating conditions.

Patent_Title: Autonomous Self-Decision Water Quality Monitoring System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Prasad M. Pujar | Dr. Harish H. Kenchannavar
Abstract: This innovation introduces an autonomous Water Quality Monitoring framework where-in distributed sensor nodes cooperate to monitor environmental conditions, identify anomalies, and respond autonomously without human intervention. The system becomes autonomous by self-organizing, which lets sensors collaborate, adapt, and make decisions that are important in real time in changing environments. Supported by intelligent decision-making modules and diverse water quality sensors, the autonomous subsystem enhances situational awareness, improves surveyor confidence, and increases the overall effectiveness of monitoring operations. Autonomy serves as a key performance-driven, cross-cutting technology by facilitating continuous data acquisition, pattern extraction, and inference generation to guide responsive actions. The proposed WQM architecture employs a monitor-and-respond strategy that triggers system-level adaptation whenever anomalies are predicted, thereby strengthening reliability and operational efficiency.

Patent_Title: Biopolymer films from sugarcane bagasse, a green alternate for food packaging applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Hema Kumar Chandru | Dr. Priya Sampath | Ms. Bhoomika Javali Ravichandra | Ms. Namratha Badami | Ms. Shreya Tavarekere Satish | Ms. Vidhi Vikram Mandoth
Abstract: The rising environmental concerns associated with synthetic plastics, particularly their non-biodegradable nature, have driven the demand for sustainable and eco-friendly alternatives. In response, this study focuses on the development and characterization of a biopolymer film derived from sugarcane bagasse, an abundant agro-industrial waste. Bagasse presents an attractive raw material for biopolymer development due to its low cost, renewable nature, and potential for reducing waste. In this research, we explored the combination of carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and sugarcane bagasse fibers to develop biodegradable films. Various polymers, including polyvinyl alcohol (PVA), starch, sodium alginate, and natural gums like gum arabic, guar gum, and xanthan gum, were investigated to optimize the film's properties. After several trials, sodium alginate and guar gum proved to be the most effective polymer, resulting in a biopolymer film with enhanced mechanical strength, flexibility, and biodegradability. The biopolymer film exhibited promising results in terms of tensile strength, water vapor permeability, and thermal stability, making it suitable for use in food packaging applications. This novel material offers a viable alternative to conventional plastic packaging, contributing to environmental sustainability by reducing plastic waste and utilizing an otherwise discarded agro-waste product. Thus, the development of such biopolymer films holds significant promise for the food industry and supports broader efforts toward the creation of biodegradable packaging materials.

Patent_Title: Novel O=FeIV-Salophen/Nf@GCE sensor for enhanced sensitive and selective detection of S-aryl-L-Cysteines in clinical samples
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. P. Karuppasamy
Abstract: Highly sensitive and selective sensor was established for the detection of sulfur containing S-aryl-L-amino acids based on O=FeIV-Salophen complex immobilized with the help of nafion (Nf) binder on glassy carbon electrode (GCE). The developed O=FeIV-Salophen/Nf@GCE sensor showed an excellent sensitivity, selectivity and electrocatalytic performance towards S-phenyl-L-cysteine. O=FeIV-Salophen/Nf@GCE sensor showed an excellent selectivity for S-phenyl-L-cysteine in 0.05 M PBS solution at pH 7.2 containing 100-fold excess concentration of interferents. The wide-range of concentration (0.2 μM-200 μM) was used and the limit of detection was achieved to be 0.062 μM and 0.076 (S/N = 3). The developed sensor delivered an excellent stability, reproducibility, and recovery results (98.7-100.1 %) while detecting S-phenyl-L-cysteine in the spiked clinical samples such blood serum, blood and urine samples.

Patent_Title: Method for catalytically degrading diverse pollutants with Y doped La2CuO4 perovskite material
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Arpita Paul Chowdhury | Dr. Anantharaju K. S | Dr Vidya Y S | Aishwarya A | Dr. Surendra B S
Abstract: One of the most important areas of research for cutting-edge water treatment technologies is the creation of effective perovskite photocatalysts. This study used a simple precipitation method to synthesis Y-doped La2CuO4 perovskite photocatalysts. The detailed analysis showed that the addition of Y ions to the La2CuO4 lattice considerably altered the material characteristics and which improved its photocatalytic degradation efficiency. SEM and XRD authenticated the formation of the material. The photocatalyst showed good efficiency for degrading mixture of dyes (Orange G and Brilliant green) and an antibiotic (Tetracycline). The degradation efficiency of 90% (k = 0.012 min−1), was observed. The photodegradation process is consistent with a pseudo-first-order model, according to kinetic studies. Additionally, the photocatalyst did not significantly lose activity over the consecutive cycles, maintaining outstanding stability and reusability. The results highlighted the efficacy of Y doped La2CuO4 material as a strong photocatalyst for environmental cleanup.

Patent_Title: Method for Preparation of Self-Fenton Mg/Fe Co-doped Bi2WO6 nanocatalyst and application thereof
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Anantharaju K. S | Dr. Arpita Paul Chowdhury | Dr Vidya Y S | Aishwarya A
Abstract: Organic contaminants such as dyes contribute to environmental contamination and are a major hazard to aquatic ecosystems and public health. The particular needs of the customers may be the reason for this extensive use. An estimated 200,000 tons of dyes are used annually in the textile industry, according to prior research. These toxic dyes were discharged into wastewater without being adequately processed. The dyes are having enormous molecular weight and intricate chemical structures. The toxicity, longevity, and resistance to traditional wastewater treatment techniques of the synthetic dyes are a point of concern. The dyes are frequently distinguished by their large molecular weight and complex molecular structures. In this regard, heterogeneous catalysis has attracted particular attention due to its efficiency and ease of usage. Aurivillius oxides, bismuth tungstate (Bi2WO6), with a narrow band , has drawn a lot of interest because of its high photocatalytic activity under visible light, excellent stability, cost-effectiveness, and effective electron transfer properties. In the current investigation, Bi2WO6 and Mg/Fe Co-doped Bi2WO6 doped fenton catalyst is prepared by low temperature solution combustion method and tested for dye mixture elimination under visible light irradiation. The structure, and morphology of Mg/Fe Co-doped Bi2WO6 are analyzed XRD and SEM which is discussed. When exposed to light, the nanohybrid demonstrated exceptional photocatalytic activity for the photodegradation of dye mixtures, degrading 89.3% of dyes. It is anticipated that of Mg/Fe Co-doped Bi2WO6 nanohybrid is expected to be used as photocatalyst for environmental cleanup.

Patent_Title: Application of binary novel Ag3PO4/NiCu2O4 composite for advanced treatment of antibiotics
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Aishwarya A | Dr. Anantharaju K. S | Dr. Arpita Paul Chowdhury | Dr Vidya Y S
Abstract: Co-precipitation-assisted synthesis of Ag3PO4/NiCu2O4 composites was achieved. Ag3PO4 composites with varying weight percentages of NiCu2O4 were prepared in order to determine the ideal ratio of the Ag3PO4 and NiCu2O4 phases for improved photocatalytic properties. The prepared composites morphological, structural, and elemental analysis were investigated. Using the composite, about 70% of amoxicillin was broken down in 90 minutes. The investigations' findings show that Ag3PO4/NiCu2O4 is a promising catalyst material driven by visible light. The composite might be utilized as a possible catalyst material for the efficient removal of antibiotic pollutants in waste water because of its exceptional effectiveness.

Patent_Title: Eco-Friendly Nano-fertilizer Based on Biogenic Carbon Dots for Enhanced Growth of Green Gram Plants
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Smrithi S P | Ms. Sanjana R | Dr. Vinuta Kamat
Abstract: The present invention deals with a bio-friendly nano-fertilizer consisting of biogenic Carbon Dots synthesized from the medicinal plant Aegle marmelos through a hydrothermal approach. The synthesized CDs were characterized by UV-Visible spectroscopy, Photoluminescence, FTIR, and HRTEM analysis, confirming their nanoscale size and functional groups beneficial for plant uptake. Application of the CDs in optimized concentrations resulted in significant improvement in germination, growth rate, photosynthetic performance, and stress resistance in Vigna radiata (green gram). An optimum concentration of 80 mg/L was found to be the most effective for maximum growth enhancement. Considering their low cost, nontoxic nature, high biocompatibility, and the ability to enhance plant growth efficiency, these biogenic CDs stand as a viable alternative to chemical fertilizers

Patent_Title: A process for developing Zirconium doped cadmium oxide with Graphite for electrochemical sensing of mercury (Hg22) heavy metal ion
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Surendra B S | Dr. Chetana M V | Dr. Naveen Kumar A | Dr. Bhaskar M | Basavaraju N | Dr. Arpita Paul Chowdhury
Abstract: The proposed Zr-CdO NPs has been prepared by a cost-effective combustion method using bio-assisted (Tulasi extract) fuel. This NPs has lower particle size, band gap energy, and higher surface area, working for electrochemical sensing activities. The developed Zr-CdO-graphite paste electrode was effectively employed for detection of mercury (Hg22+) heavy metal ion in acidic electrolyte. The proposed Zr-CdO NPs showed an excellent electrochemical sensing action on heavy metal Hg22+ ions at 1-5 mM scan rate in 0.1 M KCl. The emerging selective electrochemical detection of mercury (Hg22+) heavy metal ion present in acidic electrolyte investigated by using immobilized Zr-CdO-graphite working electrode at scan rate of 1-5 mV/s. The modified Zr-CdO-graphite working electrode diagnose the electron transfer reactions and displayed a highly selective detection confirmed by the evidence of redox potential peaks at -0.62V, -0.83 & 0.19 V with increments of 1-5 mM mercuric 4concentrations in 0.1M KCl electrolyte at scan rate of 3 mV/s. This electrochemical sensing studies offers a higher sensitivity and selectivity of different toxic components using nano-structured materials.

Patent_Title: A Rectangular Microstrip Antenna with Enhanced Bandwidth for Satellite Communication in Ku band
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: G. Revanasiddesh Patil | Dr. Naveen S M | Dr. Aruna P | Dr. Joseph C M | Mr. Ravikumar S | Dr. Trupti Tagare | Dr. Shobha K R
Abstract: The rectangular shaped Printed Microstrip Antenna is a type of Trans receiving antenna where the radiating patch is on the FR4 dielectric substrate of thickness 1.6 mm and having a dielectric constant of 4.4. The proposed antenna substrate has the dimensions of length, width and thickness of 70 mm x 70 mm x 1.6 mm respectively. This antenna is simulated using a High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) Software. From the simulated return loss characteristics, a bandwidth of 11.7 GHz to 20 GHz was observed. The Ku band spans from 12GHz to 18GHz. Hence this antenna can be used for satellite communication applications.

Patent_Title: Preparation of sustainable, bioactive hydroxyapatite (HAp) from Tilapia fish scales and their applications in anticancer therapeutics
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Madhu A | Dr Srinatha N | Dr Gara Dheeraj Kumar | Dr Pradeep H N | Manjunatha T | Yasrib Qurishi | Venkatesh Prasad V | Alen Paul | Ullas | Anisha Mandal
Abstract: Sea waste management has been a global problem, as it causes environmental pollution when discarded or landfilled. To tackle this global issue, we have developed an alternative bio-waste-mediated preparation of hydroxyapatite (HAp) using sea waste from Tilapia fish. In the present investigation, the Tilapia fish scales were systematically processed, which includes washing, cleaning, crushing and thermal treatment. The prepared HAp was studied through XRD, SEM-EDS, and FTIR spectroscopic techniques to investigate its structural, microstructural, and compositional properties. The results reveal that the Ca/P is found to be 1.62 - 1.70. The prepared Hap have demonstrated significant, notable cytotoxic activity against lung cancer cell line (A549) cells, with a lower IC50 value of 62.01 μg/mL.

Patent_Title: Advanced material design: Investigating Actinides via first principle electronic structure calculation and modeling
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Namrata Yaduvanshi
Abstract: The present invention relates to a computational approach for predicting and optimizing the structural and electronic behavior of actinide-pnictide compounds (AnPn; An = Np, Pu, Am, Cm; Pn = N, P, As, Sb, Bi) under ambient and high-pressure conditions. The invention employs a specially designed first-principles simulation framework that integrates density functional theory with a projector-augmented wave methodology to accurately determine lattice parameters, elastic constants, bulk modulus, and phase stability. A core inventive feature of this method is the dual-state electronic evaluation, wherein the 5f electrons are selectively treated both as valence and non-valence states to precisely quantify the localization-delocalization transition that governs the mechanical and electronic behavior of these compounds. Using this framework, the invention enables the prediction of a first-order structural phase transition from the NaCl (B1) to the CsCl (B2) configuration, together with quantifiable volume collapse, pressure threshold, and mechanical stability indices. The outcomes offer a scalable predictive tool for tailoring actinide-pnictides for industrial and strategic applications. The invention further enables targeted development of advanced materials for superconducting systems, nuclear fuel matrices, high-performance electronic devices, catalytic platforms, and magnetic components.

Patent_Title: AI-Based Validation System for Orthodontic Braces Placement
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Kruthika S | Nishevithaa Gayatri T S | Shreya Subodha | Dr N.Sriraam | Dr. Prajwal Prabhu
Abstract: The invention provides an automated Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered system for validating the placement of orthodontic braces on dental arches. Traditional braces placement relies heavily on clinician expertise, which introduces subjectivity, inconsistency, and potential alignment errors. This invention utilizes deep learning-based segmentation, landmark detection, and rule-based orthodontic measurement algorithms to analyze dental radiographs or images and verify whether each bracket is placed at the optimal height, angulation, and mesiodistal position according to orthodontic standards. The system consists of an image acquisition module, an AI segmentation engine, an orthodontic measurement engine, and a validation and reporting module. The invention helps clinicians achieve uniformity, reduces human error, enables real-time feedback during bracket bonding, and enhances treatment outcomes. The solution is low-cost, easy to deploy in clinical settings, and suitable for training institutions as well.

Patent_Title: Deterministic Multi-Hop Quantum State Distribution via Quantum Router with Fidelity-Weighted Entanglement Routing Table
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Seema Aparaj | Dr. R Jayanthi | Dr. Pavithra G Shetty | Prof. Raksha Kondad R | Dr. Samitha Khaiyum
Abstract: Deterministic multi-hop quantum state distribution is made possible by a quantum router with a fidelity-weighted entanglement routing table, which dynamically chooses the best routes based on entanglement fidelity throughout a quantum network. Such a router, which makes use of sophisticated routing protocols, gives high-fidelity entanglement flows priority, guaranteeing the reliable and scalable distribution of multipartite quantum states, such Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states, even in the face of channel loss and network flaws. Compared to conventional single-path or non-fidelity-aware methods, the router delivers notable gains in distribution rate and end-to-end fidelity by combining fidelity-aware multipath routing with purification techniques. This architecture paves the way for useful, high-performance quantum networks supporting secure communication, distributed quantum computation, and quantum-enhanced sensing applications. It also supports automatic, decentralized routing decisions and is compatible with existing photonic and quantum memory technologies.

Patent_Title: Adaptive Variable-Geometry Mechanical Damping System with Mathematical Force-Response Modelling
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Geetha N K | Dr. S. Madhankumar
Abstract: The current invention reveals a variable-geometry mechanism-based adaptive mechanical damping system to control damping force according to the applied loads and displacement conditions. The proposed system is changeable as compared to traditional passive dampers that have a fixed nature, which means that the effective damping coefficient can be changed by geometric transformation of mechanical elements under control. A mathematical model is created to explain the relationship between applied load, movement, velocity, and resultant damping force. The invention allows better vibration suppression, energy dissipation, and structural stability to be achieved over the range of operating conditions, and it can be applied in automotive suspension systems, machinery isolation platforms, and structural vibration control.

Patent_Title: AI-Powered Reading Support for Dyslexia
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Rajeshwari J | Vidya G. Byakod | Rekha Jayaram | Dr. Latha A P | Bindu Bhargavi S M | Akash G S | Arun B Y | Anil Kumar V Kali | Himanshu B A
Abstract: The ability to read is a fundamental skill for all education, but for a large number of children, particularly those with learning disabilities such as dyslexia, it can be a source of great frustration. This problem is often accentuated by a lack of proper educational technology: the standard tools adopted are often unable to grasp the nuances of the child's individual needs, especially the regional accents, and thus become one-size-fits-all. If a tool is constantly misunderstanding a child's pronunciation, it might incorrectly label a rightly pronounced word as an error, which lowers the child's confidence and willingness to practice. At the same time, parents are on the lookout to support their kids but generally do not have precise information on what particular area the child finds difficult. EduVoice will fill this particular gap. EduVoice is an online, compassionate guided reading solution based on parent-child cooperation. The application creates a shared space where both parents and children have different but linked roles: parents are the ones who support, and through a digital dashboard, they can see clear, actionable analytics on their child's reading speed, accuracy, and common challenges areas; thus, helping them to set up a Weekly Reading Plan, whereby they assign specific texts for their child to practice. For the child, EduVoice provides an interesting and accepting reading situation. As they are reading aloud into a microphone, they see word-by-word highlighting that is done in real-time. Core to this system is an accent-aware AI engine. We are fine-tuning a speech recognition model specifically on the Mozilla Common Voice dataset to make it understand Indian English accents and hence give fair and accurate feedback.

Patent_Title: A Unified, AI-Powered Smart Ecosystem for Holistic Pet Care, Monitoring, and Proactive Wellness Management
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Vaidehi M | Aman Agarwal
Abstract: The present invention relates to a holistic, artificially intelligent-powered smart ecosystem for proactive pet care and is designed to address the inefficiencies related to fragmented management. The system includes a Smart Wearable Apparatus (Harness/Collar), configured for continuous collection of real-time biometric data, such as heart rate and body temperature; a Smart Feeder Apparatus, designed for automated dispensing and consumption tracking via weight sensors, further integrating an in-situ UV-C light source for disinfection and a tongue-pressure sensor for hygienic liquid release; and a Centralized Digital Platform synchronized with a Mobile Software Application. The Centralized Platform runs proprietary AI models, most importantly the Integrated Metabolic Feedback Loop, which dynamically alters the portion size from the Smart Feeder based on real-time energy expenditure data received from the Smart Wearable worn by the pet. The platform further makes use of models such as Vital Anomaly Detection through biometrics and Behavioural Anomaly Detection via camera vision to detect health deviations before symptoms manifest. This predictive power allows the system to create and send Proactive Health Alerts to the pet owner's mobile application for immediate Telehealth triage or veterinary appointment scheduling by leveraging the pet's live and historical data. This sets up a holistic, auto-correcting feedback system and brings complete transformation to pet care-from mere reactive management to continuous, data-driven wellness optimization.

Patent_Title: An Agentic AI System for Intelligent Clinical Assistance via LLMs, RAG, and Medical Imaging
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Chandrakala B M | Dr. RESHMA J | Dr. Latha Anuj | Dr. Madhura J | Keerthi B | Anusha R | Sai Bhargava S | Mrs. Shalini K B
Abstract: This invention presents a Multi-Agent Medical Assistant designed to enhance healthcare delivery by integrating advanced AI capabilities into real clinical workflows. The system performs medical imaging analysis, retrieves relevant insights from research literature, and executes diagnosis-support tasks using a coordinated multi agent architecture. It incorporates real-time web research and RAG-based knowledge retrieval to ensure responses remain accurate, current, and context-aware. Voice-interaction capabilities make the system intuitive for healthcare professionals, while safety modules such as human-in-the-loop verification and confidence-based validation help ensure reliable outcomes. The project emphasizes practical usability, enabling clinicians to quickly access evidence-driven insights, reduce diagnostic delays, and strengthen decision-making in time-critical scenarios. By bridging cutting-edge AI innovations with everyday clinical needs, aims to improve diagnostic accuracy, streamline workflows, and support more informed patient care.

Patent_Title: Adaptive Intelligence in Web Security Testing
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Yuktha P S | Varsha H | Spoorthi Gowda U | Dr. Santosh Anand
Abstract: This invention focuses on AI-driven tool that can handle web security tests on its own, requiring little human intervention. Instead of relying on old-style scanners, it seeks to spot flaws more accurately, reduce false alarms, and work better with today's fast-changing websites. It combines several smart parts - like website navigation, creating test inputs, adjusting attacks based on responses, confirming exploits, and organizing results. As it runs, the system finds app entry points, checks where data flows in, and then sends tailored probes to catch issues such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, command execution, or unsafe file uploads. Inside the setup sits an AI-powered tool that generates smart test inputs by studying how the app works and what it asks for, then watching how the server replies. Testing moves forward while the fuzzer checks live clues - like page codes, echoed data, detailed errors, slow responses, or odd shifts in behavior. These signals help reshape the next rounds of tests on the fly, so the system learns as it goes, as a human hacker would. A built-in checker proves hacks work by spotting signs such as altered replies, login-related failures, or echoes of injected code. On top of that, every check happens in a locked-down space where access is cleared in advance, keeping real websites safe from downtime during active trials.

Patent_Title: Advanced IoT Smart Power Strip with Secure Logging, AI Analytics, and Contactless Control
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Shashank S | Dr Annapurna D | Arpitha T | Keerti Patil | Aditi Rani | S.V. Srinidhi Reddy
Abstract: The present invention covers an intelligent Internet of Things-enabled smart power strip, including blockchain-secured energy logging, AI-based appliance identification, CO2-aware energy optimisation, and contactless gesture-voice control. It includes an ESP32 microcontroller, multi-sensor modules, the current and voltage monitoring circuits, a relay switching unit, gesture and voice recognition sensors, and an AI analytics engine. Energy usage data are stored on a tamper-resistant blockchain ledger, ensuring data integrity and traceability. A machine learning module, acting in a native role for appliance classification according to electrical signatures, is built to predict energy usage patterns for personalised optimisation. The system computes the carbon footprint in real time, thereby providing strategies for reduction. Gesture and voice control enable contactless switching, enhancing safety in wet or hazardous environments. The invention greatly improves energy management, safety, and reliability related to conventional smart power strips.

Patent_Title: Decentralized System and Method for Lifecycle Governance of Carbon Assets via Smart Contracts and Cryptographic Verification
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Laksh Pankajkumar Singhvi | Sarvagya Chaturvedi | Tanishq Khetwal | Keerti Patil | Arpitha T | Prof. Shashank S
Abstract: The present disclosure describes a unified decentralized application (DApp) architecture designed to digitize and automate the carbon credit market. Unlike traditional systems that rely on manual paperwork and centralized intermediaries, this solution utilizes a hybrid approach combining blockchain-based smart contracts with an off-chain database (e.g., MongoDB). The system integrates Web3 wallets (e.g., MetaMask) for cryptographic identity management, allowing users to calculate emissions and trade credits peer-to-peer. Furthermore, the infrastructure supports optional interoperability with IoT hardware oracles to validate emission reductions in real-time. By enforcing token retirement on a distributed ledger, the invention mathematically prevents the double-counting of environmental offsets. In short, this project shows how blockchain can help build a fairer and more efficient carbon credit system, one that's ready for the challenges of fighting climate change in the digital age.

Patent_Title: GATE DRIVER BOARD FOR MOSFETs OR IGBTs
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Jami Rajesh | Nakka Jayaram | Pulavarthi Satya Venkata Kishore
Abstract: This Gate driver board (100) elaborates the structure and analysis of a novel gate driver circuit for an application of topologies used in a Multi-Level Inverter (MLI) using MOSFETs or IGBTs. The proposed driver circuit contains four switches along with their driver circuits. This driver circuit also has a good protection system using TLP250 optocouplers. The isolation (102) is provided from the controller circuit to the entire gate driver circuit board. A dead band circuit (104) is provided to avoid the shoot-through problem. Separate input supplies are provided to all the TLP250 optocouplers used in the MOSFET driver using an isolated DC supply (109). The input voltage to the buffer, deadband, and complementary circuit is fed through a regulated power supply (108). Separate transformers are used for stepping down the voltage to the rectifier circuits.

Patent_Title: System and Method for Automated Egg Quality Inspection
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Dr. Pavithra G | Nirmala Y N | Michelle David | Aman Kumar | Lalit Yadav SM | Prof. Padmavathi M | Dr. Naveen S M | Dr. Aruna P | Dr. Ramya R S
Abstract: EggSense is a fully automated, and cost-effective IoT-based system designed to revolutionize egg quality monitoring by integrating infrared (IR) spectroscopy, advanced image processing, and cloud-based analytics. Traditional egg inspection methods, such as manual candling and visual grading, are prone to human error and lack precision, while industrial solutions are expensive and inaccessible to small-scale farmers and consumers. The system features a multi-microcontroller architecture, where an Arduino is responsible for infrared-based protein content analysis and transmits data via serial communication to an ESP32, which processes and uploads all readings to Thinger.io, an IoT cloud platform for real-time monitoring. Additionally, an ESP32-CAM captures high-resolution images of eggs to perform external defect detection and structural integrity analysis. A stepper motor-driven rotational platform ensures 360-degree scanning, allowing a comprehensive evaluation of internal composition and surface integrity. The infrared sensing module assesses the egg's protein content and structural integrity, while computer vision algorithms (grayscale conversion, edge detection, contour analysis, and texture mapping) analyze cracks, deformations, and irregularities. The ESP32 ensures seamless data transmission, allowing users to remotely access detailed egg quality reports. EggSense is scalable for industrial applications yet affordable for household use, helping reduce food waste, improve food safety, and enhance supply chain transparency. Future extensions include AI-powered predictive analytics for egg freshness estimation and contamination risk assessment. With its ability to revolutionize quality control in the egg industry, EggSense is positioned as a patentable, disruptive innovation in food technology and precision agriculture.

Patent_Title: REAL TIME AUCTION MONITORING STICK
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr G Manikanta | Dr Anubhav Kumar Pandey | Dr Sumana S | TARUN | VIKAS GOWDA N S | VINAY G M | Dr Priyanshu Kumar | Dr Supriya J
Abstract: This invention presents an innovative bidding system that leverages sensor technology to accurately detect and respond to participant actions during an auction. Each bidder is provided with a stick embedded with a sensor, which activates once the stick is raised to a specific angle-signalling an intent to place a bid. This motion automatically triggers an LED or bulb indicator, providing a clear and immediate visual cue to the auctioneer. By removing the need for constant manual monitoring, this system ensures fair, consistent, and easily recognizable bid recognition. The design is both straightforward and cost-effective, making it accessible while maintaining reliability. Additionally, it opens the door for integration with microcontrollers, allowing for real-time data tracking and potential future enhancements. This not only streamlines the auction process but also helps maintain an organized and transparent environment, contributing to smoother and more efficient auction management.

Patent_Title: A Smart Automated Restroom Infrastructure
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Dr. Pavithra G | Apoorva N K | Janani Shashi Kumar | Krutika S Ganpur | Sneha Chatter
Abstract: We propose a Smart Restroom System to enhance safety, hygiene, and user independence, particularly for elderly and differently abled individuals. The system enables fall detection, real-time monitoring of environmental and hygiene conditions, automated restroom operations, and emergency alerts. It integrates vibration and motion sensors for fall detection, ammonia and air-quality sensors for hygiene monitoring, and a BME280 sensor to measure temperature, humidity, and pressure. Automated features such as adjustable seating, motorized doors, and self-flushing mechanisms are supported by IoT-based data transmission and alert systems. Prototype testing demonstrates reliable fall detection, accurate monitoring, and responsive automation. Real-time alerts ensure timely assistance, while smart control of lighting, ventilation, and water usage promotes resource efficiency. The system improves safety, operational efficiency, and user comfort, with applications in homes, hospitals, care centers, and public restrooms, offering a scalable and cost-effective solution.

Patent_Title: A Hardware-Efficient RTL-Based System and Method for Implementing a SPECK Lightweight Block Cipher
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Pavithra G | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Varshith Raj C.R | Varun Raj C. R
Abstract: We present the hardware-efficient simulation and RTL-based implementation of the lightweight block cipher SPECK using Verilog. The SPECK algorithm, developed by the NSA, is optimized for performance in resource-constrained environments such as IoT devices. The design focuses on the SPECK 64/96 variant, which operates on 64-bit plaintext blocks and uses a 96-bit key. The cipher's core operations-modular addition, bitwise rotation, and XOR-are implemented in hardware to achieve efficient encryption and decryption. A modular RTL design is developed, consisting of three main components: the round function, the key scheduler, and the encryption controller. The key schedule generates 27 round keys from the 96-bit master key, and the round function applies these keys to process the plaintext in each round. The design is optimized for hardware implementation, ensuring low resource utilization while maintaining cryptographic security. Simulation is carried out using ModelSim to validate the functional correctness of the individual modules. Testbenches are created for both key expansion and round functions, with known input-output pairs to verify proper functionality. Post-synthesis analysis ensures the design meets both area and timing constraints, with performance metrics such as throughput and latency evaluated to assess real-time feasibility. The design is verified under various test scenarios, demonstrating that the SPECK cipher can be efficiently mapped onto hardware while ensuring robust cryptographic security. The simplicity of the algorithm allows for low resource consumption and high performance, making it a practical solution for hardware-based cryptographic systems in IoT and other constrained devices.

Patent_Title: A Wireless Braille-Based Assistive Communication System and Method with Multimodal Tactile, Visual, and Auditory Feedback for Individuals with Visual and Speech Impairments
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Dr. Pavithra G | Prof. Padmavathi M | Aishwarya B | Bhavana S | Chaithra N | Chandana M | Dr. Akshatha Prasanna | Dr. Namrata Yaduvanshi | Anjana Joshi
Abstract: The present invention relates to an assistive communication system designed to facilitate effective interaction for individuals with visual and/or speech impairments. The system addresses limitations of existing assistive technologies, which often require costly specialized equipment or continuous human assistance. The proposed solution comprises a cost-effective Braille-based input and output interface integrated with tactile, visual, and auditory feedback mechanisms. The system includes a transmitter unit configured to capture Braille inputs and a receiver unit configured to interpret and convey corresponding information through wireless communication. Feedback elements such as light-emitting diodes (LEDs), buzzers, and servo-based actuation are employed to enhance user awareness and interaction.
