The architecture incorporates both hardware and software components designed to support reliable data acquisition, processing, and transmission. By enabling tactile and wireless communication in an intuitive and accessible manner, the invention enhances inclusivity, promotes user independence, and supports communication in educational, personal, and information-access environments. The system further allows for scalability and future enhancements to broaden its applicability across diverse assistive technology use cases.

Patent_Title: Context-Adaptive Mobile Charging System Using Cable Signature Fingerprinting for Failure Prediction and Adaptive Charging Control
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Pallavi Kulkarni | Padmavathi S | Dr. Tripti R Kulkarni | Dr. Dilip Kumar Jang Bahadur Saini
Abstract: The present invention relates to a Context-Adaptive Mobile Charging System that utilizes Cable Signature Fingerprinting (CSF) to authenticate charging cables, predict cable degradation, and adapt charging behaviour dynamically. The system generates a multidimensional CSF by measuring electrical, thermal, and signal characteristics of the cable, including multi-frequency impedance, voltage-current transient responses, connector resistance, thermal dissipation, and signal noise patterns. A drift analysis engine monitors changes in the CSF over time to detect cable aging, micro-damage, or counterfeit replacement. A predictive failure engine estimates cable health and risk of failure, while an adaptive charging controller adjusts charging current and voltage based on the cable's condition, thereby improving safety, preventing battery damage, and extending battery and cable life. The system also provides user alerts regarding unsafe or degraded cables and logs cable health history for informed usage.

Patent_Title: Decoy-Based Security Layer for Mobile Banking Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Padmavathi S | Dr. Mohammed Tajuddin | Kavya A | Sahana M P
Abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for enhancing mobile banking security through a dynamic decoy environment. Upon detecting suspicious or fraudulent activity, the application diverts the attacker to a simulated banking interface that mimics real balances, OTPs, and transactions without granting access to actual user data. The invention ensures real user accounts remain secure while logging attacker activities for forensic analysis.

Patent_Title: AI-Enabled Smart Conflict-Free Pedestrian Signal Control System with Dynamic Phase Optimization
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Vidyashree J C | Swetti Jha | Harshitha M | Dr. R Shanthi V | Dr. H K Ramaraju | Dr. B R Manjunath
Abstract: The invention discloses an AI-enabled Smart Conflict-Free Pedestrian Signal Control System designed to enhance pedestrian safety and optimize traffic movement at urban intersections. The system integrates artificial intelligence, multi-sensor data fusion, and adaptive signal timing to predict and prevent pedestrian-vehicle conflicts before they occur. A real-time Conflict Risk Index (CRI) is computed using pedestrian density, vehicle speed, turning movements, and environmental factors. When the CRI exceeds a predefined threshold, the system automatically activates a dynamic pedestrian-only signal phase, including an all-direction scramble crossing if required. The system continually learns from historical traffic patterns, thereby improving prediction accuracy and optimizing signal cycles over time. By proactively managing conflict zones and ensuring safe, efficient crossing intervals, the invention significantly reduces accident risks, enhances traffic flow, and supports intelligent transportation infrastructure.

Patent_Title: DUAL-ACTION PLANT-DERIVED WATER TREATMENT COMPOSITION SYSTEM FOR TURBIDITY CONTROL AND TRACE METALLIC POLLUTANT REMOVAL
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Raghavendra H N | Raghavendra Prajwal H S | Sanjeev T P | Ashwini Sathynarayana | Dr. Geetha L
Abstract: A plant-derived dual-function water treatment system based on Allium cepa seed extract is disclosed for the concurrent attenuation of colloidal turbidity and dissolved transition metal contaminants in surface waters. The formulation is obtained via salt-assisted aqueous extraction of pulverized onion seeds, yielding a bioactive matrix enriched with organosulfur moieties, flavonoids, and ionizable functional groups capable of mediating charge-neutralization-driven flocculation and coordination-based metal sequestration. Under controlled dosage and contact regimes, the extract induces rapid agglomeration of suspended particulates while facilitating high-affinity adsorption and chelation of Cu2+, Zn2+, and Fe2+/Fe3+ ions through synergistic thiol, disulfide, and polyphenolic binding pathways. Process implementation demonstrates substantial turbidity suppression in highly turbid matrices alongside selective heavy-metal removal efficiencies approaching quantitative levels for copper and zinc. The system exhibits modest perturbation of bulk water conductivity and pH relative to conventional inorganic coagulants, indicating reduced secondary salinity loading. Owing to its renewable origin, low-temperature extraction, and integrated coagulation-biosorption functionality, the disclosed onion seed-derived treatment platform presents a scalable, environmentally compatible alternative for decentralized and centralized surface water purification.

Patent_Title: ENGINEERED METALLURGICAL-BYPRODUCT FILTRATION SYSTEM FOR HIGH-EFFICIENCY MICROBIAL ATTENUATION IN STORMWATER RUNOFF
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ashwini Sathynarayana | Dr. Geetha L | Raghavendra H N | Raghavendra Prajwal H S | Vibhashree N | Sanjeev T P
Abstract: A modular, flow-through stormwater treatment system employs a reactive filtration medium composed of graded steel production byproducts, including steel furnace slag and steel mill scales, packed within sectioned containment modules and hydraulically distributed by perforated stainless steel weirs to remove microbial pathogens and phosphate under variable runoff conditions. The medium presents iron, calcium, and aluminum-bearing surfaces that promote microbial attachment and inactivation and facilitate phosphate adsorption and co-precipitation, while the mixed morphology sustains porosity and minimizes mills agglomeration at short contact times. The architecture includes inlet riprap pre-screening, staged filtration sections with freeboard to prevent bypass, and effluent management with monitoring ports, maintaining a residence time on the order of minutes at base flow and robust performance at elevated flows. Representative performance includes sustained E. coli reductions around the 30-40% range and phosphate reductions exceeding 52% across storm events, while constraining dissolved iron increases to hundredths of milligrams per liter and maintaining effluent iron below secondary standards. The system integrates low-energy operation, compact footprint at outfalls, and maintenance-accessible media surfaces, enabling durable pathogen and nutrient attenuation in urban stormwater conveyances and detention pond outlets.

Patent_Title: Indian Rainfall Prediction Using Variational Quantum Circuits
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ramya R S | Dr. Samyama Gunjal G H | Dr. Pavithra G | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Amith Kumar A | Abhinava P | Akash Naik | Akash L
Abstract: The invention presents a hybrid quantum-classical framework for Indian rainfall prediction using real-world meteorological data and variational quantum circuits. Large-scale weather observations collected from multiple regions across India are processed using classical preprocessing and dimensionality reduction techniques, followed by quantum machine learning-based classification. Principal Component Analysis is employed to compress high-dimensional meteorological features into a quantum-compatible representation, which is then encoded into a multi-qubit variational quantum classifier. The system performs rainfall intensity classification into low, medium, and high categories while enabling comparative evaluation against classical machine learning models. The framework establishes realistic performance baselines for quantum machine learning in meteorology and supports future scalability as quantum hardware advances.

Patent_Title: Quantum-Integrated Multi-Layer Feature Fusion System for High-Accuracy Pest Classification Using Adaptive Quantum Kernel Mapping
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ramya R S | Dr. Samyama Gunjal G H | Dr. Anusha Preetham | Dr. Pavithra G | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Akash Ashok Nayak | Guruprasad Rachayya Hiremath
Abstract: In modern farming practices it is necessary to detect the pests at the initial stages of the crop growth to avoid the spoilage of the forthcoming harvest. The main challenges included in the pest detection are overcoming similarity features between particular pests and complexity in the natural backgrounds. Various AIML models have been implemented so far but the major hindrance is that they lack certain computational power which cannot be used on low power agricultural devices. This research introduces a new technique to detect the pests by using the QSVC (quantum support vector classification) with a new adaptive multilayer quantum feature system (AML-QFF) concepts of quantum computing. For quantum feature encoding this approach uses hierarchical variational circuits which leads to richer representations in the Hilbert space, emphasizing the textural variations and shapes of the pest. The data used here is the Pestopia data set and approach proposed performs way far better than that of the various AIML models implemented until now. The proposed solutions combines AML-QFF with QSVC to detect and predict the agricultural pests.

Patent_Title: A Knowledge-Driven Ontology-Integrated DETR Architecture for Human-Object Interaction Recognition
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Rashmi S R | Dr. Anusha Preetham | C Manasa
Abstract: This invention reveals a Detection Transformer supported model with a Knowledge driven Ontology Layer to Human Object Interaction (HOI) recognition. The system combines both convolutional transformer hybrid model with knowledge driven ontology model to enhance accuracy and flexibility of HOI detection. First, feature extraction and transformer layers are used to process first video frames to recognize humans, objects and their interactions. The identified entities and their interactions are then mapped into a domain ontology in which a semantic knowledge and rule-based inferences are implemented as description logic and SWRL rules. This ontology-based reasoning allows higher level interpretations that were overlooked in the former step. The algorithm eliminates the reliance on huge training data that is annotated. This also makes sure that there is explainable decision making and generalization between domains. Video surveillance, Robotics, autonomous systems, AR/VR, human-computer interaction and healthcare monitoring are general applications.

Patent_Title: A novel and sustainable method for preparing bioactive chitosan from shrimp shell waste
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Madhu A | Dr Srinatha N | Dr Pradeep H N | M Dhakshee | Palyam Varshitha Anand | Vasundra N | Yashaswini Arvind
Abstract: Sea waste management has been a global problem, as it causes environmental pollution when discarded or landfilled. To tackle this global issue, we develop an alternative bio-waste-mediated preparation of 'Chitosan' using sea waste, such as Shrimp shell waste, herein. In addition, chemically synthesised chitosan is inexpensive and widely available, but it suffers from reproducibility, contamination, and environmental problems that limit its use in high-value, regulated applications. Biosynthesised chitosan promises better control, cleaner supply, and greener processing, making it increasingly attractive for biomedical, food, and premium uses. In the present investigation, shrimp shells were systematically processed, which included washing, cleaning, crushing, demineralisation, deproteinization, deacetylation, and thermal treatment. The prepared Chitosan was studied through XRD, SEM-EDS, and FTIR spectroscopic techniques to investigate its structural, microstructural, and compositional properties. The results reveal that the synthesised chitosan demonstrated a degree of deacetylation (DD) of 65-67%, which is slightly lower compared to commercial chitosan (approximately 70-72%). This indicates that the synthesised chitosan has moderate deacetylation and reactivity compared to the higher solubility and amino-group availability of the commercial sample. Despite this difference, the synthesised chitosan offers the significant advantage of controlled laboratory production, allowing tailored structural and functional modifications that are not always achievable with commercial materials. Additionally, this method also generates useful materials from sea waste, providing a global waste-management solution. Abstract: ABSTRACT OF THE INVENTION SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR STABILITY ANALYSIS OF NATURAL CONVECTION IN AN INTERNALLY HEATED VERTICAL POROUS LAYER WITH DARCY-PRANDTL TIME-DEPENDENT VELOCITY FORMULATION The invention relates to a system and method for analyzing the stability of natural convection in an internally heated vertical porous layer bounded by impermeable walls at different temperatures using Darcy's law with a time-dependent velocity term. The system comprises a computational module modeling the porous layer with uniform volumetric heat generation, a momentum equation solver incorporating the Prandtl-Darcy number formulation, an energy equation solver with heat source term, a base flow calculator determining modified stream function (cubic) and temperature (quadratic) profiles, a perturbation analysis module performing linear stability analysis based on normal-mode perturbations, and an eigenvalue solver determining critical Darcy-Rayleigh numbers for stability boundaries. The invention has applications in nuclear reactor cooling, geothermal systems, and electronic thermal management.

Abstract: Disclosed is a system (100) for sustainability analysis including a user device (102) configured to enable a user to upload image data of an item and processing circuitry (118) coupled to the user device (102). Patent_Title: ELECTROCHEMICAL GLUCOSE SENSOR USING IRON-PORPHYRIN COMPLEX ON GLASSY CARBON ELECTRODE

Abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for fabricating an electrochemical sensor for glucose detection in biofluids. The method comprises synthesizing an iron-porphyrin (Fe-PP) complex, immobilizing the Fe-PP complex onto a glassy carbon electrode using Nafion polymer to obtain a Fe-PP/Nf@GCE sensor, converting the Fe-PP complex into a high-valent iron-peroxo species using hydrogen peroxide, and detecting glucose in spiked biological samples using cyclic voltammetry and differential pulse voltammetry techniques at biological pH at scan rates ranging from 50-1000 mV/s. The Fe-PP/Nf@GCE sensor exhibits detection of glucose concentrations ranging from 10-250 μM, achieves a limit of detection of 0.027 μM and quantification limit of 3.12 μM, exhibits sensitivity of 0.0023 μA μM−1 cm−2, and provides recovery rates of 95.3-100.5% in spiked biological samples including blood serum, saliva, urine and sweat. Patent_Title: ELECTROCHEMICAL DETECTION OF ASPIRIN USING TIO2/PVA/G-C3N4 MODIFIED ELECTRODE

Abstract: The present disclosure provides a process for detecting aspirin in biological and pharmaceutical samples using differential pulse voltammetry. The process comprises providing a three-electrode electrochemical cell system comprising a working electrode comprising a glassy carbon electrode modified with TiO2/PVA/g-C3N4 nanocomposite, an Ag/AgCl reference electrode in saturated KCl, and a platinum wire auxiliary electrode. The process further comprises preparing a sample solution containing aspirin in 0.1 M phosphate buffer solution at pH 5.0, and performing differential pulse voltammetry detection at a scan rate of 100 mV/s to detect aspirin in the sample solution. The process achieves a wide linear detection range of 10.0 μM to 140.0 μM with a correlation coefficient (R2) of 0.9992, a limit of detection of 0.024 μM, and a sensitivity of 0.0053 μA μM-1 cm-2. Patent_Title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PREPARING FILTRATION MEMBRANE FROM CIGARETTE BUTT WASTE
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore, 560078, Karnataka, India

Abstract: Disclosed is a system (100) for preparing a filtration membrane from cigarette butt waste, comprising: a cleaning unit (10) configured to clean and dry cigarette butt waste using double distilled water and ethanol at 45-55°C, a deacetylation unit (20) configured to treat the dried waste with 4-6% NaOH at 75-85°C for 1.5-2.5 hours under stirring to form regenerated cellulose; a dissolution unit (30) configured to dissolve the regenerated cellulose in N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) at 55-65°C for 2.5-3.5 hours to form a viscous solution and a mixing unit (40) configured to add corn starch and mix for 25-35 minutes, wherein the starch acts as a pore-forming agent and binder. Patent_Title: Plant Diagnostics and Care System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Manjunath B.T | Mr. Ravikumar S R | Abhik Anant | Karan Magarvadiya | Johaan D Noel | Elias Manoj | Jayanth P | Mohammed Yasir Shariff
Abstract: This invention relates to a precision agriculture system that integrates ground-based sensors, drones equipped with multispectral and thermal cameras, and a GSM enabled control platform, here in this we are trying to neglect the traditional irrigation system and bring a more enhanced monitoring system that takes care of the plants and not just irrigate them. This invention employs a hexagonal plant layout to maximise planting density and ensure uniform drone coverage. Drones are used as mobile sensor hubs for mapping plant health, detecting stress through thermal imaging, and capturing multispectral data. Ground sensors provide real-time soil and climate information, while the drone docking station enables autonomous operation. The combined data is processed locally and, in the cloud, with irrigation and nutrient delivery optimised at the plant or cluster level. Farmers can monitor and control the system remotely via a mobile application. The invention conserves water, reduces labor, improves crop yield, and introduces an innovative plant-layout strategy tailored for drone-based farming.

Patent_Title: Dynamic Visualization System for Optimized Bitcoin Network Topology Display
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Manjunath Mudda | Sreekanth H | Vaddi Reddy Pruthvi Charan Reddy | Sudeep S
Abstract: The rapid growth of blockchain ecosystems, particularly Bitcoin, has resulted in highly dynamic and complex network topologies that are difficult to visualize and analyze efficiently. Traditional visualization techniques often struggle to handle the scalability, responsiveness, and resource-efficiency required for representing such large-scale decentralized networks. This invention presents a scalable and efficient display mechanism for dynamic Bitcoin network topology, designed to optimize both performance and clarity in real-time visualization. The proposed mechanism leverages adaptive graph representation, hierarchical clustering, and dynamic layout algorithms to reduce computational overhead while ensuring accurate depiction of network dynamics. The system continuously monitors changes in the Bitcoin peer-to-peer network, such as node arrivals, departures, and transactional link updates, and incrementally updates the visualization without redrawing the entire topology. By applying scalable rendering techniques and selective detail display, the mechanism balance's global structure representation with localized insights, enabling users to seamlessly navigate from high-level overviews to fine-grained node interactions. Furthermore, the design integrates efficient data caching and asynchronous rendering pipelines to enhance responsiveness while minimizing energy consumption, aligning with sustainable computing practices.

Patent_Title: Intelligent Adaptive Footwear System for Predictive Monitoring and Prevention of Diabetic Foot Complications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Kavitha K S | Dr. Vimala Devi J | Dr. Preethi P
Abstract: This invention discloses an intelligent adaptive footwear system specifically developed for diabetic patients to prevent and predict foot-related complications. Unlike conventional monitoring devices, the invention integrates a distributed array of self-calibrating temperature and pressure sensors, embedded within the inner lining and sole, to ensure accurate long-term readings. An on-board edge-AI microprocessor processes multi-sensor data in real time, applying predictive modeling to identify abnormal gait patterns, localized heat accumulation, and repetitive stress cycles that may indicate the early onset of ulcers, neuropathy, or circulation disorders. Wireless communication enables two-way interaction with a companion mobile application, which not only provides alerts and historical trends but also delivers personalized recommendations, such as gait correction cues, offloading advice, and medical consultation prompts. In critical cases, the system directly notifies healthcare providers. With non-invasive continuous monitoring, adaptive feedback, and predictive intelligence, the invention represents a novel advancement in proactive diabetic foot care, reducing the likelihood of severe complications and enhancing patient quality of life.

Patent_Title: Authenticated IoT-Enabled Cooperative Driver-Assistant for Smart Parking Using Edge Computing
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Kiran A Gupta | Dr. Pavithra G | Dr. Swapnil Shantaram Ninawe
Abstract: This invention provides authentication by Adhar card for an IoT-enabled cooperative driver-assistant system for sensitive areas such as President house, Vidhan Soudha, Parade area, Military bases and cooperate offices and so on. The invention is for smart parking without human intervention in smart parking lanes. The edge computing technique is used for the development of electronic gadget using high speed processing unit with IoT and cloud interface. It integrates vehicle-mounted sensors (camera, infrared, and V2X), RFID anchors/IoT nodes, edge computing nodes (such as lampposts and smart meters), and cloud/NB-IoT services. The system offers low-latency decision-making at the edge while leveraging the cloud for data analytics and long-term storage. The proposed solution ensures efficient, secure, and scalable parking management. This invention can assist the drivers in selecting suitable and vacant parking location. The data collected by the system will be sent to the free version of IBM clouds since the invention does not claim any sensitive data for security reasons and this makes it very economical. The present challenge caused with the increase in vehicle production and world population leading to more and more parking spaces is solved using IoT enabled cooperative driver assistant parking system with edge computing.

Patent_Title: Solar panel Understanding and Navigation for Fault Detection with YOLOv8
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Dr. Pavithra G | Prof. Padmavathi M | Dr. Ramya R S | Dr. Kiran A Gupta
Abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent and self-adaptive diagnostic system for photovoltaic (PV) modules, wherein a modified YOLOv8-based architecture is employed not merely for anomaly detection but for context-aware analysis of operational health. The framework interprets static solar imagery to localize, classify, and assess the severity of multiple degradation modes including structural fractures, surface contamination, biological interference, snow masking, thermal irregularities, and latent electrical faults. A domain-specific dataset enriched with environmental descriptors and annotated defect boundaries is curated to enhance model generalization, while GPU-accelerated training platforms optimize learning efficiency. The architecture integrates a hierarchical backbone for spectral-spatial feature representation, a multi-scale fusion neck augmented with adaptive attention, and a predictive head configured to output defect coordinates, categorical probabilities, and severity indices in real time. Performance evaluation evidences mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5) values exceeding 0.85, corroborated by severity misclassification and temporal consistency analyses, thereby validating reliability under diverse field conditions. When deployed on distributed edge platforms such as drones and IoT-enabled controllers, the system autonomously generates encrypted maintenance logs, issues predictive alerts, and incrementally retrains itself with site-acquired imagery, ensuring continuous improvement and adaptability. By embedding automated, self-learning fault diagnostics into renewable energy infrastructures, the invention advances solar asset reliability, reduces operational expenditure, and accelerates the transition toward sustainable power generation.

Patent_Title: INDOOR NAVIGATION DEVICE
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr.S.THENMOZHI | N K Vinay Gowda | Hrushikesh | Dr.P.Vimala
Abstract: The proposed invention introduces an intelligent and adaptive navigation system that integrates both online and offline navigation mechanisms with lightweight machine learning capabilities for enhanced route optimization. The system begins with the user providing personal information, logging into the navigation device, and uploading images of the current landmark along with location details. Depending on internet availability, the system either accesses an online GPS application to generate the navigation route or utilizes pre-stored Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) data to identify the current location and compute an offline route. The uploaded landmark images are collected by the application server, where they are classified and compared using TinyML to enable efficient processing on resource-constrained devices. Subsequently, the CNN algorithm calculates and identifies the optimal route, which is displayed to the user through the navigation device. Furthermore, the system dynamically adapts by recalculating new routes whenever the user deviates from the suggested path, ensuring continuous and reliable guidance. This hybrid approach not only ensures uninterrupted navigation support in both connected and disconnected environments but also enhances accuracy, adaptability, and user experience, making it suitable for real-time applications in diverse environments.

Patent_Title: An Intelligent approach to classify RPL based attacks under the IoT Smart vehicle communication integrated with Blockchain Network
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. K. Janani | Dr. S. Keerthi | A M Prasad
Abstract: Incorporating the Intelligent Transport Vehicle blockchain enabled systems (ITVBES) has enhanced the efficacy of transport services. A blockchain-based primary key (PK) management solution for automotive networks is suggested in this article to increase the messages and sender identity's legitimacy. PKs are generated and validated using blockchain in the suggested vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) secure communication protocol, while an unsupervised Analysis of aberrant data in less secure vehicular communication is done using a deep learning approach. Because of the inherent characteristics of blockchain, the suggested protocol is much more secure and impervious to serious assaults than the basic ITVBES communication protocol. According to the experimental findings, abnormalities may be detected with the help of the suggested Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). Further evidence that the suggested method's total latency is suitable for ITVBES communication comes from the 1.25 ms delay that is added while retrieving PKs from the blockchain ledger. In both non-blockchain and blockchain contexts, the proposed ITVBES outperformed state-of-the-arts, as evidenced by experiments on one public data source ToN-IoT The accuracy of the proposed ITVBES was nearly 99% for this dataset.

Patent_Title: Sustainable Hydroxyapatite-Silver Nanocomposite Biosensor for Food Safety Applications Using Poultry Bone Waste
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Shashank A Tidke | Dr. Vidya G | Dr. Meera | Dr N. Rajeswari | Pooja S | G Mayur | Pranav V
Abstract: Foodborne illnesses remain a major global health threat, with pathogens such as Escherichia coli O157:H7, Salmonella, Listeria monocytogenes, Campylobacter, Vibrio cholerae, and Noroviruses causing millions of cases annually. In India, diarrheal diseases, typhoid fever, hepatitis A and E, and cholera continue to cause significant morbidity, largely due to contaminated food and water. Currently, the detection methods for these pathogens are often time-consuming, expensive, and require sophisticated laboratory infrastructure, which limits their application in real-time food safety monitoring. To address these challenges, this study focuses on the development of a novel biosensor by integrating silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) with Hydroxyapatite (HAp) derived from chicken bone waste. The approach emphasizes a novel application of agro-industrial waste valorization, transforming discarded chicken bones into a value-added biocompatible matrix for biosensor fabrication. The synergistic combination of AgNPs' antimicrobial and sensing capabilities with HAp's adsorption properties provides high surface area for pathogen capture, and excellent adsorption properties due to its porous crystalline structure. This enables us to have a promising platform for rapid, sensitive, and cost-effective detection of foodborne pathogens, specifically E. coli O157:H7. This eco-friendly and sustainable strategy not only advances food safety monitoring but also contributes to circular bio economy practices. It has significant potential for commercialization and implementation in food processing facilities, quality control laboratories, and point-of-care testing scenarios, particularly in developing regions where rapid, affordable pathogen detection is critically needed but currently unavailable.

Patent_Title: PHOTOCATALYTIC TEXTILE WASTEWATER TREATMENT USING STABILIZED SILVER NANOPARTICLES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Raghavendra H N | Raghavendra Prajwal H S | Sanjeev T P | Ashwini Sathynarayana | Dr. Geetha L
Abstract: The present invention relates to an eco-sustainable method for the treatment of textile wastewater using stabilized silver nanoparticles synthesized via spent Camellia sinensis extract. Textile effluents, containing toxic dyes such as methylene blue, methyl orange, methyl red, etc., are notoriously resistant to conventional biological, chemical, and physical treatments. This invention addresses the problem by utilizing abundant agro-waste (used camellia sinensis) as a natural reducing and capping agent to produce stable, crystalline silver nanoparticles with superior photocatalytic activity. The nanoparticles facilitate degradation of textile dyes under sunlight and ambient light, yielding reductions of up to 50- 60% for methylene and methyl dyes within 3 - 4 hours. Characterization confirmed high purity, stability, and nanoscale dispersion, which enhanced catalytic performance compared to chemically synthesized alternatives. The process integrates waste valorization, green nanotechnology, and effective dye degradation, offering a cost-efficient, scalable, and environmentally benign solution for textile wastewater remediation.

Patent_Title: Autonomous AI-Based Railway Safety Framework for Continuous Track and Surrounding Environment Monitoring
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Tushar Kudachimath | Vishal Krishna Bhat K | Harni R | Anusha Nehal | Chethan K S | E.Vittal | C Manish Kumar | Dr. D. Annapurna | Dr Suma V | Dr. H E Shahshidhar
Abstract: This invention proposes an AI-powered monitoring system of railway tracks which utilizes object detection and anomaly recognition and sensor data analysis for better rail safety. Deep learning models like YOLOv8 and CNN are used, an integrated sensor network with PIR, IR, ultrasonic, and GPS modules helps in recognition of obstacles, wildlife, and structural anomalies on a real-time basis. The intelligent agents collaborate by means of a central MQTT-based dashboard for alert generation and reporting. This innovation targets the problems of manual inspection and delayed response that are faced presently and provide scalable, less costly, and autonomous solutions that lead to less train accidents and better track maintenance.

Patent_Title: Real-Time Crowd Management and Safety Alert System Using Fuzzy Delay Integro- Differential Equations in Indian Grand Festival Context
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Thangaraj C | Dr. Yookesh TL | Dr. Keerthika KS | Dr. Valarmathi R | Dr. Geetha N K
Abstract: A novel system for real-time crowd management at grand Indian festivals is disclosed, employing fuzzy delay integro-differential equations to dynamically forecast crowd density and identify high-risk zones. Inputs such as arrival rate, delay factors, and behavioural uncertainties are processed with fuzzy logic. Delays and distributed movements are captured via integral kernels, and numerical solutions deliver rapid safety predictions. Alerts and risk visualizations are displayed using traditional Indian grand pattern motifs for immediate response by organizers. The invention advances the accuracy and cultural suitability of crowd safety management in large-scale event contexts.

Patent_Title: Laser Positioning Tool for Braces Placement
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. S. Hema Priyadarshini | Dr. Prajwal Prabhu | Mr. Naveen T. S | Mr. Anunayan Veer | Ms. Gowri S. V | Mr. Rahul D. Gowda | Ms. Yashaswini M
Abstract: The laser-guided orthodontic positioning tool intended to improve bracket installation accuracy during orthodontic treatments, is the subject of the invention. Human mistake makes traditional manual brace placement more likely, which lengthens treatment times and decreases clinical effectiveness. In order to overcome these drawbacks, invention projects a cross-line laser reference throughout the dental arch, guaranteeing uniform bracket angulation, height, and placement in relation to the tooth's anatomy. The gadget has a Class-I laser for safety and is small and portable. Dental model testing and prototyping showed a considerable reduction in treatment time and a more than 30% decrease in bracket misplacement when compared to traditional procedures. As a result, SmileLine provides a dependable, easy-to-use instrument that raises patient comfort, improves treatment results, and advances current orthodontic standardization.

Patent_Title: Integrated Machine Learning-Based Road Safety System for Electric Vehicles
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sumana S | Jasleen Singh
Abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have emerged as a cornerstone in the quest for sustainable transportation solutions, offering a promising path towards minimizing carbon emissions and increasing energy efficiency. With their adoption rising rapidly across the globe, electric vehicles are increasingly viewed as essential tools in reducing environmental footprints. However, as EVs become more commonplace, their integration into both urban and rural landscapes presents a unique set of challenges that must be addressed in order to ensure their safety. These challenges stem from the complexity of varying road conditions, environmental factors, and the sheer unpredictability of the dynamic driving environment. To overcome these challenges, advanced safety systems are required to monitor and respond to real-time hazards effectively, preventing accidents and ensuring the safety of both the vehicle occupants and pedestrians. One such solution is the development of a Smart Protective System (SPS) for electric vehicles, which integrates cutting-edge sensor technologies with sophisticated algorithms to detect potential obstacles and road hazards. This system aims to enhance vehicle safety by providing timely interventions, particularly in complex driving environments. At the heart of this innovative system is the use of the YOLO (You Only Look Once version 5) object detection model, an advanced deep learning algorithm known for its remarkable speed and accuracy in identifying and classifying various objects and obstacles in the vehicle's path. YOLO has gained significant traction in the field of computer vision for its real-time processing capabilities and its ability to detect a wide range of objects with high precision, making it an ideal choice for dynamic and fast-moving environments. This model plays a central role in the Smart Protective System by continuously analyzing visual data capture through onboard cameras to identify road hazards, such as potholes, debris, pedestrians, cyclists, and other vehicles

Patent_Title: Rocker-Bogie Rover for Disaster Management
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr G Manikanta | Dr Anubhav Kumar Pandey | Dr Murali Matcha | Abhishek Yadav | Krishankant Tekchandani | Sandeep Reddy | Arihant Srivastava | Dr Priyanshu Kumar
Abstract: The rocker-bogie mechanism has established itself as an effective suspension system for rovers, offering high stability and the capability to navigate complex terrains. This patent explores the potential of the rocker-bogie system for disaster management applications, such as post-earthquake urban exploration and flood-affected areas. The design addresses the need for a highly stable suspension system that maintains ground contact with all wheels, enabling the rover to handle uneven surfaces where the left and right rockers may independently climb over obstacles. The mechanism's capability to sustain tilts of over 50 degrees without tipping enhances its applicability in navigating rubble, debris, and unstable ground. Unlike traditional mobility systems, which are prone to mechanical failure in harsh environments and often require complex wheel or leg designs, the six-wheeled rocker-bogie rover demonstrates increased durability by housing its six motors within the body to minimize thermal variation. This configuration provides a high degree of mobility while reducing susceptibility to environmental damage.

Patent_Title: Autonomous Trash Collection and Segregation System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Deekshitha Arasa | Satish B A | Rachana M H | Harshitha M | Madhurithu T | Mohammed Yousuf | Nikhilesh Singh
Abstract: The world is currently facing a significant garbage crisis due to rapid urbanization, economic growth, and population increase. Traditional waste management systems are struggling to cope with the rising volume of waste, leading to severe environmental and health problems. Automated garbage collection and segregation systems can help alleviate these challenges by providing more efficient and sustainable waste management solutions. This challenge is being addressed by creating a robot that detects the trash, autonomously reaches the trash, collects it and segregates the trash appropriately as wet or dry waste. The system stands out for its autonomous nature and various features (detecting, collecting and segregating) incorporated in the same system. The robot is also beneficiary in terms of its cost effectiveness.

Patent_Title: Seatbelt Misuse Detection System Using Lap Belt-Integrated Distance Sensor
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Divya G S | B S Harshavardhan | Krishna Sankarshan Dasu | Dr. Rudresh M
Abstract: The invention relates to a seatbelt misuse detection system that accurately ensures the occupant protection by confirming proper usage of the seatbelt. The system consists of a distance sensor embedded within the lap belt portion of a vehicle seatbelt assembly, configured to measure the distance between the lap belt and the occupant's pelvic region or the seat surface. By comparing the measured distance with a pre-defined threshold, the system determines whether the seatbelt is being worn correctly or is misused (such as when clipped externally, worn behind the occupant, or only with the shoulder belt worn). A processing unit interprets sensor data and integrates with the existing seatbelt reminder system to generate a warning signal in the event of misuse. Unlike conventional buckle-detection systems, the proposed invention provides an additional method of confirmation that eliminates false positives caused by external clips or faulty visual detection, thereby enhancing road safety at a low cost and with minimal intrusion to user comfort.

Patent_Title: Compact Decagon Shaped Printed Monopole Antenna with Circular Slot for Wireless Communication Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Naveen S M | Dr. Aruna P | Dr. Joseph C M | Mr. Ravikumar S | Dr. Trupti Tagare | Dr. Shobha K R
Abstract: The Decagon Shaped Printed Monopole Antenna is a type of monopole antenna where the radiating patch is of the shape of decagon in shape. This type of antennas is used where compact size and omnidirectional radiation patterns are needed. The presented antenna has the dimensions of length, width and thickness 42 mm x 35 mm x 1.6 mm respectively. From the simulated return loss characteristics, it gives bandwidth from 2.53 GHz to 7.70 GHz. This antenna is simulated using High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) Software. From the measured results we observed that the antenna is resonating from 2.8 GHz to 3.55 GHz, 3.75 GHz to 4.5 GHz, 4.75 GHz to 5.45 GHz, and 6.35 GHz to 8.2 GHz. The designed antenna can be used for WiFi Applications, 5G applications and short distance wireless communications.

Patent_Title: Multi-purpose sliding corner clamp
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. V. R. SRINIVASAN | Mr.VINAYAKA H.L | Dr. M. R. KAMESH | Mr. GIRISHKUMAR. G. S | Mr. VIJAYAKUMAR NAGANNA PATIL
Abstract: A multipurpose sliding corner clamp is designed to securely hold wooden plates at precise angles, particularly 90 degrees, for storage and seating purpose. The clamp features an adjustable sliding mechanism that allows it to accommodate corner configurations. It includes a holding provision for firm alignment and stability. The design integrates sliding feature and strengthening rib for rapid assembly and removal. The clamp is constructed from durable materials suitable for high load applications and is adaptable for use on internal or external corners. Its compact, modular structure allows it to function as a stand-alone device or in conjunction with other clamping systems. The clamp is designed in such a way that it holds the wooden plates firmly. Also, it provides the required assembly angle. The clamp is designed to take up the pre-defined load without any deformation.

Patent_Title: Height Adjustable Smart Trolley for Next Generation Shopping
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rajesh S M | Mrs. Reena Y A | Mr. Vinayakumar R | Mrs. Radha Halagani | Mr. G K Vinay Kumar
Abstract: In metro cities, purchasing and shopping at supermarkets and malls is a daily activity. When people visit shops, they select different products. After that, it is hectic to stand in queues for billing purposes which are at peaks during holidays and weekends. The idea is to implement a "Smart Trolley" that will save time and the track of products purchased by showing the prices instantly, generating the bill automatically using an RFID reader. This is to benefit the customer to keep their shopping under their budget also. In "Smart Trolley" every product in the Mart will have a unique RFID tag, every trolley will have an RFID Reader, LCD display and a smart card reader attached to it. When a customer put any product in the trolley, the RFID tags of the product are scanned using the RFID reader and then put into the trolley where its unique code will be detected and the price of those products will get stored in memory. As we put the products into the trolley the costs will automatically get added to show the total price of the products. Thus the customers can make use of the automatic bill generated while they have an option to pay at the trolley with a cashless transaction. Further, the information of the total bill will get transferred to the PC at the billing counter and people can also pay at the counter with cash. The trolley is designed in such a way that the height of the trolley can be varied by 12 inches.

Patent_Title: Wearable Flexible Membrane Sleeve with Distributed Actuators for Sequential Leg Massage and Muscle Relaxation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable therapeutic massage device comprising a flexible membrane sleeve embedded with a distributed array of actuators positioned circumferentially and longitudinally along the sleeve. The actuators are electronically controlled and capable of exerting soft and light pressure over leg muscles in a sequential or user-defined manner to induce relaxation, improve circulation, and relieve fatigue. A control panel integrated on the device allows users to selectively program actuator activation patterns based on individual preferences. The invention offers a portable, programmable, and user-friendly alternative to bulky pneumatic compression systems, enhancing personal wellness and therapeutic care.

Patent_Title: GRASS CUTTER FOR UNEVEN AND ROCKY TERRAIN
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The invention relates to a specialized grass-cutting device designed to effectively operate on uneven surfaces and terrains with stones or other obstacles. The grass cutter is equipped with adjustable cutting blades, impact-resistant features, and terrain-sensing technology, ensuring efficient grass trimming while avoiding damage from rocks or rough terrain. This invention significantly improves grass-cutting performance in challenging environments, enhancing durability, precision, and user safety.

Patent_Title: Three-Dimensional Solar Panel for Enhanced Multi-Angle Light Capture and Energy Efficiency
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Vivek Bhandarkar V N | Arunadevi M | Mahesh G S | Krantikumar Kshaurad | Dr M K Venkatesh | Prof Govindaraju H | Sujan R | Santosh Patil | Tejas B R | Vishnu Prasad M
Abstract: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional (3D) solar panel structure designed to overcome the limitations of conventional flat solar panels in terms of efficiency and space utilization. The disclosed 3D solar panel comprises geometrically arranged photovoltaic surfaces configured to capture solar radiation from multiple angles, thereby enhancing overall energy conversion efficiency. Unlike traditional flat panels that rely primarily on direct overhead sunlight, the 3D configuration enables continuous and effective light absorption throughout the day and under suboptimal illumination conditions. The invention maximizes solar energy capture in areas receiving limited or variable sunlight, thereby improving performance in diverse geographical and environmental settings. The solar panel structure is designed, modeled, and analyzed using CAD software such as AutoCAD and Inventor to ensure optimal geometry for light interception, energy conversion, and structural stability. This technology represents an advancement in solar energy harvesting systems, offering improved efficiency and applicability compared to existing flat-panel designs.

Patent_Title: Biomedical Waste Segregation System Using Embedded Machine Learning
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Deenadayalan Ganapathi | Dr Joshuva Arockia Dhanraj | Dr Solomon Jenoris Muthiya
Abstract: Improper biomedical waste disposal practices in healthcare settings stem from poor waste management, posing health risks and environmental threats by spreading infections. Existing hospital waste separation techniques rely heavily on manual sorting so this reliance makes them prone to operational risks. Further consequences of human error are also reduced efficiency. "Automated Hospital Waste Segregation System" makes biomedical waste sorting into an automation since it does integrate computer software technologies along with hardware components. This is a system for the segregation of waste at a hospital. By using Pi Camera image inputs, Raspberry Pi 4 classifies biomedical waste that are processed through a machine learning model. Infrared sensors begin the waste detection process as the waste classification proceeds toward, then servo motors direct waste into the compartment. The system mounts onto a styrofoam chassis that operates efficiently and provides durability. In order to minimize direct contact with hazardous biomedical waste, this autonomous system functions independently to reduce staff workload and minimize direct contact with hazardous biomedical waste. Its real-time image processing capability enhances waste sorting accuracy, enabling healthcare facilities to achieve sustainable waste management and improved safety standards.

Patent_Title: Automated & Programmable Proximity Sensor Characterization Testing Rig for Preventive Maintenance Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Bharath T S | Dr. Rakesh M | Dr. Divya C D
Abstract: The present invention relates to the development of an Automated & Programmable Testing Rig (APTR) for proximity sensor characterization. Proximity sensors, such as inductive, capacitive, magnetic, ultrasonic, and photoelectric, are widely used in industrial and robotic applications where they are exposed to harsh environmental conditions, resulting in performance deterioration. The APTR enables preventive maintenance by precisely measuring critical sensor parameters including sensing distance, reduction factor, hysteresis, and switching frequency. The system integrates programmable logic controllers (PLC), human-machine interfaces (HMI), and webservers for automated test execution, data storage, processing, and display. The rig is further adaptable for academic laboratory applications to enhance learning by providing hands-on characterization of proximity sensors. The invention improves sensor reliability, minimizes unexpected downtime in industries, and facilitates accurate sensor parameter study in research and education.

Patent_Title: AI Virtual Mouse for Gesture Controlled Human-Computer Interaction
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Abhinav R B | Prof. Shahedhadeennisa S
Abstract: The rapid growth of virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) technologies has fueled the demand for intuitive and immersive human-computer interaction (HCI), with hand gesture recognition emerging as a key enabler of virtual control systems. This invention presents the design and implementation of gesture recognition models that leverage state-of-the-art machine learning techniques, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for feature extraction, long short-term memory networks (LSTMs) for temporal sequence learning, and dynamic time warping (DTW) for flexible gesture matching. Extensive experiments are conducted on curated datasets of annotated hand gestures relevant to virtual control, with performance rigorously evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The findings demonstrate high reliability and real-time responsiveness, highlighting the potential of gesture recognition systems to bridge the gap between natural human gestures and digital interaction. Furthermore, the integration of auxiliary technologies such as voice assistance underscores the versatility and scalability of the proposed approach. Overall, this work contributes to advancing HCI by offering robust, efficient, and user-friendly solutions for seamless control of virtual computing environments.

Patent_Title: Lube less slider bearing for low load pneumatic application
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

By adopting additive manufacturing in place of conventional injection molding, the invention not only eliminates the need for costly tooling but also significantly reduces overall manufacturing expenses. This material-process integration facilitates the fabrication of lube-free slider bearings ideally suited for low-load pneumatic sliding actuators. The inclusion of Kevlar reinforcement, combined with optimized printing parameters, enhances durability and service life compared to conventional Nylon bearings while providing a cost-effective and flexible manufacturing route.

Patent_Title: A Smart Carbon Footprint Tracker for Household Appliances
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Sameia Suha | Sandhya K | Pruthvi C N | Shahedhadeennisa S
Abstract: The Carbon Footprint tracker is the system that is designed for real-time monitoring and reduction of carbon emissions at the household appliance level. It also has an artificial intelligence module that analyses the usage patterns and provide recommendations to reduce emissions. The system further includes a user interface that displays real-time carbon footprint data, offers gamified engagement through rewards and scores, and integrates block-chain-based verification for carbon credit tracking and offsetting. The invention enables individuals, households, and small businesses to actively monitor, reduce, and offset their carbon footprint in a transparent and actionable manner.

Patent_Title: Web-Based Detection of Dyslexia Using Strokes, Reading, and Memory Features
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The invention discloses a web-based system that detects early signs of dyslexia through interactive activities such as handwriting tracing, reading aloud, and memory games. The system captures multimodal data from these tasks, extracts measurable features, and applies machine learning models to assess dyslexia risk. Unlike existing solutions, the invention combines multiple modes of child interaction to improve prediction accuracy and accessibility. The system is simple, scalable, and practical for children, parents, and educators.

Patent_Title: A Combined Watermarking Approach for Securing Biometric Data
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Chandrakala B M | Rekha Jayaram | Bindu Bhargavi S M
Abstract: A biometric security system employing zero-bit watermarking technology for protecting biometric authentication data. The invention combines iris image feature extraction with fingerprint watermark embedding to create a secure master share for user authentication. The system utilizes Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to extract unique features from iris images without altering the original biometric data. A binary pattern derived from iris characteristics is combined with an encrypted fingerprint watermark using XOR operations to generate an encrypted unique ID (master share). During authentication, the system extracts the watermark from the encrypted ID and compares it with stored database records. The zero-bit watermarking approach ensures no distortion to the host biometric images while providing robust security against various image processing attacks, making it particularly suitable for applications requiring high-security biometric authentication with data integrity preservation.

Patent_Title: IoT -Powered Mobility Shoes for Visually Impaired

Abstract: For visually impaired people, mobility in public and crowded areas is always a challenge owing to hidden barriers and absence of instantaneous feedback. This work presents a smart shoe system that can help mobility and safety through a dual-sensor mechanism coupled with a mobile application. The intelligent shoes are designed using ultrasonic sensors to identify medium- to long-range barriers. (20 cm to 100 cm) and infrared (IR) sensors for detection of objects close by (0 to 20 cm). These sensors are interfaced with an Arduino Uno, the data is processed by the board and relayed to a mobile application through Bluetooth. An obstacle detection is signal led by the android app giving vibration feedback to the user such that one gets alerts even in noisy or crowded places where buzzer beeps may not be heard and go unnoticed. This system provides a lightweight, compact, and user- friendly approach to increasing situational awareness and autonomy for the visually impaired. Future evolution can add GPS navigation, voice prompts, and machine learning-based object identification for more brain-like guidance.

Patent_Title: Frontend API Testing System with Integrated Mocking and Contract Validation

Abstract: A comprehensive frontend API testing system that integrates multiple testing methodologies including mocking, stubbing, and contract validation within a unified browser-based testing environment. The system employs Mock Service Worker (MSW) technology for realistic API simulation, integrates with testing frameworks like Cypress and Playwright for cross-browser validation, and incorporates contract testing capabilities to ensure frontend-backend schema compliance. The invention addresses test flakiness through intelligent retry mechanisms, handles Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) limitations through automated proxy configurations, and provides CI/CD pipeline integration for automated testing workflows. The system enables parallel development by allowing frontend teams to test against simulated backend services while maintaining realistic network-level behavior, thereby improving development velocity and software quality in modern web applications.

Patent_Title: Application of MQTT Protocol to Visualize the Behavior of Autonomous Vehicle in a Virtual?Environment
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Vaidehi M | Vaibhav Magadum | Sahaj Gupta | Shravya R | Sharadhi Hegde
Abstract: This study focuses on the design and implementation of an MQTT Protocol to Visualize the Behavior of Autonomous Vehicle in a Virtual Environment using the IoT technology. The primary motive of the study is to stimulate and monitor the behavior of autonomous vehicle in a virtual environment. A virtual environment having vehicle-to-environment interaction. The existing traditional vehicles will soon be replaced by autonomous vehicles due to advancements in the field of IoT in Transport. Hence, there should be a system which allows interaction between vehicles and environment in a connected ecosystem. Based on the changes in the environment the autonomous vehicles should be able to adapt changes. As the existing system completely depends on the Sensor data and Perception Systems but these are limited to a self-environment. The contribution focus on building a network in which each vehicle take decision based on the behavior of the other vehicles and choose most efficient path based on the accidents and geofences. This study proposes a system which constantly monitor and sends data such as speed, battery life, GPS location, etc. to a centralized system using various sensors, low powered wireless communication protocol (MQTT) to collect, assess and alert using Internet of Things (IoT). The results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of IoT technology for enhancing Autonomous Vehicle Network. The collected data can be used in implementation of Fleet Management System which help to visualize the performance of the Autonomous Vehicles in form of Graphs and Charts.

Patent_Title: A Convolutional Neural Network-Based Deep Learning System for Detecting and Classifying Potato Leaf Disease
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

The system can be implemented on cloud platforms, mobile devices, or embedded hardware for real-time disease detection in the field.

Patent_Title: Automated Table Top gripper for Physically Challenged
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Satish B A | Deekshitha Arsa | Ganesha G C | Dr Sharath Kumar Y N | Rachana M H
Abstract: An assistive device is disclosed for facilitating object manipulation by individuals with physical disabilities, particularly those with limited or impaired hand mobility. The device comprises a robotic arm assembly mounted on a working surface, wherein the arm is extendable and operable to traverse along one or more edges of the surface. The system is configured to receive user commands through non-physical interfaces, including voice inputs and/or image-based inputs, to identify and locate target objects placed on or near the table. Upon receiving such input, the arm automatically extends, adjusts its position along the working surface, and executes a grasp-and-lift action to retrieve the desired object. The integration of multimodal input recognition with adaptive mechanical movement enables independent operation by users with restricted physical control, thereby enhancing accessibility and personal autonomy in everyday tasks.

Patent_Title: Dual-Vertex Sensor-Triad Architecture for Hemispherical Sun Sensing in Small Satellites
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Devaraju Ramakrishna | Vinod Kumar Agrawal | Nithesh Bhaskar N | Vinod B Durdi | Pushpa B R
Abstract: The disclosed invention relates to a sun position detection system for small satellites employing a spatially optimized configuration of off-the-shelf analog quadrant photodiode sensors. The system comprises two sensor triads, each formed by three orthogonally mounted quadrant photodiodes aligned along mutually perpendicular axes converging at a common vertex of the spacecraft body. A first triad is positioned at a selected vertex, and a second triad is mounted at the diagonally opposite vertex, thereby achieving hemispherical solar incidence detection with overlapping coverage. This geometric arrangement enables continuous passive estimation of the sun vector across a near-spherical field of view using compact, low-power analog hardware. The dual-vertex configuration provides inherent redundancy, robustness against partial shading, and fault tolerance, while ensuring suitability for attitude determination, power management, and sun-synchronous operations in miniaturized satellite platforms. The invention further encompasses signal-processing methods for deriving accurate solar vector estimates from quadrant photodiode outputs.

Patent_Title: FLORA DOCTOR: Your Plant's Personal Doctor - Anytime, Anywhere

Based on the diagnosis, the device automatically provides a verbal explanation of the disease and solution in the farmer's local language. It also generates a printed prescription slip that includes medicine name, dosage, and application instructions. Results are accessible via speaker, display, and optional thermal printer. The system operates offline, supports solar power, and is tailored for rural farmers with minimal technical access. Flora Doctor provides an affordable, real-time, and field-ready solution for improving crop health and agricultural productivity.

Patent_Title: An Intelligent System for Automated Prediction and early Staging of Depression Levels and Stress Levels in Undergraduate Students
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Shobha N | Dr. Suma V | Dr. Rajeshwari Janthakal | Poornima D
Abstract: Recent trends show that students increasingly develop depression and stress during their academic tenure, sometimes leading to tragic consequences. Since depression can be measured, monitored, and controlled, this project aims at early detection and intervention using an Intelligent System. The Intelligent System acts as a pseudo-psychiatrist, providing motivational therapy and assessing daily depression and stress levels. The model is built using various source to collect data for depression and stress level monitoring using auditory and visual cues, questionnaires, social media interactions, physiological measures and behavioral measures. Interesting patterns are extracted from each data and predictive model is built to understand the behavioral changes. Weekly reports of these patterns are sent to the student's proctor and parents. If mild depression is detected over a week, the proctor provides counseling. The application consists of two UI fragments - one for students and another for proctors. The back end features a trained AI model that evaluates student responses and records data on the cloud. This information is shared weekly with the proctor, who is responsible for handling mild cases. Moderate depression levels are managed by the institution, while severe cases are referred to professional psychiatrists. By providing early detection and structured intervention, this application helps prevent worsening depression and supports student well being.

Patent_Title: Self-Healing Cybersecurity Framework for IoT Devices with AI-Driven Threat Detection and Quantum-Resistant Security

Patent_Title: Intelligent Wildlife Bioacoustic and 5G-Based System for Predicting Natural Disasters in Forest and Remote Ecosystems
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

The 5G-enabled communication infrastructure ensures rapid transmission of critical alerts to emergency management systems, providing unprecedented early warning capabilities for remote forest areas where conventional monitoring systems prove inadequate.

Patent_Title: AI-Powered Dynamic Lane Allocation System for Optimized Traffic Flow
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Patent_Title: Sustainable Method for Improving the Engineering Properties of Black cotton and Lateritic soil with Copper Slag as a Cement Substitute in Pavement Subgrades

Patent_Title: Advanced Hovercraft Transport System and Control Method

Furthermore, advanced materials and construction methods are employed to reduce weight while maintaining structural integrity, leading to increased payload capacity and extended operational range. The disclosed model, not only enhance the hovercraft's performance but also contribute to its sustainability by minimizing energy consumption and environmental impact.

Patent_Title: A System and Method for Precision Agriculture Using IoT-Based Soil and Water Quality Analysis and Crop Fertilization Recommendation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Harpreet Kaur Thind | Shivakumar Nyamgoud | Shreeshail Appasab Kohalli | Sharan M Nurandevarmath | Valmiki Vijaya Kumara | Pruthvi C N | Hemanth Uppala
Abstract: The present invention relates to an Internet of Things (IoT) based precision agriculture system for integrated monitoring and adaptive management of soil and irrigation water quality. The system comprises a distributed sensing architecture configured to measure soil parameters including moisture, pH, nutrient content, and temperature, and irrigation water parameters including pH, turbidity, electrical conductivity, and dissolved ionic concentration. Sensor data is acquired through an IoT-enabled embedded controller based on an ESP32 platform and processed using a hybrid edge-cloud analytics framework. The system introduces a Soil-Water Interaction Index (SWII) computed at an edge-intelligent node to evaluate compatibility between soil chemistry and irrigation water composition. Based on the interaction index, crop type, and growth stage information, an adaptive fertigation optimization engine generates real-time recommendations for irrigation scheduling, fertilizer composition, and nutrient dosage. The invention enables integrated soil-water compatibility assessment, improves fertilizer efficiency, reduces nutrient losses, and supports scalable and sustainable precision agriculture.

Patent_Title: REAL-TIME ACCIDENT HEALTH ASSESSMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF

Patent_Title: A simple one step Nanomaterial-Based System for Wastewater Treatment towards environmental remediation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: Agricultural and municipal effluent generation have created a critical need for advanced, efficient, and sustainable wastewater treatment technologies. Conventional treatment methods often suffered with high energy consumption, incomplete removal of contaminants, sludge generation, and inefficient. In this context, the patent presents a nanomaterial-based system and method for wastewater treatment that comprise of unique properties of engineered nanomaterials into a treatment framework.
