Patent_Title: SELF CANCELLING INDICATORS FOR TWO-WHEELER VEHICLES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. MAHESH BELIJAGALI RAMASWAMY | KAVYA JAMMANAHALLI THIMMAPPA | Dr. NANDAKUMAR MANDYA BASAVARAJU | Dr. NAVEENA BETTAHALLI ESWAREGOWDA | Dr. SOLOMON JENORIS MUTHIYA | Dr. DIVYA GURKAR SOMASHEKAR | Dr. PUNEETH N P | K SHIVARANJAN SUNILKUMAR | YASHASWINI MAHADEVAIAH
Abstract: A self-cancelling indicator system for two-wheeler vehicles is an advanced safety feature designed to automatically turn off the turn signal indicators after the rider completes a turn. In traditional systems, riders often forget to manually switch off the indicator lights, which can lead to confusion for other road users and unnecessary battery drain. This invention solves the problem by integrating a gyroscopic sensor or steering angle sensor that continuously monitors the angular motion of the handlebar. The sensor sends real-time data to a microcontroller unit (MCU), which processes the information using predefined thresholds for angular displacement and time duration to detect the beginning and completion of a turn. Once the MCU determines that the turn is completed, it triggers a relay circuit to automatically turn off the indicator lights, without requiring any additional action from the rider. This automation not only improves safety by preventing accidental prolonged signalling but also reduces power consumption by avoiding unnecessary operation of the indicator bulbs. Moreover, the system eliminates the possibility of rider forgetfulness, ensuring that the indicators function properly and reset automatically after each turn. The compact design of the circuitry allows for easy integration into existing two-wheeler models, making it suitable for both retrofitting and factory installation. Overall, this intelligent system promotes safer and more efficient two-wheeler operation.

Patent_Title: Driver calibrated Brake Drag Detection and Alarm System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. NANDAKUMAR MANDYA BASAVARAJU | DR. DINESHA P | SRINIDHI SHETTY | ANNARAO | MURGENDRA N | SHRIKANTHA | Dr. MAHESH BELIJAGALI RAMASWAMY | KAUSHIK | Dr. NAVEENA BETTAHALLI ESWAREGOWDA | Dr. PUNEETH N P
Abstract: The invention proposed is a driver calibrated aftermarket or company fitted tire temperature safety system for detecting brake drag or any other wheel faults for any vehicle. The wheel fault is mostly due to brake drag but sometimes in can be due to under inflation, bearing failure and tire miss alignment. Wheel faults would increase the temperature near to the brake assembly for heavy commercial vehicles such as single and multi-axle trucks which have risk of wheel faults going unnoticed leading to either tire blow out or brake failure. Both tire blow out and brake failure leads to economic losses and also pose a huge risk by leading to accidents. The invention is unique since it reduces false alarms caused by sensor mounting variations and environmental factors. The system continuously monitors brake assembly temperatures using sensors mounted on each wheel and generates alerts when abnormal heating is detected. Unlike existing systems which are based on the threshold temperature, the proposed solution incorporates a driver-in-the-loop calibration mechanism, where the driver may accept or reject alarms to train the system. Based on this structured feedback, the system adaptively updates its threshold values within predefined safety bounds. This ensures accurate detection of dragging brakes while preventing false positives, thereby enhancing safety, reliability and driver trust. Since the threshold temperature is set by the driver, this can be used for any vehicle. So this system can easily work as an aftermarket tire temperature alarm kit for any vehicle.

Patent_Title: Foldable and slidable Electric Scooter for Urban Mobility
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Divya G S | Abhilash naik R | Rohan Godwin | Durga Prasad L | Pratham BS | Dr. Solomon Jenoris Muthiya | Dr. Naveen B E | Dr Mahesh B R | Dr Nandakumar M B
Abstract: Urbanization and increased traffic congestion have generated a crucial need for environmentally friendly, efficient, and adaptable transportation alternatives. A portable, foldable, and lightweight electric mini scooter provides a viable solution to these issues. Built with a sturdy yet lightweight aluminum chassis, the scooter incorporates a high-performance brushless in-hub DC motor and a rechargeable lithium-ion battery, allowing for speeds of up to 25 km/h and a range of 20-30 kilometers per charge. The foldable shape allows for easy mobility, storage, and seamless interaction with public transportation. This makes it excellent for last-mile connection, daily urban commuting, and university transportation. Rider safety is enhanced by features like as sturdy wheels and a braking system, while an energy-efficient electrical system decreases consumption and emissions. This idea encourages sustainable transportation by solving important urban concerns like traffic congestion and carbon emissions, while also making cities cleaner and more habitable. Electric mini scooters revolutionize personal transportation by combining utility, sustainability, and convenience, promoting a smarter and more environmentally responsible urban lifestyle.

Patent_Title: Compact Power generator from Food waste Electrolysis
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Kusumika Krori Dutta | Prof. Ensteih Silvia | Prof. Kavya D N | Dr. S. Poornima | Prof. Kehkeshan Jallal
Abstract: Waste has become one of the major environmental issues for every nation and is adversely affecting the lives on earth. In a developing country like India, there are many places which suffer shortage of electricity to date. Ironically, they are the places which have become landfills for garbage. This paper gives a solution to the present scenario by converting food waste into electricity. This electricity is produced by the reaction between the electrodes with food waste as the medium. Different combinations and arrangements of electrodes are also taken into consideration. This is where our project plays an important role in finding an effective solution to the existing problem.

Patent_Title: Pellet Extruder Attachment for 3D Printers
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Jasti Anurag | Dr. Moumita Tewary | Dr. Anwesa Mohanty
Abstract: The present invention relates to a pellet extruder designed to be mounted onto a standard 3D printer in place of the conventional filament extruder. The extruder allows direct feeding and controlled melting of polymer pellets, eliminating the need for pre-extrusion into filament. Unlike filament-based methods, which are limited to materials that can be drawn into filament form, the proposed system enables the use of a wider variety of materials in pellet form, including polymers, blends and composites. This system reduces material costs, enhances material versatility and supports sustainable manufacturing by enabling the direct usage of recycled or custom-compounded pellets. The extruder features a motor-driven feed mechanism, a heated melt chamber and a controlled nozzle assembly to ensure uniform flow and deposition of material during additive manufacturing.

Patent_Title: Compliant wing structure for UAV Application
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Prathik Jain S | Dr. Sundaramahalingam A | Dr. Hareesha N G | Dr. Rudresh M | Sanath S | Abhishek J | Harshith G Hagalawadi
Abstract: This innovative design introduces a compliant morphing wing structure for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. Unlike conventional wings that use hinged flaps or ailerons, the proposed design employs a flexible trailing edge that changes its shape smoothly and continuously. The morphing is achieved through a lightweight corrugated core made from additively manufactured materials, combined with an elastic silicone membrane sheet that provides a seamless aerodynamic surface. A servo-based actuation system, integrated with an IoT-enabled microcontroller, allows real-time control of wing deflections during different flight phases. By eliminating discontinuous surface, the design reduces drag, delays stall, and improves lift-to-drag ratio.

Patent_Title: Bio-Inspired Elytron Beetle Trabeculae Honeycomb Structure for Enhanced Energy Absorption and Load-Bearing Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sundaramahalingam A | Dr. Prathik Jain S | Dr. Sankaralingam L | Puneet S | Darshan S | Farhan Minaj Kasim | Sathya Sai Srinivas
Abstract: The invention is a bio-inspired elytron beetle trabeculae honeycomb structure that outperforms traditional honeycomb cores in terms of energy absorption, load distribution, and resistance to deformation. The structure is made up of a number of polygonal cells strengthened with trabeculae-like struts positioned at the vertices, similar to the natural architecture of Elytron Beetle Trabeculae. This one-of-a-kind arrangement increases compressive and bending strength, reduces buckling, and provides multi-directional stress distribution while keeping a lightweight profile. The trabeculae honeycomb structure can be fabricated by additive manufacturing, composite molding, or metallic foaming processes, and it is ideal for aerospace, automotive, military, and marine engineering applications that require a high strength-to-weight ratio and impact resistance.

Patent_Title: IoT-Enabled Autonomous Emergency Evacuation and Guidance System with Intelligent Multi-Sensor Decision Framework
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Annapurna D | Prof. Shashank S | Sharada Kalal | Vrunda M | Samhitha G H
Abstract: The current invention reveals a new Internet of Things (IoT)-based emergency evacuation and guidance system that can guide people in crowded public areas on its own during dangerous situations. Utilizing distributed ESP32-based beacon nodes with multi-sensor arrays (DHT11 for temperature and humidity, BMP180 for pressure, and optional smoke/gas/motion detectors), the proposed invention performs localized real-time decision-making without reliance on the internet, in contrast to traditional cloud-dependent systems. Using an intelligent scoring algorithm, each beacon node compares environmental conditions to adaptive safety thresholds and determines the best evacuation path with the least amount of latency. SSD1306 OLED screens and a web-based evacuation interface that can be accessed on personal devices are used to provide guidance. A built-in chatbot assistant provides real-time assistance for finding exits, restrooms, medical stations, and resources, and the interface uses user seat numbers to create customized dynamic routes. A MongoDB database is used to permanently store evacuation logs and real-time sensor data for post-event analysis, predictive modeling, and system optimization. The invention presents a hybrid localized-cloud model for resilience, where cloud integration is only used for analytics and system learning, while critical evacuation guidance functions independently at the edge. For stadiums, shopping centers, transportation hubs, and environments with limited resources, the invention provides a scalable, intelligent, and fault-tolerant prototype because of its low cost, modularity, and battery-friendly design-significantly enhancing public safety during emergencies.

Patent_Title: Heart Rate Responsive Smart Therapy Lamp
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Shashank S | Prof. Poornima | Manya Sohan | Rishitha Suhani D Souza
Abstract: The Smart Therapy Lamp is a novel biofeedback device designed to enhance wellness through real-time heart rate monitoring and adaptive environmental feedback. It employs a high-precision heart rate sensor linked to an ESP32 microcontroller to dynamically adjust ambient light via an RGB LED and soothing sounds using a buzzer. This portable, self-contained device operates without external screens or applications, providing an intuitive user experience. By continuously analyzing physiological signals, it creates a personalized environment that promotes relaxation, stress reduction, and emotional regulation. Its modular design and customizable feedback zones make it an accessible and cost-effective therapeutic tool suitable for home, clinical, and educational settings.

Patent_Title: Fractal Generation through Controlled Mappings in Fuzzy Metric Space
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Thangaraj C | Dr. Geetha N K | Dr. Valarmathi R | Dr. Venkatesh Babu K P
Abstract: This innovation proposes a novel approach for producing fractals within fuzzy metric spaces where the degree of fuzziness is precisely controlled by specific control functions. In contrast to current approaches, this method offers more flexibility, efficiently handles uncertainty, and produces fractals with more robust and flexible structures. The method has real-world applications in texture and image analysis, medical imaging, cryptography, pattern recognition, and modelling of complex systems, and it is thus a powerful computing tool and theoretical development in fractal mathematics.

Patent_Title: Integrated Treatment Method for Degrading Synthetic Microfibers in Textile Wastewater
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: MS. SWETTI JHA | DR. RAMARAJU H K | HARSHITHA M | SPOORTHY SS
Abstract: The present invention relates to an integrated treatment system for the effective degradation and removal of synthetic microfibers from textile wastewater. The method combines electrocoagulation, biological degradation, and advanced monitoring assisted by Artificial Intelligence (AI). Electrocoagulation destabilises and aggregates microfibers, whereas biological treatment, utilising specialised microbial consortia, degrades residual synthetic particles. An AI-based control module continuously analyses water quality parameters, predicts treatment efficiency, and optimises operational conditions in real-time to ensure maximum microfiber removal and optimal energy efficiency. The system enables adaptive process control, early fault detection, and predictive maintenance through machine learning algorithms. The integrated approach provides a sustainable, cost-effective, and scalable solution for reducing microfiber pollution in textile effluents, ensuring compliance with stringent environmental standards.

Patent_Title: Context-Bound, Sensor-Fused Encryption Framework for Secure IoT Communication
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Prof. Alamma B H | Dr. T. Ratha Jayalakshmi | Prof. Smitha G V | Dr. Pavithra G Shetty
Abstract: This invention reveals a lightweight encryption system of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, which obtains dynamically a symmetric key based on physical context information, including temperature, humidity, and motion, without the use of a fixed or shared keys. The invention will integrate sensor fused key generation, adaptive sensor mode (DHT only, MPU only and hybrid) and context matching authentication to provide a secure communication between IoT devices. The integrity is ensured through a light-weight Message Authentication code (MAC) and tamper detection. An operational demonstration of ESP8266 with Firebase cloud enables has confirmed that encryption can only operate under the same context of the devices, which minimizes vulnerability to replay, spoofing, and man-in-the- middle attacks. It is an invention which facilitates low-power context-aware and scalable wearable, home, and embedded system IoT security.

Patent_Title: Revolutionizing Genomic Research: Advanced Bioinformatics Tools for Comprehensive Analysis, Visualization, and Interpretation of Genomic Data
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rakshitha Kiran P | Ms. Raksha Kodnad R | Dr.R.Jayanthi | Dr Samitha Khaiyum
Abstract: The rapid advancement of high-throughput sequencing technologies has revolutionized genomic research, enabling comprehensive analysis of complex genetic data. Advanced bioinformatics tools play a critical role in managing, analyzing, and interpreting the vast amounts of genomic data generated. These tools facilitate variant annotation, gene expression profiling, pathway analysis, and multi-omics data integration, providing deeper insights into genetic mechanisms and disease processes. Visualization platforms such as integrative genome browsers and interactive network graphs allow researchers to intuitively explore and interpret large-scale genomic datasets. Comprehensive bioinformatics suites accommodate workflows from raw data processing to clinical variant interpretation, supporting precision medicine efforts. The integration of long-read sequencing technologies with advanced bioinformatics expands the ability to detect structural variations and complex genomic rearrangements. Public repositories and databases enriched with bioinformatics access tools promote collaborative research and data sharing. These tools have empowered breakthroughs in biomarker discovery, therapeutic target identification, and personalized treatment strategies. Challenges remain in data standardization, clinical annotation, and interpreting biological significance, which drive continuous development of more sophisticated tools. Overall, bioinformatics tools are transforming genomic research into a holistic, accessible, and clinically relevant field. They enable scientists and clinicians to decode genetic information efficiently, accelerating advances in precision oncology, genetic disease research, and population genomics. Ongoing improvements in computational methods, statistical models, and large-scale integration approaches further enhance the accuracy and utility of genomic data interpretation. The expanding availability of high-quality data and improved software platforms facilitate multidisciplinary collaboration across biology, medicine, and computational sciences. This synergy is critical for understanding complex biological systems and translating genomic discoveries into clinical applications. Ultimately, the evolution of advanced bioinformatics tools promises to drive new insights into health and disease, supporting the future of personalized medicine and genomics-driven healthcare.

Patent_Title: A Hybrid AI-Quantum Computing Framework for building Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to forecast the faults in software
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr.R.Jayanthi | Dr. Rakshitha Kiran P | Dr Samitha Khaiyum | Ms. Raksha Kodnad R
Abstract: The objective is to develop a novel hybrid AI-quantum computing framework for developing an advanced intrusion detection system (IDS) that can also foresee, predict and mitigate software system defects. Fault management and system reliability challenges have taken on a new class as a result of the increasing use of distributed cloud-edge computing architectures for latency-sensitive and high-availability applications. It is impossible for traditional fault detection techniques, which often rely on rule-based or threshold-driven procedures, to keep up with the dynamic, diverse, and decentralized nature of modern cloud-edge systems. The fault detection architecture presented in this paper is driven by Quantum AI (QAI) and integrates deep learning to detect, locate, and anticipate flaws in real time across cloud and edge layers. Automotive software systems (ASS) dependability and security are assessed using hardware-in-the-loop, or HIL, testing. However, due to the complex and enormous amount of data created by the HIL platform throughout the testing process, the conventional data assessment techniques used for issue identification and categorization employing human specialists are not possible. This work proposes a unique intelligent failure detection and classification (FDC) methodology that can be applied in the V-cycle phase of development or the integration testing phase by utilizing hybrid DL methodologies. Additionally, a combination of Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) was used to build the model structure.

Patent_Title: Multi-Modal Artificial Intelligence System and Method for Early Prediction of Clinical Escalation from Ambiguous Presentations in Primary Care Using Hybrid Language Model and Deep Learning Architecture
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ms. Raksha Kodnad R | Dr. Rakshitha Kiran P | Dr Samitha Khaiyum | Dr R Jayanthi
Abstract: he present invention relates to a multi-modal artificial intelligence (AI) system and method for the early prediction of clinical escalation in patients who present with non-specific or ambiguous symptomatology in primary care, telemedicine, and other front-line healthcare environments. Conventional diagnostic decision-making tools often require clear and overt symptom manifestation to initiate escalation protocols, resulting in missed opportunities for timely intervention. By contrast, the disclosed invention operates at a stage where clinical indicators are subtle, incomplete, or atypical, enabling detection of deterioration risks far earlier in the patient trajectory. The system integrates heterogeneous patient data sources by simultaneously processing unstructured clinical narratives and structured numerical records from electronic health records (EHRs). A Large Language Model (LLM) ingests and interprets free-text inputs - such as physician notes, triage documentation, teleconsultation transcripts, and patient-reported symptom descriptions - to produce context-rich semantic embeddings. In parallel, a Deep Learning (DL) module analyzes structured and time-series medical data including vital signs, laboratory test measurements, demographics, historical diagnoses, and medication profiles, yielding dense numerical feature representations. These complementary feature domains are merged within a dedicated fusion layer employing concatenation, cross-attention, or gated integration mechanisms to form a unified patient risk representation. A prediction head receives the fused representation and outputs one or more risk assessment indicators, including escalation probability, severity classification, and - optionally - an estimated time to escalation. An explainability module generates clinician-facing rationales in natural language, improving decision transparency and trust. This architecture enables earlier and more accurate triage decisions compared with current systems, minimizes false negatives, and facilitates proactive clinical response. The invention is adaptable to varying resource environments, scalable across institutions, and deployable both on-premises and in cloud-integrated EHR systems, thereby offering a transformative improvement in patient safety and primary care workflow efficiency.

Patent_Title: Unmanned Electronic Control unit for auto detection and cleaning of water bodies
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Kusumika Krori Dutta | Dr. Aruna M G | Dr. Reshma S | Dr. Sarita Kumari | Prof. Ramya K
Abstract: The Compact Water Surface Waste Cleaning and Water Monitoring System is a highly innovative solution for addressing the pressing issue of water pollution caused by surface waste in water bodies. This system consists of a floating device that is compact and equipped with multiple sensors as well as a waste collection mechanism. The sensors are designed to monitor various parameters of water quality and send the data to a central control unit. The waste collection mechanism is highly efficient and collects the surface waste using a conveyor belt system and stores it in a collection bin, which can be disposed of in an environmentally friendly manner. This system's design is highly versatile, making it an ideal solution for managing water pollution in different water bodies. Its compact design makes it easy to deploy and move between different water bodies, and its highly efficient waste collection mechanism ensures that the surface waste is removed effectively. With its ability to monitor and clean surface waste from water bodies, this system provides an effective and sustainable method for protecting and preserving our water resources.

Patent_Title: APP based Self Navigating Electronic Controlled wheelchair with floor lifting and emergency alert systems
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Kusumika Krori Dutta | Dr. Vindhya P M | Dr. Annapurna Patil | Dr. Harsha Karamchandani
Abstract: Falls are a serious public health issue on a global scale. Plenty of reasons, such as slippery floors, some obstacles, uneven surfaces, etc., exist for falls, which might be fatal or nonfatal. Most of the fall needs medical attention and a proper diagnosis for quality of life. The first and foremost challenge one faces on the event of fall is how to get up from the floor. The process takes time and effort, and many times people die due to the delay of medical attention. There is a need for an assistant for 24/7, who should be very strong and skilled to lift people from the floor. This product described is a remotely operated electrical wheelchair, whose seat can go to the floor level, and any person can be dragged from the floor to the seat and then the seat automatically lifts to seating level. It can take up to 150kgs of weight and takes 1 minute to lift the person.

Patent_Title: Channel and Oxide Engineered Tunnel field effect transistor for Enhanced Device Parameters
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Nithin Kumar N R | Dr. Dinesha P | Dr. Madhura R
Abstract: Boosting the performance of semiconductor device by employing heterojunction TFET, involves several key design considerations and strategies to improve their structure. The hetero structure provides better performance compared to traditional counterpart. This configuration significantly enhances gate control over the channel, reducing leakage currents and improving subthreshold slope. High-k dielectrics and metal gates are often used to minimize gate leakage and enhance drive current. Novel material for the Channels can be provide excellent electrostatic control, thermal conductivity and offer higher drive current due to their larger cross-sectional area.

Patent_Title: Sustainable and Affordable Food-storage for micro-Enterprises
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Pavithra G | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Prof. Padmavathi M | Mallikarjun | Ravi Gorentla | Sujal S. K | Yogesh Desai
Abstract: Food storage and preservation plays a very crucial challenge for many small- and large-scale businesses and farmers who need to preserve their produce from getting spoiled and their food, hard work goes to waste, for these reasons small- and large-scale cooling systems are used by them. But when you take into consideration much smaller businesses like street vendors who buy perishable items like fruits, vegetables, and dairy products every single day and struggle to keep them fresh till the end's end as they easily spoil due to high temperatures and inadequate cooling solutions, this leads to significant food waste and financial losses. Traditional cooling systems used by small- and large-scale industries cannot be used by the street vendors as they are expensive, require a continuous power supply, making them impractical for mobile vendors and areas with unstable electricity grids. Some vendors rely on ice-based cooling, but this method is temporary, requires frequent replenishment and does not provide consistent temperature control. This invention addressed these limitations by introducing a solar powered cooling system using Peltier modules, heat sinks, and fans to maintain an optimal storage temperature. The system is energy-efficient, affordable, and portable making this a food storage and preservation solution for street vendors.

Patent_Title: A Browser Extension for Preventing Sensitive Data Leaks during Online Uploads
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Nikitha Kulashreshtha | Samarth B C | Dr. Deepthi V S | Dr. Mohammed Tajuddin
Abstract: A browser extension called SafeUpload guards against inadvertently disclosing private data when uploading files online. It automatically checks text, photos, and files for private keys, metadata, and identifiers. If any content is found, it notifies the user and gives them the choice to anonymize or redact it. SafeUpload improves user privacy and digital security by reducing the likelihood of identity theft, stalking, and targeted cyberattacks by filtering sensitive material before it is published.

Patent_Title: Blockchain-Enabled Infrastructure for Clinical Trial Data Integrity with Post-Quantum Cryptography and ZK-HSMs
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Deepthi V S | Dr. Mohammed Tajuddin | Manasa C | Dr. Dheeraj D | Dr. Shashidhar R
Abstract: Every dataset is based on a permissioned blockchain ledger, which securely and impenetrably stores metadata, patient consent logs, cryptographic hashes, and regulatory audit trails. The system uses ZK-HSMs, which provide hardware-anchored zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) to verify compliance, data validity, and protocol adherence without revealing private patient-level information, in order to strike a compromise between privacy and openness. With the help of these modules, sponsors, clinical researchers, and regulators can securely confirm trial results and data integrity while safeguarding private medical data. In order to lower the possibility of fraud and human mistake, the infrastructure also uses smart contracts to automate consent management, protocol enforcement, regulatory compliance checks, and anomaly detection. The system ensures controlled visibility and selective dissemination of data while adhering to FDA, GDPR, and HIPAA regulations by granting role-based access to various stakeholders. The invention creates a tamper-proof, quantum-resistant, and regulatory-compliant environment for clinical trial data management by fusing post-quantum cryptographic resilience, blockchain immutability, and zero-knowledge privacy-preserving verification. This increases confidence in study findings, guards against data tampering, facilitates open audits, and bolsters the legitimacy of healthcare innovation pipelines.

Patent_Title: An AI Content Detection and Verification Extension
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Samarth B C | Nikitha Kulashreshtha | Dr. Deepthi V S | Dr. Mohammed Tajuddin
Abstract: In order to safeguard consumers against false information, deepfakes, and manipulative media, the current invention, invention is a browser extension that allows real-time identification and verification of online material. The system incorporates a sentiment analysis module to identify biased or persuasive tones, a verification module to extract factual claims and compare them to reliable knowledge repositories, and an AI-content detection module to identify machine-generated or altered text and images. Invention provides clear visual cues without interfering with the user experience by highlighting dubious or unconfirmed content right within the user's browser context. Sensitive user data is anonymised during external verification queries thanks to additional privacy-preserving features included in the extension. Invention offers a complete and flexible solution against online disinformation and content by integrating multimodal detection, real-time claim validation, and rhetorical transparency. Invention offers a complete and flexible solution for online disinformation and content authenticity verification by fusing multimodal detection, real-time claim validation, and rhetorical transparency.

Patent_Title: Ni based spinel ferrite (SmxNdxNi1-2xFe2O4) for pharmaceutical pollutant detoxification
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Anantharaju K. S | Dr. Arpita Paul Chowdhury | Dr. Vidya Y S
Abstract: It is uncertain whether the environmental pollutants will have any short, medium or long-term effects on human health, and the maximum permissible levels of these contaminants are not systematically monitored. These recently identified contaminants have been present in water for years and are now being identified as potentially fatal contaminants. Pharmaceuticals are biologically active substances created to advance human health and welfare. However, a number of these chemicals, such as tranquilizers, antidepressants, birth control medications, antibiotics, chemotherapeutic agents, and painkillers are entering the environment through human and animal waste which affects groundwater, because a significant portion of the dose is not absorbed by the body. As a result, certain residual amounts are still present in treated water or have been discovered in drinking water. Ferrites materials are class of one of the highly chemically stable materials, especially in severe environments, is crucial for wastewater treatment applications. In the present study Ni based spinel ferrite (SmxNdxNi1-2xFe2O4) is prepared by solid state reaction technique by one step autocombustion method. The phase and surface morphology were analyzed by XRD, SEM analysis and optical property by UV-vis spectroscopy. The performance was assessed via the degradation of paracetamol compound under visible light irradiation. The incorporation of Nd3+ and Sm3+ ions significantly enhanced the degradation efficiency to 85%. The study results demonstrated that the material's magnetic and photocatalytic properties may be optimized simultaneously by precisely adjusting its structural and compositional parameters, suggesting that it may be suitable for soft magnetic components and wastewater remediation applications.

Patent_Title: Hybrid La/Dy co-doped Bismuth oxide for catalytic removal of dye mixtures in aqueous medium
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Arpita Paul Chowdhury | Dr. Anantharaju K. S | Dr. Vidya Y S | Aishwarya A
Abstract: Despite being regarded as a cutting-edge photoactive energy material, bismuth oxide (Bi2O3), a yellow semiconductor ceramic material, still requires refinement in order to be used in practical applications. In the present study one step combustion method is employed to synthesize La/Dy co-doped Bi2O3 samples. The samples were characterized by XRD, SEM and DRS. Further advanced oxidation process (photocatalysis) method is adopted for the removal of dye mixtures from waste water sample. Upon exposure to visible light, synthesize La/Dy co-doped Bi2O3 samples showed 98.5% degradation efficiency within 60 min. Thus the material developed is effective, realistic, affordable, and ecologically friendly technique for treating wastewater discharged by many industries

Patent_Title: A Wearable Proximity-Alert System for Preventing Group Member Separation in Crowded Public Spaces
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rudresh M | Ms. Nishchitha M H | Dr. Prashanth K P | Dr. Ravikumar M
Abstract: Group travel in crowded environments such as temples, tourist destinations, and festivals often poses the risk of accidental separation, particularly for vulnerable members like children and the elderly. Existing solutions, including public announcements and CCTV monitoring, are reactive and only assist after separation occurs, leading to stress and delays. This innovation proposes the GroupGuard Band, a proactive, wearable proximity-alert system designed to prevent such incidents. Each group member wears a Wi-Fi-enabled wristband that forms a local communication network. The system continuously monitors distance using Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) and determines relative direction via an integrated QMC5883L compass sensor. If a member exceeds the predefined safe distance, the band triggers a vibration alert and provides directional guidance on an OLED display. An SOS button allows emergency signaling. The prototype demonstrates a low-cost, real-time, and user-friendly solution, offering enhanced safety and peace of mind for travelers in crowded public spaces.

Patent_Title: Emerging electrochemical application of disposable modified Bi-CdFe2O4-carbon paste electrode for sensing of heavy metal mercury ion (Hg2?)
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Surendra B S | Dr. Bhaskar M | Dr. Kiran T | Dr. H.C. Ananda Murthy | Dr. Prashanth T | Dr. Tan Kar Ban | Dr. Rudresh M
Abstract: The facile, cost-effective synthesized Bi-CdFe2O4 nanoparticle by Probe-sonication approach employed for electrochemical sensor studies. The synthesized Bi-CdFe2O4 nanomaterial displayed an excellent electrochemical sensing activity towards heavy metal mercury ion (Hg2+) due to its lower crystallite size with energy band gap, higher surface area, catalytic and sensitivity. The emerging selective and sensitive electrochemical spotting of heavy metal mercury ion (Hg2+) present in acidic electrolyte was achieved by using immobilized modified nano-carbon paste electrode at scan rate of 0.01-0.05 V/s. The developed Bi-CdFe2O4/carbon paste immobilized electrode exploring the electron transfer reactions and displayed a highly selective detection confirmed by the evidence of redox potential peaks at -0.72V & 0.88V with increments of 1-5mM mercuric concentrations in 0.1M KCl electrolyte at scan rate of 0.03V/s. This electrochemical sensing studies offers a higher sensitivity and selectivity of different toxic components using nano-structured materials

Patent_Title: Lanthanum-Doped Copper Oxide Nanomaterial Derived from Citrus limetta and Manihot esculenta for Hydrogen Evolution and Perovskite Solar Cell Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Deepa H A | Dr. Hemavathi B | Johar R Athigiri | M G Shashank | Sahana M | Manasi V Prasad | Dr. Jagannathan Krishnan
Abstract: This invention presents an eco-friendly method for synthesizing lanthanum-doped copper oxide (La-CuO) nanomaterials using natural plant-based extracts-Citrus limetta and Manihot esculenta. These green fuels serve as reducing and combustion agents in the solution combustion synthesis of CuO nanoparticles. The invention highlights significant enhancements in material performance due to lanthanum doping, including improved current density in Electrochemical Hydrogen Evolution (EHE) and power conversion efficiency in perovskite solar cell (PSC) applications. Analytical characterization via SEM, FTIR, EDAX, and XRD confirms structural integrity, elemental composition, and crystalline quality of the synthesized nanomaterial. The invention provides a non-toxic, and scalable route for fabricating advanced functional nanomaterials.

Patent_Title: Novel nitrobenzene-filled planar three-core PCF with an enhanced nonlinearity for all-optical switching and computing applications at 1310 nm
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: T. Uthayakumar
Abstract: This invention discloses a three-core photonic crystal fiber (TCPCF) architecture with its optical guiding cores infiltrated by nitrobenzene, a highly nonlinear liquid, aimed at facilitating all-optical switching and computing functionalities at the telecommunication wavelength of 1310 nm. The fiber structure is engineered through a precise arrangement of air holes embedded in a silica glass matrix, forming the photonic crystal cladding. The design incorporates a central core and two adjacent linear cores on either side; all infiltrated with nitrobenzene to act as nonlinear optical waveguides. To ensure proper confinement and minimize boundary reflections, the PCF is encapsulated within a perfectly matched layer (PML) boundary of 4 μm thickness. Numerical simulations through finite element method (FEM) confirm that this TCPCF design supports single-mode propagation at 1310 nm, exhibiting strong nonlinear coefficients attributable to the nitrobenzene infiltration with a sufficiently low absorption loss. The configuration is optimized for advanced nonlinear photonic applications, including supercontinuum generation, ultrafast all-optical signal processing, and photonic computing architectures for short-reach ultrafast optical networks.

Patent_Title: FPGA Based Precision Fertigation System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr.A.R.Aswatha | B.H.Monish | Kavya A | Khushi M.S | Gagan M.K
Abstract: Modern precision farming depends critically on efficient resource management and crop-specific care to maximize output while preserving sustainability. Using Verilog, this mini project aims to design and simulate a Smart Fertigation System automating moisture monitoring, soil pH adjustment, and fertilizer delivery. Designed to satisfy the demands of two crops-capsicum and cauliflower-the system uses real-time data to guide decisions about nutrient supply and watering. After calibrating it with a Vedic multiplier, the pH Correction Module compares raw 10-bit ADC data to crop-specific pH criteria. It suggests, then, an either basic or acidic correction. Irrigation is only started when moisture levels fall below a specified threshold, so preventing overwatering and encouraging efficient water management. Based on crop type and day of week, the Fertigation Scheduler activates a particular 8-bit fertilizer code delivering exact nutrient combinations. The system is tested under a variety of crop type, pH, moisture, and day input conditions using a full simulation framework-Verilog Testbench.

Patent_Title: IoT-Integrated Predictive Monitoring for Sustainable Fish Farming
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Meharunnisa S.P | Anjana Joshi | Mohammed Mustafa Raza | Krishna Mohan VSS
Abstract: The IoT‐Based Smart Aquaculture System delivers portable, battery‐powered nodes that continuously monitor critical water parameters pH, temperature, turbidity, and TDS in fish farms, hatcheries, and aquaponic setups. Each node uses an ESP32 microcontroller to process sensor data and relay it via MQTT to a centralized Home Assistant server, providing real‐time visibility and basic actuator assistance for heaters, oxygenators, pH dosing, feeders, and pumps. By empowering farmers with live dashboards and historical trend charts, the system reduces manual sampling, improves response times to environmental fluctuations, and supports sustainable aquaculture practices. Its modular design allows quick deployment pond‐side without extensive wiring, making advanced monitoring accessible to both small‐scale operators and large commercial enterprises.

Patent_Title: Garcinia indica derived antimicrobial formulation as botanical biopesticide, natural preservative and veterinary feed supplement
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Supreetha K | Shubham Shiralkar | Pururava H
Abstract: The current invention relates to a novel antimicrobial formulation derived from the fruit rind extract of Garcinia indica, a plant commonly consumed as food in the form of juice, curries, and concentrated syrups. Although Garcinia indica is widely valued for its culinary and nutraceutical properties, its potent antimicrobial activity has not been exploited for industrial applications. The invention discloses a standardized plant-derived formulation exhibiting strong antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The formulation is suitable for diverse applications, including as a botanical biopesticide for controlling bacterial and fungal pathogens in crops, as a natural preservative for extending the shelf-life of food and beverages, and as a veterinary feed supplement to enhance immunity and reduce susceptibility to microbial infections in livestock. This invention demonstrates the novel use of a commonly consumed edible plant as a multipurpose antimicrobial agent, providing a safe, eco-friendly, and sustainable alternative to chemical pesticides, preservatives, and antibiotics.

Patent_Title: Solvent Assisted - Selective Extraction of Nutrients from Vermicompost Waste for Substrate Formulation to Optimize Oleaginous Microorganism Cultivation and Enhance Lipid Biosynthesis
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Priya S | Mithali Kishore Rao
Abstract: The invention relates to a novel process for converting vermicompost waste into nutrient enhanced microbial growth media optimized to cultivate oleaginous microorganisms for lipid biosynthesis. The method employs selective extraction of the nutrients by employing EDTA, HCl, water and ethanol as solvents. The substrate to solvent ratio is varied from 1:05 to 1:20 (w/v), determined through factorial experimental design. The process demonstrates that HCl extraction yields optimal nutrient profiles with enhanced nitrogen (1.5%), phosphorus (0.9%), and essential micronutrients (Fe: 170 ppm, Zn: 24 ppm) compared to conventional extraction methods. The resulting media exhibits balanced C:N ratios suitable for oleaginous species including Rhodotorula, Yarrowia lipolytica, and Mortierella species. The extract, provides natural source of macro and micro nutrients and therefore is used as media to support yeast growth and boost lipid accumulation up to 75% dry cell weight with fatty acid composition. The enhanced bioavailability of nutrients through solvent extraction reduces the cost by 60-80% compared to conventional synthetic media and thus can be used for economically scalable production of microbial oils for therapeutic applications. Microbial oils have excellent pharmaceutical applications particularly in wound healing formulations as fatty acids in it promote tissue regeneration, reduce inflammation and provide antimicrobial properties. The invention provides a sustainable biotechnology solution addressing crucial environmental challenges like organic waste management and green synthesis of therapeutic lipids for pharmaceutical applications.

Patent_Title: Smart User Engagement System for Video-Based Learning Using Contextual Key-Based Interaction
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Krishnan Rangarajan
Abstract: A system and method for verifying active user engagement with video learning material, which intelligently identifies contextually significant points in the video and prompts the user to perform specific key-based interactions. The solution distinguishes between passive listening and active viewing, enabling more reliable assessment of user attention and participation in self-paced digital learning environments.

Patent_Title: Hybrid LiDAR-Sonar System for Submerged Object Detection in Turbid and Contaminated Floodwaters
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Preethi.P | Dr.Kavitha K S | Prof. Muquitha Almas
Abstract: A hybrid sensing system is disclosed for detecting submerged objects in turbid and contaminated floodwaters. The system integrates Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) and sonar technologies mounted on a watercraft platform to enhance object detection in environments where conventional optical or acoustic sensing alone is limited by poor visibility, mud, and suspended contaminants. The LiDAR subsystem provides high-resolution surface and near-surface mapping, while the sonar subsystem penetrates below the water surface to identify submerged objects and terrain irregularities. Sensor fusion algorithms combine data from both modalities to generate a reliable three-dimensional representation of the flooded environment. The system enables accurate localization and classification of hazardous submerged obstacles, supporting safe navigation, disaster response, and recovery operations. This invention improves detection accuracy under adverse water conditions, reduces false positives caused by turbidity, and enhances resilience in real-world flood scenarios.

Patent_Title: Automated Entertainment Device Power Control Using Gaze and Audio Response Detection
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Krishnan Rangarajan
Abstract: A system and method for automatically switching off an entertainment device, such as a television, that is integrated into a home automation network. The invention uses camera-based gaze detection to determine if anyone is actively viewing the device. Upon detecting no viewing presence, an audio prompt is issued; if no user responds by turning their gaze towards the device within a predetermined time, the entertainment device is powered off. This approach ensures effective energy savings.

Patent_Title: App-Based System and Method for Customized Catering Service Selection, AI Menu Generation, and Invoicing with Payment Management
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. D R Ramesh Babu | Manasvini S | Teeksha Harish
Abstract: The present invention relates to a computerized app-based system and method for assisting customers in selecting catering services tailored to their specific requirements. By collecting input regarding occasion, desired menu, budget, and other preferences, the system filters and shortlists suitable caterers. It provides detailed information about each caterer, enabling customers to make informed decisions and secure catering services that best fit their needs. The system includes an AI-powered feature that helps customers customize their menu by adjusting the kinds and quantities of meal items, filtering options to generate a desired menu. Upon booking, the system automatically generates an invoice to simplify payment processing and enable efficient tracking. The payment terms require 50% advance to confirm booking and balance due within three days after the event, enhancing payment efficiency. This innovative solution streamlines catering selection, menu customization, booking, and payment processes to improve customer satisfaction and service quality.

Patent_Title: A System and Method for Enabling AI-Based Object Detection and Data Processing
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Shobana Padmanabhan | Gooty Zeba Fathima
Abstract: This invention refers to a system and method of real-time object detection and data processing with the aid of machine learning algorithms. The features were detected by the ORB algorithm and the feature matching FLANN algorithm. Both ensured that there is delivery of high accuracy in the processing of diversity in environments. The system verifies the input data, employs dynamic matching thresholding, and classifies results on the basis of the criteria of binary needs such that the reliable detection is implemented without substantial computational burdens. This invention highly reflects the industrial applications in retail, logistics, security, and autonomous systems industries. It is also expected to be used in the manufacturing and healthcare industries.

Patent_Title: Phyto-mediated green synthesis of dysprosium oxide nanoparticles and their applications in antimicrobial and anticancer therapeutics
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Madhu A | Dr Srinatha N | Dr. Mohamed Zikriya | Pradeep H N | Josephine Princy T R | M. Sai Shriya | Pooja S | Bipin Rohan
Abstract: We report on the green-mediated synthesis of dysprosium oxide (Dy2O3) nanocrystalline particles (NPs) using the extract of the Rosa-sinensis flower, which exhibits antimicrobial and cytotoxic properties. The quantification of photo-chemicals revealed that the extract contains 240.56 ± 12.06 μg/mL of total polyphenols and 97.86 ± 7.707 μg/mL of flavonoids. The Dy2O3 NPs demonstrated significant antifungal activity against Aspergillus flavus, showing an inhibition zone of 15.33 ± 0.57 mm, which exceeds the control measure of 14.33 ± 0.57 mm at a concentration of 30 μL. Additionally, the prepared Dy2O3 NPs exhibited notable cytotoxic activity against MCF-7 cells, with a lower IC50 value of 87.50 μg/mL.

Patent_Title: A novel and compact design of Rectangular Monopole antenna with elliptical slot and L stubs for wireless communication systems
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Aruna P | Dr. Naveen S M | Dr. Joseph C M | Mr. Ravikumar S | Dr. Trupti Tagare | Dr. Shobha K R
Abstract: A compact rectangular monopole antenna for wireless communication systems is disclosed in this invention. The antenna has an elliptical slot etched into radiating patch and symmetrical square shaped slots at the corners are also integrated to radiating patch and rectangular slots in the ground plane. This unique design and configuration of the slots and stubs introduces multiple resonant frequencies that merge to create a wide impedance bandwidth. The design offers improved impedance matching and stable radiation pattern (shape) which makes it suitable for various ultra wide band (UWB) and multi band applications. Our designed UWB printed monopole antenna is compact and efficient.

Patent_Title: MediScan - UUID's linked with QR Codes, for Monitoring Expiry Dates and Ensuring Protection against Fake Medicines
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Rajeshwari J | Dr. Prathima Mabel J | Vibha Shankar Rao | Sweedel Rodrigues | Sakshi Shetty | Teli Mushera
Abstract: The consumption of fake or expired medicines leads to health risks due to a lack of critical information on the packaging of the medicine, like medicine name, expiry date, price, composition, authenticity status, etc. This can happen if the medicine packaging is torn or half used, etc. To address this challenge, our website, MediScan, is designed to enhance medicine safety through QR-based verification. It allows the users to upload an image of the QR code printed on the packaging of each medicine from any device. Where the QR code contains the unique UUID (Universally Unique ID), which is decoded and sent to the backend to verify in the centralized database. Upon verification of the UUID, our website MediScan displays the information about medicine, which includes medicine name, expiry date, price, composition, authenticity status and more. If the UUID doesn't match the centralized database in the backend, the user is alerted about it. Also, an admin panel is provided for pharmaceutical manufacturers to securely log in, add medicine information, and generate the QR code for medicine. Password hashing is implemented for ensuring the security of admin credentials. Our website promotes transparency and safety in the pharmaceutical supply chain and also offers user-friendly solutions to customers, consumers, healthcare providers, and pharmacies.

Patent_Title: AI-Driven Smart Retention: Strategies for Predicting and Preventing Customer Loss
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Chandrakala B M | Dr. Madhura J | Shalini K B | Bharath BC | Madhavaram Swapna | Vidya G Byakod
Abstract: Customer churn is a significant challenge that many businesses face today. Keeping existing customers is often more cost-effective than trying to win new ones, and it's crucial for long-term success. In this paper, we introduce Smart Retention, a user-friendly web-based AI platform designed to help businesses predict and reduce customer loss. Built using technologies like HTML, React, TypeScript, Flask, and Tailwind CSS, this platform includes a smart conversational agent powered by the Gemini 2.0 Flash API. By analyzing customer behavior and using predictive modeling, Smart Retention can identify customers who might be at risk of leaving and engage them proactively with personalized interactions. Our main goal is to improve customer retention and satisfaction through automation and real-time decision-making, helping businesses thrive in a competitive landscape.

Patent_Title: Drone-Aided Bio-Inspired Ground Robots: A Synergistic Approach to Mobile Robotics
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Devaraju Ramakrishna | Vinod Kumar Agrawal
Abstract: The disclosed invention relates to a synergistic robotic system that integrates an aerial drone with one or more bio-inspired ground robots to achieve enhanced task execution through coordinated operation. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) configured to transport, deploy, and provide situational awareness for ground robots modelled on animal locomotion strategies, including serpentine, tortoise-like, hopping, or multi-legged motion. The UAV contributes rapid aerial mapping, global navigation support, and communication relay, while the ground robots perform localized interaction in confined, cluttered, or terrain-challenging environments. The UAV can direct, observe, or relocate the ground robots in accordance with mission requirements thanks to a cooperative control system that permits dynamic task allocation between the aerial and ground units. The accuracy and resilience of task execution are further improved by sensor fusion between the ground robot's local perception and the drone's aerial perspective. In addition to allowing cooperative task sharing among heterogeneous robotic units and opening up new applications in agriculture, search and rescue, environmental monitoring, and defence, this architecture offers significant advantages in overcoming the mobility limitations of aerial or ground platforms when used independently.

Patent_Title: IIR Filters with Balanced Ternary Floating-Point Representation for ECG Signal Artefact Removal
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Srividya B V | Mrs. Nagarathna | Dr. A R Aswatha
Abstract: In the field of medicinal practice, electrocardiogram (ECG) signals are frequently used for diagnosing cardiac related problems. These signals are normally affected by artefacts such interference due to power line, baseline wander, electromyogram (EMG) noise, and disturbances caused by the movement of electrodes. In the ECG signals the significant features are P-wave, QRS complex, and T-wave. These features can be distorted by the artefacts, which cause a reduction in the diagnosis accuracy. Hence it is mandatory to reduce the effect of artefacts for an accurate ECG analysis. According to researchers, the conventional filtering techniques used are low-pass filters for high-frequency muscle artefacts, notch filters for power line noise, and high-pass filters to minimize baseline drift. The data signals are normally processed in Binary floating point format and the entire system can be implemented on a reconfigurable logic after verifying its functionality. Data storage becomes more compact by transforming traditional binary representation into balanced ternary, which conserves memory space and makes it possible to store and handle higher quantities of biological signal data effectively. Hence this system is implemented using Ternary Floating-Point Unit and its associated floating-point arithmetic to maintain the accuracy required for biomedical signal processing. Floating-point addition, subtraction, and multiplication units developed at the Register Transfer Level are incorporated into the filtering design.

Patent_Title: Low Noise Amplifier with a Programmable Digital Attenuator for RF front-end and SATCOM Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Pushpa B R | Dr. Devaraju R | Prajwala P | Priti Prasad P
Abstract: A high-performance RF module is disclosed, comprising a cascaded two-stage Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) and a programmable digital attenuator for satellite and microwave applications. The LNA, designed using a Heterojunction Field Effect Transistor (HJFET), achieves a gain of 25.81 dB with a noise figure of 0.40 dB at 12 GHz. The programmable attenuator operates from DC to 30 GHz with a minimum step of 0.5 dB and a maximum attenuation of 31.5 dB, controlled by a 6-bit digital input. A metal housing minimizes electromagnetic interference, ensuring stable operation. The combined design offers low noise, wide bandwidth, fine attenuation control, and cost-effective integration for microwave receiver and satellite communication systems.

Patent_Title: Modular Test Rig for Characterization and Analysis of Solar Photovoltaic Modules
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. M. PREMKUMAR | Mr. VIGNESH | Mr. OMKAR M NAIK | Mr. SUDEEP K | Mr. SURAJ M WALIKAR
Abstract: The invention provides a modular test rig apparatus for evaluating the performance of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems under simulated environmental and electrical conditions. The apparatus comprises multiple photovoltaic panels mounted on adjustable tilt mechanisms, a halogen-lamp-based solar simulator movable along a linear track, and an irradiance control system enabling real-time variation of light intensity. The rig incorporates configurable electrical connections for series and parallel arrangements, integrated temperature and irradiance sensors, and a data acquisition unit for real-time measurement of current-voltage (I-V) and power-voltage (P-V) characteristics. The invention enables experimental analysis of maximum power point tracking (MPPT), shading effects, temperature coefficients, and configuration efficiency. By replicating real-world solar conditions in a controlled environment, the invention facilitates reliable research, educational demonstration, and photovoltaic technology optimization.

Patent_Title: Renewable Energy Powered Intelligent Load Monitoring System for Railway Wagons
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. M. PREMKUMAR | Mr. RAKSHIT ANAND MOKTALI | Mr. SRUJAN S KASHYAP | Mr. PUNITH KUMAR S M | Mr. POOJTH H S
Abstract: The invention discloses a renewable energy-powered intelligent load monitoring system for railway wagons. The system comprises load sensors integrated with a microcontroller, data acquisition, GSM and GPS communication modules, and a solar-powered supply with maximum power point tracking (MPPT). The system continuously monitors wagon loads, detects overloading and imbalance conditions, and provides real-time alerts through cloud-based IoT platforms. Visual indicators and alarms assist in local identification of unsafe loading conditions, while remote transmission ensures transparency and operational safety. The invention enhances railway freight transport's efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.

Patent_Title: Adaptive Robotic Manipulator with Smart Vision and Real-Time Control
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Pavithra G | Dr. Swapnil S. Ninawe | Prof. Padmavathi M | Sujith M S | Edwin C Daison | Sudarshan D Pai | Meha Shree
Abstract: The invention presents a Smart Robotic Arm that integrates real-time image recognition and adaptive control algorithms to replicate human arm movements with high precision. Utilizing a camera-based vision system, AI- driven image processing, and microcontroller-based actuation, the robotic arm dynamically mirrors human gestures for applications in surgery, manufacturing, and assistive technologies. Key innovations include low- latency motion tracking, sensor fusion for adaptive feedback, and AI-powered speech recognition for gesture activation. The system ensures seamless human-robot collaboration by processing visual data locally, reducing dependency on centralized systems, and enabling real-time responsiveness.

Patent_Title: Configurable and Low-Power Instruction Cache Architecture with Incremental Synthesis Optimization for Embedded and RISC-Based Processors
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Madhura R | Dr. Manasa R
Abstract: The current invention leads to the revelation of a programmable and low-energy intake cache (ICache) construction adapted to suit embedded systems and RISC-based processors. The cache architecture is written in Verilog as well and can be parameterized with cache size (4k-16k blocks) and block size (4-64 bytes) parameters as needed, making it flexible across a wide variety of system architectures without needing to be re-architectured or re-synthesized into concrete engineering systems. The verification under functional verification performed with Cadence Xcelium was done to check correct cache hit and miss operations during the simulation for runs up to 90 ns. Using Cadence Genus, smaller tree synthesis of a 268-cell design engine reduced the cell count to 213 even with active constant propagation, logic simplification, and elimination of redundant gates without timing errors. A Cadence Joules power analysis calculated a total power of 23.64 uW, which was contributed mainly by registers. The invention therefore offers a performance-optimized, resource-efficient, performance-per-watt solution: a performance-optimized, area-optimized, and power-optimized, scalable, low-power cache that is adapted to and integrated into high-speed embedded and processor-based systems today.

Patent_Title: AI-Driven Predictive and Preventive System for Railway Sabotage Detection and Risk Mitigation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sathvik S | Dr. Shashi Raj K | Dr. Trupti S Tagare | Raghavendra Prajwal H.S | Nitin Kumar | Shahaji Patil | Tahera | Dr Gautam | Dr. Shashidhar Halagappa Eswarappa | Dr. Suma V
Abstract: This invention proposes an integrated artificial intelligence (AI)-based system for detecting, predicting, and preventing acts of sabotage on railway infrastructure. The system leverages real-time sensor data, computer vision, drone surveillance, anomaly detection models, and risk-based geospatial analytics to identify threats to tracks, bridges, and signaling systems. The invention provides an intelligent framework for immediate threat alerting, automated countermeasures, and law enforcement coordination, reducing the risk of deliberate damage or obstruction.

Patent_Title: IoT-Based Distributed Monitoring and Emergency Response Framework for Sabotage Prevention in Railway Networks
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sathvik S | Dr. Shashi Raj K | Dr. Trupti S Tagare | Raghavendra Prajwal H.S | Nitin Kumar | Shahaji Patil | Tahera | Dr Gautam | Dr. Shashidhar Halagappa Eswarappa | Dr. Suma V
Abstract: This invention discloses a smart Internet of Things (IoT)-based framework for detecting and mitigating sabotage threats across railway infrastructure. Unlike conventional systems, the invention enables continuous multi-point sensing through a distributed IoT architecture with edge analytics, fault-tolerant wireless mesh communication, and real-time coordination with railway command centers. The framework emphasizes decentralized intelligence, low-latency alerts, and autonomous responses such as section lockdown, illumination deterrents, or electromagnetic signal blocking to prevent sabotage incidents in critical zones.

Patent_Title: AI-Driven Integrated Rare Earth Element Recycling and Supply Chain Management System with Real-Time Optimization and Predictive Analytics
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Gagana H R | V Shriyatha | Srujana D V | Thrisha C S | Ranjitha M | Megha Karil
Abstract: This invention introduces RECycleAI-a holistic, artificial intelligence-based sustainable, rare earth element (REE) recycling system that seamlessly integrates advanced material recovery, real-time supply chain optimization and predictive analytics. While existing recycling practices are inherently disaggregated, this system brings together an artificial intelligence-based approach to material identification, automated sorting, energy-efficient extraction, and blockchain-based supply chain monitoring into a holistic solution. The core of this invention is an adaptive AI controller that continuously optimizes recycling parameters based on material composition analysis, energy consumption, and forecasted market demand. RECycleAI closes the gap in sustainable REE recovery by providing a cost-effective, environmentally sound, and scalable solution that minimizes reliance on environmentally negative primary mining, along with protecting and securing intellectual property through processing protocols.

Patent_Title: Sleep Enhancement and Creative Thought System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sharon Christa | Aprameya Bharadwaj | C V Balaji | Rohan G | Vineeth Nakka | Tanvi Thakre | Himanshu Rai
Abstract: A system for optimizing sleep quality and preserving creative thought is disclosed. The system integrates real-time biometric sleep monitoring (heart rate, motion and REM cycle detection from wearables) with AI-driven environmental and auditory control. An intelligent processor analyzes incoming sensor data to identify sleep stages. In response, an adaptive audio engine selects or generates sleep-promoting auditory stimuli to facilitate uninterrupted sleep. Concurrently, an IoT-enabled environment controller adjusts ambient conditions - for example, modulating room temperature via a smart air conditioner - based on the current sleep phase. The system replaces conventional alarms by identifying an optimal wake window and gently rousing the user through gradual thermal changes and soft sound cues, building on prior EEG-synchronized awakening techniques. During the hypnagogic sleep-onset phase, an EEG-equipped smart pillow monitors neural activity. A user tap on the pillow activates a thought-capture mode, triggering recording of recent EEG patterns and contextual audio. A machine-learning module processes these signals: neural-pattern recognition reconstructs the emergent semi-conscious thoughts or images and encodes them as textual journal entries. Upon awakening, a morning dashboard presents consolidated sleep metrics alongside the captured ideas and AI-generated dream interpretations. The novelty of the invention lies in its cohesive software intelligence. Machine-learning algorithms continuously fuse multisource sleep data with adaptive stimuli control and environment management while interfacing with the EEG pillow "consciousness interface" for ideation capture.

Patent_Title: Context-Persistent, Multi-User AI-Collaborative Workspace for Full-Cycle Startup Creation and Acceleration
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Davan C Reddy | Krishna Chaithanya S N | Shishir Hebbar | Dr. Suma V | Shobha N | Prof. Poornima D
Abstract: The invention reveals Sparkboard AI-an integrated, real-time, multi-user collaboration environment with a persistent, context-aware AI assistant tailored to eliminate friction in the entire lifecycle of startup development. In contrast to current disconnected tools, this platform integrates ideation, prototyping, coding, docs, and presentation into a single synchronous environment. The central differentiator is a shared, always-on AI collaborator that can keep context session-to-session, user-to-user, and module-to-module-thus allowing smart, continuous assistance along the team's path from idea to launch. Sparkboard AI removes tool fragmentation, greatly accelerates team velocity, and invents a new category of AI-augmented collaborative infrastructure.

Patent_Title: A Method for Enhancing the Performance of Bituminous Mixtures Using Digested Sludge Ash
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Shiva Kumar. G | Ujwal. M.S | Dr. H. K. Ramaraju
Abstract: The present invention relates to a bituminous mixture modified with digested sludge ash (DSA) for road construction applications. The invention provides an optimized composition wherein DSA, a waste-derived material, is incorporated as a modifier with bitumen to improve the performance and sustainability of asphalt mixtures. Using Response Surface Methodology (RSM), the effects of varying DSA content (4-16%) and bitumen content (5-6%) were systematically evaluated on critical performance parameters including voids in total mix (VTM), voids in mineral aggregates (VMA), voids filled with bitumen (VFA), bulk specific gravity (Gmb), Marshall stability, flow, tensile strength (dry and wet), tensile strength ratio, rutting resistance, dynamic modulus, and elastic modulus. The optimized formulation was identified at approximately 5.5% bitumen and 10% DSA, achieving a balanced enhancement in mechanical and durability properties. Statistical validation confirmed the significant influence of DSA on the mixture performance. The invention demonstrates that incorporation of DSA provides an environmentally beneficial and cost-effective means of improving bituminous mixtures, thereby promoting sustainable pavement construction practices.

Patent_Title: SUSTAINABLE METHOD FOR SLOPE STABILIZATION AND LANDSLIDE CONTROL USING PLANT-DERIVED ENZYMES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Raghavendra H N | Sanjeev T P | Raghavendra Prajwal H S | Ashwini Sathynarayana | Dr. Geetha L
Abstract: The invention relates to an eco-technological system for mitigating rainfall-induced shallow landslides through soil stabilization using Enzyme-Induced Calcite Precipitation (EICP). Conventional approaches such as retaining structures and cement-based grouting are cost-intensive, environmentally unsustainable, and limited in long-term resilience. The present invention introduces a sustainable bio-geotechnical method wherein ekozyme and urease enzymes catalyze urea hydrolysis, producing carbonate ions that precipitate as calcium carbonate in the presence of calcium salts. The resulting calcite crystals bind soil particles, reduce permeability, and enhance shear strength, thereby improving slope stability under rainfall infiltration. The system integrates rainfall simulation, controlled delivery of EICP solution, and performance monitoring through shear strength and permeability. Applications include slope stabilization in highways, railways, hilly terrains, and erosion-prone regions. Key innovations include an optimized enzymatic treatment protocol for heterogeneous soils, enhanced rainfall resistance without environmental hazards, and the replacement of energy-intensive chemical stabilizers with a bio-based approach. The invention thus provides a sustainable, cost-effective, and scalable solution to erosion-induced shallow landslides.

Abstract: Concrete, a composite material composed of aggregates bound by cementitious paste, is widely used in construction. Abstract: The Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) is an electric motor that operates using magnetic fields to generate motion, rather than relying on brushes and commutators like traditional DC motors. By eliminating the commutator, SRMs offer a simplified mechanical design since power does not need to be transferred to moving components. However, this introduces complexities in the electrical design, as a switching system is required to regulate power delivery to different windings of the motor armature. The absence of brushes enhances durability and efficiency, making SRMs a reliable choice for various applications. Their operation is based on the principle of magnetic reluctance, where rotor movement is guided toward positions that minimize reluctance. This paper explores the fundamental working principles of SRMs, their advantages, and the challenges associated with their design, particularly in managing switching mechanisms for optimal performance.

Patent_Title: Honeycomb Structured Expanded Polystyrene Helmet Protective Liner

Abstract: This invention presents the design of a helmet liner made as honeycomb structures, which can solve the existing problems of motorcycle riders and increase their safety. Lattice structures allow for better ventilation than foam. This is because the struts in a lattice structure create channels for air to flow through the helmet. Lattice structures can be customized to fit the individual head shape. Customization can improve comfort and protection and can also help to reduce the risk of movement within the helmet during an impact, which can further reduce the risk of injury. Drop tests were simulated to evaluate the effectiveness of the honeycomb structures. The values of Peak linear acceleration (PLA), Head Impact Criteria (HIC) and Volumetric energy absorption (VEA) were obtained as per the Indian standards and are observed to be better than the conventional foam helmet liners. This is followed by the development of hybrid biosensors comparing invasive, non-invasive, electrical and acoustic mechanisms to determine the vitality for the same plant species. Patent_Title: A novel approach for assessing the performance of microstrip antennas operating at 5.8 GHz and 26 GHz for applications pertaining to 5G and beyond
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The latest technology, fifth generation (5G) is leading fast wireless and cellular communication system. It uses a millimetre wave technology and has a high frequency spectrum between 1GHz to 100GHz, which provides a better enhancement in the areas like latency, speed, connectivity, bandwidth, capacity, and security. A common option for 5G applications, microstrip patch antennas have a low profile, are simple to fabricate, and work with both planar and non-planar surfaces. This work uses the Computer Simulation Technology (CST) Microwave Studio Suite to design, simulate, and analyse the antenna at 5.8GHz and 26GHz frequencies. It is designed by using substrate material Flame Retardant 4 (FR4) and Copper, with 4.3 and 4.4 dielectric constants. The simulation results for 5.8GHz shows gain of 2.09692, return loss of -28.6590dB, bandwidth of 0.2072GHz, directivity of 6.429dBi, and efficiency of -4.4013dB. Similarly, for 26GHz frequency has a gain of 8.194, return loss of -35.657dB, bandwidth of 4.885GHz, directivity of 11.951dBi and efficiency -3.761dB. The suggested antenna's simulation results indicate how suitable it is for the 5G mobile communication system.

Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
