Abstract: Diabetes poses a significant health challenge worldwide, characterized by insufficient insulin production or ineffective utilisation, leading to elevated blood glucose levels. Hyperglycaemia resulting from uncontrolled diabetes can cause severe damage to various organs, elevating the risk of complications like heart disease, stroke, and kidney failure. To address the need for non-invasive glucose monitoring, researchers are exploring near-infrared spectroscopy (NIR) and other spectrum-based approaches. This work focuses on developing a low-cost, stress-free, on-the-spot glucose monitoring device utilizing NIR spectroscopy. The Prototype comprises a transmitter (light source), receiver, and processor/data display sections. NIR light is directed onto one side of the finger, and the attenuated light received on the opposite side is converted into a voltage signal. A microprocessor processes these variables, amplifies them, and communicates the glucose reading. Linear Regression Analysis establishes a proportional relationship between receiver output voltages and glucose concentrations. The study demonstrates that glucose concentration can be predicted accurately using NIR light at 1550 nm. Comparative analysis between invasive and non-invasive glucose concentration estimation methods further validates the device's efficacy. This work lays the groundwork for a non-invasive, user-friendly approach to diabetes monitoring, offering potential benefits in improved patient compliance and healthcare outcomes

Abstract: Gridded binary data, particularly in the context of large-scale datasets like those provided by the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD), is an essential format for representing geospatial data over large areas. This data is often collected and stored as a uniform grid with specific values at each grid point, where binary files offer a compact and efficient way to store large volumes of information. Gridded binary data is widely used in various scientific fields, including meteorology, climate modeling, and hydrology, because of its ability to represent complex phenomena across time and space with high precision. Gridded binary data is crucial for several reasons, particularly when it comes to the analysis of large-scale meteorological or environmental phenomena. Some advantages of gridded binary data are efficient in storage and handling, uniformity of data, scalability, precision and cross-disciplinary utility. Despite its advantages, gridded binary data has certain limitations. The limitations include complexity, accessibility, computational intensity and data integration. Interpreting and processing gridded binary data can be challenging, especially for users unfamiliar with the specific tools and techniques required to work with such data. While gridded data is efficient, it is not inherently user-friendly. Accessing and visualizing this data often requires specialized software and technical expertise.

The combination of Gen AI, NLP and machine learning algorithm in this healthcare chatbot exemplifies the potential of advanced technologies to revolutionize personalized healthcare services and improve overall public health outcomes.

Patent_Title: AI-Driven Deep CNN Approach For Multi-Label Pathology Classification Using Chest X-Rays
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Chandrakala B M | Dr Annapurna P Patil | Preethi Lokesh | Ananya Satish | Dr. Latha A P
Abstract: Radiography, renowned for its diagnostic prowess and affordability, plays a pivotal role in detecting diseases, including critical conditions. Chest radiography, focusing on a vital body area, poses interpretational challenges necessitating experienced radiologists for accuracy. Scarce expertise and human error susceptibility drive researchers to explore artificial intelligence (AI), predominantly employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). This innovation proposes a novel method of parallelizing multiple CNN architectures for chest X-ray classification. It conducts a thorough evaluation of existing architectures using this approach across four extensive datasets, including one non-medical. Results exhibit enhanced accuracy for most labels on the primary evaluation datasets. By leveraging AI and parallelization techniques, the proposed method showcases promising strides towards improving diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in chest radiography, while also highlighting areas for further refinement and exploration in the intersection of AI and medical imaging.

Patent_Title: A Catalyst for Secure Medical Data Aggregation through Block chain Technology
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Vani K A | Dr.Prathima Mabel J | Dr.Rama Mohan Babu K N
Abstract: Medical data is an essential and highly confidential piece of information. Individuals are now used to using either private medical record systems or, in most cases, none at all. This has led to a substantial lack of information in the diagnosis of a patient, affecting not only the patient but also the physicians and organizations involved. The most recent pandemic also emphasizes the lack of reliable, clear data, which keeps academic institutions from undertaking investigations that could help with preventative measures. One solution to this issue is a medical aggregation system that can provide the aforementioned functionalities to the stakeholders indicated above. Health-Coin is a platform for aggregating medical data that operates on IPFS and blockchain technology. These two technologies are used to create a distributed, decentralized, and secure system. This innovation aims to elucidate the system's concept, use-case, underlying technology, implementation, and future directions.

Patent_Title: Lead Zirconate Titanate based Polyvinylidene Fluoride a future energy harvesting Nanocomposites for Enhanced Robotic End Effector Performance
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Rakesh M | Dr. Rudresh M
Abstract: The present patent describes a novel method for fabricating lead zirconate titanate (PZT)-based polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) polymer nano-composites with enhanced microcrystalline structure, morphology, and electrical properties. The process involves the synthesis of PZT nanoparticles, which are then incorporated into a PVDF matrix using a specialized blending technique. This approach results in a composite material exhibiting improved piezoelectric and ferroelectric characteristics compared to traditional PVDF-based composites. Detailed studies reveal that the microcrystalline structure of the PZT nanoparticles influences the overall morphology of the PVDF matrix, leading to significant enhancements in electrical performance. The nano-composites demonstrated superior piezoelectric coefficients, increased dielectric permittivity, and enhanced mechanical properties, making them suitable for advanced applications in sensors, actuators, and energy harvesting devices. It was investigated how the PZT content affected the shape, crystalline size, and dielectric characteristics of the PVDF polymer. It was investigated how the PZT content affected the shape, crystalline size, and dielectric characteristics of the PVDF polymer.

Patent_Title: A Wearable Fabric Antenna with a Defective Ground Structure for Enhanced GPS Tracking for Safety Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ravikanti Swetha | Dr. Preeti Khanwalkar | Dr. Anitha Suresh | Aadya R Herle | Lakkshita K | Lakshmi S K | Leeshitha H
Abstract: Smart clothing as textile wearable electronics is capable of changing almost all sectors in society including healthcare, fun and entertainment, sports, and others like military and firefighting with wireless body communication for tracking and navigation through GPS access. One of the key sub-components of this technology is the wearable Antenna, which should have low thickness, and high flexibility and be easy to integrate into fabric material without compromising on the performance of Wearable Antennas. For instance, textile-based antennas have several drawbacks including frequency detuning and efficiency reduction due to deformation such as bending. This research work intends to proffer a 1. 8 GHz size for GPS tracking with a Defective Ground Structure (DGS), with a fabric antenna that does not detune frequencies and has good bending characteristics. The developed antenna has a dimension of 90mm × 100mm and comprises copper as the radiating part while the substrate is jean material. The current carrying, rectangular slots in the DGS increase the bandwidth while the structural distortions affect the detuning. Employing ANSYS and CST (Computer Simulation Technology) software, the assessment of the antenna was done with special emphasis on S-parameters, gain, radiation pattern, and current distribution. Simulation results along with numerical assessments reveal that the antenna can resonate at the intended frequency even when under E-plane bending. This design enhances GPS tracking performance so that the design is well-suited for wearable applications. This design is ideal for enhancing female security by enabling real-time location tracking in situations where they may face threats.

Patent_Title: Heuristic multi-valued focal plane processor with embedded cryptosystem
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Srividya B V | Mrs. Nagarathna | Dr. A R Aswatha | Dr. Vinod B Durdi
Abstract: In satellite communication, the number of beams in the field of view and their relative placements dictate the surveying and imaging speed of a radio telescope. Furthermore, a long integration time, a wide bandwidth, a low-noise receiver temperature, and efficient reflector illumination are required for high-quality observations in a Focal Plane Array (FPA). Large external Focal Plane Processors (FPP) has historically been needed in order to provide clocks, biases, and digitize the analogue output signals for FPA. Because the FPP is frequently large, heavy, and power-hungry, it needs to be carefully built. Above all, it is more challenging to maintain low noise performance across the system since the FPP and FPA need to be kept apart. The primary goal of this invention is the design of an Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) for the focal plane processor on a single chip, using multi-valued (such as Ternary and Quaternary) signals and low power circuits. Embedding the multi-valued Edward curve based crypto system is an enhanced feature of this invention. This ASIC provides a simplified interface to the external environment and manages the functionality needed for a variety of devices.

Patent_Title: Isolated Measurement System for Amplitude and Phase Detection in 3-Phase Power Lines without Neutral Wire
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Devaraju Ramakrishna | Vinod Kumar Agrawal
Abstract: The invention relates to an Isolated Measurement System for Amplitude and Phase Detection in 3-Phase Power Lines, specifically designed for applications where a neutral wire is absent. Traditional methods of measuring amplitude and phase relationships in 3-phase power systems often require direct contact with the power lines, posing significant safety risks and compromising the reliability of the measurement circuitry. This system provides a novel isolation technique that allows accurate measurement of voltage amplitudes and observation of phase relationships across the power lines, ensuring enhanced safety and circuit protection. The isolation scheme not only safeguards the connected hardware from high-voltage exposure but also delivers precise and real-time data on line voltage amplitudes and phase shifts. The system is particularly beneficial for industries and environments where monitoring 3-phase power lines without a neutral wire is necessary, offering robust performance in both measurement and monitoring. This invention enables safe, reliable, and efficient power line analysis, which is critical for maintaining the integrity and performance of 3-phase power systems in various applications.

Patent_Title: Multi-Function Portable Lab Kit
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Roopa M R | Dr Yashaswini Gowda N | Ms Aishwarya N | Ms Sowmya P
Abstract: With rapid advancements in electronics and technology, the demand for portable and adaptable test and measurement equipment has never been greater. Engineers, technicians, and electronics enthusiasts frequently require a combination of tools-such as regulated power supplies, function generators, and oscilloscopes-to analyze, create, and power circuits and components. However, transporting multiple heavy and bulky instruments to different locations can be both impractical and inconvenient. To address this challenge, we introduce the Multi-Function Portable Lab Kit, a cutting-edge solution that consolidates the capabilities of a regulated power supply, function generator, and oscilloscope into one compact, portable device. Designed to provide a comprehensive, all-in-one solution, this lab kit meets the diverse needs of professionals and hobbyists alike in the electronics field.

Patent_Title: Method and System for Unequal Delay Control of Signal Rising and Falling Edges in Digital Systems
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Devaraju Ramakrishna | Vinod Kumar Agrawal
Abstract: This invention presents a novel method and system for controlling unequal delays in the rising and falling edges of an incoming digital signal. The system leverages the use of logic gates and specialized delay circuits to independently adjust the propagation time of signal transitions. By introducing a controlled delay in both the rising and falling edges, the system optimizes the timing behavior in various digital circuits, ensuring precise edge alignment in applications where signal integrity and synchronization are critical. The proposed method allows for fine-tuning of transition delays by incorporating adjustable delay elements, which are selectively triggered depending on the signal edge type. Logic gates are used to differentiate between rising and falling edges, enabling separate control paths for each transition.

Patent_Title: Autonomous and Intelligent Swarm Robots
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. M. PREMKUMAR | Ms. SUSHMITHA K | Mr. VALLABH KARNAWADI | Mr. NIMITH H D | Mr. SRIVATHSA B R
Abstract: The proposed invention introduces an innovative swarm-based robotic system designed for real-time surveillance and detection in complex environments. Swarm robotics, rooted in swarm intelligence, enables decentralized coordination of multiple homogeneous robots, collectively performing tasks that surpass the capabilities of individual robots. The system integrates advanced technologies, including Arduino Mega microcontroller, Raspberry Pi 4 microprocessor, metal detector, ultrasonic sensor, KY-038 audio sensor, and artificial intelligence & machine learning. Each robot is equipped with a 360-degree rotating camera for live surveillance and object detection using Haar cascade algorithms, capable of distinguishing between enemy combatants and friendly forces. When one robot detects a threat or anomaly, such as enemies, landmines, or suspicious sounds, it immediately communicates with nearby robots via Zigbee-based intercommunication, forming a dynamic "swarm army" to encircle the object of interest. This real-time communication allows for efficient threat containment, supported by live video and sensor data transmission to a remote-control centre via cloud-based instant messaging. The system leverages GPS for precise object location tracking and situational awareness, enhancing military operations by improving coordination and minimizing risks to human personnel in high-stakes scenarios. The intelligent swarm system offers a transformative solution for surveillance and defence, providing robust, scalable, and autonomous operation in challenging terrains.

Patent_Title: Roadway Infrastructure Monitoring for Safety Using Machine Learning
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Srividya L | Dr. Suma M R | Mr. Vinayak Channayya Sheelavantamath | Mr. Sudeep Tuppad | Mr. Vamshi Krishna A V | Mr. Vinay B W
Abstract: Potholes on roadways pose a serious risk to road safety, often leading to accidents and fatalities. In India alone, potholes contribute to thousands of deaths each year. Current pothole detection methods employed by municipal authorities are inefficient and slow, delaying necessary repairs. This delay not only escalates road damage but also burdens local governments with increased maintenance costs. The need for a fast, accurate, and efficient detection system is critical to improving road safety and infrastructure maintenance. Our innovation aims to detect potholes in real-time, providing immediate alerts to road maintenance teams, thus reducing the time between detection and repair. The work also aims to optimize road maintenance processes by promptly notifying authorities about pothole locations, reduce accidents and vehicle damage caused by undetected potholes, and provide substantial financial savings for municipalities by improving resource allocation and reducing the overall maintenance burden. Our system leverages modern technology to enhance road safety through real-time pothole detection and road condition monitoring. By integrating cameras with machine learning models into a pilot vehicle, the system captures images of road conditions and identifies potholes using advanced object detection techniques

Patent_Title: Modular Rover for Data Collection and Analysis
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Satish B A | Deekshitha Arsa | Ganesh G C | Sharath Kumar Y N | Kavitha K | Vinit H | Sai Praveen
Abstract: Robotics plays a vital role today with a wide range of applications and their ability to reach and act in situations where humans can be endangered. One of the fields where robotics has made massive strides is in using rovers for sensing and data collection from remote, or dangerous scenarios, which help humans take appropriate action based on the data obtained from the rovers. Even though using such rovers is becoming common, the rovers built for such applications tend to be specific to an application and are not adaptable to different scenarios. The idea being proposed aims at creating a rover that can be adapted to various scenes for data collection based on the requirement. The modular sensor matrix will allow the robot to be configured based on the need and deployed in the relevant field. This will allow the users to get specific data of use and take appropriate actions.

Patent_Title: An SMS based alert system for illegal logging of Precious Trees
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ashmeet Singh | Akash Radha | Aditya Raj | Aadya | Dr. Basavaraj S
Abstract: The southern part of India is famous for growing sandalwood trees, the most valuable. The Forest Guardian system is a scalable and cost-effective solution designed to detect and prevent illegal logging of precious trees in forest areas. This system employs an array of sensors to identify the unique acoustic and vibrational signatures associated with tree cutting. Upon detection, the system sends real-time alerts via SMS to relevant authorities, enabling immediate intervention. This invention aims to enhance forest conservation efforts by leveraging modern technology for real-time environmental monitoring, contributing to the preservation of biodiversity and the enforcement of forest protection laws.

Patent_Title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PERSONALIZED HEALTHCARE DIAGNOSTICS USING DEEP LEARNING MODELS AND MEDICAL IMAGING
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Shobha K R
Abstract: The present invention discloses a system and method for personalized healthcare diagnostics utilizing deep learning models and medical imaging techniques. By integrating medical imaging data, such as MRI, CT scans, and X-rays, with individual patient-specific information-like medical history and genetic predispositions-the system enhances diagnostic accuracy and tailors treatment recommendations. The deep learning diagnostic engine analyzes imaging data to detect anomalies, while the patient data integration module contextualizes these findings. The result is a personalized diagnostic report that facilitates early disease detection, improves clinical decision-making, and promotes individualized healthcare strategies, ultimately leading to better patient outcomes.

Patent_Title: Oxygen-Supported Wound Healing Machine for Enhanced Treatment of Chronic Hypoxic Wounds
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Shashi Raj K | Dr. Trupti S Tagare | Dr. Deepa N P | Dr. Sapna P J | Mr. Shivakumar C
Abstract: Chronic wounds, which are characterized by slow healing, are frequently hypoxic, with oxygen levels below the crucial threshold required for tissue repair. This shortage of oxygen prevents enzymatic reactions necessary for wound healing. To address this issue, Topical Oxygen Therapy (TOT) has showed higher healing rates than alternative therapy approaches. In keeping with this, we created the Oxygen-Supported Wound Healing Machine (OSWHM), a system that delivers controlled and optimal oxygen levels to chronic wounds. OSWHM intends to greatly improve healing outcomes by maintaining optimal enzymatic activity conditions.

Patent_Title: An Affordable Intelligent Autonomous Trolley with Integrated Anti-Theft Mechanism and smart billing system
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Kartavya Raushan | Prabhjot Singh | Sai Nikhil Kandagiri | Dr. Manasa R | Dr. Mahesh Kumar N
Abstract: Our innovative design of an autonomously powered trolley that follows the user throughout their shopping experience and includes smart billing and theft detection, eliminating the need to stand at a billing counter. In modern supermarkets and hypermarkets, shopping baskets and trolleys help customers select and store products. However, customers must carry their trolley, place items in it, and then proceed to checkout, which is often tedious and time-consuming. This process leads to increased staffing needs at the billing counter and long wait times. Our patent, 'Design and Development: A Low- Cost Intelligent Autonomous Trolley with Anti-Theft Mechanism,' aims to reduce the effort required to move the trolley, decrease customer wait times, lower manpower requirements, and cut costs for supermarkets, all while providing a contactless billing experience.

Patent_Title: SMART DARTS: Smart Ring based Drowning Alert Technology System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. RameshBabu D R | Prof. Aruna S | Prof. Sunanda | Anush G R | Vinay B
Abstract: The smart ring design is designed to meet the critical needs for real-time drowning detection. Uses advanced sensors including pressure sensors. Optical Biosensor, skin Temperature sensor, Accelerometer and Gyroscope To monitor physiological and environmental signals. The main objective is continuous data analysis to detect drowning from abnormal physiological variations. This ensures early intervention in life-threatening situations. Sensors are integrated into the ring to identify abnormal patterns, such as rapid or sudden changes in heart rate, oxygen level, body temperature, panic movement and difference in external pressure. The smart ring communicates with paired mobile devices via Bluetooth. When these signals are detected, the mobile app processes this information. It automatically sends SOS messages to pre-selected emergency contacts and nearby rescue teams. If a possible drowning situation is confirmed It shares the user's geo-location.

Patent_Title: A System and method of Augmented Reality Learn Suite for Autistic Children
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ramya R S | Manish Gowda N S | Harpreet Kaur Thind
Abstract: Enhancing the traditional learning environment for children with spectrum disorders is essential to their development and overall well-being. Augmented Reality (AR) is incorporated for an improved educational experience in real world contexts, which is very important for the development of cognitive skills in children. The proposed model evaluates the children's abilities to perceive the objects around them, visualize them, and have greater memory retention. Concentration levels are the most necessary parameter for the evaluation of the child's learning ability, in which the AR model will play a vital role. The Learn Suite is included with AR to provide children with spectrum disorders with a new world where they will be able to indulge in the creative atmosphere with engaged learning sessions and have their motivation maintained for a longer duration. The provided suite consists of various augmented activities to improve behavioural, reasoning, and other perceptive skills.

Patent_Title: Building Smart Intruder Detection with AI and OpenCV
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: KANCHANA M DIXIT | SHREYAS S | V VILAS | YASHAS J | OMKAR M
Abstract: In today's fast-paced world, there is a growing demand for intelligent surveillance systems driven by the need for increased security and real-time threat detection. While traditional systems are reliable, they often lack the adaptive, always-on capabilities needed to meet modern security challenges. This is where the Intelligent Eyes comes in, revolutionizing the landscape. By utilizing cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning, these systems go beyond static cameras and manual oversight, providing dynamic, automated monitoring that detects intrusions with remarkable precision. With the ability to process vast streams of visual data, identify anomalies, and make real-time decisions, AI-driven surveillance systems deliver unmatched efficiency and accuracy, setting a new standard in security technology.

Patent_Title: Speed Read using Natural language processing
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Akchara T K B | Dr. S. Amutha | Dr. C. Vinothini | Dr. S. Keerthi
Abstract: The invention involves a highly evolved deep learning model for classifying sentences in medical abstracts, aiming to maximize the accuracy and efficiency of text classification tasks in nature language processing (NLP). It can go, such as determining whether the sentence provides context, methods, results, or conclusions. The model's unique architecture uses convolutional and attentional mechanisms to deal with these embeddings, increasing the ability to accurately classify sentences. The system is trained on datasets of medical abstracts, with the help of deep learning methods to identify complex patterns in text. This model is much more effective than the existing methods as it has better performance parameters with increased accuracy and higher F1 scores. By offering a more accurate classification of sentence roles in medical abstracts, the invention facilitates quicker and more effective information retrieval for researchers, ultimately contributing to more efficient literature review and analysis. This advancement addresses limitations in previous models by providing a robust solution for sequential sentence classification in specialized medical texts.

Patent_Title: Classification of Arrhythmia on ECG signal with Stacked Auto Encoder
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Rajeshwari M R | Dr Kavitha K S
Abstract: Computerized systems that can be employed as a screening tool for the classification of cardiac arrhythmias play an important role not only for the patients but also can help the doctors in the decision making of correct treatment selection. For recognizing cardiac arrhythmia in ECG signals, common signal processing techniques such as pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, feature selection and classification are crucial. The purpose of this invention is to provide an appropriate model for classification of arrhythmia into different classes using ECG signal.

Patent_Title: On-Booking Ambulance Service
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Bhoomika K S | Yashwant K | Richard Jophy | Dr. Suma V | Shobha N | Prof. Poornima D
Abstract: In emergency situations, every second counts, yet traditional ambulance dispatch systems often involve time-consuming steps that can delay critical care. This innovation proposes a transformative solution: an app-based platform designed to expedite the process of booking ambulances. The current approach to emergency medical services typically requires individuals to dial a toll number, relay vital information to an operator, and wait for the operator to connect them to an available ambulance and then relay the same information to the ambulance drivers. This process can be further hindered by the challenge of accurately communicating the exact location, leading to potential delays. Our proposed system revolutionizes this process by enabling users to request an ambulance directly through a mobile application, similar to ride-hailing services. The app leverages GPS technology to automatically capture the user's precise location, ensuring that the nearest available ambulance is dispatched immediately without the need for verbal communication of the address. Ambulance drivers register independently on the platform and accept bookings based on their proximity to the emergency, allowing for faster response times and more efficient service delivery.

Patent_Title: Water-Soluble Bio-Packaging from Potato Starch
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Kanuri Balasri Saisindhu | R Varnika Reddy | Dr. Suma V | Shobha N | Prof. Poornima D
Abstract: This innovation introduces biodegradable and water-soluble packaging material made from processed potato starch. Such material could be processed into pellets, replacing plastic in the current packaging material. The packaging material dissolves within minutes in water to produce harmless residues, easily countering plastic pollution. Reducing reliance on plastic significantly contributes to sustainability efforts. These materials hold important applications mainly in single-use packaging and are highly useful for many applications in food preservation and consumer products. They have no risk to human health or the ecology and are environmentally sustainable with an economically feasible production process.

Patent_Title: Innovative Approach to Assess and Improve Faculty Teaching Quality Based on Diverse Learner Groups
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Dattatreya P Mankame | Mrs H D Aparna | Mrs Veena Dhavalgi | Dr Basavaraj Patil
Abstract: The proposed system aims to assess and enhance the teaching quality of individual faculty members by evaluating multiple factors that contribute to effective learning outcomes. The assessment is conducted based on a faculty member's interaction with diverse groups of students, including slow learners, average learners, and advanced learners. The system evaluates communication skills, depth of subject knowledge, teaching methodologies, content presentation, and adaptive strategies employed by the faculty. Feedback from students is utilized to measure the effectiveness of teaching for each group. The system then recommends tailored teaching methods to address the needs of different learner types and improve overall teaching quality. By providing real-time feedback and suggestions, this system fosters continuous improvement in teaching strategies.

Patent_Title: Comprehensive System for Assessing and Enhancing Faculty Retention in Engineering Colleges
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mrs H D Aparna | Dr Basavaraj Patil | Dr Dattatreya P Mankame | Mrs Veena Dhavalgi
Abstract: The proposed system is designed to assess and enhance faculty retention in engineering colleges by monitoring various factors that influence job satisfaction, teaching quality, and overall well-being. The system evaluates faculty members' mental status, financial situation, teaching quality, research output, and professional growth to predict attrition risks and suggest retention strategies. By integrating data from student feedback, peer evaluations, financial records, and mental health assessments, the system generates personalized recommendations for faculty improvement and support. This helps management make informed decisions about interventions, thereby improving faculty satisfaction and retention.

Patent_Title: Automated Faculty Skill-Based Course Recommendation and Allocation System for Optimized Teaching Assignments in Academic Institutions
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Mrs Veena Dhavalgi | Mrs H D Aparna | Dr Dattatreya P Mankame | Dr Basavaraj Patil
Abstract: The proposed system automates the course assignment process for academic institutions by extracting the key skills, courses, and areas of interest from a faculty candidate's resume or application. The system uses this data to map the candidate's expertise to the relevant courses available in the institution's course repository. By matching faculty qualifications with program requirements and course content, the system can recommend appropriate courses for the faculty to teach. This solution addresses the challenges institutions face in course allotment, ensuring optimized course assignments, reducing administrative burdens, and improving educational outcomes.

Patent_Title: Propped Cantilever Thrust Testing Rig
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Prathik Jain S | Dr. Rudresh M | Dr. Sundaramahalingam A | Dr. Sudhagara Rajan S | Vishnu M
Abstract: The performance of a drone or remote-control aircraft is greatly impacted by the choice of motor. This innovation presents a novel propped cantilever style brushless DC motor thrust testing rig that provides more stability than traditional single lever rigs. Key performance characteristics of BLDC motors, such as thrust, torque, voltage applied to the motor, and current consumption, can be measured by the rig. These factors are essential for assessing motor performance and efficiency in various propeller configurations. The rig is equipped with a display that can produce data in real time. By connecting to a laptop, the user can upload readings to an Excel sheet. For the purpose of optimizing motor-propeller combinations, especially in drones and RC aircraft, this efficient testing apparatus is optimal.

Patent_Title: Two-Seater Quadrotor Air Taxi
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Jensin Joshua J | Dr. Sundaramahalingam A | Dr. Prathik Jain S | Dr. Hareesha N G | Dr. Parth Thaker
Abstract: The proposed two-seater quadrotor air taxi is an advanced urban air mobility solution designed to address the challenges of modern urban transportation. It features a simple and compact design, integrating an electric propulsion system with a lightweight composite airframe that significantly reduces the vehicle's empty weight compared to existing air taxi models. This lightweight construction, combined with the use of high-efficiency electric motors, enables vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) with minimal energy consumption, making it ideal for short to medium-range urban flights. The quadrotor configuration, with four rotors strategically positioned for optimal balance and stability, ensures smooth, safe, and efficient hovering and flight performance. The compact design allows the air taxi to navigate and land in tight urban spaces, including rooftops and other designated urban air mobility hubs. Additionally, the air taxi is equipped with advanced autonomous flight systems, integrating AI-based navigation to enhance safety, reduce pilot error, and improve overall reliability during flight operations

Patent_Title: Bus-Integrated Aerodynamic Cyclone separator System for Ambient Dust Reduction
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. MAHESH BELIJAGALI RAMASWAMY | Dr. NANDAKUMAR MANDYA BASAVARAJU | Dr. NAVEENA BETTAHALLI ESWAREGOWDA | Dr. SOLOMON JENORIS MUTHIYA | Dr. DIVYA GURKAR SOMASHEKAR | Dr. SANTHOSH K
Abstract: Our invention is a novel way of reducing dust and particulate matter on the roads by sucking them out of the road surface by buses which ply on the roads. As a bus moves forward, it displaces air, creating a high-pressure zone in front of the bus and a low-pressure zone behind it. The system uses a cyclone separator which works due to differential pressures between underbody and back of the bus. The cyclone filter spins the air rapidly in a circular motion, creating a vortex. The centrifugal force generated separates larger particles from the air stream. Our system helps mitigate air pollution, especially in urban environments where buses often travel through areas with poor air quality. It could also improve the health and comfort of passengers by reducing airborne allergens and pollutants.

Patent_Title: INTEGRATING HOLLOW PASSAGE DESIGNS FOR IMPROVED AERODYNAMICS AND FIRE SAFETY IN REAR ENGINE VEHICLES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. NAVEENA BETTAHALLI ESWAREGOWDA | Dr. PRAVEEN KUMAR MELLAHALLI VASANTHARAJU | Dr. SOLOMON JENORIS MUTHIYA | Dr. MAHESH BELIJAGALI RAMASWAMY | KAVYA JAMMANAHALLI THIMMAPPA | Dr. NANDAKUMAR MANDYA BASAVARAJU | Dr. SANTHOSH K | PRATHAM B S
Abstract: A hollow passage provided in the vehicle, extended from the front air point to the rear part of the vehicle helps in improving the vehicle's aerodynamic performance. This design feature focuses on the integration of the aerodynamic feature into the vehicle design, assessed through Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) for velocity, streamline, and static pressure characteristics which reduces the vehicles drag force and improves the fuel consumption and enhances the optimum engine cooling for fire safety. This hollow passage can be of any design shapes and sizes.

Patent_Title: Hybrid magnetic semi-active damper
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Puneet N P | B M Ganesha | Asmith B | Jeevan Raj Rai | Rithik K
Abstract: The current invention of the hybrid magnetic semi-active damper includes a damper cylinder, a piston, a piston rod, a permanent magnet and an electromagnet arranged in a longitudinal axis. Patent_Title: Air drag reduction in buses using side air channel diverters
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: Our invention introduces air channels in the front of the bus to reduce air drag by decreasing the pressure built up on the front side of a bus by providing an escape route to the sides through channels. The two opening of channels in front of the bus are placed below the windshield which usually has high pressure build up. The cross section along its length of the two air channels has a small convergent section and large divergent to allow the air to expand to the low pressure on the sides of the bus producing draft effect which sucks the air from the front of the bus. The above modifications based on their size and shape will reduces drag from 0.7 to 0.53 and an additional modification of the bus body at the rear would reduce the air drag to as low as 0.36. Novelty of the invention is mainly with regard to the air channels provided at the front of the vehicle. The air drag is significant at higher speeds which would have resulted in higher fuel consumption without the modification suggested above. The modification suggested in the innovation will benefit any vehicle which has a box type of design such as bus and trucks.

Patent_Title: Temperature Dependent Optimized Cooling System for EV Battery Pack and a Method Thereof

Abstract: This invention presents an advanced thermal management system for battery packs, enhancing efficiency and safety through a novel approach to cooling. The invention also includes the use of smart adhesives and durable tubes to house and release the healing agents precisely at the damaged locations. This approach increases the lifespan of reinforced concrete structures, minimizes repair frequency, and ensures sustainability by reducing material wastage. Patent_Title: Silane-Based Compounds for Enhancing Black Cotton Soil Stability

Patent_Title: A Novel Approach to Develop Malted Liquor Using Plant Extract
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Patent_Title: Conversion of Waste Polystyrene to Fuel Oil using High Alumina Cement as Catalyst
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: The global issue of plastic waste accumulation requires a scientific approach to transform it into valuable resources like fuel oil, thereby reducing environmental pollution. Waste polystyrene plastic was converted into fuel oil through catalytic pyrolysis, focusing specifically on the utilization of high alumina cement as a catalyst. A batch reactor of 549.77 cm3 capacity was fabricated for catalytic pyrolysis. The surface properties of high alumina cement were investigated using BET analysis and compared with those of natural zeolite. The resulting pyrolysis fuel oil was characterized using FTIR to identify functional groups, and GC-MS to determine its components. The findings contribute to the understanding of the efficacy of high alumina cement as a catalyst in waste plastic pyrolysis and its potential advantages over traditional catalysts.

Patent_Title: Immobilized and Reusable Adsorbent for Removal of Heavy Metals From Water
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: Heavy metals are persistent in many water bodies around us and possess an immediate threat to the health of humans and environment. Majority of the pollutants are impossible to be removed at concentrations below 1 ppm. The current plant adsorbents are immobilized onto sol gel-based product and may be used for an extended period for repeated cycles of adsorptive removal of water. The sol gel-based adsorbent is an inert low-cost immobilized adsorbent that is small in size and can be used for immediate purification of water in containers up to 10 liters of capacity. Patent_Title: Biodegradable and Intrinsically Flexible Conducting polymer Microbial Cellulose Composite for Wearable Thermotherapy Applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: Thermotherapy demonstrates momentous potential for tissue metabolism, pain relief, improved blood flow in rehabilitation including humans and animals, especially the ones who are suffering injuries. But, the wide-ranging implementation of this technology is stalled by the absence of decomposable nature of the materials, which has been used for the manufacturing of thermo- devices. Another major disadvantage of thermo- devices is lack of stretchability of the substrate, and alarms E-waste related problems in natural habitats. This work fetches this challenge by inspecting eco-friendly biodegradable conducting composite consisting of copolymer of conducting polymers, microbial cellulose, and plasticizer. As an environmentally safe biomass, microbial cellulose has high crystallinity, mechanical properties, biocompatibility, and low cost. Accordingly, microbial cellulose will offer an exceptional thermoelectric effect over a wide range of temperatures. In this work, we propose that the introduction of a highly stable and thermally active conducting copolymer blended with microbial cellulose provides thermally active biocomposite for thermotherapy applications. Adding plasticizers will provide good flexibility and more stretchability to the conducting biocomposite. The combination of significant biodegradability and heat performing capacity will offer the current thermally active biodegradable composite for sustainable heat-therapy applications in rehabilitation for both humans and animals, well addressing the ecological issues allied with E-waste.

Patent_Title: Analysis of Wrist Pulse Signals to Identify Type II Diabetic Subjects Non-Invasively Using Recurrence Quantification Technique
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. S. Hema Priyadarshini | Dr. Anand Prem Rajan
Abstract: A wrist pulse signal comprises dynamic evidence about an individual's health status. The preliminary studies verify the linking of several diseases with wrist pulses. Hence, this research focuses on distinguishing subjects with Type II diabetes and non-diabetes using nonlinear methods on wrist pulse signals. A total of 600 subjects contributed to the study. The wrist pulse recorded at three wrist positions on the radial artery showed many variations for Type II diabetic subjects. At the same time, there were not many variations for non-diabetic subjects. The relation between the three positions of the wrist pulse is obtained to understand the effect of pulse variation. Another experiment is conducted to analyse the impact of hypertension and obesity on Type II diabetic conditions using nonlinear signal processing techniques. A multichannel wrist pulse acquisition system was designed, and data were collected on 600 subjects. Analysis of signals recorded from the multichannel wrist pulse acquisition system for different experimental conditions showed comparable results with expected results. Nonlinear methods were more effective than spectral analysis methods in understanding the variations and dynamics of the wrist pulse signals. The average of the derived parameter from nonlinear signal processing technique is used as input for the classification algorithms, and performance measures were analysed. The design of a low cost, simple multichannel wrist pulse acquisition system is proven effective for pulse diagnosis. The integration of the acquisition system with the nonlinear signal processing techniques may lead to a robust, portable system that can record wrist pulse signals and aid in the non-invasive diagnosis of many pathological conditions of the human body.

Patent_Title: DETECTION OF DIABETIC FOOT ULCER AND PAIN RELEIF USING IR LED
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a common condition in people where the blood glucose level is higher than the recommended level. It occurs either due to the improper secretion of insulin by the pancreas or when the body doesn't use the insulin effectively. The count of the number of people being affected by diabetes has been increasing drastically over the past few decades. About 60% of patients with diabetics will sustain from nerve damage, in which 5% of the patients suffer from diabetic foot ulcer and 1% of patient end up with amputation. Hence, with the early prediction of foot ulcers among diabetics, we can cure foot ulcers in the early stages of infection. An attempt is made to design a device that will be able to predict diabetic foot ulcers in patients with the help of various sensors. The device measures temperature (LM35 Sensor), IR Led, and oxygen level (Max30100 pulse oximeter). It is done by placing the sensors in predefined locations. The output of sensors is processed using ESP 32. The device uses the sensors described in the methodology. The processed values are compared with the standard values. The results obtained from the comparisons can be used to differentiate between the normal and abnormal feet of the patients. Hence, can be used as an early detection of foot ulcer.

Patent_Title: Formulation Design of Herbal Gel-based sunscreen containing Silymarin from Milk Thistle and other ingredients to enhance UV Protection and other applications
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Pradeep H N | Dr. Jayaram L N | B. Preethi | Keerthana S | Lekhana R | M. Sirisha | Dr. P Sivakami Sundari | Dr. Manjula D
Abstract: The skin is the first layer of defense and a mechanical barrier to our body against external exposures. This barrier is disturbed when the skin is exposed to the harmful UV (Ultra Violet) rays. The primary mechanism behind UV skin damage is the generation of reactive oxygen species. ROS causes oxidation and activates enzymes. These enzymes further damage the elastic and collagen fibers of the connective tissue of the skin and cause premature skin aging. As a result of UV exposure, skin is prone to acute skin cancer, allergies, erythema, and tanning. Secondary metabolites, which are organic compounds produced by plants and other microorganisms, play a crucial role in pharmaceutical, agricultural, and biotechnological applications. These metabolites include alkaloids, flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolics, which possess properties such as antimicrobial, anticancer, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. Invention relates to the development of herbal skincare gel-based formulations, specifically focusing on the creation of effective products for enhancing skin health and appearance. This includes the formulation of active ingredients for improved skincare outcomes.

Patent_Title: Optimized Fed Batch Fermentation Process for Continuous Hydrogen Generation
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Priya S | Rakesh Kumar | Poojarani C Kalamadi | Tejas Madane | Kruthika M K
Abstract: The invention presents an innovative approach for continuous hydrogen production through optimization of fed-batch fermentation process. The process integrates systematic parameter optimization, strategic feeding mechanisms and precise control strategies to enhance hydrogen yield adopting a two-phase optimization process. The substrate used as key nutrient source to the bacteria is crude glycerol, produced as by-product from biodiesel industries. Mesophilic bacteria, Klebsiella pneumoniae, that has the potential to acclimatize to crude glycerol is used in the current innovation. Initial batch experiments were conducted to determine the optimal temperature and pH conditions for dark fermentation, establishing the foundation for fed-batch process. The fed-batch process was then devised by incorporating variable substrate concentrations and inoculum sizes to optimize, in order to maximize the hydrogen production efficiency. A comprehensive control mechanism that synergistically manages the temperature, initial media pH, substrate availability and the microbial population dynamics to create a conducive environment for continuous hydrogen generation is developed through the two-phase optimization process. This approach resulted in the prolonged maintenance of an active microbial population, continuous availability of the substrate at the optimized process temperature and initial media pH that could facilitate optimum microbial activity, yielding improved hydrogen output compared to the traditional batch processes. Thus, the system demonstrates a significant potential for scaling up continuous biohydrogen production with improved efficiency and yield over the existing batch processes, emphasizing the need for sustainable hydrogen production methods to address the demand for renewable energy.

Patent_Title: Real-Time ACL Injury Monitoring and Prevention Using an IoT-Based Wearable Device
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Pratyush | Dr. Mahesh Kumar N | R Harinandan | Puram Vamshi | Dr. Manasa R
Abstract: The proposed invention is an IoT-based wearable medical device designed for monitoring and assisting in the rehabilitation of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injuries. Traditional methods for detecting ACL injuries, such as physical examinations, Lachman tests, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), often require clinical environments, specialized equipment, and trained professionals. These methods are not suitable for continuous monitoring and can be costly, time-consuming, and inaccessible for routine rehabilitation, particularly in remote or resource-limited areas. In contrast, this device employs motion sensors placed on the thigh and shin to measure real-time knee flexion angles, processed by an embedded microcontroller. Additionally, the device monitors the electrical activity of surrounding muscles. Real-time data is transmitted to a cloud platform, and a dedicated Android application provides real-time visualization, predefined exercise routines, haptic feedback, and voice guidance for knee angle monitoring. The data is recorded for subsequent analysis and to enable machine learning-based treatment recommendations. The device is ergonomically designed for wear on the thigh and shin, with adjustable settings managed through the mobile application. This approach enables continuous, real-time monitoring outside clinical settings, offering a more cost-effective and accessible alternative for ACL rehabilitation. It is particularly beneficial for sportspersons, as it allows them to track their recovery progress in real-time, perform rehabilitation exercises efficiently, and receive personalized feedback, helping to accelerate recovery and prevent re-injury during training and competition.

Patent_Title: Integration of behavioral biometrics with multifactor authentication to enhance security in digital environment
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Deepthi V S
Abstract: The integration of behavioral biometrics with multi-factor authentication (MFA) marks a significant evolution in cybersecurity, enhancing security through multiple verification layers. Behavioral biometrics focuses on analyzing distinct patterns in user interactions, including typing speed, mouse movements, and touch gestures, which facilitates continuous authentication and real-time anomaly detection. When combined with traditional MFA methods-such as passwords, one-time passwords (OTPs), and physical tokens-this integrated approach strengthens defenses against unauthorized access by mitigating the weaknesses inherent in each individual method. The ongoing nature of behavioral biometrics complements the static verification provided by MFA, thereby reducing the risk of credential theft and enhancing user experience through seamless, background authentication. Despite challenges like privacy concerns and implementation complexities, this integration presents a powerful solution for safeguarding sensitive information and ensuring secure access in an increasingly dynamic digital landscape.

Patent_Title: Hidden Camera Detection for Women Safety Using AI Technology
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Amutha S | Prof. Aruna S | Prof. Sunanda | Anisha Ravishankar
Abstract: The increasing prevalence of hidden cameras in public and private spaces has raised significant concerns regarding privacy and safety, particularly for women. To address this issue, this invention proposes an advanced solution leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology to detect and identify hidden cameras. The proposed system is designed to enhance women's safety by providing a reliable method for detecting covert surveillance devices in various environments. The core of this technology is an AI-powered application that integrates with portable electronic devices, such as smartphones or wearables. The application utilizes a combination of computer vision, machine learning, and signal processing techniques to detect hidden cameras. It performs real-time analysis of the environment by capturing images and video through the device's camera and analyzing them for signs of camera lenses or suspicious electronic devices. Additionally, the system employs a sophisticated algorithm to scan for electromagnetic signals that may indicate the presence of a hidden camera. By using AI to recognize patterns and anomalies in these signals, the application can identify both visible and invisible camera systems, including those operating with low power or using advanced concealment techniques. The invention also includes a user-friendly interface that provides immediate feedback to the user regarding potential threats.

Patent_Title: Improving the Reliability of E-learning Platform using Hyperledger Fabric
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ramya R S | Dr. Deepak G | Aayush Kumar | Anish Srivastava | Aditya Kumar | Ankita Verma
Abstract: This invention relates to a blockchain-powered system for managing users, exams, and results in an educational setting. It offers a decentralized solution that ensures security, transparency, and tamper-resistance in managing student data, conducting examinations, and grading results. By leveraging Hyperledger Fabric, this system mitigates the risks associated with traditional centralized databases, such as unauthorized data manipulation and grade tampering. The invention provides role-based access for administrators, teachers, and students, and includes functionalities for user management, exam scheduling, question creation, and secure submission and grading of answers.

Patent_Title: Utilization of Fish Scale powder as a Cement Replacement in Self Compacting Concrete
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Ujwal. M.S | Dr. Shivakumar. G
Abstract: The invention relates to a novel method for producing sustainable self-compacting concrete (SCC) by utilizing Fish Scale Powder (FSP) as a partial replacement for cement. This innovative approach addresses the increasing demand for environmentally friendly construction materials by repurposing fish scales, a biowaste product, thereby reducing the reliance on traditional cement and mitigating its associated carbon emissions. The method involves processing fish scales into a fine powder, which is then incorporated into SCC formulations at 2% to 6% substitution ratios. The resulting concrete exhibits enhanced rheological properties, workability, and durability while maintaining its self-compacting nature. Additionally, the use of FSP improves the mechanical performance of the concrete and contributes to sustainability by minimizing industrial waste and reducing the carbon footprint of construction practices. This invention offers a cost-effective and environmentally sustainable alternative for modern concrete applications.

Patent_Title: BIOTECHNOLOGICAL SYSTEM FOR LANDSLIDE CONTROL USING BACILLUS SUBTILIS AND SPOROSARCINA PASTEURII
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Raghavendra H N | Sanjeev T P | Raghavendra Prajwal H S
Abstract: This invention describes a biotechnological system designed for landslide control by applying specific bacterial strains, namely Bacillus subtilis and Sporosarcina pasteurii, as soil reinforcement. The system leverages the unique properties of these bacteria to enhance soil stability and reduce the risk of landslides. Bacillus subtilis contributes to soil fortification by producing extracellular enzymes and biopolymers that bind soil particles, while Sporosarcina pasteurii facilitates the precipitation of calcium carbonate, by strengthening the soil matrix. This innovative approach combines microbial activity with soil mechanics to create a sustainable and eco-friendly solution for landslide mitigation. The system offers a novel, biologically driven method for improving soil integrity and stability, potentially transforming current landslide prevention and control practices.

Patent_Title: Geopolymer Mortar Composition Utilizing Red Mud and Biomedical Waste for Enhanced Strength Properties
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore

Abstract: This patent introduces a geopolymer mortar composition utilizing Incinerated Biomedical Waste Ash (IBWA) and industrial by-products as sustainable alternatives to traditional cement. Geopolymer mortars, formed by the activation of aluminosilicate materials with alkaline solutions, provide an environmentally friendly solution for construction. The invention leverages IBWA, derived from incinerated hospital waste such as cotton and degradable fibers (excluding plastics), which contain aluminum and silica suitable for geopolymerization. Other industrial waste Red mud which is -product generated during the Bayer process, which is used to extract alumina (aluminum oxide) from bauxite which further enhances the mortar's performance. Key properties, including fresh performance (workability and setting time), mechanical strength (compressive, tensile, and flexural), and durability (acid resistance, high-temperature resistance, water absorption, and shrinkage), are significantly improved. The study highlights the potential of geopolymer mortars to replace conventional cement, promoting sustainability in construction practices. The work promotes environmental sustainability by repurposing biomedical and industrial waste, reducing the carbon footprint of traditional cement. It enhances the mechanical strength and durability of geopolymer mortars, offering better performance in harsh conditions. Additionally, it lowers construction costs by utilizing waste materials as affordable raw ingredients.

Patent_Title: Secure and Scalable Online Voting System
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Soumya Patil | Akarsh M | Dhanunjaya Reddy M R | Praveen B | Sanjana S M
Abstract: This invention relates to an online voting system designed to offer secure, scalable, and user-friendly mechanisms for conducting elections over the internet. The system ensures voter privacy, vote integrity, and allows for real-time monitoring of voting activities while preventing unauthorized access or tampering. It leverages advanced encryption protocols and blockchain technology to provide transparency, auditability, and immutability of votes. The system is adaptable for various types of elections, including government, corporate, and organizational voting processes.

Patent_Title: System and Method of Kannada Speech-to-Braille Translation for Individuals with Visual and Hearing Impairments
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Harpreet Kaur Thind | Keerthi K S | Khushi V | Lavanya HU | Kavana N S
Abstract: Existing assistive technologies for individuals with visual and hearing impairments often fall short in providing real-time communication solutions. While some systems convert between audio, text, and Braille or translate static documents into Braille, they typically lack support for specific regional languages like Kannada and do not offer real-time, wearable solutions. Current technologies may also be limited to cloud-based systems, which can hinder accessibility in offline environments. The present invention addresses these gaps by offering a wearable device that dynamically converts spoken Kannada into Braille. The device utilizes piezoelectric actuators to provide precise, real-time Braille display, ensuring immediate and effective communication. Unlike existing solutions, this system operates offline, making it portable and accessible in various environments. By integrating advanced components into a compact, user-friendly design, this invention enhances communication for individuals with visual and hearing impairments, providing a practical, real-time solution for everyday interactions.

Patent_Title: An Efficient Way to Vehicle Movement Monitor in Flooded Underpasses and Tunnels Using IoT
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ramya R S | Dr. Deepak G | D Ravikumara | Lakshmi D | Nuthana S | Rahul R
Abstract: Urban infrastructure faces significant challenges due to waterlogging in underpass and tunnel during heavy rainfall. This leads to traffic gridlocks, vehicle immobilization, and even accidents. The existing systems fail to provide real-time, accurate monitoring or adequate response mechanisms. Our system proposes an IoT-based solution to monitor water levels in underpasses and tunnels, offering real-time updates to drivers and authorities. Using sensors controlled by an ESP32 board, data is continuously uploaded to the cloud. This allows vehicles to be rerouted efficiently and helps prevent accidents. An LCD screen at the underpass and tunnel displays real-time water levels, informing drivers of safe passage. Additionally, a DC motor pump is activated when water levels exceed the safe threshold, ensuring rapid water clearance. This cost-effective solution ensures public safety and reduces traffic disruptions during floods.

Patent_Title: Highly accurate detection of poisonous arsenic and mercury ions in human blood serum samples based on AgTiO3/PVA/BN nanocomposite immobilized glassy carbon electrode
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. P. Karuppasamy
Abstract: Silver titanate (AgTiO3) blend with polyvinyl acrylate (PVA) decorated boron nitride (BN) nanocomposite immobilized glassy carbon electrode (GCE) is fabricated for an accurate detection of poisonous arsenic as well as mercury ions in blood serum samples by amperometric technique. The as-synthesized AgTiO3/PVA/BN nanocomposite material is well characterized by spectral, analytical, and electrochemical studies. The developed electrochemical sensor provided enhanced electrochemical sensing properties owing to its excellent surface area, lower electron transfer resistance, and catalytic property as compared to reported electrodes. The developed AgTiO3/PVA/BN immobilized GCE electrochemical sensor exhibited a highly selective detection of AsIII and HgII ions at pH-7.4. The developed sensor showed a wide linear range of response (1 μM -100 μM) and the limit of detections (LOD) are found to be 0.033 μM and 0.022 μM for AsIII and HgII ions respectively. The developed AgTiO3/PVA/BN immobilized GCE sensor exhibited excellent stability, sensitivity, selectivity, and reproducibility. It was utilized to successfully detect real-world human blood serum samples for AsIII and HgII ions.

The achieved method allows various types of nanostructured materials to be developed with good stability and high sensitivity towards detection of Lithium ion (Li3+).

Patent_Title: Auto Levelling Helipad for Naval Operations

Patent_Title: Skin-care Smart Mirror

Patent_Title: Pedagogy and andragogy suggestion using NLP & Gen AI

Patent_Title: IoT-Driven Intelligent Hospital Bed with AI-Based Patient Safety and Fall Prevention System

Abstract: The study employs the PHREEQC model to analyze hydrogeochemical characteristics of groundwater in Sohag City, Egypt, focusing on physico-chemical properties and rock-water interactions. Abstract: Combinatorial Testing is a method for systematically testing software using a limited number of test cases without compromising on the quality of testing. Combinatorial Testing has been proven to be a very effective method for testing software systems where faults occur due to parameter interactions. It tests all possible, discrete combinations of parameters involved and detects parameter interactions that trigger system faults. Not all parameters are relevant to the defects found. Hence, locating the minimal subset of parameters that caused the fault will help in faster and effective debugging of the failure. This process of identifying the minimal subset of parameters that caused a failure is called Fault Localization. Fault Localization helps in deducing the exact source of a failure from a set of observed failure indications. It is considered the most important step of Fault Management.

Abstract: In the contemporary environment, many individuals are leading increasingly sedentary lifestyles, which often results in a decrease in physical activity. This lack of physical movement can contribute to the development of varicose veins, a condition where the veins in the legs become swollen and twisted. Furthermore, varicose veins may develop when the valves within the leg veins become weakened. This valve weakness allows blood to flow in both directions within the veins, leading to discomfort and pain. Factors such as being overweight, hormonal fluctuations during menstruation and pregnancy, and prolonged periods of sitting or standing can increase the risk of developing varicose veins. To address the discomfort associated with varicose veins, there is a need for an innovative system that analyzes positional data using various sensors and processes this information in a microcontroller. Such a system can provide relief through thermal and vibration therapy. The newly developed system distinguishes itself through several unique features. Firstly, it offers precise and targeted therapy by being worn specifically on the affected area, ensuring both comfort and effectiveness. Users can control the intensity of the vibration therapy through a potentiometer and have the option of selecting between two modes: auto and manual. In auto mode, the therapy adapts based on the pressure applied, while in manual mode, users can input their weight for a personalized treatment experience. Patent_Title: A NOVEL FRAMEWORK FOR OPTIMIZING VLSI CIRCUITS PARTITIONING USING EVOLUTIONARY COMPUTATION ALGORITHM
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Rajeswari.P | Dr.Theodore Chandra S
Abstract: Very-large-scale integration (VLSI) physical architecture standardization of VLSI chips and multichip platforms is now in its early development. The division of complex structures into smaller, easier sub-circuits has been a common strategy in response to the rising intricacy of current VLSI architecture. Circuitry partitioning might be utilized to minimize the size of VLSI chips, the number of components and interconnects utilized in constructing large system electronics, the length of wiring, the efficiency of parallel circuit modeling, the ease of test structure for electronic devices, and timing interruptions. The goal of VLSI partitioning is to split the circuit into many sub-circuits with a minimal amount of connections between them. This may be done by splitting a circuit into two pieces repeatedly until the appropriate amount of complexity is reached. Therefore, circuit design and dividing fundamental issue is partitioning. The partitioning issue in VLSI circuit design may be resolved using the effective method of evolutionary computation. By searching the solution space and progressively raising the quality of solutions, it offers a heuristic method to deal with this issue. As a result, we suggested an evolutionary Optimized Simulated annealing Memetic algorithm (OSAMA) that incorporates one or more local search stages inside its evolutionary cycle to acquire the smallest Wire Length (WL), area, and connections. Performance measures such as area, number of connections, WL, delay, cost, and time were used to evaluate the suggested efficacy. The experimental findings demonstrated that in VLSI design, the OSAMA technique reduced the area, WL, and interconnections.

Patent_Title: Control of an Assistive Radiologist Robot for Enhanced Healthcare Accessibility and Support System for Disabled Patients

Abstract: The development of the Healthcare bot focuses on addressing critical challenges in radiology, particularly regarding radiation exposure and the manual handling of imaging equipment. Our design proposes the use of this bot in ultrasonography procedures, replacing manual tasks with precise robotic assistance. The goal is to improve the working conditions for radiologists while ensuring a safer and more efficient diagnostic process. One of the primary innovations of the Healthcare bot is its ability to enhance both patient comfort and diagnostic accuracy during USG procedures. Patients often experience discomfort due to inconsistent pressure and positioning of the transducer when handled manually, leading to potential diagnostic errors. The bot's precise control system ensures that the transducer is applied with consistent pressure, improving the quality of diagnostic images. This reliability can lead to more accurate diagnoses, reduced patient anxiety, and overall better patient outcomes. Patent_Title: An integrated system for optimizing silk production process and enhancement of the quality of silk

Abstract: An integrated system for optimizing silk production process and enhancement of silk quality focuses on revolutionizing silk production through the design and development of a comprehensive system known as the Silkbot. This innovative system aims to optimize every critical phase of the silk production process to significantly improve yield and enhance the quality of silk produced. The developed product addresses four key components essential to achieving these goals: Cocoon Segregation, Diseased Cocoon Identification, Temperature Control, and an Optimized Feeding System. Firstly, the Cocoon Segregation System implements an advanced method of segregating cocoons based on gender, ensuring that female cocoons, which produce more raw silk than males, are nurtured in optimal conditions. This not only boosts production but also helps control disease spread. Secondly, the Diseased Cocoon Identification System integrates automation to identify and remove diseased cocoons early in the process, thus preventing the transmission of diseases that could otherwise lead to reduced harvest rates. The third component, the Temperature Control System, focuses on maintaining ideal environmental conditions for the growth of silkworms. This ensures both the quality and quantity of the silk produced are optimized. Lastly, the Optimized Feeding System tailors the feeding process according to the growth stages and nutritional needs of silkworms, further enhancing silk production. By integrating these critical components, the Silkbot offers a comprehensive solution to modernize and streamline silk production, ultimately improving efficiency, yield, and the quality of the silk produced.

Patent_Title: HYBRID ROBOTIC LENSMAN FOR INDOOR PHOTOGRAPHY APPLICATIONS

As the name suggests, "Robotic Lensman" is an unmanned ground vehicle with a rotatable camera set up to capture precious moments in the ceremony. Lensman makes photography look much simpler by easing the photographer's task by capturing clear images at a difficult angle. Lensmen can be used in the educational field as a room-monitoring or exam-invigilating autonomous surveillance bot. The proposed concept has been implemented, experimentally tested, and analyzed. Patent_Title: CONTROLLED COOLING OF MOTOR-BIKE ENGINE
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Nandakumar M B | Dr Rudresh M | Dr Mahesh B R | Dr S Jenoris M | Dr Naveena B E | Dr Divya G S | Kavya J T | Dr Santhosh K
Abstract: ABSTRACT: Internal combustion engines perform better and have low emissions when they operate at optimum temperature. The engine temperature must lie within a precise and narrow range of, not too cold or not too hot for complete fuel burning and smooth engine functioning. The liquid cooled engines have the facility of controlled cooling by either circulating or not circulating the coolant around the cylinder. But the air-cooled engines have no control on cooling since they are always exposed to air. So, when an air-cooled engine starts from a cold condition, the engines loose vital heat even when the engines have not reached the optimal temperature. Therefore, the time taken to reach the optimal temperature is extended leading to higher fuel consumption and lower emissions which can be attributed to incomplete burning of the fuel inside a cold engine. This problem may aggravate in cold weather conditions and intermittent stops due to traffic signals. So, our invention is a system which is mounted in the path of the air flow to the engine and controls the air flow using the hinged baffle plates. The system can fit in most motor-bikes with proper sizing of the plates but the controller, sensor and actuator would remain the same. Engines operating at optimal temperatures result in fuel efficiency improved by around 4% for a single stretch drive and 6% for a city drive cycle. Emissions shows significant drop in CO and HC emissions. These benefits are attributed to engine reaching optimal temperature quicker compared to engine with no control in cooling.

Patent_Title: AN ENHANCED SURFACE TOPOLOGY MAPPING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR 3D PRINTING
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Madhava Moorthy | Vishwanath B S | G S Manoj Kumar | L Darshan | Chayaank B R | Dr. Vivek Bhandarkar V N
Abstract: Traditional 3D printers often suffer from inaccuracies due to uneven print beds, leading to warped prints and wasted filament. Here the integration of an enhanced surface topology mapping device (ESTMD) directly into the 3D printer surpasses conventional bed leveling methods by generating a high-resolution 3D map of the print surface, capturing even minute deviations. The ESTMD operates on a principle distinct from traditional methods. Instead of relying on single-point measurements, it employs an array of scans the entire bed surface, capturing a comprehensive picture of its topography. The captured 3D map is then used to dynamically adjust the print head trajectory in real-time. As the print progresses, the ESTMD continuously monitors the print surface, ensuring that each layer adheres perfectly to the one below, regardless of the underlying topography. This closed-loop feedback system guarantees a level playing field for every print, maximizing accuracy and minimizing waste. The ESTMD promises to transform 3D printing by precisely accounting for bed irregularities, the ESTMD ensures that even large-format prints remain perfectly flat. It also helps in accurate bed leveling which intern minimizes failed prints and wasted filament, leading to significant cost savings. The ESTMD's ability to handle uneven surfaces opens doors for printing with more challenging materials prone to warping.

Patent_Title: DOUBLE-GATE TUNNEL FIELD EFFECT TRANSISTOR FOR THE BREAST CANCER CELLS DETECTION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
