Abstract: The Double Gate Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor (DG-TFET) used for detecting Cell lines derived from breast cancer tissue (Hs578T, MDA-MB-231, MCF-7 and T47D). The device incorporates 2 nanocavities positioned below the two gate electrodes, significantly enhancing capability of detection of detection. Our study highlights the ability to differentiate between non-tumorigenic cells healthy (MCF-10A) and Cell lines derived from breast cancer tissue by incorporating gate engineering into TFET. We also explore how changes in the dielectric values of these different breast malignant types of cells impact the biosensor's detection capabilities. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of changes in device geometry, including cavity dimensions and dielectric layer thickness, on parameters such as drain current sensitivity, transconductance sensitivity, and ION/IOFF sensitivity. We examine sensitivity with respect to drive current, ION/IOFF ratio, the threshold voltage (Vth), and the transconductance. The device's structural design lends itself to facilitating array-based diagnosis and screening of Cell lines derived from breast cancer tissue. This design offers advantages, including a simplified transduction process, compatibility with CMOS processes, cost-effectiveness, reproducibility, and adjustable electrical responses. To model and define the device structure, we utilized ATLAS, a two-dimensional (2D) device simulator from Silvaco. Through numerical simulations, we validate the device's performance, demonstrating favorable ON-OFF transition profiles.

Usually after preparation of food, it is stored in container with electrical heating dining of any hotel or in any occasion to serve the meals hot. To bring this integration into existence, several parameters need to be considered. Firstly, the design and engineering of the sprayer must be modified to accommodate the Rocker Bogie Mechanism. This involves ensuring compatibility, structural integrity, and ease of operation. These algorithms should consider factors such as path planning to ensure efficient and safe operation. Patent_Title: STOCHASTIC PROGRAMMING MODEL IN LEAST COST FEED FORMULATION FOR LACTATING CATTLE

Abstract: A conventional linear programming model (LPM) for feed formulation of lactating cattle will overlook the variation in feed components. Due to the fact that LPM only considers the mean composition of feed values, regardless of variations, the confidence in satisfying the nutrient need falls to 50%. The formulation of the feed, on the other hand, can be done using the stochastic model (SM), which takes into account both the mean and variation of feed composition and provides 90-99 percent confidence in meeting the nutrient need. In present work, we have proposed stochastic programming model for least-cost feed formulation of lactating cattle where the variation in the composition of nutrients like crude protein (CP), Calcium (Ca) and Phosphorus (P) in the feedstuff are considered. These stochastic models are resolved using M.S. Excel's Generalized Reduced Gradient (GRG) nonlinear and LINGO's Nonlinear solver, and the results are compared to LPM; the feed formulated by SM (90 % and 99 %) has the lowest cost when compared to LPM. Nutrients estimated by LPM, SM by GRG nonlinear, and SM by Nonlinear solver utilized for feed formulation had no significant differences as (p>0.05). When compared to LPM, the stochastic model is a better technique, particularly when dealing with nutrient variation, which is one of LPM's drawbacks. As a result, the SM model can be used to formulate low-cost feed for lactating cattle.

Abstract: An eye-gaze controlled wheelchair system provides an intuitive and accessible interface for individuals with severe motor disabilities to navigate their surroundings with freedom and confidence. The camera captures images of the user's eyes and uses image processing and machine learning algorithms to track the pupil and corneal reflection. The eye-tracking data is then used to determine the user's gaze direction. The gaze direction is then mapped to the wheelchair's movement controls. For example, if the user looks forward, the wheelchair will move forward. If the user looks left, the wheelchair will turn left. The mapping of gaze direction to wheelchair movement can be customized to meet the individual user's needs. The eye-gaze controlled wheelchair system has the potential to significantly enhance the independence and mobility of individuals with severe motor disabilities. By allowing users to control their wheelchair with their eyes, the system empowers them to navigate their surroundings with freedom and confidence, leading to a better quality of life.

Patent_Title: BENDING ANALYSIS OF FUNCTIONALLY GRADED POROUS BEAM ADAPTING HIGHER ORDER SHEAR DEFORMATION THEORY
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Geetha N K | Dr. B. Vivekanandam | Dr. Seshibe Makgato | Dr. P. Bridjesh
Abstract: Functionally graded materials with spatially varying properties have gained traction in engineering applications due to their tailored characteristics. To maximize structural performance, improve energy absorption, and enhance the overall efficiency and safety of engineered systems, customized material properties can be helpful. Porous structures, on the other hand, find utility in various domains such as in the light weight structures. An innovative approach that extends the applicability of higher order shear deformation theory to functionally graded beams in introduced in this invention. In this invention, the bending behavior of two-directional functionally graded porous beams is investigated. This is accomplished by adapting the higher order shear deformation theory. The mathematical model that takes into account the qualities of the material in beam, which are distributed according to a power law, as well as polynomial functions for axial and transverse deflections. The proposed method offers a comprehensive solution for accurately analysing the bending response of beams that feature spatially varying material properties and porosity.

Patent_Title: KKT SHEAR DEFORMATION METHOD ON BUCKLING OF POROUS FUNCTIONALLY GRADED BEAM
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Geetha N K | Dr. B. Vivekanandam | Dr Radha Gupta | Dr Kirthiga M
Abstract: Pores have a significant impact on materials that have been functionally graded. Numerous features can be introduced by gradually increasing the dispersion of pores from the surface to the interior. The materials are affected by the quantity and distribution of porosity. Young's modulus as well as tensile power. Using a third-order shear deformation theory, several sets of boundary conditions are applied to 2D functionally graded porous beams. The material's properties of the beam fluctuate in both the axial and thickness directions, according to the power-law distribution. To compute the buckling load, axial and transverse deflections within the cross sections could be stated in polynomial formulas. To satisfy the boundary criteria, auxiliary functions are mixed with displacement functions. The three boundary conditions simply-supported, clamped-free, and clamped-clamped are considered. Comparisons are made between the outcomes and earlier attempts at convergence and verification investigations. The influence of various aspect ratios, boundary conditions, and gradient indices on buckling reactions of 2D-functionally graded porous beams is investigated.

Patent_Title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PREDICTIVE ANALYSIS OF SOFTWARE TESTING PRODUCTIVITY ENHANCEMENT USING SUPPORT VECTOR REGRESSION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Bindu Bhargavi S M | Dr. Suma V | Dr. Sharon Christa
Abstract: Software Testing is the validation of the functionalities of the software based on the requirements specified. Testing can be performed manually / through automation or both. Any changes in the functionality of the software would require the entire process of testing to be repeated to ensure the conformance of the functionality of the software. If the number of test cases is large, it is tedious to repeat the entire testing process. This is simplified by using test automation to speed up the process of testing and thereby achieving optimum test coverage. Test data related to several real time projects is collected and analysis is performed on the details related to each project. The data related to the project includes the technology used, number of developers and testers employed, cost estimation and project duration in terms of months. The analysis obtained would facilitate further formulation of factors which contribute to achieve productivity gain in automation testing. The effectiveness of productivity gain is predicted using a Support Vector Regression Technique. For predicting the productivity gain, linear regression is used in the industry. In this work a support vector machine is integrated.

Patent_Title: A 4-PORT ORGANIC MIMO ANTENNA FOR RF-ENERGY HARVESTING APPLICATION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Ravikanti Swetha | Dr. P. Aruna | Dr. Anju Kulkarni | Dr. C. M. Joseph | Dr. Vinod B Durdi | Dr. Preeti Khanwalkar
Abstract: The present invention focuses on the design of a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna along with organic materials to be used in radio frequency (RF) electronics for RF-energy harvesting applications. In this work, a poly (3, 4-ethylenedioxythiophene) (P3HT MIMO) antenna is presented. P3HT is a conjugated semiconducting polymer that has been shown to be well-suited for use in organic antennas. Organic materials can also be used to fabricate the antenna in addition to regular materials to improve the performance of the antenna. In this 4 input MIMO antenna, isolation was optimized which is a key factor for radio wave propagation. After the design and simulation of the antenna using High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) software, the antenna is fabricated and tested. In order to improvise the performance of the proposed antenna, P3HT was coated. With addition of P3HT, it was observed that the return loss and gain improved, after fabrication of the proposed design, the antenna will be tested and the results will be compared with the simulated results. So we propose the usage of organic material P3HT in the fabrication of MIMO antennas which can be adopted for RF-energy Harvesting.

Patent_Title: KNEE PHYSIOTHERAPY SYSTEM
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr V S Krushnasamy | Aakash Bhattacharjee | Anusha TA | Prithwish Roy | Siri Ranganath
Abstract: The IoT-based Knee Physiotherapy System is a ground breaking innovation that aims to revolutionize knee injury rehabilitation, osteoarthritis treatment, and neuromuscular disability management. By harnessing interconnected devices and advanced technology, this system offers a range of transformative benefits for individuals recovering from knee-related issues. Traditional knee replacement programs and physiotherapy sessions often require clinic visits or home-based prescriptions, lacking critical elements like real-time monitoring, feedback mechanisms, and self-guided exercises, resulting in prolonged and less effective recovery periods. However, the IoT-based knee physiotherapy system effectively addresses these limitations by seamlessly integrating IoT devices and users into a centralized network. Comprising portable equipment and a mobile application, it enables users to input vital information such as name, age, BMI, and more, facilitating wireless transmission to the Arduino device for seamless hardware-software interfacing. This innovation empowers patients with at-home treatment options, reducing complications and expediting recovery while bridging the gap between patients and healthcare providers through IoT technology. Moreover, it holds the potential to enhance patient well-being by providing personalized therapy sessions, increasing treatment efficiency, and ultimately lowering healthcare costs. Through improved quality, efficiency, and personalized physical therapy, the IoT-based Knee Physiotherapy System represents a transformative approach to achieving improved knee health and recovery.

Patent_Title: FUEL AUTOMATA ON AUTOMOTIVE APPLICATIONS
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. M. Premkumar | Ms. Chandana S | Dhanyashree C J | Ashwini K L | Harini R
Abstract: In an era where time is of the essence, delays in daily tasks are unwelcome. Traditional fuel stations, which often require significant time and manpower, are becoming less efficient as the number of vehicles and devices grows in our technologically advanced society. With long queues at these stations, there's a pressing need for a shift from manual to automated fuel dispensing systems to accommodate the busy lives of fuel station patrons. To tackle these challenges, we introduce a cutting-edge fuel dispenser system that not only automates fuel stations but also incorporates charging stations for electric vehicles. This initiative leverages RFID technology to streamline the fueling process, significantly reducing wait times compared to manual operations. Furthermore, we've developed an Android app to oversee the flow of transactions for both consumers and station operators. This system, integrated with NodeMCU, utilizes the Internet-of-Things (IoT) platform to facilitate seamless communication between the system, users, and dealers.

Patent_Title: NAVIGATION SYSTEM ON AR HEADSET
Applicant_Address: Shavigemalleshwara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr Abhishek M.B | Samarth D.S | Samarth Kolekar | Shantanu Rao | Vinaykumar V Hiremath
Abstract: Points of interest are identified within the area of study and are marked as the reference points. These reference points serve to be the location points within the framework of a navigation system. The navigation system then uses a predefined framework to successfully calculate the shortest distance between these points and display the route obtained on the Augmented Reality Headset in the form of visual cues. NavigatAR is a cutting-edge project that introduces a revolutionary navigation system through the integration of augmented reality (AR) technology into AR headsets. This innovation aims to redefine traditional navigation experiences by providing users with an immersive and intuitive wayfinding interface. Leveraging real-time data, the system incorporates dynamic route adjustments and location-based information, enhancing the overall navigation experience. NavigatAR not only represents a significant advancement in navigation technology but also serves as a pioneering example of the potential for augmented reality applications to transform and elevate everyday tasks.

Patent_Title: FIVE STAGE CONSTANT CURRENT CHARGING TECHNIQUE FOR LITHIUM-ION BATTERY
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Soni M | Dr. Abraham George | Dr. Roopa M S
Abstract: Lithium-ion batteries play vital role in supplying electricity to charge electric vehicles. A battery is deceptive and does not exhibit changes in usage of it; a battery looks the same when it is empty or fully charged, old or new, and it is in need or to be replaced. Battery life is measured by its number of charging or discharging cycles. However, these batteries are more sensitive to overcharging, deep discharging, and temperature. Hence it is essential to use an optimal charging pattern to charge the battery to keep it safe. Multistage (Five-stages) constant current pattern is considered for charging Li-ion battery, as it gives better results than three-stages or more than five-stages. The optimal five-stage constant current charging pattern is estimated from battery parameters obtained by High Pulse Power Characterization (HPPC) test. The proposed method can charge the battery to 100% of its capacity. Compared to the conventional constant current constant voltage (CCCV) charging pattern, it takes 15% less charging time and 0.6% higher charging efficiency

Patent_Title: IOT BASED NFT HYDROPONICS SYSTEM
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: P. Usha | Suganthi N | Sanjay C K | Yashwanth Reddy V | Uday Malagar | Vishnu Prasad
Abstract: The primary goal of the invention is to create a hydroponic system based on NFT in which plant roots are covered by a thin layer of nutrient-rich water. Particularly for leafy greens and herbs, it encourages optimal nutrient absorption and root growth. As the entire system is connected to IOT technology, managing hydroponic systems is more automated, controlled, and effective. Hydroponic NFT systems may distribute water and nutrients precisely to the roots of plants using IOT technology integrated with a variety of sensors, which lowers the amount of water needed to support healthy plant growth. By ensuring that water is only utilized where it is necessary, this targeted delivery system lowers overall water use.

Patent_Title: IMPROVING THE CIRCUIT PERFORMANCE OF GATE ALL AROUND MOSFET
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Nithin Kumar NR | Dr. Dinesha P
Abstract: In this invention we have developed TCAD Simulation results of a novel device structure for Gate All around (GAA) Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistor (MOSFET). The functionality of an Integrated Circuit (IC) has been enhanced by semiconductor devices, since billions of transistors are accumulated in an IC. To overcome the short-channel effects incurred by the Bulk MOSFETs, Multi-gate MOSFETs gained researcher's interest. FinFETs being the most common FETs which are employed in all ICs. GAA FETs, being the most promising device in future technology of ICs. The circuit performance of the GAA FETs has been evaluated by the ON Current and ION to IOFF ratio (ION/IOFF), threshold voltage (Vt) and sub threshold swing (SS). The claimed novel device promises to enhance the ON current and ION/IOFF with lesser Vt.

Patent_Title: SELF HEALING CONCRETE
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Meghashree M | Dr. Neethu Urs | Tahera
Abstract: Self-healing concrete is designed to repair and close cracks autonomously, the bacteria present in the concrete are activated when cracks occur. The size and width of the crack can affect the rate of healing. Smaller cracks heal more quickly than larger ones. After giving a healing period of 14 days again when the loading was given, the healed crack took up the load and crack developed at a different place from previous crack. The invention relates to the development of concrete in which the crack heals on its own. The concrete was mixed with BACILLUS SUBTILIS which is a GRAM POSITIVE bacterium to the mixture. Repetitive loading is given on the specimen to check for the strength of the healing site. This concrete is especially helpful in the structural elements that are submerged in water.

Patent_Title: SUSTAINABLE MUD BLOCKS USING BAGASSE
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Tahera | Meghashree M | Dr. Neethu Urs
Abstract: Sugarcane bagasse ash and bagasse fiber represent the primary waste products generated by the sugar industry. Cement manufacturing contributes to environmental issues due to increased carbon dioxide emissions. To mitigate this impact, fly ash and bagasse ash are being used to partially replace cement. The innovation is to reintroduce traditional construction methods that promote eco-friendliness. This involves creating stabilized mud blocks using locally available resources like red mud, fly ash, and agricultural waste such as sugarcane bagasse ash and sugarcane bagasse fiber. Importantly, these changes are made without compromising the material's mechanical properties. Two sets of blocks were produced: one from red mud, fly ash, and bagasse fiber, and the other from red mud, fly ash, bagasse ash, and bagasse fiber. These blocks were subjected to various tests, including wet and dry compressive strength, water absorption, efflorescence, and scanning electron microscopy. The results demonstrate that embracing new technologies to repurpose and convert waste or surplus materials into reusable resources plays a significant role in safeguarding the environment and promoting sustainable societal development.

Patent_Title: PERSISTENT STAY FIT AND PHYSIOTHERAPY IN VIRTUAL ENVIRONMENT
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. C. Vinothini | Dr. Ramya RS | S.Keerthi
Abstract: Our technique encourage the children and adults to engage in physical activity while aiming to develop effective and pleasurable exercise regimes. They can accomplish it by employing online technologies and having simple access to the Internet to select proper exercise. The users who have been injured in an accident and have sustained minor injuries virtually always require physiotherapy following hand or leg surgery to aid in their recovery. The users will need to do various exercises at home as part of this. Our invention also focuses on E-physiotherapy, which is more convenient and user- friendly for both doctors and patients. The doctors can actually view the user's virtual environment and help them solve problems within it, as well as provide real-time technique suggestions. As a result, the suggested architecture helps users save time, have fun with training, and stay in shape. This invention also recommends safe, low-cost, and practicable treatment to mitigate the harmful effects of the SB pandemic, improve users' health, and lower the higher rate of death associated with regular fitness activities among adults. On the other hand, users may not always complete the exercises correctly or may forget to do them. Our system remind the user to continue the activity regularly to stay fit.

Patent_Title: DYNAMIC GESTURE RECOGNITION SYSTEM
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Deepak. G | Dr. Ramya R S | Mownika Reddy K A | Prajna Harish | Sambhrama K | Vinayak Bhat
Abstract: The subject matter of the present invention relates to Body language, that includes hand gestures, arm movements and facial emotions, is an essential component of nonverbal communication. These modes of expression are essential to human connection and are utilized to communicate information. Hand gesture recognition systems have made an appearance in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI) as a creative, easy, and natural method of communicating with computers. The approach of the invention is to create and apply into use of real-time dynamic gesture recognition system that can accurately identify and interpret gestures in real-time using hand movements of different sign language. Users should be able to fluidly engage through speech and text formats, and the system should be able to deliver results with high accuracy and efficiency. The major goal is to develop a solid and dependable system that can recognise hand gestures and convert them into actionable instructions or actions, improving user experience and enabling easy and intuitive human-computer interaction.

Patent_Title: INDUCTIVE WIRELESS POWER TRANSFER SYSTEM FOR AUTONOMOUS ROBOTICS TO ACHIEVE BATTERY ELIMINATION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Suma V | Manju M S | Revanth G | M Rakshith | Rahul
Abstract: In an automated factory bustling with numerous robots working collaboratively, a persistent challenge emerges as wires become tangled among them. Currently, the robots in our setup rely on batteries for their power, which need frequent replacement or manual recharging through wired connections when they run out of energy. This constant need for human intervention to replace batteries and plug in cables disrupts the automation process. To address this multifaceted challenge, we're introducing an innovative solution that tackles both issues: the implementation of a wireless charging pathway specifically designed for the robots. By establishing designated lanes for the robots to operate within, we create a seamless and continuous supply of electricity, ensuring that the robots remain powered without interruption. This approach yields several advantages. First and foremost, the intricate issue of tangled wires is swiftly eradicated, streamlining operations and minimizing disruptions. Additionally, the reliance on large Lithium-ion battery packs can be substantially reduced or eliminated, allowing for more efficient space utilization. Through the strategic integration of wireless charging and designated operational pathways, the factory can optimize its workflow, enhance safety, and pave the way for a more streamlined and sustainable future. This innovative solution not only eliminates the need for frequent battery changes and cable connections but also sets the stage for an enhanced automation process that operates seamlessly and without interruption.

Patent_Title: INFLUENCE OF POST-TRANSITION METAL ON THE ELECTROCHEMICAL TETRYZOLINE SENSING PERFORMANCE OF ZIRCONATE NANOMATERIAL
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Surendra B S | Dr. Rudresh M | Dr. H.C. Ananda Murthy | Dr. Tan Kar Ban | Dr Kiran T | Dr Shamantha kumar | Chethana MV | Dr. S Giridhar Reddy | Dr N. Basavaraju | Dr N. Raghavendra
Abstract: The sensitive electrochemical detection technique for Eye drop (Tetryzoline) present in acidic electrolyte, while efficient potentially eliminating the hindrance of other chemicals has been lacking at the present time. We found that the interfacial barrier of Mg doped ZrO4 hetero-nanoparticle had powerful physical effects on electrochemical sensor investigation. As based on the interfacial physical barrier, it could avoid the existing problem of the traditional electrochemical sensing mechanism and apply in more interfering environment. High sensitivity and specificity towards sensitive detection of Eye drop (Tetryzoline) in acidic electrolyte (0.1M HCl) was achieved by employing the modified electrode of graphite-MgZrO4 hetero-nanoparticle. The interfacial barrier effect provides a chance to develop sensors used in more interfering environment. The achieved method allows various types of nanostructured materials to be developed with good stability and high sensitivity towards detection of Eye drop (Tetryzoline).

Patent_Title: ALL-IN-ONE DISCRIMINATOR
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Suma V | Kausthub Kannan | Aditya Awati
Abstract: The invention introduces the AOD (All In One Discriminator), a comprehensive regulatory framework developed to address the evolving challenges presented by AI-generated data in the digital realm. In an era marked by the rapid progression of AI technology, concerns regarding the veracity and trustworthiness of content disseminated on social media and web platforms are on the rise. The AOD framework endeavors to offer a resilient solution by effectively identifying and filtering content that remains concealed lacks authorization from genuine users, or is generated by AI models. This invention explores the key features and significance of the AOD framework in safeguarding the integrity of digital information.

Patent_Title: INNOVATIVE METHOD OF DEVULCANIZING WASTE RUBBER FROM THE AUTOMOTIVE INDUSTRY
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Deepa H A | Chandini N V | Himanshu Mishra | Priyanka Sahu | R Neelesh | Dr. Ravishankar R
Abstract: The automotive industry generates a significant amount of waste rubber mainly in the form of used tires. Chemical devulcanization of vulcanized waste rubber from the automotive industry carried out using benzoyl peroxide as devulcanizing agent and, toluene as solvent, interferes with the sulphur cross-links present in rubber. Thus, the resulting devulcanized rubber can be blended with virgin rubber and on revulcanizing the mixture, it becomes possible to reuse waste rubber and give it a new life. This recycling method is environmentally friendly, as it reduces the amount of rubber waste that ends up in landfills and conserves natural resources by incorporating recycled materials into new rubber products.

Patent_Title: DEVELOPMENT OF PVA-CHITOSAN BASED SUTURES FOR SURGICAL LIGATURE & OTHER WOUND HEALING APPLICATIONS.
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Blessy Baby Mathew | M Monisha | Hanskritha Singh U | Poorvika BP | Dr. Anantharaju K.S
Abstract: Chitosan individually as a biopolymer does not have enough good properties to make sutures. Hence, an attempt to make a Poly-Vinyl Alcohol (PVA) and Chitosan based sutures were carried out, owing to good mechanical properties of PVA for producing sutures. These sutures can be used as ligature mat that can be used to cover the wound or else could be used for ligature purpose as it possesses antimicrobial properties and can dissolve in blood after wound healing. Chitosan was successfully extracted from Clam shells after which the PVA was added in varied concentrations. After standardization of different ratios in which solvents were used and post optimization of process parameters, the percentage of chitosan and PVA was fixed to get the most preferred and desirable sutures. Initially, the PVA-Chitosan based sutures were produced by syringe propulsion method which resulted in dis-continuous and hard sutures, and later the wet-spinning process was used to make continuous and soft sutures that were flexible in nature. The sutures were characterized using FTIR, XRD and SEM. The sutures were tested to analyze its tensile strength and elongation property. Young's modulus was also estimated to check the ductility and degradability index of the produced sutures. The developed sutures prove to be a safer alternative to conventional ligatures that may result in threats such as biological magnification of toxic substances and other adverse effects on environment due to lack of degradability and interaction with non-target organisms including human health.

Patent_Title: PREPARATION OF A NOVEL STICKER TO SLOW DOWN FRUIT RIPENING
Applicant_Address: ,Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr.Hema Kumar C | Shivani Papanna | Apeksha Ganapati Patagar | Sushmitha S | Yogitha P N
Abstract: Food security is an arising issue due to massive waste production from the agricultural sector to final household consumption. The UN estimates that 42% of the fruits and vegetables produced worldwide are wasted each year and in India 40% of it gets wasted. Fruits are wasted at various levels from harvest to consumer due to improper storage, transportation and fast ripening. Ripening, is a normal phase in the maturation process of fruits and vegetables. Upon its onset, it only takes about a few days before the fruit or vegetable is considered inedible. The present invention provides a sticker containing natural formulation helps in fruit ripening slowly. Design of the sticker is spherical in shape, contains natural formulations, thereby during the storage or even during the transportation process, the effect of slow-release of ethylene may be achieved, and the fruit is gradually ripened.

Patent_Title: DEVELOPMENT OF ZIRCONIUM DOPED CHITIN TETRAPODS FOR DETOXIFICATION OF PHARMACEUTICALS
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Blessy Baby Mathew | Dr. Anantharaju K.S | Shreya Kispotta | Srijea Roy | Saumya Jaiswal
Abstract: Water pollution is at high alert with an increase in population of India. Pharmaceutical effluent is an emerging class of effluent that is affecting the water bodies in recent times. Antibiotics, cytotoxins, birth control pills, synthetic hormones, anti-inflammatories, synthetic hormone analogues, and statins are only a few of the varied chemical compounds that make up Pharmaceutical Active Compound. When these effluents are released into the water stream, they have genotoxic, mutagenic, and ecotoxicological effects on people, animals, plants, and other organisms. The consumption of antibiotics have increased up to 39% in India, due to improper discard of these medicines they are accumulating in river bodies and contaminating the water. Zirconium has been found to be helpful in the removal of fluoride and arsenic from aqueous solutions due to its tetravalent nature. Tetrapods have the ability to take up heavy metals, which has been shown to be advantageous when heavy metals are taken up from water bodies, which is a possible effluent. In this study Zirconium doped Chitin adsorbents are synthesized for the uptake of antibiotics from water samples. Chitin was extracted from biowaste that is shrimp shells and further doped with Zirconyl Chloride along with Polyvinyl butryl (PVB) as a crossliner using the Hydrothermal method.

Patent_Title: SWITCHABLE BATTERY TECHNOLOGY FOR SOLAR-POWERED ELECTRIC VEHICLES
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore-560111
Inventor_Name: Dr. S. Jenoris Muthiya | P MABUBASHA | DHEERAJ J | CHAITANYA M PATIL | AJITH KUMAR S N | Dr. Naveena B.E | Dr. Nandakumar M.B | Dr. Mahesh B.R
Abstract: The preference for e-bikes is increasing, in India compared with the year 2022 in 2023 the sales of e-bikes have increased more than 50%. The present E-bikes cannot be used for long-distance travel due to limited battery capacity and range anxiety. Charging the E-bike battery using conventional electricity is increasing the carbon footprint of the vehicle.The current design is focus of finding solution of the mentioned problem stattements.SBT is a viable option to reduce the mentioned problems. In this system, dual batteries (B1 and B2) are used to operate the EV. The SBT system is designed in such a way that it will select the battery with maximum charge to operate the EV. By that time other batteries will be charged in solar. In this, switching of the battery will be done automatically.

Patent_Title: PLASMA SPRAYED FLYASH-ALUMINA COMPOSITE COATINGS ON PISTON CROWN OF SINGLE CYLINDER DIESEL ENGINE
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Naveena Bettahalli Eswaregowda | Keshavamurthy Ramaiah | Solomon Jenoris Muthiya
Abstract: Plasma Sprayed Flyash and Alumina coatings were developed on the piston crown of a single cylinder diesel engine under optimized conditions to enhance its efficiency and emission characteristics. The invention focuses on protecting high temperature components with an insulating coating to function as a low heat dissipation engine. This reduces heat transfer through the engine, allowing more energy to be generated and improving efficiency. The focus of the invention leads to specified application improvement, development of coating compositions and the methodology of coating.

Patent_Title: APPROACH TO TEST OCCLUSION HANDLING IN TRACKING ALGORITHMS
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Krishnan Rangarajan | Dr. Vindhya P Malagi | Dr. Ramesh Babu D R
Abstract: The present invention relates to an approach to test handling of occlusion in multiple object tracking algorithms. Occlusion is hiding of a part or whole of an object from the view of the camera and hence in the registered image. Occlusion can be caused by one or more moving or stationary objects in the background. When occlusion happens, tracking of the target object which is occluded becomes difficult as it is visible only partially and the tracker may lose track of the target. Evaluating the performance of the algorithms used for tracking objects in handling occlusion is very useful in: a. Selecting the tracking algorithm to be used in a system b. Improving the tracking algorithm for handling occlusion

Patent_Title: IMAGE SEQUENCE CHARACTERIZATION FOR OBJECT TRACKING TEST RESULT INTERPRETATION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Vindhya P Malagi | Dr. Krishnan Rangarajan | Dr. Ramesh Babu D R
Abstract: There are many applications like object tracking, video change detection etc. which involve handling image sequences. Considering Object tracking, even though object movement, object identification and association/labelling of identified objects is the key focus in testing of these algorithms, the complexity of the test cases is decided by the imaging conditions as well as the movement of the object of interest. Each test image sequence may bring in specific challenges based on imaging conditions. These imaging conditions get documented in the descriptions associated with the corresponding test case. We present a specific way of capturing this information through the values of select attributes. The values of these attributes can be used for naming the image sequence file as well. This naming nomenclature for naming the images will help in analysing and interpreting test results, especially that of the failed test cases, when the performance of the algorithm on different test cases are to be analysed.

Patent_Title: MEAGER - A NOTIFICATION FILTER FOR CHAT APPLICATIONS USING TEXT CLASSIFICATION
Applicant_Address: Shavige Malleswara Hills, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bangalore
Inventor_Name: Dr. Archudha A | Kavya D N
Abstract: Chat applications have permeated our daily lives. With their user-friendly interfaces and burgeoning popularity, instant messaging applications facilitate communication with a broad spectrum of individuals, ranging from family members and professional colleagues to social acquaintances. According to statistical data, an average person receives approximately 106 messages per day. With the proliferation of smart devices, these chat messages not only appear on smartphones but also on various other devices such as smartwatches, laptops, and even in smart car connections. Consequently, a single incoming message can trigger multiple notifications across different devices. To address this issue effectively, the implementation of a filtering module is imperative, one that can discern between important and less significant messages. This module would only push notifications for messages deemed of high importance. Achieving this can be accomplished through the integration of a text classification module within the chat application.

Patent_Title: ELECTROMAGNETIC UAV LAUNCH SYSTEM

An electromagnetic UAV launch system has been proposed to combine the benefits of electromagnetic launchers and UAVs. Comparing the technology to traditional launchers, there are several benefits. Abstract: The present invention introduces a Spherical Cage-Gimbal System designed to enhance the mobility, protection, and versatility of drones in various environments. This system comprises a gimbal assembly with independent rings, and a protective outer sphere. The spherical enclosure not only shields the drone from collisions with obstacles but also enables seamless ground-based movement, mimicking the behavior of a rolling ball. The innovative gimbal assembly allows for independent movement of the drone and the spherical cage, ensuring stability during collisions and controlled navigation both in air and land. This dynamic integration of aerial and ground mobility, coupled with advanced collision resilience, establishes a new paradigm in drone technology, enabling safe and efficient operations in confined spaces and challenging terrains across diverse industries.

Abstract: To address the challenges posed by animals and birds in agricultural settings, a low-cost specialized deterrent system is being developed. The goal was to make a device, specifically a fabricated gun, that could act as an effective repellent against these creatures. This innovative gun makes a very loud noise, making it unbearable for animals and birds. The resulting cacophony acts as an effective deterrent, driving pests away from crop fields. We achieve this noise generation by utilizing calcium carbide, a chemical compound capable of producing a startling spark, thereby producing the alarming noise that causes the animals to flee. This versatile gun is widely used in the protection of crop fields and orchards. It can effectively mitigate fruit damage by deploying it in orchards. This device's effectiveness is primarily attributed to its ability to produce a shotgun-like noise, which has proven to be an extremely effective means of preventing crop damage by birds and animals. In comparison to other methods such as acetylene exploders, gas cannons, propane-powered guns, scarecrow models, hawk kites, colored lights, lasers, flashers, and chemical solutions, our solution is the most straightforward and cost-effective. Some of these alternatives are prohibitively expensive, while others have shown limited efficacy. Our efforts have been focused on designing and manufacturing a low-cost animal and bird scare noise production gun, reducing agricultural losses and food grain waste.

Abstract: The present invention focuses on improving the electrochemical reversibility of P3HT thin films in an economical manner. In this work, electrochromic devices with P3HT as active layer were fabricated and the effect of post-deposition vacuum annealing on the electrochromic reversibility of P3HT films was studied. In the study, cyclic voltammetry (CV) measurements were performed on a P3HT film deposited on an ITO glass substrate at room temperature (RT) in the voltage range of -1.6 V to 2.0 V. In the CV measurements it was observed that the P3HT film changed its color from dark purple to transparent and during the reverse cycle, it returned to its original dark purple color state. To investigate the impact of annealing on the electrochromic properties, CV analysis was repeated on P3HT films that underwent post-deposition vacuum annealing at different temperatures. It was observed that the oxidation and reduction peaks were more prominent in the vacuum annealed P3HT thin films. Further analysis revealed that P3HT films annealed at l 00°C exhibited the highest electrochromic reversibility. However, as the annealing temperature increased, the reversibility gradually decreased. This finding suggests that vacuum annealing of low cost spin coated P3HT thin films at a temperature of 100 °C is a cost-effective method for increasing the electrochemical reversibility of these P3HT thin films.

Abstract: Brain Tumour Detection and Analysis received an increased attention by researchers in the recent few years. Research studies show that nearly 78,980 cases are diagnosed with brain tumour in the world in 2020 among which 18,020 led to deaths. Brain Tumour is a disease which occur when the brain cells behave abnormally. Brain is a vital human organ responsible for thoughts, memory and vision. The mortality rate due to brain tumour could be reduced by diagnosing the disease at early stages. Brain Tumours are classified into primary and secondary types. Primary tumours are developed in brain tissues whereas secondary tumours are detected in body parts other than brain and are taken to brain through blood flow. Primary Brain Tumours such as Glioma, Meningioma and Pituitary are very risky and may lead to chronic problems if not diagnosed and treated properly. Proposed is an ensemble deep learning model for brain tumour detection and classification. MRI images of the brain are pre-processed for resizing and data augmentation. Resized and augmented image are trained and feature extraction is carried out by improved Support Vector Machines. Deep Feature Space extraction is carried out by Ensemble Classifiers. Efficient feature extraction is carried out in the sequence of convolution and pooling layers and classified in the fully connected layer of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Outer Contour and Edge points are searched for cropping the image after thresholding. Multilevel ensemble technique based on Support Vector Machine, k-nearest neighbour, random forest is employed for efficient classification of brain tumour into Meningioma, Glioma or Pituitary.

Abstract: Diagnosing development problems is facilitated by skeletal age. If a child is healthy, their skeletal and chronological ages will coincide. The effects of developmental problems can be lessened if they are caught early. The most common technique for determining the disparity between bone and chronological ages is the subjective Tanner-Whitehouse test, which examines selected areas on hand X-rays. Within the medical team, there is substantial intra-observer bias with this procedure due to years of expertise. An automated bone age prediction approach with image registration using hand X-ray photographs is proposed to provide a second opinion for less-experienced practitioners. Its regression network is optimised using a novel residual separable convolution model. In order to predict bone age using three Xception network modules, the regress or network requires a 299 image. Images will be pre-processed by independent convolutional neural networks to a standardised and normalised position. Picture registration entails three steps: (a) isolating the hands in the image, (b) rotating the hands about four key points of interest, and (c) placing alignment to centre the region of interest. While Deep Lab V3 plus is used for hand segmentation, Mobile Net V1 is used for the key points regress or in angle alignment. Separate convolution is the primary operator in both cases. In order to prevent under fitting, synthetic data are created by manipulating photos by rotating, zooming, and shearing. The results of the experiments show that the proposed method has the lowest mean absolute error (8.200 months) and mean squared error (121.902 months) 2. A bone age predictor with an inaccuracy of less than a year is therefore a useful instrument for providing a complementary expert opinion. This study does not account for gender, which may lead to more accurate forecasts given that male and female bone forms differ.

Abstract: Recent days have seen a steep rise in developing system to detect emotional states of a person using ECG Signals. Developing a system to recognize human emotions is very helpful in multiple areas such as detecting emotion-based disorders, mental health conditions, stress and autism related disorders. Proposed is a Machine Learning Based Emotion Recognition and Recommendation System by Analysing ECG Signals. In the first step the raw ECG data is pre-processed to remove unwanted noise and clean the signal. Filtering and Normalization processes are carried out for processing ECG Signals. Abstract: Parkinson's Disease is considered to be one of the long-term degenerative disorders of the central nervous system. More than 10 million people worldwide suffer from this chronic disease with varying severity and progression. Proposed is an Artificial Intelligence Based Smart Watch to Diagnose Parkinson's Disease using efficient Gait Analysis. Arm swing motion of the person is captured and analysed using gyro sensors and three-axis acceleration sensors. One of the primary metrics to estimate the variations in upper limb movement is by Phase Coordination Index. Phase Coordination Index is measured by comparing the swing times of one of the legs to another. Machine Learning Based classification algorithms are applied to analyse the motor symptoms such as tremors, rigidity, slowness of movement and difficulty with walking. Distance in Autocorrelation waveforms by k-nearest neighbour algorithm is determined by cadence calculation at regular intervals and periodicity metrics to make comparative Gait analysis. Artificial Intelligence based ambulatory analysis is employed for sequential tracking of fluctuations of tremor and dyskinesia based on inertial sensor in the smart watch. Based on the severity of symptoms detected in tremor and dyskinesia, appropriate recommendation of treatment methods such as medication titration and adherence, life style changes or deep brain simulation is suggested.

Abstract: Brain Tumour is considered to be one of the fatal diseases that could be developed due to abnormal growth of brain cells. Brain Tumours could primarily be classified into two types namely cancerous and non-cancerous. Research studies show that nearly 70% of the brain tumour starts spreading in the brain whereas remaining secondary types of tumours are diagnosed in breast, kidney and lung before propagating into brain. Proposed is a Deep Learning Approach for Brain Tumour Detection and Classification using Multistage Convolutional Neural Networks. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scan images are first pre-processed for image registration. Convolutional Neural Networks are applied for efficient learning of feature map. Localization of tumour is achieved by Multistage Convolutional Neural Networks. Machine Learning Classifiers are applied with Convolutional Neural Networks for estimating the predicted output. The CNN architecture consists of a series of alternative convolution and pooling layers. The input image is manipulated in convolution max pooling layer and transmitted to fully connected layer. Naïve Bayes Classifier, Support Vector Machine and Extreme Machine Learning classification algorithms are employed with Multistage Convolutional Neural Networks for prediction and classification of tumours as Glioma, Meningioma and Pituitary.

Abstract: With the introduction of Paralympic sports and games for athletes with disability the need for assistive technology have also risen in the recent few years. People suffering from different types of disabilities or diseases due to various reasons including cognitive impairment, motion impairment and sensory impairment are in need of smart wheelchair for their activities and for their participation in Paralympics. Proposed is a Smart Intelligent Wheelchair for Assisting Disabled Athletes using Compensation Algorithm. The first module in architecture of smart intelligent wheelchair is acquisition of electrical signals through brain. A wearable headband is provided to the disabled person who is going to use the wheelchair. Sensors in the headband senses and records various facial expressions and gestures, head movements and metrics of EEG signals, where signals are converted into accessible data. For efficient interaction of human with smart chair, EEG signals are extracted and analyzed. Using the headband various environmental sensors for intelligent agents including 3D scanners, camera and GPS senses the necessary information and based on the compensation algorithm, multiple sensor fusion model is built. Based on the analysis report from EEG, multimodal perception model is built and the input is fed to smart chair robotic arm controller for efficient assisting of disabled people.

Abstract: Diabetes Mellitus is known to have many complications and one of the most distressing is diabetic foot ulcer which affects 15% of people with diabetes. It puts enormous financial burden on the patient and the health care services, even though it is preventable. Diabetic foot ulcer is characterized by a classical triad of neuropathy, ischemia, and infection. These factors are compounded by mechanical stress created by foot deformities. Prevention of this condition is paramount to prevent long term morbidity and sometimes mortality. This can be achieved by patient self-awareness and emphasis on regular foot examinations during follow-up. Diabetic Foot Ulcer (DFU) can appear anywhere on the foot and can vary in size, colour, and contrast depending on various pathologies. There are certain indicators that help us detect early occurrence of a DFU such as pressure, temperature and Photoplethysmography (PPG). Foot ulcers are a common complication of poorly controlled diabetes, forming as a result of skin tissue breaking down and exposing the layers underneath. Diabetic foot ulcers are most caused by poor circulation, hyperglycaemia (high blood sugar), nerve damage and wounded feet especially in elderly people. Due to diabetic neuropathy, patients do not feel any pain in their feet and are often unaware of any ulcer or wound formed on their feet. This along with impaired healing of the wounds often escalates into lower extremity amputation affecting the patient's socio-economic well-being. The novelty of our work is that we record PPG signals from the feet along with pressure and temperature which would make the analysis specific. Since diabetic foot has the root cause from the blood vessels, PPG signals will have some correlation with change in pressure and temperature of the foot before the inflammation of the ulcer begins.

Abstract: ABSTRACT OF THE INVENTION One of the world's most pressing issues is energy. For both urban and rural households in India, the availability of electricity has been one of the foremost issues. Fuelwood and agricultural waste supply around 60 to 70 percent of the nation's energy requirements. Photovoltaic panels that are stacked in several arrays in a solar farm or solar system are the primary source of solar electricity. The build-up of dust and debris even on single panel in an array, reduces the effectiveness of the energy produced by PV panels. Because cleaning techniques for solar arrays are expensive in terms of time, water and energy use and they lack automation. A completely automated system that uses no water to clean solar panels is suggested as a solution. The concept uses an Arduino controller system to regulate the system's motion during cleaning. The outcome demonstrates that the created solar panel cleaning method can efficiently clean the panel and after the dust on the PV panel is cleaned, boost back the output current as well as the maximum power of the panel by 50%.

Abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is one of the long-term regressive disorders of the central nervous system that mainly affects the nervous system in humans due to which there is the recurrent occurrence of falls which might even lead to deaths or put them in a serious situation. For solving this issue, we have proposed an idea that detects patient fall and reports to the caretaker or family member utilizing message/call/Alarm thereby avoiding deaths. Our work focuses to develop and apply the wearable fall- detection system for Parkinson's disease long-sufferings formed on a Wi-Fi module. Patient falls were precisely traced on the outcome of an accelerometer, oximeter, and pressure sensors which are sent to the cloud via NodeMCU-ESP32.Furthermore, Node MCUESP32is planned for attaining smooth communication between the fall detection device and the system for obtaining and processing the data anytime and anywhere until we have a Wi-Fi connection. Inconsequence, the cloud will perform the calculations based on SVM that is the Support Vector Machine. In turn, it sends the fall detection outcomes to the MIT application. This WFDS turn out to be the best among the existing models in terms of fall detection sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. The fall of direction in PD can be performed accurately based on the fall detection algorithm at the receiver end. The preliminary outcomes show that the wearable fall-detection system attains eighty-eight percent accuracy in identifying the patient's fall.

Patent_Title: Power Efficient Data Aggregation Technique for IOT and cloud Enabled Wireless Sensor Network

Abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN) based Internet of Things (IoT) has gained much popularity, in offering solutions to several real-time applications by interaction between sensor nodes and physical world entities through interconnected technology. WSN based IoT has become key technology in achieving real-time quality of service (QoS), low-cost operation and long-term reliability. IoT based WSN nodes, permits interconnection of various objects wirelessly and these nodes are tiny, equipped with irreplaceable battery and are resource constrain. Due to continuous sensing and gathering, IoT produce huge volume of data which may results in high computation overhead, data redundancy, packet collision and high energy consumption. To address resource constrains, significant research has been conducted to optimize energy consumption of nodes to extend network lifetime. Most of the existing methods focus on extending network lifetime by scheduling method through duty cycles, however these methods fails to handle data redundancy and has lower throughput. Cluster based data aggregation schemes have offered solution to eliminate data redundancy and harvest energy. In this work, we propose an efficient data aggregation scheme (EDAS) for IoT based WSN, this scheme considers improved low energy adaptive clustering algorithm (I-LEACH) to form optimal number of cluster head (CH), by considering node residual energy and average network energy. Data redundancy is eliminated using network coding, this technique integrates liner XOR operation and ensures non-replicated data transmissions. Finally, we performed simulations by network simulator tool (NS2) of proposed EDAS scheme to evaluate network parameters and performance of EDAS is compared with existing schemes.

Abstract: To overcome the major challenge of the lack of access to physical examination including accurate and inexpensive measurement of remote vital signs. Here we implement a machine learning-based estimation of patient respiratory rate from audio. There exist non-learning methods, but their accuracy is limited and work using machine learning known to us is either not directly useful or uses non-public datasets. We are aware of only one publicly available dataset which is small and which we use to evaluate our algorithm. However, to avoid the overfitting problem, we expand its effective size by proposing a new data augmentation method. Our algorithm uses the spectrogram representation and requires labels for breathing cycles, which are used to train a recurrent neural network for recognizing the cycles. Our augmentation method exploits the independence property of the most periodic frequency components of the spectrogram and permutes their order to create multiple signal representations, relying only on an audio signal of a patient breathing. This signal can be collected from a smartphone such that physicians can automatically and reliably determine respiratory rate in a remote setting.

Abstract: Heavy metals are discharged into water from various industries. They can be toxic or carcinogenic in nature and can cause severe problems for humans and aquatic ecosystems. Thus, the removal of heavy metals from wastewater is a serious problem. Discharge from industry contains various organic and inorganic pollutants. Among these pollutants are heavy metals which can be toxic and/or carcinogenic and which are harmful to humans and other living species. The heavy metals of most concern from various industries include lead (Pb), zinc (Zn), copper (Cu), arsenic (As), cadmium (Cd), chromium (Cr), nickel (Ni) and mercury (Hg). Various treatment technologies employed for the removal of heavy metals include chemical precipitation, ion exchange, chemical oxidation, reduction, reverse osmosis, ultrafiltration, electro dialysis and adsorption. Among these methods, adsorption is the most efficient as the other techniques have inherent limitations such as the generation of a large amount of sludge, low efficiency, sensitive operating conditions and costly disposal. The adsorption method is a relatively new process and is emerging as a potentially preferred alternative for the removal of heavy metals because it provides flexibility in design, high-quality treated effluent and is reversible and the adsorbent can be regenerated. The nickel synthetic wastewater was prepared and Sorption studies were conducted by the batch technique and column testby using using the atomic-absorption spectrophotometer.

Abstract: Insulators in transmission lines are expected to be in good condition all the time as failures are costly. A critical failure can cause long-term damage as well as material and financial losses. To perform essential periodic maintenance on transmission lines without power disruption and the associated high costs; hot line maintenance has become inevitable. Presently hot line workers are climbing up the transmission tower to detect punctured insulators and replace them. Though this activity is periodic, it is time consuming and with risk factor involved. Drone operated punctured insulator detector can be operated with a remote device. The drone carries the PID which can be moved to the top of the transmission tower, identify the faulty insulator and transmit the data to the personal computer at the ground station via Bluetooth. This makes the periodic maintenance faster, cheaper and with reduced/no risk.

Abstract: The present invention is the result of an eco-friendly and plant-based approach. The formulated herbal product was based on traditional practices through scientific approach using the extracts from orange fruit peels, mugwort (Artemesia) and marigold which was further evaluated for mosquitocidal properties. Two dimensional structures of all the compounds present in Orange, Artemisia and Marigold were obtained from NCBI PubChem database, followed by Molecular Interaction Analysis and Molecular docking which was performed to determine the interactions between the receptor and ligands. It was inferred that Limonene was responsible for highest larvicidal activity in Orange; similarly in Marigold it was Leutin and in Artemesia it was the Artemisinin that depicted the maximum binding affinity. This means that the interaction with the receptor was stronger compared to other phytochemicals. Different combinations of these extracts were prepared in varied ratios and tested for its effectiveness against Anopheles stephensi mosquito larvae. The formulation showed good efficiency and a working span of 24-48 hours. Normal Human Dermal Fibroblast (NHDF) cells were procured from ATCC and stock cells were cultured in FGM supplemented with 10% inactivated Fetal Bovine Serum, Penicillin and Streptomycin in a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO2 at 37°C until confluent. The formulation did not show significant inhibition in NHDF cells, thus marking it dermatologically safe and non-toxic to humans. The developed formulation proves to be a safer alternative to mosquito control strategy using chemicals which when continuously used can cause development of resistance in vector species, biological magnification of toxic substances through the food chain and adverse effects on environmental quality and non-target organisms including human health.

Abstract: ABSTRACT The present invention relates to an advanced electric vehicle charging system integrating photovoltaic (PV) generation, battery storage, and grid support enhanced through a Luo converter topology. The proposed system addresses limitations in conventional EV charging infrastructure such as voltage instability, poor efficiency, and intermittent renewable energy utilization. The Luo converter, known for its high voltage gain and reduced ripple characteristics, is employed to improve energy transfer efficiency between PV panels and the DC bus. The system dynamically manages power flow between PV, battery, and grid using an intelligent control strategy, ensuring uninterrupted charging and optimal energy utilization. The integration enhances system stability, reduces dependency on grid power, and supports bidirectional energy flow. The proposed architecture significantly improves charging efficiency, reduces power losses, and ensures sustainable operation. This invention is particularly suitable for smart grids, fast-charging stations, and renewable-based EV infrastructure.

Patent_Title: MULTI-LEVEL DUST CLASSIFICATION AND ADAPTIVE CLEANING CONTROL SYSTEM FOR PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULES
Applicant_Address: Kumaraswamy Layout, Bengaluru - 560111, Karnataka, India
Inventor_Name: Dr. SUMANA S | Mrs. SHRUTI R GUNAGA | Dr. GOPISETTI MANIKANTA | MANJULA S | MARULA SIDDESH K A | DIVYA RANI M | BHAVANA T
Abstract: Solar photovoltaic systems provide clean and renewable energy, yet their efficiency often decreases in outdoor environments due to dust accumulation on panel surfaces. Dust particles obstruct sunlight and reduce electrical power generation, particularly in regions with dry climates and industrial pollution. Conventional maintenance practices rely on manual inspection or fixed cleaning schedules, which may result in unnecessary cleaning or delayed maintenance. The present invention introduces an intelligent solar panel maintenance system that integrates artificial intelligence, embedded control, and automated cleaning. A camera continuously captures images of the panel surface and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) deployed on a Raspberry Pi classifies dust accumulation into four severity levels. Electrical parameters including voltage, current, and power output are monitored using sensors. Based on the combined analysis of visual dust detection and electrical performance reduction, a cleaning mechanism driven by a DC motor is activated through a microcontroller-controlled motor driver. The system operates autonomously and improves solar energy generation efficiency while reducing water usage, manual labour, and maintenance costs.

Inventor_Name: Kavitha K | Aathira Anil | Nandini B J | Pavan Naik C | Vinod N K
Abstract: ABSTRACT OF THE INVENTION Title: "A High-Efficiency Nine-Level Inverter Architecture with Smart Switch Reduction" The invention relates to a high-efficiency nine-level inverter architecture with smart switch reduction that employs a novel single-parameter-based switching-angle calculation technique for low-switching-frequency operation. The system comprises a regulated power supply unit for stable DC generation, a PIC16F877A microcontroller programmed with the optimized switching-angle calculation algorithm, a TLP250-based gate driver stage for signal isolation and amplification, and a reduced-switch nine-level multilevel inverter using only seven power semiconductor switches arranged in a level generator stage with four DC link capacitors and three switches, and an H-bridge polarity stage with four switches. The switching-angle calculation algorithm uniquely determines all required switching angles from a single control parameter without iterative optimization, lookup tables, or multi-variable solvers. The present invention ensures substantially lower total harmonic distortion and higher fundamental output voltage compared to conventional low-frequency methods such as Equal Phase, Feed-Forward, and Half-Height techniques. The approach is scalable across different inverter configurations, validated through MATLAB/Simulink simulations and hardware prototyping, and is suitable for renewable energy systems, motor drives, electric vehicles, uninterruptible power supplies, and grid-interfacing applications.

Patent_Title: Multi-Class Classification Framework for EEG-Based Cognitive State Analysis
Applicant_Address: ShavigeMalleshwara Hills, 91st Main Rd, 1st Stage, Kumaraswamy Layout, Bengaluru – 560111, Karnataka, India
Inventor_Name: DR.IFFATHFAWAD | DR. SANDEEP K V | MR. NADEEM PASHA | MR. RAJATH G R | DR. DRUVA KUMAR S | DR. SANTOSH KUMAR R | MR. CHETAN UMADI
Abstract: Multi-Class Classification Framework for EEG-Based Cognitive State Analysis Electroencephalography (EEG)-based cognitive state analysis has gained significant attention in neuroscience, human-computer interaction, and brain-computer interface (BCI) applications due to its non-invasive nature and ability to capture dynamic brain activity. This paper presents a novel multi-class classification framework designed to accurately identify and differentiate multiple cognitive states from EEG signals, overcoming challenges such as high dimensionality, signal non-stationarity, and inter-subject variability. The proposed framework integrates advanced signal preprocessing, feature extraction, and robust machine learning techniques to ensure high classification accuracy and generalizability. First, raw EEG signals undergo artifact removal, band-pass filtering, and normalization to enhance signal quality and reduce noise. Subsequently, discriminative features are extracted in both time-frequency and spatial domains using wavelet transforms, statistical measures, and common spatial patterns. These features are then optimized through dimensionality reduction techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) or Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) to enhance computational efficiency. For classification, the framework employs ensemble learning methods combined with deep neural networks to capture complex nonlinear relationships between EEG features and cognitive states.

Abstract: The growing global water scarcity crisis demands innovative and sustainable approaches to secure reliable water supplies. Desalination and advanced water treatment have emerged as pivotal solutions, offering the potential to augment freshwater availability in diverse regions. This chapter provides a comprehensive exploration of desalination principles, highlighting both environmental considerations and operational challenges. Membrane-based technologies such as Reverse Osmosis (RO), Nanofiltration (NF), and Ultrafiltration (UF) are examined, alongside innovative processes including Forward Osmosis (FO), Pressure-Retarded Osmosis (PRO), Electrodialysis, and capacitive deionization. Thermal desalination methods are also discussed, providing insight into their role in water production. In addition, emerging and sustainable desalination techniques are introduced, reflecting ongoing advancements in efficiency and environmental compatibility. The importance of pre-treatment and post-treatment strategies in improving performance and water quality is emphasized. Concluding perspectives focus on future research directions, offering valuable insights for researchers, policymakers, and practitioners striving to address water scarcity and achieve long-term global water security.

Abstract: This invention presents advanced material systems and fabrication techniques tailored for miniaturized reaction wheels in CubeSat attitude control systems. Conventional reaction wheels face limitations due to stringent mass, volume, and power constraints inherent to CubeSat platforms. The proposed innovation addresses these challenges by introducing high-density flywheel materials-such as tungsten-heavy alloys and nano-grained metallic glasses-alongside additive manufacturing methods to achieve radially graded inertia profiles. The system also incorporates low-friction ceramic hybrid bearings with solid lubricants like MoS2 or DLC for long-duration, vacuum-compatible performance. Housing components are redesigned using thermally stable polymer composites (e.g., carbon fiber-reinforced PEEK) to minimize mass and improve thermal behavior. Additionally, integrated structural-functional laminates with embedded viscoelastic damping layers suppress micro-vibrations without external dampers. Collectively, these innovations enable compact, thermally resilient, and highly stable reaction wheel assemblies that enhance CubeSat performance, increase payload capacity, and support extended mission durations.

Abstract: This invention presents a hybrid cloud architecture designed to enable scalable, real-time AI-based processing of oceanographic satellite data. The system integrates a modular satellite ground station, an on-premise academic high-performance computing (HPC) cluster, and public cloud infrastructure (e.g., Amazon AWS) to support efficient data ingestion, preprocessing, and analysis. The architecture leverages local GPU/FPGA resources for low-latency operations such as decompression, calibration, and geo-referencing, while utilizing cloud-based elastic compute for large-scale AI model training and inference. A federated AI framework enables predictive ocean mapping capabilities-including marine species migration, algal bloom detection, and ocean current estimation-across both local and cloud environments. A Kubernetes-based orchestration layer dynamically allocates workloads based on latency, cost, and compute demand, and an integrated security layer ensures data compliance with academic and research policies. This hybrid approach empowers academic institutions to process satellite Earth observation data efficiently while maintaining compliance and achieving cloud-scale performance for ocean science applications.

Abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are crucial in various applications and the development of new-generation technology. In 5G technology, a key feature is the connectivity with registered and unregistered networks, enabling remote automation and diverse applications such as motion detection and object tracking. This work proposes an underwater object tracking technique to predict the movement of a mobile sensor node. A simulation demonstrates a 2D-UASN architecture with randomly positioned static sensor nodes and a mobile sensor node with random mobility. Statistical analysis is used to predict the node's next position. Experiments measure the predictive accuracy in two scenarios: varying the number of nodes in a fixed 1000x1000 area, and varying the simulation area with a fixed number of nodes. Results show that in large areas with low node density, detection accuracy is significantly lower compared to dense networks. The trend from dense to less dense areas shows a decreasing prediction accuracy.

Patent_Title: ANALYZING TRANSIENTS AND MITIGATING POWER QUALITY ISSUES IN AN AC/DC HYBRID MICROGRID FOR ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING
Applicant_Address: Kumaraswamy Layout, Bengaluru - 560078, Karnataka, India
Inventor_Name: Dr. Sumana S | Mrs. Tanuja H | Ms. Supriya J | Mrs. Shruti R Gunaga
Abstract: The usage of electric vehicles (EV) increased in recent years as the vehicles design and performances are nearly similar to petrol vehicles. The main source of energy for EV is taken from the grid for charging. So, the penetration of EVs in alternating current (AC) grid creates more power quality issues like voltage sag, swell and harmonics in the current. This energy can also be produced from the renewable energy resources like photo voltaic (PV) power generation. This PV energy can also be used as direct current (DC) grid. The electric vehicle chargers which come with intelligent grid operation is considered as load in this paper. This paper is an attempt to discuss the penetration of EVs in AC/DC hybrid micro grid which causes the power quality problems, and the power quality problem is mitigated by using the unified power quality conditioner (UPQC). The results are analyzed for three cases and four scenarios which is based on the function of UPQC and the action of smart charger in grid connected as well as autonomous mode operation of the AC/DC micro grid when the load is considered as dynamic load. The simulation is carried out in MATLAB2017b environment.

Abstract: This innovation demonstrates a completely assembled six-legged hexapod spider robot with a variety of degrees of freedom and varied movement. The presented Hexapod spider robot's numerous legs have the benefit of allowing for simple customization and a range of gaits, including the tripod, wave, ripple, and quadruped gaits. Wheels, tracks, and bio-inspired legs are the three main means of propulsion for terrestrial or land-based mobile robots. Legged robots, while limited to lighter payloads, are capable of navigating obstacles with sizes comparable to their leg lengths while wheeled and tracked robots are capable of carrying heavier payloads and efficiently navigating terrains with obstacle sizes limited to 50% of their wheel diameters. Additionally, more than 50% of the Earth's surface is thought to be inaccessible by wheels or rails alone. Legged robots typically have one or more limbs that are attached to a central body or frame. The appendages are made up of numerous pieces that are joined to one another directly. Legged robots are far superior at navigating terrain with obstacles greater than their wheel diameters than wheeled or tracked automated machinery, making them extremely useful for exploring more than half of the Earth's surface. Robots with legs often have limbs attached to a central body, which allows them to move objects with the help of their leg lengths.

Abstract: The invention presents the biopolymers matrix incorporated with active drug aimed at treating restenosis. The polymer matrix essentially comprises of the blend of biopolymer extracted from natural sources such as fruit pulp or peel and biocompatible polymer. The other biocompatible polymer may encompass polyacrylate, polyglycolic acid, polylactic acid, cellulose, polycaprolactone, polyethylene glycol, polyphosphoester urethane, starch or a combination of them. The blend of biopolymer and the biocompatible polymer with optimal property is incorporated with therapeutic amount of the active drug by solution processing technique. Polymer loaded with the drug will be prepared by dissolving the drug in appropriate solvent and incorporated in the polymer blend solution in calculated v/v ratios. The polymer incorporated with the drug will be then coated on the stent using dip coating method. Then the stent coated will be baked to remove the solvent and to obtain a better polymer films uniformly coated over the stent. Baking is essential to remove the solvents completely which is otherwise can lead to other unprecedented outcomes. The active therapeutic drug essentially immiscible in the polymer matrix for controlled and sustained release. The rate of elution of the active drug when in contact with the body fluid will be contemplated to ascertain the therapeutic efficiency in the treatment of restenosis.

Applicant_Address: b 1202, Skylark Esta, Hoodi main road | 132 AECS Layout ITPL Main Road, Kundalahalli Bangalore 560037, India | 132 AECS Layout ITPL Main Road, Kundalahalli Bangalore 560037, India
