Abstract: [0021] The present invention discloses an Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)-enabled real-time wearable system for predictive fall prevention based on dynamic monitoring of the Line of Gravity (LOG) relative to the Base of Support (BOS). The system integrates multi-modal sensors, including inertial measurement units and optional plantar pressure sensors, to estimate the user's center of mass and compute BOS boundaries during daily activities. A predictive artificial intelligence engine analyzes sequential motion data to calculate an instability probability score by evaluating the displacement and velocity of the projected LOG relative to BOS limits. [0022] An integrated explainability module generates human-interpretable justifications for each instability prediction by identifying contributing biomechanical factors such as lateral tilt angle, COM displacement velocity, postural sway magnitude, and pressure asymmetry. When the system detects that LOG is approaching or likely to move beyond BOS boundaries, it provides immediate tactile, auditory, or visual corrective feedback to assist the user in restoring balance. The system further incorporates adaptive learning mechanisms to personalize instability thresholds based on user-specific gait and posture patterns. [0023] By transitioning from reactive fall detection to proactive, interpretable instability prediction and corrective intervention, the invention enhances clinical transparency, user trust, and regulatory compliance while significantly reducing fall-related disability among elderly individuals.

The system comprises an input module configured to capture artwork images created by children using devices such as mobile cameras, tablets, or scanners. A preprocessing module processes the captured images through techniques including noise reduction, color normalization, and edge detection to ensure consistency and accuracy. A feature extraction module derives critical visual and behavioral attributes such as stroke patterns, shape complexity, symmetry, spatial arrangement, repetition, and color usage. These extracted features are analyzed using machine learning models trained on labeled datasets of artwork from children with and without ASD. The system generates a probability score indicating the likelihood of autism-related indicators and provides alerts and recommendations for further evaluation through a user interface accessible via mobile or web platforms. The proposed invention enables early identification of ASD indicators in preschool environments, reducing dependency on specialized clinical assessments and facilitating timely intervention. The system is particularly beneficial in resource-constrained settings by providing an accessible and automated screening mechanism based on natural child activities such as drawing.

Abstract: Early identification of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) is clinically important due to the elevated risk of adverse outcomes in this population. Although electrocardiograms (ECGs) and clinical records are routinely collected in hospital settings, most automated approaches rely on a single data modality, potentially limiting predictive performance. This study evaluates the integration of ECG waveforms with routinely available clinical data using multimodal deep learning improves CVD identification in patients with confirmed AF, compared with unimodal models. We will compare three models: a clinical-only model (M1), an ECG-only model (M2), and a multimodal model using early feature fusion (M3). Class imbalance will be addressed using resampling techniques applied exclusively to the training data. Model performance will be assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC).

Applicant_Address: #132, AECS Layout, IT Park Road, Bengaluru | Assistant Professor, Department of ECE, CMR Institute of Technology, Bangalore-560037, Karnataka, India | Goudar Oni Muttur | Associate Professor, Department of ECE, CMR Institute of Technology, Bangalore-560037, Karnataka, India | Department of ECE, CMR Institute of Technology, Bangalore-560037, Karnataka, India | Department of ECE, CMR Institute of Technology, Bangalore-560037, Karnataka, India
Inventor_Name: Meenakshi Patil | Dr. Richa Tengshe | Dr. Sridevi S | Lavadeep Kumar Tiwari | Rishi Dhar Mishra
Abstract: Wearable sensor-based fetus health monitoring system disclosed in this invention comprises a wearable non-invasive multi sensor IoT enabled device. This device uses 9 vibration sensors placed on a wearable fabric that surrounds the womb of the expectant mother to count the foetus movement and also determine the position of the baby in the womb. Nine vibration sensors are used to track the number of moves made by the fetus in the womb. Open-source IoT applications used to monitor the data by transferring it to a processor (in this case, a Raspberry Pi) and then to the cloud. The other resistive sensors are also placed to check the various health conditions of the mother like heart beat pulse and temperature variations. The data obtained is then compared with historical data and creates alarms if we find any abnormalities. This data about the health of the baby and expectant mother can be even used to monitor the health remotely by the doctor or the loved ones. Additionally, we developed a mechanism that attempts to programmatically infer the baby's position by looking for the location that records the greatest number of moves at a particular location which in turn helps to identify the placement of a baby.

Abstract: The present invention relates to an innovative IoT-based Emergency Vehicle Prioritization System (E-ViPS) designed to enhance urban mobility and safety by dynamically prioritizing emergency vehicles in real-time. E-ViPS utilizes sound detection sensors installed at intersections to continuously monitor ambient noise levels and employs machine learning algorithms to accurately identify emergency vehicle sirens amidst surrounding traffic noise. Once a siren is detected, the system triggers real-time adjustments to traffic signals, providing a green light to the emergency vehicle while managing surrounding traffic to ensure safety and minimize disruptions. The system incorporates edge computing for low latency data processing, enabling rapid decision-making at the intersection level, and utilizes wireless communication protocols for seamless coordination across multiple intersections in an urban network. This technology allows E-ViPS to adapt dynamically to real-time changes in traffic conditions, road closures, and other factors that may impact emergency vehicle movement. By reducing delays and optimizing traffic flow, E-ViPS significantly improves emergency response times, reduces traffic congestion, and enhances overall road safety, contributing to more efficient and safer urban environments.

Abstract: The development of graphene nanogrid field-effect transistor (FET) biosensors represent a significant advancement in the detection of viral proteins at sub-femtomolar concentrations. This patent describes a novel and scalable fabrication process for graphene nanogrid structures tailored for high-precision biosensing applications. The fabricated nanogrid enhances surface area and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), enabling the detection of extremely low biomolecule concentrations, which is crucial for practical applications in complex physiological analytes such as blood and urine serum. By optimizing the pore morphology and functionalization parameters, the graphene nanogrid FET biosensors achieve superior performance, including the detection of Hepatitis B surface antigen at concentrations as low as 0.20 femtomolar, with a 70% increase in SNR and a 60% sensitivity rate. This innovation marks a significant step forward in the development of reliable, reproducible, and scalable graphene-based biosensors for ultrasensitive detection in clinical diagnostics and other biomedical applications.

Abstract: In response to the escalating issue of plastic waste and the quest for sustainable materials, this study presents an innovative AI-optimized method for producing carbon nanotubes (CNTs) through the thermal decomposition of plastic waste. By leveraging advanced machine learning algorithms, we optimized the decomposition process parameters, including temperature, heating rate, and catalyst concentration, to maximize the yield and quality of CNTs. The process begins with the pyrolysis of plastic waste, which breaks down the polymers into simpler hydrocarbons. These hydrocarbons are then subjected to catalytic chemical vapor deposition (CVD) under precisely controlled conditions. The AI-driven optimization ensures efficient conversion of plastic waste into high-purity CNTs, minimizing the production of undesirable by-products and enhancing overall efficiency. Characterization techniques such as scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Raman spectroscopy confirm the structural integrity and high aspect ratio of the synthesized CNTs. This method not only provides a novel approach to recycling plastic waste but also contributes to the production of valuable nanomaterials with potential applications in various fields, including electronics, materials science, and nanotechnology.

Abstract: The present invention relates to a smart locker system within the field of Electronic Information Technology. The system comprises a locker housing equipped with a pressure sensor positioned at the base to detect the occupancy status by measuring the weight of items placed inside. An LED indicator on the front of the locker provides a visual indication of whether the locker is vacant (green) or occupied (red), based on the weight detected. The locking mechanism of the locker is controlled by a QR code, which can be scanned and managed via a user-centric mobile application. This application allows users to create and log into accounts, scan QR codes for locker access, and verify user credentials and locker status through a backend algorithm. This smart locker system ensures secure storage and efficient management of access through an integrated pressure sensor and QR code technology, providing enhanced safety and user convenience.

Abstract: The Multi-Use Shipping Materials (MUSMs) represent a novel approach to sustainable packaging, combining biodegradable components with advanced additive technologies to optimize material performance and environmental compatibility. At the core of MUSMs is a starch-based biodegradable matrix, derived from renewable sources such as corn or potato starch, offering structural integrity and biodegradability. Additives, including hydrophobic substances like plant-based waxes and microbial inhibitors such as chitosan, are incorporated to enhance moisture management and prevent microbial degradation during composting. Controlled degradation is achieved through the inclusion of polylactic acid (PLA), prolonging material lifespan while facilitating gradual breakdown in composting environments. MUSMs exhibit controlled porosity to facilitate gas exchange while maintaining structural integrity, achieved through cost-effective molding techniques. Molded trays made from the biodegradable matrix provide structural support for packaged goods, reducing the need for additional cushioning materials. Manufacturing processes are optimized for efficiency and scalability, with molding methods identified as preferred for mass production. Future refinements include barrier testing to evaluate gas permeability and shelf-life simulation to assess long-term stability and compostability. Overall, MUSMs represent a promising solution for sustainable packaging, addressing key challenges in material performance, environmental impact, and manufacturing efficiency.

Abstract: The rising global temperatures due to increasing levels of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere have created ideal conditions for mosquitoes to breed in various regions, increasing their activity levels. This has led to a rise in diseases such as malaria and dengue. Households typically use various mosquito repellent mechanisms like coils, mats, and vaporizers to combat mosquitoes. Abstract: QR codes have become a de-facto standard for the digital transfer of data and information across domains such as finance, healthcare, and retail. At the same time, QR code manipulations have become increasingly prevalent, causing serious frauds. To secure QR codes further for preventing these frauds, we propose a novel method of 'Scrambled QR codes' using a technique called Random Masking. We also propose a system named as 'secure QR scanner' to decode the scrambled QR codes. Our Scrambled QR codes can be visibly detected and read only by the secure QR scanner. The secure QR scanner is similar to ordinary QR code scanners, with access to a secret key. This secret key is used for the application of the random mask during the QR code generation. The resultant Scrambled QR codes cannot be manipulated without removing the random mask using the secret key. When these scrambled QR codes are replaced by counterfeit QR codes, the secure scanners fail to scan them. This results in preventing QR frauds. Our method is beneficial as we observed no performance bottleneck or loss in error correction of QR codes due to random masking. We also make the Scrambled QR codes compatible with the existing hardware for QR code generation and scanning with the simple software upgrade. Abstract: There have been significant developments in the use of wearable technology in healthcare, providing a proactive method of tracking and controlling personal health. The gadget can measure vital indications including heartbeat, oxygen levels in the blood, anxiety level, body heat, and physical activity owing to the coordinated efforts of these sensors. Abstract: In rural areas, residents typically store their staple food in large containers or drums for extended periods, often up to a year. Unfortunately, sometimes these stored wheat, rice or cereals can deteriorate due to bacterial growth or unfavourable moisture levels if not regularly monitored. The quality of stored grains within warehouses and godowns is heavily influenced by atmospheric conditions, specifically temperature, humidity, and carbon dioxide concentration. Traditional methods for grain storage management are outdated, as the focus is on monitoring temperature and humidity levels while neglecting other critical factors that require independent monitoring for effective storage maintenance. On a broader scale, many traders also store wheat or rice in sacks for extended periods and sell them throughout the year. They encounter similar challenges, as thousands of sacks are often stacked in large warehouses for months, making them susceptible to issues like excessive moisture or insect infestations. To mitigate these problems, the installation of sensors in these drums or sacks becomes essential. These sensors can provide timely alerts, indicating if a particular sack contains affected grains due to insect presence or if the moisture levels are either too low or too high, helping to prevent damage and wastage of food grains.

The methodology involves a computational system that receives digital images captured by the spectacles' embedded camera, depicting the user's physical surroundings. Patent_Title: SMART SYSTEM TO DIAGNOSIS THE PRENATAL VENTRICULAR SEPTAL DEFECTS USING DEEP LEARNING

Inventor_Name: CMR Institute of Technology | Dr Kavitha D | Meenakshi Patil | Dr Lakshmi CR
Abstract: Prenatal ventricular septal disease (PVSD) is one of the critical anomalies that is related to the structural malformation of the fetal heart. According to the cardiological society of India over 10 out of 100 children were born with congenital anomaly, so it is evident to design a smart system which will automatically diagnose the heart disease prenatally using ultrasound images as the input data. This system consists of various modules such as pre-processing module, segmentation module, modules related to morphological operations and finally deep learning module for classification. A novel Perona Malik filter is proposed to remove the speckle noise inherent in the US image, the next step is to segment the biomarkers of the heart using K-means clustering algorithm. The morphological operations such as dilation and thickening are proposed in order to bring out the original features of the heart. Finally, a deep learning classifier called Multilayer perceptron is proposed which classifies whether an anomaly is present or not. This system uses python programming and MATLAB for segmentation, classification and image pre- processing. Hence, all the modules are integrated to bring out a smart GUI model. This smart system will diagnose the PVSD well in advance that is when the fetus is in the mother's womb. Hence, a choice can be made whether to start the treatment in advance or to treat after pregnancy. The overall motive is to avoid prenatal ventricular septal disease in the future. This system will act as a secondary tool for the radiologist to conclude a clear result about the diagnosis.

Abstract: The Indo Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) plays a vital role in maintaining the security and integrity of the borders in challenging tropical areas. However, the adverse climatic conditions and environmental factors often pose significant risks and discomfort to the personnel, hampering their effectiveness in fulfilling their duties. To address these challenges, a special uniform has been developed specifically for ITBP personnel deployed in tropical areas, aiming to enhance their safety, well-being, and overall operational efficiency. The special uniform incorporates innovative design elements and advanced materials to mitigate the harm caused by tropical conditions. Extensive research and development efforts have resulted in a lightweight and breathable fabric that provides optimal ventilation and moisture management. This fabric not only helps in regulating body temperature but also minimizes the risk of heat-related illnesses such as heatstroke and dehydration. To ensure comfort and ease of movement, the uniform incorporates ergonomic design elements. Additionally, the special uniform emphasizes functional utility by incorporating multiple pockets, specialized compartments, and modular attachments to accommodate essential equipment and gear. This promotes efficiency and quick access to critical resources during operational deployments, enabling ITBP personnel to carry out their duties effectively. In conclusion, the development of a special uniform for ITBP personnel in tropical areas represents a significant advancement in safeguarding their safety and well-being. By addressing the challenges posed by adverse climatic conditions, this uniform enhances operational effectiveness and minimizes the risks associated. Through ongoing research, testing, and user feedback, this specialized uniform can continue to evolve and adapt, ensuring that ITBP personnel are equipped with the best possible protective gear to fulfil their crucial responsibilities in tropical border areas. The proposed method should, therefore, be implemented in real life.

Abstract: In recent years, the issue of women's safety has gained significant attention due to the alarming rise in incidents of harassment and violence. The smart safety protection device combines advanced technology with user-friendly features to ensure ease of use and reliable functionality. It is equipped with a range of sensors and intelligent algorithms to detect and analyse potential threats or dangerous situations allowing for comprehensive situational awareness. When a potential threat is identified, the device activates a multi-switching defence system. It immediately alerts the user by emitting a loud alarm and activating a distress signal to a preconfigured list of emergency contacts. Additionally, it utilizes geolocation services to transmit the user's location in real-time, enabling quick response from law enforcement or designated contacts. It can be worn as a wearable accessory or attached to personal belongings, ensuring constant accessibility and minimizing the risk of detection by potential assailants.

Abstract: An electronic nose for urinary infection detection is a device that can accurately detect urinary tract infections (UTIs) by analysing the volatile organic compounds (VOCs) released by bacteria associated with the infection. The device uses an array of sensors that can detect different VOCs and a machine learning algorithm for data analysis and interpretation. Once a urine sample is introduced to the sensor array, the sensors detect the VOCs, which are then converted into a digital signal by the signal processing unit. The data analysis unit analyses the digital signal to determine if the VOCs are associated with UTIs. The device provides a rapid and non-invasive method for detecting UTIs, making it a valuable tool for healthcare professionals. In addition, the device can be used in resource-limited settings, making it accessible to a larger population.

Abstract: Abstract: A decentralized system for wills and testaments can include a user interface and a backend consisting of single or multiple smart contracts deployed on any blockchain system (public or private) to ensure transparency and data integrity through the immutability of smart contracts. Personally identifiable information (PII), including but not limited to name and email, can be stored off-chain on a traditional centralized database or a decentralized database solution such as GunDB with encryption using various encryption algorithms such as AES-256 to ensure data privacy. Asset details, beneficiary details, and other information critical to the functioning of different modules of the proposed system can be stored off-chain on a permanent storage solution such as IPFS or Swarm, which can be encrypted using various encryption algorithms such as AES-256. The smart contract may contain a reference to the stored data along with a checksum, which can be a hash of the contents of the data or any other security measure to ensure data integrity. The reference will depend on the type of off-chain permanent storage solution used. In the case of IPFS, it can be a CID that can be accessed via the IPFS protocol or using a public IPFS gateway.

Abstract: Abstract: The traditional doorbell system is being revolutionized with the introduction of "QRConnect," a cutting-edge communication solution. QRConnect replaces the conventional doorbell with a QR code placed outside the house, enabling seamless communication between guests and homeowners. When a guest scans the QR code using their smartphone or a QR scanning app, they are instantly directed to a dedicated website, unlocking a world of communication possibilities. QRConnect offers three primary communication options for guests. Firstly, a one-way video call feature allows guests to transmit their video feed to the homeowner, providing an authentic visual connection. Secondly, guests can initiate a direct phone call, enabling real-time voice conversations with the homeowner. Lastly, a simple chat platform facilitates text-based communication, with homeowners receiving instant notifications of incoming messages. To ensure security and prevent misuse, QRConnect incorporates geofencing technology. Homeowners can set a predefined radius within which guest interaction is allowed, safeguarding against unauthorized access and potential spamming. Furthermore, robust security measures are implemented, including IP address tracking and JWT token-based access revocation, effectively mitigating spamming attempts within the designated radius. QRConnect also integrates IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) technology to enhance data security and availability. Users can choose to store recordings and chats in IPFS, ensuring decentralized and secure storage of media content.

Abstract: Abstract: People with visual impairments, such as those who are blind, deafblind, or have limited eyesight, utilize the tactile writing method called Braille. By tracing the lines of dots with their fingertips, Braille readers may read from left to right. For blind people, a system that employs touch reading and writing and raised dots to represent the alphabet is used. Writing and expressing information in Braille is difficult. Since it is difficult for the deaf-blind to write using the Braille writer system, there is no established method in India for administering examinations in Braille. There is much of need for research on improved brail writer alternatives that would make writing easier overall for deaf-blind individuals. Our invention unleashes an effective mode of typing and communication for the disabled. The device consists of two analog 2-axis thumb joysticks. The text is converted to Braille with instant haptic feedback on a wrist band. The wrist band has, 6 linear vibration coins, which correspond to the entered Braille equivalent. The coins are of diameter 5 to 10 mm. The Joysticks are used for character entry, and the other is used to shift between different character maps and quick access words. Also the combinations of the 2 joysticks can be used to enter quick access words and sentences.

Abstract: The present invention discloses a Vehicle-Integrated Bock Wind Energy (BWE) system designed to extract wind energy and generate electricity. The system incorporates a wind turbine located at the back trunk of a vehicle. When exposed to wind, the turbine rotates, driving a shaft connected to a generator. The generator efficiently converts the rotational mechanical energy of the shaft into electrical energy, facilitating electricity production. The BWE system includes a control system that monitors wind speed and adjusts the wind turbine's rotational speed accordingly, ensuring optimal energy extraction. The wind turbine comprises multiple blades mounted on a central hub, and the generator utilizes permanent magnet technology for enhanced efficiency. Integration of this wind energy system into a vehicle enables on-the-go electricity generation, making it suitable for applications such as electric vehicles and mobile power stations. In summary, the Vehicle-Integrated Bock Wind Energy (BWE) system provides a practical and efficient solution for harnessing wind energy during vehicular operations, facilitating sustainable and environmentally friendly electricity generation.

Abstract: The most prevalent form of dementia is Alzheimer's disease, which is characterized by a significant loss of memory and other cognitive functions that impair daily activities. This requires ongoing tracking of their locations, which costs the persons and their carer's money and causes emotional distress. The system employs an ESP32-S microcontroller and a Neo-6M GPS sensor to track the patient's location in real-time. The current latitude and longitude of the patient are communicated to the caretaker through the Ubidots cloud platform. The system also features a MAX30102 sensor that detects and displays the patient's temperature and pulse rate on a 0.96-inch OLED device. In addition, a pulse oximeter sensor monitors the patient's oxygen levels and displays .A DS3231 RTC module is used to display the date and time.To ensure that the device is worn properly, an ESP32 Touch Sensor is used. Moreover, a buzzer is included to remind the patient to take their medication. The patient can stop the buzzer by pressing a push button after taking the medication. In the event of a fall, the system employs an MPU-6050 sensor to detect it. The caretaker is then notified of the fall through a message, enabling them to respond promptly and take necessary action. Overall, this GPS and microcontroller-based system provides a reliable and comprehensive solution to ensure the safety and well-being of Alzheimer's patients. It combines multiple sensors and cloud technology to provide real-time information and alerts, enabling caregivers to respond quickly and effectively to any emergencies.

Abstract: When a vehicle moves it generally experiences three types of forces. One frictional, two gravitational weight and three atmospheric drag. At lower speed (40-50 km/h) drag doesn't even matter. But, at higher speed (>60 km/h) the drag significantly increases and this is a huge problem because around 80% of the fuel/power required by the engine/motor will just be used to overcome this drag. If we build a vehicle which is aerodynamically stable & experiences less drag, then the coefficient of drag (Cd) for a given vehicle can be reduced which helps in giving better range. This is the motivation behind this proposed invention. Today's vehicles are designed in such a way that air hits the body & then moves back. Due to this, vortices are created at the end of the vehicles and this increases the drag on vehicles by creating a pull against the vehicle's motion. With the help of the present invention Aerodynamic Bock Technology (ABT) maximum amount of air hitting the vehicles is extracted via a hydraulic valve setup system and it is sent inside the vehicle so that there are no vortices created. This helps in making the vehicle more aerodynamically stable, less Cd, increased braking efficiency during braking and also increased grip over tyers during any turning even at high speed.

Abstract: Vitamin B12, also known as cobalamin, is an essential vitamin that body needs but cannot produce. Vitamin B12 has many roles in the body. Vitamin B12 is an important nutrient that helps the body keep nerve cells and blood cells healthy. It also helps the body make DNA, the genetic material in all of body cells. The body does not make vitamin B12 on its own, so we have to consume food and drinks that have vitamin B12 in order to get it. Vitamin B12 deficiency causes fatigue, weight loss, memory loss, muscle twitching, neurological disorder etc. Vitamin B12 deficiency happens when your body is either not getting enough or not absorbing enough vitamin B12 from the food that we eat. The invention develops a method to monitor vitamin B12 deficiency in the body. The smart device is enabled by IoT infrastructure. The application monitors the user's vitamin B12 deficiency and muscle twitching. The system comprises a set of sensors to record certain measurements and a processing unit to receive and process the data. In case of problematic condition, the application sends alert messages to the family doctor and relatives from whom the user can get a help. The application monitors muscle twitching without human intervention. The application manages data, do data analysis and generate reports on daily, weekly basis to provide meaningful insight to the user as well as doctor for user medication. The application also guide the user for B12 deficiency symptoms, supplements, to record test results and helps to manage medical calendar.

Abstract: A system and technique for automatically segmenting brain tumors that will enhance patient care using artificial intelligence. Whole tumor segmentation is used in the automatic brain tumor segmentation method and system. A method that is programmed in a non-transitory memory of a device, in one aspect, entails executing multi-class tumor segmentation as well as entire tumor segmentation. Data normalization and initial segmentation are both parts of the entire tumor segmentation process. Utilizing multi-modal MRIs, such as T1 and T2, identifying intensity control points based on the intensities of various tissue structures, entire tumor segmentation procedure includes finding the initial tumor seeds, normalizing the intensity for each of the MRIs based on the intensity control points, and segmenting a tumor based on the tumor seeds. The multi-class tumor segmentation includes feature extraction, voxel classification, and refinement. voxel classification uses data from decision tree-based feature extraction and machine learning algorithms to categorize tumors. Pathology-guided refinement is a type of refinement that makes sure that the tumor is classified correctly while considering the contour of tumor.

This might include baiting hooks, setting nets, and checking the weather forecast. Once out at sea, the fisherman will spend the day fishing, which can include hauling in nets, baiting hooks, and cleaning and sorting the catch. Fishermen use a variety of methods to identify fish in the sea so they can catch them. Some of the most common methods include visual observation, acoustic technology, surface markers etc. To make the fishing optimize we propose in developing fishing gear that includes sensors and other technology to help fishermen optimize their catch. Acoustic sensor-equipped fishing net could automatically release undersized fish, or a sensor-equipped buoy could alert the fisherman when a fish is on the line. These sensors use sound waves to detect the presence and location of fish. Acoustic sensors can be used to detect fish swimming in open water, as well as those swimming near the bottom. Abstract: Waste bins are placed in various locations such as homes, offices, retail stores, and public areas to dispose of waste. These waste bins were fixed and emptied periodically according to the general bin usage level. Usually this is weekly or daily. However, each bin within an area is used in varying amounts, depending on the bin's position within the collection area, special events, and other factors. As a result, the frequency of collection is usually sub-optimal, and frequency does not consider the amount of waste in individual bins. This results in low bin utilization, waste generation, and inefficient management of waste collection from bins. So, we propose a system for monitoring waste levels in garbage containers by connecting ultrasonic sensors to an Arduino Uno board and sending metrics such as waste level to the user. A smart container was designed for this purpose, and they are monitored in real time via mobile applications. When the amount of waste exceeds a certain threshold, notification alerts are also sent. These dustbins are wirelessly connected in the form of a mesh network using Zigbee-based transceivers to facilitate the transfer of the amount of waste present in these dustbins to the nearest garbage collection truck. Also helps to find the shortest route to reach the places to collect the waste from the bins.

It is typically made of stainless steel or other materials that are resistant to heat and corrosion, and it has a vacuum-sealed insulation layer that helps to maintain the temperature of the liquid inside. Some thermoflasks have a double-wall construction, which provides even more insulation and helps to reduce heat transfer. Some also have a handle or a shoulder strap for easy carrying. These types of containers are often used to keep coffee, tea, or soup hot, or to keep water, sports drinks, or smoothies cold. Current thermoflasks use some common methods like vacuum insulation, double all construction, reflective coatings, thermally conductive materials and porous materials to maintain the water temperature levels. Inventor_Name: Sophia. M | Soundarya | Anusudha V | CMR Institute of Technology, Bengaluru
Abstract: The current invention relates to ecofriendly geocells made of sisal fibers for improving pavement performance. Geocells manufactured from sisal fiber can be utilized as a reinforcement at the interface of a pavement's base and subgrade layers. When compared to polymer-based synthetic geocells, this is less expensive and more environmentally friendly. Sisal geocells can be used to support paved and unpaved roads for long term by two different mechanisms. When aggregate is compacted over the top of a geocell, the individual stones become "seated," leaving impressions in the geocell and the subgrade. This interaction stabilizes the aggregate layer forever by locking the bottom of the aggregate into a fixed location. The subgrade soil is stabilized beneath the geocells in the second mechanism. This is because the surrounding soil is retained in place when the soil is loaded from the top, preventing local punching or shear collapse. This shift in soil failure mode from local shear to global shear allows for around 80% more stress before the strength of the soils is exceeded. This method allows for a smaller structural section over a geocell stabilized subgrade. This idea is for a product that use natural geocell for reinforcement, separation, drainage, and lateral restraint.

Abstract: An electric metre, often known as an energy metre, is a device that measures how much electricity a building, tenant space, or electrically powered equipment consumes. The existing smart metre measures the energy consumption digitally and monitors how much and when electricity is consumed at a location. When there is power shut down inverters with power electronics regulates the flow of electricity. Fundamentally, an inverter converts DC to AC by rapidly flipping the direction of a DC input. A DC input becomes an AC output as a result. The connection for the inverter is done separately along with the main wiring only to the required supplies in the building. Thus during power shut down heavy load appliances are maintained off due to overload problems. Here a Smart Inverter is introduced which is connected along with the AC line through the electric meter. The inverter along with smart battery backup runs along with the AC line and stores the consumed power. During power shut down AC line switches to DC and with the same wiring the power can be distributed to the needed appliance through a Controller which monitors the power back up stored. The proposed system does not need an additional inverter and additional wiring for the building, thus replacing the existing meter into inverter. These metres give secure data that can be used to identify peak demand and outages with the IoT and Machine learning methods for calculating energy stored and consumed.

Geosynthetic clay liner (GCL) is the commercially available product which is used for landfills. The system can be used for monitoring the state of a soil in real time and timely detecting premonitions of landslides and has the advantages of flexible deployment and convenience for use.

Abstract: The current invention relates to concrete, with coarse aggregate replacement with Shahabad stone waste partially. At this juncture of rapid urbanization and industrialization concrete is used in huge quantities which results in concrete leaving a very high carbon footprint on the environment. When a particular building material is being produced it leads to three big problems firstly depletion of natural resources, second the localized pollution it creates and thirdly is the fossil fuels used for the production which contributes to global warming. Hence the search for alternative construction techniques and materials has been started. The terms alternative construction techniques and building materials means that any conventional building material or technology is being replaced by a different one, which is going to be locally available, sustainable, has lesser carbon foot print and is reliable after construction. This work aims at utilizing Shahabad stone waste in concrete as an alternative building material. Shahabad is a town situated in North Karnataka. The Shahabad stones are calcareous stone reserves that are plentiful in this area. An enormous amount of trash, with sizes ranging from 5 mm to about 150 mm massive stone wastes, is produced during the treatment of this stone. In the last 15 years, handling and disposing of this stone has become a significant issue. Due to the high cost of producing concrete, research into alternatives to the raw materials has become crucial for lowering the price of concrete while improving its compressive strength and other durable characteristics. As a result, all three concerns have been addressed in this patent. Making concrete from Shahabad stone waste will address the issue of local stone waste, improve the concrete's compressive strength and durability, and reduce the cost of obtaining raw materials like coarse aggregate.

Abstract: A simple method to utilize M- sand slurry in geopolymer concrete along with ingredients like fly-ash, aggregates and alkali activators to make concrete members. In general cement or lime is used as the binding material and hence, this patent is different from the conventional paver blocks available. The patent is claimed for the idea of using the slurry in concrete members of any strength and composition combining the usage of geopolymer, alkali activators for the binding material. In general the M- sand manufacturing process includes the final stage of washing the manufactured sand. This is done to remove the very fine dust particles covered over the freshly manufactured m-sand. Pumps are used to clean this dust and the liquid which comes out after the washing of M- sand is called m-sand slurry. This slurry is not very environmental friendly and will damage the water bodies nearby and also poses a serious bulk waste elimination challenge. Technical field of invention: This invention relates to Utilization of industry by product. More specifically it relates to utilization of m-sand slurry in geopolymer concrete. More specifically it is about making structural and non-structural members using this m-sand slurry geopolymer concrete.

Abstract: The current invention relates to bricks for construction purpose using biochar. When decaying plant and animal material are heated to 700 degree Celsius it forms a carbon rich black material called biochar. The production of biochar is a carbon-negative process. It actually lowers atmospheric CO2 levels. Making biochar transforms the unstable carbon in decomposing plant matter into a stable form of carbon, which is then stored in the final product. When biochar is incorporated into the soil, the carbon is safely stored there for a number of centuries or even millennia. Simply defined, if the feedstocks used to make biochar were allowed to naturally decay, they would release higher levels of carbon dioxide into the environment. Biochar technology ultimately lowers atmospheric carbon dioxide levels by heating the feedstocks and converting their carbon content into a stable structure that doesn't react with oxygen. The current patent deals with a method to make building bricks which need not be fired as in the case of the conventional bricks. Therefore the costs associated with the making of a common brick is higher when compared to bio- char bricks. The composition of the bricks and the method to make it is being patented here.

Abstract: Some of the products like shampoo, moisturizing lotions, cleansing milk, conditioners and body washes used in our day-to-day lives when used from a concealed bottle are not used till the last drop of its contents.When the contents are very minimal inside the bottle, the consumer might find it difficult to dispense the product for usage. Issues faced by the consumer in order to utilize the entire contents would include tilting the bottle inverted and waiting for the product to slowly slide and come out. Also few contents which would be sticking along the interior walls of the bottle would not be dispensed and goes wasted. Ideally a bottle should have a design in which its contents can be dispensed to the maximum and be used in its entirety. Hence we propose an efficient utility bottle design which would help in reducing the wastage. The bottle would include a circular disc at the base with almost the same radius as the interior wall of the bottle from the centre, so that this disc is in total contact with the interior wall without any gap between them, but also able to move up and down with little friction. A perpendicular stick up to the mouth of the bottle is attached to the disc as a single mould.

Abstract: Abstract Water is considered to be one of the prime nutrients of human health. Consumption of a certain amount of water per day can be a potential preventative barrier against a host of physiological problems, (e.g., kidney stones, dehydration, obesity, digestive problems, et al). However, the rush of everyday life makes individuals often ignore drinking the requisite amount of water, leading to a shortfall in water content in the body. As a result, urinary diseases have become a quite persistent health challenge, affecting nearly 10% of the US population. The issue is further compounded by patients nowadays often unwilling to disclose their personal medical data on any cloud platform for fear of compromising their privacy. To conquer these dual complications, we have proposed a prototype design of a novel, fully homomorphic, encryption-based, capacitive touch-sensing incorporated smart water bottle. The proposed smart water bottle is designed to achieve sustainable improvements in hydration status of users by tracking their daily water intake in realtime via smartphone applications. The water bottle uses an application that requires user details like name, age, sex, prior disease information, and water consumption limit prescribed by physicians. The Wi-fi controller device in the bottle supports 802.1 lb/g/n and direct support for cloud services and enables users to choose various physiological features applicable to their BMI levels and/or preferred cases. The bottle's volumetric data comprises the changes in water level over 24 hours, detected through an accelerometer incorporated with capacitive proximity sensors. The data is securely sent to the cloud server after encrypting it with FHE-based crypto:system that masks information on the users' personal details. Data computations and analysis are performed in the cloud server to determine the necessary water intake volume for users and alert them on optimizing their water consumption.

Abstract: When a customer/user stores data in the third-party cloud server, they are worried about the security and privacy of their data. In which there is a chance for compromising the privacy of the data. To avoid this type of situation we are using fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) algorithm. In this method, a third-party can perform operation on the encrypted data without decrypting it. The encrypted result will be sent to the user, who is having the secret key to decrypt it. But one disadvantage of this FHE algorithm is it takes more time if we have implemented using software. To overcome this problem our invention includes implementing BV FHE scheme using Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA). BV FHE scheme is based on Learning with Error (LWE). In real time environment, the volume of data will be more and data privacy can't be compromised. Modem FPGA comprises of large number of logic elements, memory blocks, multipliers, and high-speed serial interface for both memory and data.

The proposed device integrates pollutant capture, regeneration, and energy harvesting within a single scalable architecture suitable for both urban and industrial environments. Polluted air containing volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is drawn into the system through an intake unit and directed to a multi-layer adsorption chamber where contaminants are effectively trapped. The captured pollutants are then subjected to controlled thermal and catalytic regeneration, releasing heat energy. This recovered thermal energy is directly converted into electricity using high-efficiency thermoelectric generators. The system is equipped with smart sensors and a control unit to continuously monitor pollutant levels, temperature conditions, and energy output, thereby optimizing operational efficiency. Unlike conventional waste-to-energy systems that are centralized and rely on solid waste streams, this invention operates on ambient air pollutants and is portable, energy-efficient, and easily deployable. The technology offers a dual benefit of reducing air pollution and generating renewable energy, making it highly suitable for sustainable cities, industrial emission management, and carbon-neutral initiatives.

Applicant_Address: DEPARTMENT OF CHEMISTRY, CMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, 132, AECS LAYOUT, IT PARK ROAD, KUNDALAHALLI P.O, BENGALURU, KARNATAKA, INDIA-560037 | 132, AECS LAYOUT, IT PARK ROAD, KUNDALAHALLI P.O, BENGALURU, KARNATAKA, INDIA-560037
Inventor_Name: BATHINAPATLA AYYAPPA | ASEENA AZEEZ | BHUJANGAIAH NS
Abstract: TITLE OF THE INVENTION: Development of a Photocatalytic Method for the Degradation of 2,4-Dichlorophenoxyacetic Acid Persistent synthetic herbicides, particularly 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid (2,4-D), pose serious environmental and public health concerns due to their chemical persistence, resistance to natural degradation, and propensity to accumulate in aquatic ecosystems. These attributes lead to trophic disruption and long-term toxicity toward aquatic organisms. ln this study, we present the development of a robust and multifunctional photocatalyst, engineered by encapsulating a copper-based metal-organic framework (Cu-BTC MOF) within graphitic carbon nitride (gC3 N4 ), yielding a Cu-BTC MOF/g-C3 N4 nanocomposite with markedly enhanced photocatalytic activity. Comprehensive physicochemical analyses-including UV-Vis spectroscopy, FTIR, XRD, SEM--confirmed the successful integration of Cu-BTC MOF into the g-C3 N4 matrix, demonstrating improved light absorption capacity, a narrowed bandgap, and a larger specific surface area. Under visible light irradiation, the Cu-BTC MOF/g-C, N. composite achieved a high degradation efficiency of approximately 98.5% for 2,4-D within 120 minutes at pH 9.0, significantly outperforming its individual constituents. This superior performance is attributed to the formation of a Type-II heterojunction, which enables efficient directional charge transfer, enhances charge separation, and suppresses electron-hole recombination by offering numerous reactive sites. Kinetic studies revealed that the degradation process follows pseudo-first-order reaction kinetics. Additionally, the composite exhibited excellent reusability, maintaining high photocatalytic performance across successive cycles . These results highlight the potential of g-Ca N. -encapsulated Cu-BTC MOF nanocomposites as high-efficiency, recyclable photocatalysis for environmental detoxification and prospective environmental applications.

Abstract: The present invention relates to ultra-scaled double-gate graphene nanoribbon (GR) tunnel field-effect transistors (TFETs) based on GaN/InSb heterostructures, designed for low-power, high-performance biomolecule detection in sub-5 nm applications. This device incorporates novel doping profiles and dielectric modulation to enhance biomolecule sensitivity, minimize leakage currents, and improve energy efficiency. Leveraging quantum simulations grounded in the Non-Equilibrium Green's Function (NEGF) formalism, the invention models key performance parameters, including I-V characteristics, subthreshold swing, charge density, and ION/IOFF ratios, achieving optimized performance at the nanoscale. The tailored doping profile reduces direct source-to-drain tunneling and ambipolar behavior, overcoming critical challenges in ultra-scaled TFET designs. Furthermore, the dual-gate configuration with work function engineering enhances device control, sensitivity, and switching speed, resulting in a scalable, low-power solution ideal for high-precision biosensing applications. The proposed GR-GaN/InSb TFET architecture surpasses conventional FET-based sensors in terms of electrical efficiency and functionality, positioning it as a highly viable candidate for next-generation, ultra-sensitive biomolecule detection systems.

Sliding bin lid acts as a collector of the waste, until the sensor, senses the waste on the lid. The segregation process may be initiated automatically after detection of the waste using the controlling unit. The effortlessly segregated wastes can be further processed to be recycled and reused. The entire process is alternatively powered by renewable source of energy like solar energy.

Abstract: By adopting a straightforward process, an efficient template for encapsulating monometallic (Pd, Pt, and Ru) and bimetallic (Pt-Ru, Pd-Ru) nanoparticles was created using a well-balanced amphiphilic poly(propyleneimine) dendrimer. The FT-IR, NMR, and MALDI- TOF spectroscopies were used to confirm the structure of the freshly synthesized template. With the use of FT-IR, TEM, EDAX, and XRD investigations, the encapsulation of mono and bimetallic nanoparticles on dendrimer templates was described. The synthesized nanoparticles had an average diameter of 1-10 nm and a spherical shape. They were fairly monodispersed. The produced mono and bimetallic nanoparticles were used as a catalyst to accelerate the generally slow reduction of the dye rhodamine B (Rh B) using NaBH4. Using spectrophotometry, the reaction was monitored for changes in absorbance at the dye's distinctive peak of 554 nm. Additionally, a comparative analysis of the catalytic efficacy of individual monometallic and bimetallic nanoparticles and their synthesis was conducted for the reduction reaction. First order kinetics govern the degrading reaction, and the rate constants k for monometallic Pd and bimetallic Pd-Ru nanoparticles are 2.68 x 10-3 s-1 and 8.49 x 10-3 s-1, respectively. Based on the synergistic effect of two metal nanoparticles and their tiny size, our results indicate that bimetallic Pd-Ru nanoparticles are particularly promising for catalytic use compared to their monometallic counterparts.

Abstract: The integration between the discrete control (the "cyber") and the analog environment (the "physical") through sensors and actuators over wired or wireless communication networks, is the defining feature of cyber-physical systems. The functional correctness of a cyber- physical system is crucially dependent not only on the dynamics of the analog physical environment, but also on the decisions taken by the dis- crete control that alter the dynamics of the environment. The framework of Hybrid automata - introduced by Alur, Courcoubetis, Henzinger, provide a formal modeling and specification environment to analyze the interaction between the discrete and continuous parts of a cyber- physical system. Hybrid automata can be considered as generalizations of finite state automata augmented with a finite set of real-valued variables whose dynamics in each state is governed by a system of ordinary differential equations. Moreover, the discrete transitions of hybrid automata are guarded by timing constraints over the values of these real-valued variables, and enable discontinuous jumps in the evolution of these variables. Considering the richness of the dynamics in a hybrid automaton with time variable, it is perhaps not surprising that the fundamental verification questions, like reachability, for the general model are undecidable. We develop a general tool for the verification purpose of cyber-physical system.

Abstract: A novel Cu-Fe NPs/ZEA/Gr electrochemical biosensor was developed through the use of a facile sol-gel spin coating process. Abstract: The present invention focuses on providing a variable sampling rate for the digitization of speech signal and thereby resulting in lower bit rate. Speech samples are characterized by a high correlation between adjacent samples. Therefore, even if a few adjacent samples are missing, we can estimate the missing samples using polynomial interpolation. While a polynomial of degree one can be good enough to estimate the missing samples when correlation is sufficiently high, a higher order polynomial would be necessary when correlation levels are low. When speech samples are encoded, we can reserve one bit to indicate the degree of polynomial needed for interpolation. If the bit is 1, then it indicates that we have to predict one more sample between two adjacent samples and the polynomial degree is increased by 1. If the bit is 0, then it indicates that we have to predict one fewer sample between adjacent samples and the polynomial degree is decreased by 1. This way, we can sample the speech signal with variable sampling rate resulting in lower bit rate

Abstract: A decade ago, the Engineering and diploma students were practicing Engineering drawing using drawing instruments like a mini drafter, a drawing compass, a drawing divider, a protractor etc. But now, the advancement in technology made way for computer aided Engineering Drawing. Certain universities in India practice Engineering Drawing using a drafting package like Auto Cad, Solid Edge, Solid Works etc. The major advantage associated with the drafting package is the accuracy in measurement and less time consumption. However in some universities in India, Engineering Drawing is practiced using both manual and computer aided methods. The method used for manual drawings is referred to as Sketching and the one used for computer aided drawing is referred to as Drafting. During evaluation of drawings, certain weight age is given for sketching and Drafting. A student is required to adopt both the methods of drawing during examination and the solutions obtained are compared for the solutions in terms of length and angles. In drafting, the distance between any two parallel lines and the angle between any two lines can be measured to an accuracy of 0.01 mm and 0.01 degrees respectively. However this accuracy is not possible in sketching using an ordinary scale and a protractor. A digital Roto Scale is an instrument capable of measuring linear and angular measurements to an accuracy of 0.01 mm and 0.01 degrees respectively. This makes the comparison of measurements in Drafting and Sketching more sensible. The present invention is a simple measuring instrument, compact in size, easy to handle and economical as well. It is a simple digital device that replaces a scale and a protractor and is capable of capturing both linear and angular measurements to an accuracy of 0.01 mm and 0.01 degrees respectively.

Inventor_Name: Anish M | Jayaprabakar J | Manikandan H | Arunkumar T
Abstract: This invention relates to study the performance, combustion, and emission analyses of novel algal biodiesel by varying different blending loads and injection timing. The experimenting with macro algae and micro algae biodiesel through engine research and optimization studies makes this study unique. Microalgae oil extracted from biomass of freshwater algae, macro-algae oil extracted from macro-algae biomass collected from brackish water and neat refined rice bran are the three types of fuels used in this work. The standard injection timing for the tested engine is 23° BTDC; it was advanced and retarded for 3°CA for experimental purposes. For the experiment, five sets of loads ranging from 0% to 100% are changed. For each load condition, the time it took for 10cc of fuel to be consumed was recorded. The findings suggest that pure diesel has a higher thermal efficiency than biodiesel blends. The brake thermal efficiency improve as the proportion of biodiesel in the blends increases. Overall, conventional diesel produces the highest volumetric efficiency values of all the fuel types evaluated at all injection timings and under all loads due to its higher heating value. On the other hand, the micro algae biodiesel blends shows better performance as well as less emission compared to other fuel types. Therefore, the micro algae oils, methyl esters are a superior substitute for traditional diesel fuel than rice bran and macro algae oil. On the basis of utility, cost, and without any alterations, the B20 blend of micro algae oil and diesel can be recommended.

The nature of many work environments requires workers to sit and slouch for extended periods of time, which can lead to back pain. Medical research suggests that maintaining a correct sitting posture over time is the most effective way to prevent this discomfort. Abstract: The patent proposal, titled "A Secret Message Communication System for Soldiers," aims to create a system that can assist the soldiers who stand in the sun and snow to protect our borders. When the outposts transmit messages via radio, the frequencies are randomly hacked by the enemies, exposing the messages to them. What if we had a system that not only confused enemies but also left them in the dark? In the proposed system the message can be sent using an Android device of any kind with a keyboard. The messages will be fed from an Android device to a microprocessor (Raspberry Pi) via Wi-Fi, where they will be converted into an encrypted code and then transmitted by flashing the LED. A phototransistor on the receiver's side will record the flashes and feed it as input to the microprocessor, which will decode it to get the original message, so the enemies will perceive it as fluctuations in power rather than a message. It is also proposed to personalise internationally used Morse Codes, which will be used to transmit messages from one defence outpost to another. It can also be implemented if the lighting inside the posts is turned off for security reasons by using the soldiers' available torches. The microprocessor will be linked to the LED to send flashing instructions via codes.

This may require a lot of electric energy. The Invention discloses a hybrid methodology using renewable resource as a source of energy at these toll plazas. The renewable resource powered automatic toll gate system comprises a Microcontroller module, Renewable resource power unit, an IR receiver, RFID Reader, motor-based toll gate controlling unit, LCD and buzzer. DC motor and Motor Drivers powered by renewable sources of energy are used to open the gate and a motor driver IC is used to drive the motor. The primary objective is to utilize abundantly available Renewable Sources of energy to power the working of Toll Plazas and efficiently save nonrenewable sources of energy for future generations.

To avoid anomalies, the blood pressure and diabetes need to monitor simultaneously, leased on the distinctions, the blood pressure has to control the optimal drug delivery system. The cascade control studies' simulations demonstrated, and the proposed approach provides proper estimating drug delivery and regulates hypertension as per the recommended levels.

Applicant_Address: ASSISTANT PROFESSOR, DEPT. OF ECE, CMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, AECS LAYOUT, ITPL ROAD, BENGALURU-560037. | JRF, DEPT OF ECE, CMRINSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, AECS LAYOUT, ITPL ROAD, BENGALURU-560037 | AECS LAYOUT, ITPL ROAD, BENGALURU-560037
Inventor_Name: PARTHASARATHY P | NAVASHREE N | CMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
Abstract: Nanomaterials research has gotten a lot of attention because of its unique features and wide range of applications. The type and composition of nanoparticles determines the applications of such materials in various industries. Metallic nanoparticles are particularly sought for their, superior properties, among them copper nanoparticles (Cu NPs) have gained special attention in nanoscience and technology owing to their low cost, ubiquity, and excellent catalytic, optical, and thermal characteristics. The proposed biosensor based on copper nanoparticle-modified glassy carbon electrode shows enhanced response of electrochemical determination of hydrogen peroxide. Here, the copper nanoparticles were prepared by chemical reduction method and characterized by SEM, XRD, TEM and AFM. The prepared nanoparticles were used to develop a thin film electrode using spin coating method where the CV Studies (CV Curve, Current VS Hydrogen peroxide) proves that the Cu NP electrode was found to be suitable for the selective determination of hydrogen peroxide even in the presence of ascorbic acid and uric acid from our previous study. The observed linear range and detection limit shows that the newly developed thin film biosensor is suitable for the determination of hydrogen peroxide with non- enzymatic method. Thus, it can be potentially applied for the detection in real samples such as human blood serum.

Abstract: Nowadays, users use their smartphones for a variety of purposes, including voice calls, video calls, text messages, multimedia messages, email, online banking, webinars, and online shopping. The smart phone has to establish a connection with any base station or access point in the area in order to access those services. Each access point or base station will have a distinct bandwidth level (data speed), frequency of the signal, signal encoding technique, packet delay, transmitting power, energy consumption, cost, etc. since these access points or base stations may offer services with different network standards. The strength of the signal will also vary depending on how close or far the smartphone is to the base station. The smart phones will use less energy to connect to nearby access points or base stations and more energy to connect to access points or base stations that are farther away. Due to weak signal strength, the connectivity between the access point or base station may be lost when the smart phone moves from one location to another. In order to maintain uninterrupted service, the smart phone must search for an accessible access point or base station that is close enough to it. The smart phone may discover numerous access points or base stations during the search process, and in this case, it must choose one of them depending on factors like signal strength, bandwidth, packet delay, energy consumption, network standard utilised, security level, etc.

Patent_Title: A Novel Layered Approach for the Measurement of Design Properties to Infer on the Improvement of Quality using Aspect Oriented Software Development
Applicant_Name: Senthil Velan Suganantham | CMR Institute of Technology
Applicant_Address: G2 BLOCK 3, S/O: SUGANANTHAM, SANNATHI STREET, ARSAN HOMES, MARUTHY NAGAR RAJAKILPAKKAM, SEMBAKKAM, KANCHEEPURAM, , KANCHEEPURAM, TAMIL NADU, INDIA, 600073 | CMR Institute of Technology 132 AECS Layout ITPL Main Road Kundalahalli, Bengaluru Karnataka India
Inventor_Name: Senthil Velan Suganantham | CMR Institute of Technology
Abstract: Aspect Oriented Software Development (AOSD) achieves a higher degree of modularity compared to the procedural and Object Oriented (OO) methodologies. This methodology provides constructs to clearly separate core and cross-cutting concerns into independent units of functionality. Due to this improved separation of concerns, it is generally considered that the Aspect Oriented (AO) software will exhibit higher quality than its OO counterpart. Even though, the AO methodology claims to improve maintainability, reusability and evolution, these quality attributes are not currently quantitatively measurable from the AO software. This mandates a need to design an approach to quantitatively assess the quality attributes of AO software. A set of core design properties such as, cohesion, coupling, inheritance, complexity and ripple effect, can directly or indirectly affect the above-mentioned quality attributes. These properties can be analyzed using a suitable set of metrics that quantitatively captures the design artifacts that affect them either positively or negatively. Quality of software requires thoughtful considerations during the earlier phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) itself and has a far-reaching impact on the usefulness of software. Since, quality cannot be directly measured for a software product, a systematic approach needs to be defined and applied to the design of software. Each new software development methodology provides certain unique techniques to address the shortcomings of the earlier methodologies. In this context, it becomes significant to have a Layered Measurement Approach to measure and understand the impact of any new methodology. To fulfill this need, a layered measurement of design properties has been proposed with structural design than can be evaluated using different methodologies that can use the core software design properties.

Applicant_Name: ARIJIT DATTA | CMR Institute of Technology
Applicant_Address: ASSISTANT PROFESSOR, DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRONICS & COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING, SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING AND APPLIED SCIENCES, SRM UNIVERSITY-AP, ANDHRA PRADESH-522502, INDIA. | CMR Institute of Technology, 132, AECS Layout, ITPL Main Road, Bengaluru-560037, India.
Inventor_Name: ARIJIT DATTA | CMR Institute of Technology
Abstract: With the advent of non-diffracting beams, Bessel-Gauss beam-based optical devices have experienced resurgent attention due to higher order mode-induced sensitivity. The current invention considers the viability of utilizing the benefits of a Bessel-Gauss beam in the designing of a novel and sharp optical bandpass filter which exhibits a lower insertion loss with sharp transition characteristics. The proposed filtering system comprises of a multimode fiber which is joined in between two higher-order mode fibers and it works on the notion of modal interference where the spectral response of the filter varies with the self-imaging distance. As compared with the conventional optical filter, the proposed bandpass filter indicates a narrower bandwidth of ~2 nm with a lower insertion loss of ~0.008 dB. Therefore, the present paradigm paves the way for many potential applications, like in optical communication, spectroscopy, and sensing.

Abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system (102) and method (1100) for detecting anomalies in media acquisition data. The system employs a pre-trained and frozen spatiotemporal feature extraction model to generate semantic representations from sequences of media frames, ensuring computational efficiency and prevention of catastrophic forgetting. The generated feature representation is processed through a dual-pathway architecture comprising a specialist pathway for detecting predefined anomaly classes using supervised learning, and a generalist pathway for identifying unknown anomalies through zero-shot semantic similarity with text-based representations. A hierarchical arbitration logic determines the anomaly state by prioritizing high-confidence outputs from the specialist pathway while selectively validating generalist outputs to reduce false positives. Further, temporal persistence validation ensures robustness by confirming anomalies across consecutive frames. The system outputs validated anomaly results with classification, confidence, and temporal metadata, enabling reliable real-time monitoring and forensic analysis.

Abstract: TITLE: A DISTRIBUTED ADAPTIVE INTRUSION PREVENTION SYSTEM FOR 5G OPEN RADIO ACCESS NETWORKS APPLICANT: PES UNIVERSITY ABSTRACT The patent invention discloses a scalable, layered, and closed-loop security system specifically designed for 5G Open Radio Access Networks (ORAN). As the evolution to 5G introduces increased openness and functional disaggregation, ORAN networks face new security vulnerabilities. To address these, the present invention system integrates a Lightweight Filtering Entity (LFE), an inline rule-based Intrusion Prevention System (IPS), with a High-Level Deciding Entity (HLDE) responsible for advanced anomaly detection and dynamic rule generation. By combining real-time signature-based and anomaly-based detection techniques, the HLDE enhances the system's ability to detect and filter malicious traffic based on novel or existing attack signatures. This innovative framework ensures comprehensive network protection with minimal overhead, making it highly adaptable for various network environments while promoting interoperability and reducing vendor dependency in ORAN systems.

Patent_Title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR OPTIMIZING COMPUTATIONAL RESOURCES DURING KERNEL CONVOLUTION
Applicant_Address: #100 Feet Ring Road, Banashankari Stage III, Dwaraka Nagar, Banashankari, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560085
Inventor_Name: Madhusudana A V
Abstract: The present disclosure teaches a system and method to optimize computational resources during kernel convolution. Memory access times of memory elements accessed are tracked during read or write operations in kernel convolution. Further, based on the tracked memory access times, the memory access time for a kernel iteration is determined. An updated average memory access time is retrieved from a shared-memory performance counter. The updated average memory access time accounts for historical data and previous kernel iteration averages. Furthermore, by comparing the memory access time for the current iteration with the updated average, an execution efficiency of computational resources is evaluated. Based on the evaluated execution efficiency dynamic thread coarsening is applied to optimize resource utilization based on the evaluated efficiency

Abstract: OAT PROTEIN SPONGE FILTER FOR FEEDING BOTTLES AND METHOD OF PREPARATION THEREOF ABSTRACT The present disclosure discloses a method for preparing an Oat Protein Sponge (OPS) filter for feeding bottles to remove microplastics. The method involves isolating proteins from oats using cell disruption with alkali. The oats are cultivated through tissue culture and/or hydroponics. The isolated protein is then made soluble through incubation and breakdown, followed by neutralization with a strong acid such as Hydrochloric or Sulfuric acid. Abstract: ABSTRACT A WATER DISPENSING SYSTEM The present disclosure relates to a water dispensing system (100) configured to selectively deliver hot, cold, and warm water through an energy-efficient thermoelectric arrangement. The system comprises separate tanks including a cold-water tank (102), a hot water tank (104), and a warm water tank (106), each provided with a dispensing unit (114) having a solenoid valve (116). At least one thermoelectric cooling module (108) is thermally coupled between the cold-water tank (102) and the hot water tank (104) to enable concurrent cooling and heating. Temperature sensors (110) provide real-time feedback to a control module (112) which regulates operation of the thermoelectric cooling module (108) in pulsed mode to minimise energy consumption while maintaining stability. A ultrasonic proximity sensor (118) detects placement of a receiving container and automatically actuates the solenoid valves (116) for contactless and hygienic dispensing.

Abstract: ABSTRACT AN AUTONOMOUS (UAV) SYSTEM FOR ENHANCED HUMAN TARGET DETECTION AND ACQUISITION AND METHOD THEREOF An autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for human target detection and acquisition. The UAV platform is equipped with an infrared (IR) night vision camera and a Raspberry Pi-based processing module, enabling autonomous navigation, target tracking, and real-time video streaming. The system leverages deep learning for human detection through a YoLo CNN model and utilizes pose estimation and target tracking algorithms like MediaPipe and DeepSORT. Abstract: ABSTRACT SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR RECOVERING WASTE HEAT ENERGY FROM AN INTERNAL COMBUSTION ENGINE The present disclosure relates to a thermoelectric waste heat recovery system (100) for an internal combustion engine (200). The system (100) comprises an exhaust component (102) for receiving combustion-generated exhaust gases, and a thermoelectric generator (TEG) module (104) thermally coupled via a thermal interface material (106). The TEG module (104) includes a plurality of thermoelectric elements arranged between hot and cold sides to generate electrical energy using the Seebeck effect. A hot-side heat exchanger (108) transfers heat from the exhaust gases to the TEG module (104), while a cold-side heat exchanger (110) extracts heat from the cold side to maintain a thermal gradient. A maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller (112) optimizes electrical output, which is then amplified by a voltage boosting circuit (114) and stored in an energy storage device (116). A multimeter (118) measures voltage, current, and power, and a digital display (120) presents these parameters in real time.

Abstract: ABSTRACT SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR GENERATING ELECTRICAL POWER FROM VEHICULAR MOTION OVER A SPEED BREAKER The present disclosure relates to a system (100) for generating electrical power from vehicular motion over a speed breaker. The system (100) comprises a speed breaker structure (101) positioned on a roadway to receive force from passing vehicles. This force actuates a rack and pinion assembly (102), converting vertical displacement into rotational motion. The rack (102A) moves linearly, rotating a pinion gear (102B), which drives a gear train (103) to regulate torque and speed. A one-way bearing mechanism (104) ensures the unidirectional rotation of a generator shaft (105) irrespective of the speed breaker's motion. Motion is transmitted through a sprocket and chain assembly (106) to a flywheel (107), storing rotational energy for smooth power transmission. A rotary shaft (108) transfers this motion to an electrical generator (109), which converts mechanical energy into electrical power. A power conditioning unit (110) regulates the output, while a spring mechanism (111) resets the speed breaker for continuous operation.

Abstract: Micro Ring Resonator (MRR) based Photonic Configurable Logic Block (PCLB) and Method thereof A Micro Ring Resonator (MRR) based Photonic Configurable Logic Block (PCLB) (100) and method thereof is disclosed. The block (100) includes optical look up table (LUT) (102), an optical D-flip flop (104), and an optical 2X1 multipliers (106). The optical LUT (102) includes at least two 4X1 multiplexers and 2X1 multipliers with plurality of waveguides (I0-I7), one or more input lines (S0, S1, and S2), and one output waveguide (Y). The plurality of waveguides (I0-I7) are configured as input lines (A-C). The optical D-flip flop is configured with a clock signal (CLOCK). The clock signal modulates a light for allowing a data input wavelength to pass through and be stored in the MRR or a delay line. The optical 2X1 multipliers is configured as an output of the MRR based PCLB. A light representing binary values of A, B, and C is injected into the optical LUT.

Abstract: ABSTRACT A ROBOTIC DOG SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DETECTING HAZARDOUS TOXINS IN MINING AND INDUSTRIAL ENVIRONMENTS The present disclosure envisages a robotic dog system (100) and a method (300) for detecting hazardous toxins in mining and industrial environments using the robotic dog system (100). The driving unit (102) includes a 6-wheel drive mechanism for navigation over mining environments. The detection unit (104) detects chemical substances present in the environment in the entire concerned region of mining environments. The event output unit (106) analyzes the presence of chemical substance data and determines the occurrence of hazardous events for outputting hazardous event-related information. Abstract: ABSTRACT DFT STUDIES, DOCKING AND PHARMACOKINETIC EVALUATIONS OF NOVEL 6-FLUORO-4-HYDROXY-2-METHYLQUINOLINE The present invention relates to 6-fluoro, 4-hydroxy, 2-methyl quinoline (6-FHMQ] molecule. The molecule exhibits efficient energy transfer as indicated by the energy seperation between its HUMO and LUMO levels. Further analysis involve studying Mulliken charges and thermodynamic parameters together with natural bond orbitals and nonlinear optical characteristics.
